            (μ_ℂ₁ j ζ - (X_ℂ₁ j ζ + (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₁ j ζ) / 2)) -
              (μ_ℂ₂ j ζ - (X_ℂ₂ j ζ + (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ) / 2))) z‖ ≤
          R_mesh * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂)

noncomputable def periodicFourierCoeff (f : ℝ → ℂ) (k : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * f x

noncomputable def fourierSeriesℂ (c : ℤ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' k : ℤ, c k * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * z)

noncomputable def fourierSeriesℝ (c : ℤ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (fourierSeriesℂ c (x : ℂ)).re

noncomputable def uTable {Ω : Set Plane} (R : RationalCollarData Ω) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (deriv R.ϕ x)

noncomputable def uTableCoeff {Ω : Set Plane} (R : RationalCollarData Ω) (k : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  periodicFourierCoeff (fun x => (uTable R x : ℂ)) k

noncomputable def uTableBound {Ω : Set Plane} (R : RationalCollarData Ω) : ℝ :=
  8 * Real.exp 1 * (1 + ∑' k : ℤ, (1 + |(k : ℝ)|) ^ 53 * ‖uTableCoeff R k‖)

noncomputable def uTruncCoeff {Ω : Set Plane} (R : RationalCollarData Ω) (P : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  if |k| ≤ (P : ℤ) then uTableCoeff R k else 0

structure WienerHighModeAt {Ω : Set Plane} (R : RationalCollarData Ω)
    (H_sys : HighFreqActionSystem (uTable R)) (N : ℕ) where
  N_pos : 1 ≤ N
  C_quad : ℝ
  C_lip : ℝ
  C_quad_ge_one : 1 ≤ C_quad
  C_lip_pos : 0 < C_lip
  solve_high : ∀ (σ ε : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (y : ℤ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    0 ≤ ε →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (3 * uTableBound R / 4) w →
    IsBoundedStripExt 17 σ (3 * uTableBound R / 4) w W →
    (∀ n : ℤ, (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| → y (-n) = starRingEnd ℂ (y n)) →
    Summable (fun n : ℤ => if (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| then ‖y n‖ * Real.exp (σ * |(n : ℝ)|) else 0) →
    (∑' n : ℤ, if (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| then ‖y n‖ * Real.exp (σ * |(n : ℝ)|) else 0) ≤ ε →
    ∃ c : ℤ → ℂ,
      (∀ k : ℤ, c (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (c k)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℤ, |k| < (N : ℤ) → c k = 0) ∧
      Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖c k‖ * Real.exp (σ * |(k : ℝ)|)) ∧
      (∑' k : ℤ, ‖c k‖ * Real.exp (σ * |(k : ℝ)|)) ≤ 2 * ε ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| →
        ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * H_sys.b_mult n w x *
              (fourierSeriesℝ c x : ℂ)) = -y n)
  taylor_rem_wiener : ∀ (σ' D_η B_c : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W H : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℤ → ℂ),
    σ' ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    0 ≤ D_η →
    D_η ≤ uTableBound R / 4 →
    0 ≤ B_c →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (uTableBound R / 2) w →
    IsBoundedStripExt 17 σ' (uTableBound R / 2) w W →
    (∀ k : ℤ, c (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (c k)) →
    Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖c k‖ * Real.exp (σ' * |(k : ℝ)|)) →
    (∑' k : ℤ, ‖c k‖ * Real.exp (σ' * |(k : ℝ)|)) ≤ B_c →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 D_η (fourierSeriesℝ c) →
    IsBoundedStripExt 17 σ' D_η (fourierSeriesℝ c) H →
    let rem : ℤ → ℂ := fun n : ℤ =>
      H_sys.C_coeff n (fun x => w x + fourierSeriesℝ c x) - H_sys.C_coeff n w -
        ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * H_sys.b_mult n w x *
              (fourierSeriesℝ c x : ℂ)
    Summable (fun n : ℤ => if (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| then ‖rem n‖ * Real.exp (σ' * |(n : ℝ)|) else 0) ∧
    (∑' n : ℤ, if (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| then ‖rem n‖ * Real.exp (σ' * |(n : ℝ)|) else 0) ≤
      C_quad * D_η * B_c
  C_coeff_lip : ∀ (n : ℤ), (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| →
    ∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (D : ℝ),
      0 ≤ D →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (3 * uTableBound R / 4) w₁ →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (3 * uTableBound R / 4) w₂ →
      (∀ x : ℝ, |w₁ x - w₂ x| ≤ D) →
      ‖H_sys.C_coeff n w₁ - H_sys.C_coeff n w₂‖ ≤ C_lip * D
  real_uniqueness : ∀ (c_star : ℤ → ℂ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (uTableBound R / 4) (uTable R) →
    Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖uTableCoeff R k‖) →
    (∀ x : ℝ, fourierSeriesℝ (uTableCoeff R) x = uTable R x) →
    (∀ k : ℤ, c_star (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (c_star k)) →
    Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖c_star k‖) →
    (∀ k : ℤ, |k| < (N : ℤ) → c_star k = uTableCoeff R k) →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (3 * uTableBound R / 4) (fourierSeriesℝ c_star) →
    (∀ n : ℤ, (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| → H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ c_star) = 0) →
    ∀ x : ℝ, fourierSeriesℝ c_star x = uTable R x

def InitialTruncationAt {Ω : Set Plane} (R : RationalCollarData Ω)
    (H_sys : HighFreqActionSystem (uTable R)) (N : ℕ) : Prop :=
  IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (uTableBound R / 4) (uTable R) ∧
  (∀ k : ℤ, uTableCoeff R (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (uTableCoeff R k)) ∧
  Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖uTableCoeff R k‖) ∧
  (∀ x : ℝ, fourierSeriesℝ (uTableCoeff R) x = uTable R x) ∧
  ∃ P₀ : ℕ, N < P₀ ∧ ∀ P : ℕ, P₀ ≤ P →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (uTableBound R / 4) (fourierSeriesℝ (uTruncCoeff R P)) ∧
    IsBoundedStripExt 17 (1 / (P : ℝ)) (uTableBound R / 4)
      (fourierSeriesℝ (uTruncCoeff R P)) (fourierSeriesℂ (uTruncCoeff R P)) ∧
    Summable (fun n : ℤ =>
      if (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| then
        ‖H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ (uTruncCoeff R P))‖ *
          Real.exp ((1 / (P : ℝ)) * |(n : ℝ)|)
      else 0) ∧
    (∑' n : ℤ,
      if (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| then
        ‖H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ (uTruncCoeff R P))‖ *
          Real.exp ((1 / (P : ℝ)) * |(n : ℝ)|)
      else 0) ≤ 1 / (P : ℝ) ^ 34

structure AnalyticLogSpeedData {Ω : Set Plane} (R : RationalCollarData Ω) where
  σ_raw : ℝ
  M_raw : ℝ
  σ_raw_pos : 0 < σ_raw
  M_raw_pos : 0 < M_raw
  u_raw : ℂ → ℂ
  u_raw_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ u_raw (horizStrip σ_raw)
  u_raw_real : ∀ x : ℝ, u_raw x = Real.log (deriv R.ϕ x)
  u_raw_periodic : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_raw, u_raw (z + 2 * Real.pi) = u_raw z
  u_raw_conj : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_raw, u_raw (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (u_raw z)
  u_raw_bound : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_raw, ‖u_raw z‖ ≤ M_raw ∧ ‖deriv u_raw z‖ ≤ M_raw

def meshClosedSquare (c : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { z : ℂ | |(z - c).re| ≤ ρ / 2 ∧ |(z - c).im| ≤ ρ / 2 }

def meshPolyTrace : List ℂ → Set ℂ
  | [] => ∅
  | [a] => {a}
  | a :: b :: rest => segment ℝ a b ∪ meshPolyTrace (b :: rest)

noncomputable def meshPolyLength : List ℂ → ℝ
  | [] => 0
  | [_] => 0
  | a :: b :: rest => ‖b - a‖ + meshPolyLength (b :: rest)

def meshGridAdj4 {W H : ℕ} (p q : Fin W × Fin H) : Prop :=
  |(p.1.val : ℤ) - (q.1.val : ℤ)| + |(p.2.val : ℤ) - (q.2.val : ℤ)| = 1

def meshGridAdj8 {W H : ℕ} (p q : Fin W × Fin H) : Prop :=
  max |(p.1.val : ℤ) - (q.1.val : ℤ)| |(p.2.val : ℤ) - (q.2.val : ℤ)| ≤ 1

def BadTileShadowBoundProp : Prop :=
  ∀ a b K : ℝ, 1 ≤ a → a ≤ b → 0 < K →
    ∃ M_lat C_shad : ℝ, K + 1 < M_lat ∧ 0 < C_shad ∧
      ∀ (p d τ M_top U₀ H_def : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ) (U_open : Set ℂ)
        (N : ℕ) (x_T d_T ρ_T : Fin N → ℝ),
        0 < d → 0 < τ → τ < d / 4 → 0 ≤ U₀ → 0 < H_def →
        (∀ i : Fin N, 0 < ρ_T i ∧ a * ρ_T i ≤ d_T i ∧ d_T i ≤ b * ρ_T i ∧
          d_T i ≤ d / 2 ∧ |x_T i - p| ≤ K * d ∧ τ < d_T i / 4) →
        IsOpen U_open →
        { z : ℂ | |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * d ∧ τ ≤ -z.im ∧ -z.im ≤ 2 * d } ⊆ U_open →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F U_open →
        (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * d → τ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * d →
          ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top) →
        Real.exp (M_top - U₀) ≤ ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (d : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ →
        (∀ i : Fin N, ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall ((x_T i : ℂ) - (d_T i : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ρ_T i / 8),
          ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top - H_def)) →
        MeasureTheory.volume.real
          (⋃ i : Fin N, Set.Icc (x_T i - ρ_T i / 2) (x_T i + ρ_T i / 2)) ≤
          C_shad * d * (U₀ / H_def)

def GoodChainRoutingProp : Prop :=
  ∃ C_route C_len : ℝ, 0 < C_route ∧ 0 < C_len ∧
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (c : Fin (m + 1) → ℂ) (ρ : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
      (F : ℂ → ℂ) (M T : ℝ),
      0 < T →
      (∀ k : Fin (m + 1), 0 < ρ k) →
      (∀ k : Fin m,
        (meshClosedSquare (c k.castSucc) (ρ k.castSucc) ∩
          meshClosedSquare (c k.succ) (ρ k.succ)).Nonempty ∧
        ρ k.castSucc / 2 ≤ ρ k.succ ∧ ρ k.succ ≤ 2 * ρ k.castSucc) →
      (∀ k : Fin (m + 1),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball (c k) (100 * ρ k)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (c k) (100 * ρ k), ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M) ∧
        (∃ q ∈ meshClosedSquare (c k) (ρ k), Real.exp (M - 2 * T) ≤ ‖F q‖)) →
      ∃ (γ : List ℂ) (hγ : γ ≠ []),
        γ.head hγ ∈ meshClosedSquare (c 0) (ρ 0) ∧
        γ.getLast hγ ∈ meshClosedSquare (c (Fin.last m)) (ρ (Fin.last m)) ∧
        meshPolyTrace γ ⊆ (⋃ k : Fin (m + 1), meshClosedSquare (c k) (9 * ρ k)) ∧
        meshPolyLength γ ≤ C_len * (∑ k : Fin (m + 1), ρ k) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ meshPolyTrace γ, Real.exp (M - C_route * T) ≤ ‖F z‖

def GridFourEightDualityProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (W H : ℕ), 1 ≤ W → 1 ≤ H → ∀ (good : Fin W × Fin H → Bool),
    (∃ (L : List (Fin W × Fin H)) (hL : L ≠ []),
      (∀ p ∈ L, good p = true) ∧
      List.IsChain meshGridAdj4 L ∧
      (L.head hL).1.val = 0 ∧
      (L.getLast hL).1.val = W - 1) ∨
    (∃ (B : List (Fin W × Fin H)) (hB : B ≠ []),
      (∀ p ∈ B, good p = false) ∧
      List.IsChain meshGridAdj8 B ∧
      (B.head hB).2.val = 0 ∧
      (B.getLast hB).2.val = H - 1)

structure HighModulusPolygonalMesh (F : ℂ → ℂ) (lam : ℝ) : Prop where
  exists_mesh :
    ∃ (u A B η : ℕ → ℝ) (γ σ_left σ_right : ℕ → List ℂ)
      (hγ : ∀ j : ℕ, γ j ≠ [])
      (hσL : ∀ j : ℕ, σ_left j ≠ [])
      (hσR : ∀ j : ℕ, σ_right j ≠ []),
      (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ u j ∧ u j + 1 ≤ u (j + 1)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 0 < A j ∧ A j < B j ∧ B (j + 1) < A j) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto B Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 0 < η j) ∧
      Antitone η ∧
      Filter.Tendsto η Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ,
        (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace (γ j),
          -4 ≤ w.re ∧ w.re ≤ 4 ∧ A j < -w.im ∧ -w.im < B j) ∧
        ((γ j).head (hγ j)).re ≤ -2.5 ∧
        2.5 ≤ ((γ j).getLast (hγ j)).re ∧
        (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace (σ_left j),
          -2.4 < w.re ∧ w.re < -1.1 ∧ 0 < -w.im) ∧
        B j ≤ -((σ_left j).head (hσL j)).im ∧
        -((σ_left j).getLast (hσL j)).im ≤ A (j + 2) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace (σ_right j),
          1.1 < w.re ∧ w.re < 2.4 ∧ 0 < -w.im) ∧
        B j ≤ -((σ_right j).head (hσR j)).im ∧
        -((σ_right j).getLast (hσR j)).im ≤ A (j + 2) ∧
        meshPolyLength (γ j) ≤ Real.exp (η j * u j) ∧
        meshPolyLength (σ_left j) ≤ Real.exp (η j * u j) ∧
        meshPolyLength (σ_right j) ≤ Real.exp (η j * u j) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace (γ j) ∪ meshPolyTrace (σ_left j) ∪ meshPolyTrace (σ_right j),
          Real.exp ((lam - η j) * u j) ≤ ‖F w‖ ∧
          ‖F w‖ ≤ Real.exp ((lam + η j) * u j)))

structure LogDeficitTransferPackage (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  sqrt_q_first_moment :
    ∃ C_q : ℝ, 0 < C_q ∧
      ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        Real.exp (-k) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) ≤
          C_q * (1 + k)
  disk_chain_q_bound :
    ∀ (K : Set ℂ) (A : ℝ),
      IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → K ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane → 1 ≤ A →
      ∃ C_margin C_chain : ℝ, 0 < C_margin ∧ 0 < C_chain ∧
        ∀ (κ k_a k_n y₀ U D₀ : ℝ),
          criticalDepthThreshold S + C_margin ≤ min κ (min k_a k_n) →
          0 ≤ U → 0 ≤ D₀ →
          (∀ z : ℂ,
            Real.exp (-(max κ (max k_a k_n) + C_margin)) ≤ wallDepth S z →
            wallDepth S z ≤ Real.exp (-(min κ (min k_a k_n) - C_margin)) →
            ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp U) →
          Real.exp (U - D₀) ≤
            ‖S.f ((y₀ : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-κ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ →
          ∀ x : ℝ, |x - y₀| ≤ A * Real.exp (-k_a) →
            ∀ Z ∈ K,
              Real.exp (-k_n) *
                Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                  (Real.exp (-k_n) : ℂ) * Z)‖ ≤
                C_chain * (1 + D₀) *
                  Real.exp (C_chain * (1 + |κ - k_a| + |k_n - k_a|))
  poisson_q_bound :
    ∀ K : Set ℂ, IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → K ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane →
      ∃ C_margin C_har : ℝ, 0 < C_margin ∧ 0 < C_har ∧
        ∀ (k_a k_n K_top D_a : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
          criticalDepthThreshold S + C_margin ≤ k_a →
          k_a + C_margin ≤ k_n →

          (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w y) →
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y) = 1 →
          (∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ S.H - Real.exp (-(k_n + C_margin)) →
            ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K_top) →
          (∀ y : ℝ, 0 < w y →

              Real.exp (-k_n) *
                Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                  (Real.exp (-k_n) : ℂ) * Z)‖) '' K) *
              ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_a)) w x) ≤
            C_har * (1 + D_a + Real.exp (-k_a) * (1 + K_top))

noncomputable def bootRowPt (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I

noncomputable def bootConeCost (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (δ_b L β₁ : ℝ) (N : ℝ → ℝ) (k x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 + sSup { v : ℝ | ∃ s : ℂ,
    Real.exp (-k) / 20 ≤ wallDepth S s ∧
    wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b ∧
    |s.re - x| ≤ L * wallDepth S s ∧
    v = (wallDepth S s * shapeModulus S s) /
      (N k * (wallDepth S s / Real.exp (-k)) ^ β₁) }

def BootRealWallTransferProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∀ α δ_b : ℝ, 1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    ∃ L δ_star : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < δ_star ∧ δ_star < δ_b ∧
      ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K → ∃ ε₀ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 < d₀ ∧
        ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → d < min d₀ (δ_star / 4) →
          0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
          (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
            |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
            r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
          ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < S.r_star → |t| ≤ r / 2 →
            S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ) ≤ 2 * d

noncomputable def bootStripPoissonTerm (h' u y : ℝ) (n : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * h')⁻¹ * Real.sin (Real.pi * (h' - y) / h') /
    (Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u + 2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)) / h') -
      Real.cos (Real.pi * (h' - y) / h'))

noncomputable def bootStripPoissonKernel (h' u y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' n : ℤ, bootStripPoissonTerm h' u y n

        PowerSeries.constantCoeff (S r) = 1 ∧
        (S r) ^ 2 = 1 + PowerSeries.C (c r) * PowerSeries.X) →
      ∑ r : Fin M, S r = PowerSeries.C (M : ℂ) →
      ∀ r : Fin M, c r = 0

def webTrapezoid (a₀ R δ_star C₀ : ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  { q : ℝ × ℝ | 0 < q.2 ∧ q.2 < δ_star ∧ |q.1 - a₀| < R - C₀ * q.2 }

def webBaseClosure (a₀ R δ_star : ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  { q : ℝ × ℝ | 0 ≤ q.2 ∧ q.2 < δ_star ∧ |q.1 - a₀| ≤ R }

def FiniteWebContinuationProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m →
  ∀ (a₀ R δ_star C₀ : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < δ_star → 0 < C₀ → C₀ * δ_star < R / 2 →
  ∀ (U₀ U_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), IsOpen U₀ → IsOpen U_plus →
    (∀ q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ U₀) →
    (∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ U_plus) →
  ∀ (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (B : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    (∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ i) U₀) →
    (∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (w i) U_plus) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ B U_plus →
    (∀ i : Fin m, ∀ q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star,
      (ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0 ∧
      |(ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re - q.1| ≤ C₀ * q.2 ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ (deriv (fun z : ℂ => ψ i (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)).re) →
    (∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀,
      (∀ i : Fin m, w i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ≠ 0) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i : Fin m =>
        deriv (fun z : ℂ => ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), z)) (q.2 : ℂ) /
          deriv (fun z : ℂ => ψ i (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ))) →
  ∀ (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ), 0 < δ₁ → δ₁ < δ_star → |a₁ - a₀| < R - C₀ * δ_star →
  ∀ (f : Fin m → PowerSeries ℂ),
    (∑ i : Fin m,
      taylor2D (w i) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
        compPowerSeries2D (f i) (centeredTaylor2D (ψ i) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) =
      taylor2D B ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) →
    ∃ (W_ψ : Set ℂ) (V_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (g : Fin m → ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W_ψ ∧ IsPreconnected W_ψ ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, |x - a₀| < R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_ψ) ∧
      IsOpen V_plus ∧ IsPreconnected V_plus ∧ V_plus ⊆ U₀ ∧ V_plus ⊆ U_plus ∧
      (∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_plus) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i) W_ψ) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m,
        ψ i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ W_ψ ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ,
          iteratedDeriv n (g i) (ψ i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) / (n.factorial : ℂ) =
            PowerSeries.coeff n (f i)) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ V_plus,
        (∀ i : Fin m, ψ i p ∈ W_ψ) ∧
        ∑ i : Fin m, w i p * g i (ψ i p) = B p)

def LineEndpointDetProp {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (s_det r_det : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j < k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∃ (M D : ℕ) (_hD : 1 ≤ D)
      (Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M) ℂ)
      (Disc : MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M) ℂ),
      (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det → ‖t‖ < r_det / (k : ℝ) →
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval
            (lineJetEnv M
              (fun c q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 c)
              (fun c q => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
              (y, t))
            (Q d) *
          (glancingDualLine C (y + (j : ℂ) * t) t ι) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ∧
      (∃ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det ∧ ‖t‖ < r_det / (k : ℝ) ∧
        MvPolynomial.eval
          (lineJetEnv M
            (fun c q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 c)
            (fun c q => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
            (y, t))
          (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 ∧
        MvPolynomial.eval
          (lineJetEnv M
            (fun c q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 c)
            (fun c q => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
            (y, t))
          Disc ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (env : LineJetVar M → ℂ) (z : ℂ),
        MvPolynomial.eval env (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 →
        MvPolynomial.eval env Disc ≠ 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d) * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin D,
          (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d.succ) * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0)

def PointEndpointDetProp {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (s_det r_det : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j ≤ k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∃ (M D : ℕ) (_hD : 1 ≤ D)
      (Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ)
      (Disc : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
      (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det → ‖t‖ < r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) →
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval
            (pointJetEnv M
              (fun c q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 c)
              (fun c q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
              C.A (y, t))
            (Q d) *
          (glancingDualLine C (y + ((j : ℂ) - 1 / 2) * t) t ι) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ∧
      (∃ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det ∧ ‖t‖ < r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ∧
        MvPolynomial.eval
          (pointJetEnv M
            (fun c q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 c)
            (fun c q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
            C.A (y, t))
          (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 ∧
        MvPolynomial.eval
          (pointJetEnv M
            (fun c q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 c)
            (fun c q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
            C.A (y, t))
          Disc ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (env : PointJetVar M → ℂ) (z : ℂ),
        MvPolynomial.eval env (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 →
        MvPolynomial.eval env Disc ≠ 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d) * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin D,
          (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d.succ) * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0)

open Classical in
noncomputable def speedPotentialQ {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if K.f s = 0 then deriv (deriv (deriv K.f)) s / deriv K.f s
  else deriv (deriv K.f) s / K.f s

noncomputable def supportProfileH0 {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ)
    (fun z => K.Γ z 0 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ z) + K.Γ z 1 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ z))

noncomputable def firstImpactDisplacementV {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * deriv (deriv (fun t : ℂ => L.𝔰 (y, t))) 0

noncomputable def realCollarChordLen {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) (x t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 0).re * Real.sin ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) +
    (K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 1).re * Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re)

def RealCollarChordProp {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) : Prop :=
  ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < L.r_star →
    (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    (L.p_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (L.𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (L.𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x - t / 2, t)).re + (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re = 2 * (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x + 2 * Real.pi + t / 2, t)).re = (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < realCollarChordLen L x t ∧
    K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 =
      -realCollarChordLen L x t * Real.sin ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 =
      realCollarChordLen L x t * Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    L.p_gl (x + t / 2, t) =
      K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 * Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) +
        K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 * Real.sin ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re)

structure UniversalGlancingCalculus : Prop where
  partial_y_holo : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', p.2)) p.1) W
  partial_t_holo : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun t' : ℂ => U (p.1, t')) p.2) W
  param_integral_holo : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W →
    ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => F q.1 q.2) (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W) →
    (∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F τ) W) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ∫ τ in a..b, F τ p) W
  param_integral_cont : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ))) (F : ℝ → ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ),
    ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ)) => F q.1 q.2) (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W) →
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => ∫ τ in a..b, F τ p) W
  deriv_conj_strip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (f z)) →
    ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, deriv f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv f z)
  sinc_props :
    Differentiable ℂ sinc_ℂ ∧
    sinc_ℂ 0 = 1 ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, sinc_ℂ (-z) = sinc_ℂ z) ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, sinc_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (sinc_ℂ z)) ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, z * sinc_ℂ z = Complex.sin z) ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → ‖sinc_ℂ z - 1‖ ≤ ‖z‖)
  diffOp_props :
    (∀ (σ α : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < σ → 0 ≤ α → IsOpen V_t →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ v { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + α * |p.2.im| < σ } →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingDiffOp v)
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + (α + 1 / 2) * |p.2.im| < σ }) ∧
    (∀ (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y : ℂ),
      glancingDiffOp v (y, 0) = deriv (fun y' : ℂ => v (y', 0)) y) ∧
    (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y t : ℂ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
      t ≠ 0 → |y.im| + |t.im| / 2 < σ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
      glancingDiffOp (fun p => u p.1) (y, t) = t⁻¹ * (u (y + t / 2) - u (y - t / 2))) ∧
    (∀ (σ α : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 ≤ α → IsOpen V_t → (∀ t ∈ V_t, -t ∈ V_t) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ v { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + α * |p.2.im| < σ } →
      (∀ y t : ℂ, t ∈ V_t → |y.im| + α * |t.im| < σ → v (y, -t) = v (y, t)) →
      ∀ y t : ℂ, t ∈ V_t → |y.im| + (α + 1 / 2) * |t.im| < σ →
        glancingDiffOp v (y, -t) = glancingDiffOp v (y, t))
  dslope_quad_bound : ∀ (R M : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < R → 0 ≤ M →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) →
    (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖g ζ‖ ≤ M) →
    ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R,
      ‖g z - g 0 - z * deriv g 0‖ ≤ (4 * M / R ^ 2) * ‖z‖ ^ 2

structure NormActionPackage {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) where
  M_act : ℝ
  M_rem : ℝ
  δ_lin : ℝ
  M_act_pos : 0 < M_act
  M_rem_pos : 0 < M_rem
  δ_lin_pos : 0 < δ_lin
  δ_lin_le_eighth_s₀ : δ_lin ≤ B.s₀ / 8
  δ_lin_le_half : δ_lin ≤ 1 / 2
  normAction1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction12_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction12_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction_diag_periodic : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    normAction1_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction1_ℂ B X Y ∧
    normAction2_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction2_ℂ B X Y ∧
    normAction12_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  normAction_conj : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    normAction1_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B X Y) ∧
    normAction2_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction2_ℂ B X Y) ∧
    normAction12_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction12_ℂ B X Y)
  normAction2_eq_neg_swap : ∀ X Y : ℂ, normAction2_ℂ B X Y = -normAction1_ℂ B Y X
  deriv_normAction1_right : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X Y') Y = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  deriv_normAction2_left : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    deriv (fun X' : ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B X' Y) X = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  normAction_real_stationary_iff : ∀ x₀ x₁ x₂ : ℝ,
    normAction1_ℂ B (x₁ : ℂ) (x₂ : ℂ) + normAction2_ℂ B (x₀ : ℂ) (x₁ : ℂ) = 0 ↔
      -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂) = supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁)
  normAction_bound : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) → Y ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) →
    ‖normAction1_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖normAction2_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖normAction12_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act
  ϕ_deriv_strip_lip :
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4), ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z‖ ≤ M_act) ∧
    (∀ z₁ ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4), ∀ z₂ ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4),
      ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z₁ - deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z₂‖ ≤ M_act * ‖z₁ - z₂‖)
  real_step_bound : ∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ,
    0 < x₁ - x₀ → x₁ - x₀ ≤ δ_lin →
    0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ ∧ B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ < Real.pi
  boundary_lin_close : ∀ X_m X_p W : ℂ,
    X_m ∈ horizStrip B.s₀ →
    ‖X_p - X_m‖ ≤ δ_lin →
    ‖2 * W - deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_m‖ ≤ δ_lin →
    ‖W‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖4 * ((deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_m * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_p / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) *
      r_ℂ B ((B.ϕ_ℂ X_m + B.ϕ_ℂ X_p) / 2) * W) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16
  normActionRem_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
    (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normActionRem_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip B.s₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4))
  normActionRem_bound : ∀ X ∈ horizStrip B.s₀, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4),
    ‖normActionRem_ℂ B X b‖ ≤ M_rem
  normActionRem_conj : ∀ X ∈ horizStrip B.s₀, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4),
    normActionRem_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ b) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normActionRem_ℂ B X b)
  normAction1_taylor4 : ∀ X ∈ horizStrip B.s₀, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4),
    normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b) = b ^ 2 / 8 + b ^ 4 * normActionRem_ℂ B X b

structure GlancingOperatorCore {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (_A : NormActionPackage B) where
  s_act : ℝ
  d_act : ℝ
  η_adm : ℝ
  M_E : ℝ
  s_act_pos : 0 < s_act
  s_act_le_half_s₀ : s_act ≤ B.s₀ / 2
  s_act_le_one : s_act ≤ 1
  d_act_pos : 0 < d_act
  d_act_lt_half_s_act : d_act < s_act / 2
  d_act_lt_one : d_act < 1
  d_act_lt_half_δ_col : d_act < B.δ_col / 2
  d_act_lt_half_τ₀ : d_act < B.τ₀ / 2
  η_adm_pos : 0 < η_adm
  η_adm_le_inv32 : η_adm ≤ 1 / 32
  η_adm_le_quarter_s₀ : η_adm ≤ B.s₀ / 4
  M_E_pos : 0 < M_E
  real_step_collar : ∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ,
    0 < x₁ - x₀ → x₁ - x₀ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * d_act →
    x₁ - x₀ < B.δ_col ∧ 0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ ∧ B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ < Real.pi
  E_op_props : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U) (glancingDomain 1 s d) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d →
      glancingResidualOp B U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingResidualOp B U (y, -t) = glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingResidualOp B U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U (y, t))) ∧
    (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d → (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), glancingResidualOp B U (x, t)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s →
      glancingResidualOp B U (y, 0) =
        (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', 0)) y) ^ 2 *
          deriv (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', 0))) y)
  E_op_cont : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U_seq : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_lim : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    (∀ n : ℕ, IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm (U_seq n)) →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U_lim →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 →
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) =>
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_seq n (y', p.2) - U_lim (y', p.2)) p.1)
        (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (glancingDomain 0 s d)) →
    ∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => glancingResidualOp B (U_seq n) p)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (glancingResidualOp B U_lim p))
  stationarity_equiv : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s → ‖t‖ < d → U (y, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀)) →
    (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, glancingResidualOp B U p = 0) →
    ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| + ‖t‖ < s → ‖t‖ < d →
      -supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t, t))) =
        supportAction2_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y - t, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t)))
  residual_and_linCoeff_ne_zero : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (t : ℂ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → t ≠ 0 → ‖t‖ < d_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => u y' - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
      glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) =
        t⁻¹ ^ 3 * deriv u y *
          (normAction1_ℂ B (u y) (u (y + t)) + normAction2_ℂ B (u (y - t)) (u y))) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| + |t.im| / 2 < σ →
      glancingLinCoeff B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) =
        t⁻¹ * normAction12_ℂ B (u (y - t / 2)) (u (y + t / 2)) *
          deriv u (y - t / 2) * deriv u (y + t / 2))
  enlarged_holo_and_bounds : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → IsOpen V_t → V_t ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U (horizStrip σ ×ˢ V_t) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ V_t,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t) - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| < σ } ∧
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p.2 ∈ V_t → |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| < σ →
      ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ M_E) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 < σ } ∧
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p.2 ∈ V_t → |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 < σ →
      ‖4 * glancingLinCoeff B U p - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4)
  linCoeff_props : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U) (glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d →
      glancingLinCoeff B U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingLinCoeff B U (y, -t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingLinCoeff B U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t)) ∧
      ‖4 * glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4)
  slice_at_zero : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℂ → ℂ) (y : ℂ),
    0 < σ → DifferentiableOn ℂ w (horizStrip σ) → y ∈ horizStrip σ →
    glancingResidualOp B (fun q => w q.1) (y, 0) =
      (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (deriv w y) ^ 2 * deriv (deriv w) y ∧
    (w y ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀) →
      glancingLinCoeff B (fun q => w q.1) (y, 0) = (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (deriv w y) ^ 3)
  param_slice_holo_and_bound : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (V_ζ : Set ℂ) (y t : ℂ) (u_fam : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → IsOpen V_ζ → ‖t‖ < d_act → |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => u_fam q.1 q.2) (horizStrip σ ×ˢ V_ζ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ ζ ∈ V_ζ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => u_fam y' ζ - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun ζ : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u_fam q.1 ζ) (y, t)) V_ζ ∧
    (∀ ζ ∈ V_ζ, ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u_fam q.1 ζ) (y, t)‖ ≤ M_E)

structure GlancingFactorizationData {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (A : NormActionPackage B) (O : GlancingOperatorCore B A) where
  C_quad : ℝ
  C_quad_pos : 0 < C_quad
  formal_perturbation :
    ∀ (s s' d η_prev η_next M_prev M_u : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (U_prev : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (u_j : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s' → s' < s → s ≤ O.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ O.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 ≤ η_prev → η_prev < η_next → η_next ≤ O.η_adm →
      0 < M_prev → 0 < M_u → 1 ≤ j →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_prev U_prev →
      (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s → U_prev (y, 0) = y) →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U_prev p‖ ≤ M_prev * ‖p.2‖ ^ (2 * j)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ u_j (horizStrip s) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, u_j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = u_j y) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, u_j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (u_j y)) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, ‖u_j y‖ ≤ M_u) →
      ∃ (d₁ M_next : ℝ), 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ ≤ d ∧ d₁ < s' / 2 ∧ 0 < M_next ∧
        IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s' d₁ η_next
          (fun p => U_prev p + u_j p.1 * p.2 ^ (2 * j)) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s' d₁,
          ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => U_prev q + u_j q.1 * q.2 ^ (2 * j)) p -
            (glancingResidualOp B U_prev p +
              (1 / 4 : ℂ) * deriv (deriv u_j) p.1 * p.2 ^ (2 * j))‖ ≤
            M_next * ‖p.2‖ ^ (2 * j + 2))
  slice_quad_approx : ∀ (σ ρ : ℝ) (y t : ℂ) (u v : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ O.s_act → ‖t‖ < O.d_act → |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
    0 ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ O.η_adm / 8 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ v (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z' : ℂ => u z' - z') z‖ ≤ O.η_adm) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z' : ℂ => deriv u z' * v z') z‖ ≤ ρ) →
    ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1 + deriv u q.1 * v q.1) (y, t) -
      glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) -
      (glancingDiffOp
        (fun q =>
          glancingLinCoeff B (fun r => u r.1) (q.1, t) *
            glancingDiffOp (fun r => v r.1) (q.1, t))
        (y, t) +
        deriv
          (fun z : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B (fun r => u r.1) (z, t) * v z)
          y)‖ ≤ C_quad * ρ ^ 2
  exact_jet_deriv : ∀ (t₀ σ σ' r_t : ℝ) (U_cand : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < t₀ → 0 < r_t → t₀ + r_t ≤ O.d_act →
    0 < σ' → σ' + r_t ≤ σ → σ ≤ O.s_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U_cand (horizStrip σ ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_cand (y', t) - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * O.η_adm / 4) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, glancingResidualOp B U_cand (z, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0) →
    ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ',
      let u_star : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => U_cand (z, (t₀ : ℂ))
      let z_jet : ℂ → ℂ :=
        fun z => deriv (fun t : ℂ => U_cand (z, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) / deriv u_star z
      deriv (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U_cand (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) =
        glancingDiffOp
          (fun q =>
            glancingLinCoeff B U_cand (q.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) *
              (glancingDiffOp (fun r => z_jet r.1) (q.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹))
          (y, (t₀ : ℂ))

noncomputable def finiteWallWidthFn {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) (t : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (M.h_X t).toReal + (L.b_shift t).im

def coneDomain (H δ_star d x₀ : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    d / 10 < H - p.1.im ∧ H - p.1.im < δ_star ∧
    |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d }

def coneDomainBack (H δ_star d x₀ : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    (p.1 - (3 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ ∧
    (p.1 - (1 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ }

def coneDomainFwd (H δ_star d x₀ : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    (p.1 + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ ∧
    (p.1 + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ }

def MeroEqOnPullback {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
    (Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) : Prop :=
  U ⊆ W₁ ∧ Set.MapsTo Φ U W₂ ∧
  ∀ p ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ F₁.rad p ∧
    Set.MapsTo Φ (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.ball (Φ p) (F₂.rad (Φ p))) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r,
      F₁.num p q * F₂.den (Φ p) (Φ q) = F₂.num (Φ p) (Φ q) * F₁.den p q

structure ShiftedConeDualLines {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) (H δ_star d x₀ : ℝ) where
  L_back : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀)
  L_fwd : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀)
  back_eq_fwd : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroEqOn (L_back i) (L_fwd i)
      (coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ ∩ coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀)
  η₂ : ℝ
  η₂_pos : 0 < η₂
  η₂_le : η₂ ≤ 2 * d
  back_eq_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroEqOnPullback (L_back i) (M.L_mero i)
      (fun p => (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2, p.2))
      (coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ ∩ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < η₂ })

structure RegularCollarLocusData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M) where
  eqOn_of_preconnected_2D : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {r₀ : ℝ},
    IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W →
    p₀ ∈ W → 0 < r₀ → Metric.ball p₀ r₀ ⊆ W →
    (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀, f q = g q) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = g p
  iterDerivYT_holo : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) W ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) W ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 2 0 f) W
  iterDerivYT_comm : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W →
    ∀ p ∈ W, iterDerivYT 0 1 (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) p = iterDerivYT 1 0 (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) p
  T_mero_open : IsOpen (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X)
  T_mero_preconnected : IsPreconnected (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X)
  T_mero_star : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → u ≤ 1 →
    (((p.1.re : ℂ) + ((u * p.1.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I), p.2) ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X
  base_sub_T_mero : { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < M.s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < M.r_base } ⊆
    meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X
  U_reg : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  U_reg_sub : U_reg ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X
  U_reg_open : IsOpen U_reg
  X_true : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  X_true_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_true i) U_reg
  r_origin : ℝ
  r_origin_pos : 0 < r_origin
  ball_origin_sub : Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) r_origin ⊆
    U_reg ∩ { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < K.s_init ∧ ‖p.2‖ < K.r_init }
  X_true_origin_eq : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) r_origin, ∀ i : Fin 2,
    X_true i q = K.Γ (K.𝔰_init q) i
  chart_nonvanishing : ∀ p₀ ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
    ∃ (r₀ : ℝ) (B_chart : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r₀ ∧
      r₀ ≤ min ((M.X_mero 0).rad p₀) ((M.X_mero 1).rad p₀) ∧
      Metric.ball p₀ r₀ ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ B_chart (Metric.ball p₀ r₀) ∧
      (∃ q₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀ / 2), B_chart q₁ ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀, B_chart q ≠ 0 →
        q ∈ U_reg ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, (M.X_mero i).den p₀ q ≠ 0 ∧
          (M.X_mero i).num p₀ q = X_true i q * (M.X_mero i).den p₀ q
  G_6 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  R_ratio : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  G_6_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_6 U_reg
  R_ratio_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ R_ratio U_reg
  G_6_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ U_reg, G_6 p ≠ 0
  compat_eq : ∀ p ∈ U_reg,
    iterDerivYT 0 1 G_6 p - R_ratio p * iterDerivYT 1 0 G_6 p -
      6 * G_6 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 R_ratio p = 0
  init_ode : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) r_origin,
    (iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q) ^ 6 = G_6 q ∧
    iterDerivYT 0 1 K.𝔰_init q = R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q
  ball_chain_reach : ∀ p ∈ U_reg,
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (c : Fin (N + 1) → ℂ × ℂ) (ρ : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ),
      c 0 = ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∧
      ρ 0 = r_origin ∧
      p ∈ Metric.ball (c (Fin.last N)) (ρ (Fin.last N)) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin (N + 1), 0 < ρ k ∧ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k) ⊆ U_reg) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin N,
        (Metric.ball (c k.castSucc) (ρ k.castSucc) ∩
          Metric.ball (c k.succ) (ρ k.succ)).Nonempty)

structure RegularExponentialLiftData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (Reg : RegularCollarLocusData C M K) where
  v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  v_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ v Reg.U_reg
  v_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ Reg.U_reg, v p ≠ 0
  v_origin_eq : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) Reg.r_origin,
    v q = Complex.exp (Complex.I * K.𝔰_init q)
  v_local_lift : ∀ p ∈ Reg.U_reg,
    ∃ (r : ℝ) (𝔰_loc : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r ∧
      Metric.ball p r ⊆ Reg.U_reg ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_loc (Metric.ball p r) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r,
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_loc q) = v q ∧
        𝔰_loc q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
        K.f (𝔰_loc q) ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, Reg.X_true i q = K.Γ (𝔰_loc q) i

structure RawGlobalLiftPackage {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M) where
  𝔰_raw : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  𝔰_raw_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_raw (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X)
  𝔰_raw_maps_to : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, 𝔰_raw p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)
  𝔰_raw_init_eq : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < K.s_init → ‖t‖ < K.r_init →
    𝔰_raw (y, t) = K.𝔰_init (y, t)
  𝔰_raw_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), 𝔰_raw (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_raw_quasiperiodic : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
    𝔰_raw (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) = 𝔰_raw p + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_raw_even : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, 𝔰_raw (p.1, -p.2) = 𝔰_raw p
  𝔰_raw_conj : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
    𝔰_raw (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰_raw p)
  𝔰_raw_comp_X : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, K.f (𝔰_raw p) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball p r ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, K.f (𝔰_raw q) ≠ 0) ∧

noncomputable def sfcaEtaSL : ℝ := 1 / 256

noncomputable def sfcaRhoB : ℝ := 1 / 16

noncomputable def sfcaRhoC : ℝ := 1 / 32

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraIter (y₀ : ℝ → ℂ) (Q : ℝ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ
  | 0, w => y₀ w
  | m + 1, w => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraC (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter (fun _ => 1) Q m w

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraK (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter (fun v => (v : ℂ)) Q m w

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraCDeriv (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraKDeriv (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  1 + ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v

noncomputable def sfcaSlopeA1 (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (z₁ - z₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1) / sfcaVolterraK Q 1

noncomputable def sfcaFieldF (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  z₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q w + sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁ * sfcaVolterraK Q w

noncomputable def sfcaFieldFDeriv (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  z₀ * sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w + sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁ * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w

noncomputable def sfcaPotPlus (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  Q w - (3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w -
    (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2

noncomputable def sfcaPotMinus (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  Q w + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w -
    (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2

noncomputable def sfcaNumN (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let k₀ := sfcaVolterraK Q 1
  let k_p := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) 1
  let k_m := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) 1
  k₀ * (1 - Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (k_p * k_m / k₀ ^ 2)))

noncomputable def sfcaDivH (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (b₀ b₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  dslope (fun z₀ => dslope (fun z₁ => sfcaNumN Q z₀ z₁) 0 b₁) 0 b₀

noncomputable def sfcaUniversalPsi (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  sfcaDivH Q a₀ (a₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1 + a₁ * sfcaVolterraK Q 1)

noncomputable def sfcaStripPot (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s h : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  h ^ 2 * S.q (s + (w : ℂ) * h)

noncomputable def sfcaStripPhi (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  sfcaUniversalPsi (sfcaStripPot S q.1 q.2) (q.2 * S.f q.1) (q.2 ^ 2 * deriv S.f q.1)

structure SfcaVolterraKernelProp : Prop where

        1 + ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v ∧

  zero_pot : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,

  quant_bounds : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (M_Q : ℝ),
    ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) → 0 ≤ M_Q → M_Q ≤ 1 / 2 →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ M_Q) →

      ‖sfcaVolterraK Q w - (w : ℂ)‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M_Q ∧
      ‖sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w‖ ≤ 2 * M_Q ∧
      ‖sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w - 1‖ ≤ 2 * M_Q
  lip_bounds : ∀ (Q₁ Q₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (M_diff : ℝ),
    ContinuousOn Q₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) → ContinuousOn Q₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ ‖Q₂ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →

    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ ≤ M_diff) →
    ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖sfcaVolterraC Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraC Q₂ w‖ ≤ M_diff ∧
      ‖sfcaVolterraK Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraK Q₂ w‖ ≤ M_diff ∧
      ‖sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ 2 * M_diff ∧
      ‖sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ 2 * M_diff
  ode_unique : ∀ (Q g g' : ℝ → ℂ),
    ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
    ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    ContinuousOn g' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt g (g' w) w ∧ HasDerivAt g' (Q w * g w) w) →
    ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      g w = g 0 * sfcaVolterraC Q w + g' 0 * sfcaVolterraK Q w ∧
      g' w = g 0 * sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w + g' 0 * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w
  rev_symm : ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    sfcaVolterraK (fun w => Q (1 - w)) 1 = sfcaVolterraK Q 1
  param_holo : ∀ (Ω : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Q : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ),
    IsOpen Ω →
    ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => Q p.1 p.2) (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Q q w) Ω) →
    ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaVolterraC (Q p.1) p.2) (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaVolterraK (Q p.1) p.2) (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaVolterraCDeriv (Q p.1) p.2) (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaVolterraKDeriv (Q p.1) p.2) (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,

      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraCDeriv (Q q) w) Ω ∧

def StationaryComplexMeshAt {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (s δ η_mesh : ℝ) (l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (X_mesh : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
  (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - δ),
    X_mesh 0 y = U (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∧
    X_mesh q y = U (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_mesh j) (horizStrip (s - δ)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - δ),
      X_mesh j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = X_mesh j y + 2 * Real.pi ∧
      X_mesh j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (X_mesh j y) ∧
      ‖X_mesh j y - U (y + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))‖ ≤ η_mesh)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - δ),
    normAction1_ℂ B (X_mesh (j + 1) y) (X_mesh (j + 2) y) +
      normAction2_ℂ B (X_mesh j y) (X_mesh (j + 1) y) = 0)

def StationaryMeshProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  ∃ (C_mesh : ℝ) (B_mesh : ℕ), 1 ≤ C_mesh ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ε : ℝ) (N l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
      1 ≤ l → 2 ≤ q → q ≤ N → Nat.Coprime l q →
      (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) < d - 2 * δ →
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
      C_mesh * Q ^ B_mesh * ε ≤ 1 →
      ∃ X_mesh : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ,
        StationaryComplexMeshAt B s δ (C_mesh * Q ^ B_mesh * ε) l q U X_mesh

def ExactRationalSliceAt {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (s δ η_slice : ℝ) (l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
  DifferentiableOn ℂ U_star (horizStrip (s - 5 * δ)) ∧
  (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ),
    U_star (y + 2 * Real.pi) = U_star y + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    U_star (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (U_star y)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ),
    ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z : ℂ => U_star z - U (z, (t₀ : ℂ))) y‖ ≤ η_slice) ∧
  (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ),
    glancingResidualOp B (fun p => U_star p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0)

def CollarExactSliceProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  ∃ (C_slice : ℝ) (B_slice : ℕ), 1 ≤ C_slice ∧
    ∀ (s d δ η_mesh : ℝ) (N l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (X_mesh : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < η_mesh → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      1 ≤ l → 2 ≤ q → q ≤ N → Nat.Coprime l q →
      (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) < d - 2 * δ →
      StationaryComplexMeshAt B s δ η_mesh l q U X_mesh →
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹

def CyclicJetAndDiffOpProp : Prop :=
  ((∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (V : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),

        (horizStrip σ' ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t) ∧

    0 < σ' → 0 < r_t → σ' + r_t ≤ σ →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t_c : ℂ) r_t, V₂ (y, t) = V₁ (y, -t)) →
    ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ', ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t_c : ℂ) r_t,
      glancingDiffOp V₂ (y, t) = glancingDiffOp V₁ (y, -t)) ∧
  (∀ (σ t₀ M_dot : ℝ) (l q : ℕ) (a_star E_dot g_init : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → 0 < t₀ → 0 ≤ M_dot → 1 ≤ l → 1 ≤ q →
    (q : ℝ) * t₀ = 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ) →
    (∀ (f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ (horizStrip σ) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ (horizStrip σ) →
      ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ,
        glancingDiffOp (fun p => f₁ p.1 + f₂ p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) =
          glancingDiffOp (fun p => f₁ p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) +
            glancingDiffOp (fun p => f₂ p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ))) ∧
    (DifferentiableOn ℂ a_star (horizStrip σ) →
     DifferentiableOn ℂ E_dot (horizStrip σ) →
     DifferentiableOn ℂ g_init (horizStrip σ) →
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, a_star (y + 2 * Real.pi) = a_star y ∧ ‖4 * a_star y - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) →
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, E_dot (y + 2 * Real.pi) = E_dot y ∧ ‖E_dot y‖ ≤ M_dot) →
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, g_init (y + 2 * Real.pi) = g_init y) →
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, E_dot y = glancingDiffOp (fun p => g_init p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ))) →

       (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ‖z y‖ ≤ 24 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 * M_dot) ∧

         glancingDiffOp
           (fun p => a_star p.1 * glancingDiffOp (fun r => z r.1) (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ)))

def PositiveRationalJetAt {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)

   DifferentiableOn ℂ g_jet
     (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
   (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
     g_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = g_jet (y, t) ∧
     ‖g_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ M_lin ∧
     ‖glancingDiffOp W_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ M_lin) ∧
   DifferentiableOn ℂ
     (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U p + glancingDiffOp g_jet p)
     (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
   DifferentiableOn ℂ
     (fun y : ℂ =>
       deriv
         (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, t))
         (t₀ : ℂ))
     (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ)) ∧
   (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 10 * δ),
     ‖glancingResidualOp B U (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, (t₀ : ℂ))‖ ≤ M_quad ∧
     ‖deriv
         (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, t))
         (t₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ M_quad))

def PositiveJetLiftProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  CyclicJetAndDiffOpProp →
  ∃ (C_lift : ℝ) (B_lift : ℕ), 1 ≤ C_lift ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ε η_slice : ℝ) (N l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 0 ≤ η_slice → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
      1 ≤ l → 2 ≤ q → q ≤ N → Nat.Coprime l q →
      let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
      t₀ < d - 2 * δ →
      ExactRationalSliceAt B s δ η_slice l q U U_star →
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
      let η_tot := ε + η_slice
      C_lift * Q ^ B_lift * η_tot ≤ 1 →
      ∃ W_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
        PositiveRationalJetAt B s δ
          (C_lift * Q ^ B_lift * η_tot)
          (C_lift * Q ^ B_lift * η_tot ^ 2)
          t₀ U W_plus

def IsRealJetPerturb (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (e : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Function.Periodic e (2 * Real.pi) ∧
  ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) e ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k e x| ≤ B

def IsStripJetPerturb (p : ℕ) (σ' α B : ℝ) (e : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ e (horizStrip σ') ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', e (z + 2 * Real.pi) = e z) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', e (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (e z)) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖deriv e z‖ ≤ α) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv k e z‖ ≤ B)
