    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => realMeshDisp q w₁ j y - realMeshDisp q w₂ j y) x| ≤
        R_real * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ =>
          (realMeshDisp q w₁ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₁ j y) -
            (realMeshDisp q w₂ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₂ j y)) x| ≤
        R_real * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => realMidpointDisp q w₁ j y - realMidpointDisp q w₂ j y) x| ≤
        R_real * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂)

structure StripMeshSystemPart (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  R_strip : ℝ
  K_strip : ℝ
  N_strip : ℕ
  R_strip_pos : 0 < R_strip
  K_strip_pos : 0 < K_strip
  N_strip_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_strip
  strip_mesh_ext : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_strip ≤ q →
    K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w W →
    ∃ (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        X_ℂ 0 z = z ∧ X_ℂ q z = z + ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ j x = realMesh q w x j) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          X_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = X_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          X_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (X_ℂ j z)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          X_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => X_ℂ j ζ - (ζ + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
            R_strip)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ j x = midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          μ_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = μ_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          μ_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (μ_ℂ j z)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          μ_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) - ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤
            R_strip) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => μ_ℂ j ζ - (X_ℂ j ζ + (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) / 2)) z‖ ≤
            R_strip))
  strip_mesh_lip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_strip ≤ q →
    K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ₁ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ₂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ₁ j x = realMesh q w₁ x j) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ₂ j x = realMesh q w₂ x j)) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ₁ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ₂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ₁ j x = midpoint_ℝ w₁ (realMesh q w₁ x j) (realMesh q w₁ x (j + 1))) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ₂ j x = midpoint_ℝ w₂ (realMesh q w₂ x j) (realMesh q w₂ x (j + 1)))) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => X_ℂ₁ j ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ) z‖ ≤
          R_strip * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ =>
            (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₁ j ζ) - (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ)) z‖ ≤
          R_strip * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ =>
            (μ_ℂ₁ j ζ - (X_ℂ₁ j ζ + (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₁ j ζ) / 2)) -
              (μ_ℂ₂ j ζ - (X_ℂ₂ j ζ + (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ) / 2))) z‖ ≤
          R_strip * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂)

def IsSliceClearedOnCollar {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W)
    (U_w : Set ℂ) (w₁ : ℂ) (r ε_r : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let U_col := U_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | r - ε_r < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < r + ε_r }
  U_col ⊆ W ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ G U_col ∧
  ∀ p ∈ U_col, ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η ≤ F.rad p ∧ Metric.ball p η ⊆ U_col ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p η,
      G q * F.den p q = (q.1 - w₁) ^ m * F.num p q

noncomputable def laurentMoment (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r), G (w, ζ) * ζ ^ n

noncomputable def hankelSubmatrix (L : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (d : ℕ) (I : Fin d → ℕ) (w : ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ :=
  fun a b => L (I a + (b : ℕ)) w

def Mero2DSheafGluingToolkit : Prop :=
  (∀ (w_a w_b : ℂ) (δ_a δ_b ρ R : ℝ) (W_F : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
     (F : MeroOn2D W_F)
     (G_a : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w_a δ_a ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R)),
     0 < δ_b → 0 < ρ → ρ < R →
     Metric.ball w_b δ_b ⊆ Metric.ball w_a δ_a →
     MeroEqOn G_a F (Metric.ball w_a δ_a ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }) →
     ∃ G_b : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w_b δ_b ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R),
       MeroEqOn G_b F (Metric.ball w_b δ_b ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })) ∧
  (∀ (r_w ρ R r ε_r δ₀ δ₂ : ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : ℂ) (m : ℕ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
     (F : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }))
     (G₂ : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w₂ δ₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R)),
     0 < δ₂ → 0 < ε_r → ρ < r - ε_r → r + ε_r < R →
     Metric.ball w₂ δ₂ ⊆ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ →
     IsSliceClearedOnCollar F (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀) w₁ r ε_r m G →
     MeroEqOn G₂ F (Metric.ball w₂ δ₂ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }) →
     IsSliceClearedOnCollar G₂ (Metric.ball w₂ δ₂) w₁ r ε_r m G) ∧
  (∀ (r_w ρ R r ε_r δ₀ : ℝ) (w₁ : ℂ) (m : ℕ) (G N_tilde Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
     (F : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })),
     0 < r_w → 0 < ρ → 0 < δ₀ → 0 < ε_r → ρ < r - ε_r → r + ε_r < R →
     Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w →
     IsSliceClearedOnCollar F (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀) w₁ r ε_r m G →
     DifferentiableOn ℂ N_tilde (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) →
     DifferentiableOn ℂ Q (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) →
     (∃ w_nz ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀, w_nz ≠ w₁ ∧
       ∃ z_nz ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r, Q (w_nz, z_nz) ≠ 0) →
     (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ { z : ℂ | r - ε_r / 2 < ‖z‖ ∧ ‖z‖ < r },
       N_tilde p = Q p * G p) →
     ∃ G_loc : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R),
       MeroEqOn G_loc F (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })) ∧
  (∀ (r_w ρ R : ℝ)
     (F : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })),
     0 < r_w → 0 < ρ → ρ < R →
     (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w, ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
       Metric.ball w δ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ∧
       ∃ G : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w δ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R),
         MeroEqOn G F (Metric.ball w δ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })) →
     ∃ F_ext : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R),
       MeroEqOn F_ext F (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }))

noncomputable def k0Minus (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Real.pi ^ 2 / 2) * (3 * α ^ 2 - 1)

noncomputable def k0Plus (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Real.pi ^ 2 / 2) * (3 * (1 - α) ^ 2 - 1)

noncomputable def fwdKernelMinus (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cellKernelMinus_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))
    (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α x)

noncomputable def fwdKernelPlus (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cellKernelPlus_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))
    (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α x)

noncomputable def halfCellInvDispMinus (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z - (z - 2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + α / 2) / (q : ℝ))

noncomputable def halfCellInvDispPlus (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z - (z - 2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + (1 + α) / 2) / (q : ℝ))

def NormActionCalculusProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) →
    ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) w →
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => midpoint_ℝ w p.1 p.2) ∧
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cellKernelMinus_ℝ w p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cellKernelPlus_ℝ w p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
    (∀ X Y z : ℝ,
      midpoint_ℝ w (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = midpoint_ℝ w X Y + 2 * Real.pi ∧
      cellKernelMinus_ℝ w (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℝ w (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z) ∧
    (∀ X Y : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun X' : ℝ => normAction_ℝ w X' Y) (normAction1_ℝ w X Y) X ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℝ => normAction_ℝ w X Y') (-normAction1_ℝ w Y X) Y) ∧
    (∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ),
      Function.Periodic v (2 * Real.pi) →
      ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) v →
      ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞)
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => normAction_ℝ (fun z => w z + p.2.2 * v z) p.1 p.2.1) ∧
      (∀ X Y : ℝ, X < Y →
        X < midpoint_ℝ w X Y ∧ midpoint_ℝ w X Y < Y ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => normAction_ℝ (fun z => w z + t * v z) X Y)
          ((∫ z in X..(midpoint_ℝ w X Y), cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z * v z) +
            (∫ z in (midpoint_ℝ w X Y)..Y, cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z * v z))
          0))

structure HalfCellInverseSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1)) where
  C_inv : ℝ
  N_inv : ℕ
  C_inv_pos : 0 < C_inv
  N_inv_ge : S.N_mesh ≤ N_inv
  inv_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ),
    N_inv ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    j < q →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (halfCellInvDispMinus q w j p.1) p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (halfCellInvDispPlus q w j p.1) p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ)) ∧
    (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (halfCellInvDispMinus q w j α) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (halfCellInvDispPlus q w j α) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α (x + 2 * Real.pi) =
        halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α x + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α (x + 2 * Real.pi) =
        halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α x + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      Function.LeftInverse (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      Function.RightInverse (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      Function.LeftInverse (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      Function.RightInverse (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ,
        deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α x) *
          deriv (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) x = 1) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ,
        deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α x) *
          deriv (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) x = 1) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv k (halfCellInvDispMinus q w j α) z| ≤ C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ∧
        |iteratedDeriv k (halfCellInvDispPlus q w j α) z| ≤ C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2))
  inv_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α : ℝ),
    N_inv ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
    j < q →
    α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ =>
          halfCellInvDispMinus q w₁ j α y - halfCellInvDispMinus q w₂ j α y) z| ≤
        (C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ ∧
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ =>
          halfCellInvDispPlus q w₁ j α y - halfCellInvDispPlus q w₂ j α y) z| ≤
        (C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂

structure ForwardKernelSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1)) where
  C_kern : ℝ
  N_kern : ℕ
  C_kern_pos : 0 < C_kern
  N_kern_ge : S.N_mesh ≤ N_kern
  kern_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ),
    N_kern ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    j < q →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (fwdKernelMinus q w j p.1) p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (fwdKernelPlus q w j p.1) p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ)) ∧
    (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fwdKernelMinus q w j α) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fwdKernelPlus q w j α) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => fwdKernelMinus q w j α y - k0Minus α / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) x| ≤
          C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 ∧
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => fwdKernelPlus q w j α y - k0Plus α / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) x| ≤
          C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3))
  kern_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α : ℝ),
    N_kern ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
    j < q →
    α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => fwdKernelMinus q w₁ j α y - fwdKernelMinus q w₂ j α y) x| ≤
        (C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ ∧
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => fwdKernelPlus q w₁ j α y - fwdKernelPlus q w₂ j α y) x| ≤
        (C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂

noncomputable def pairIsoZ (X : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  X 0 q + Complex.I * X 1 q

noncomputable def pairIsoW (X : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  X 0 q - Complex.I * X 1 q

def SatisfiesRankOneAt (X : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : Prop :=
  deriv (fun y' => pairIsoZ X (y', q.2)) q.1 *
    deriv (fun t' => pairIsoW X (q.1, t')) q.2 =
  deriv (fun t' => pairIsoZ X (q.1, t')) q.2 *
    deriv (fun y' => pairIsoW X (y', q.2)) q.1

def SatisfiesIsoReflectAt (X : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : Prop :=
  (pairIsoZ X q - pairIsoZ X (q.1 - q.2, q.2)) *
    (pairIsoZ X (q.1 + q.2, q.2) - pairIsoZ X q) *
    (deriv (fun y' => pairIsoW X (y', q.2)) q.1) ^ 2 =
  (pairIsoW X q - pairIsoW X (q.1 - q.2, q.2)) *
    (pairIsoW X (q.1 + q.2, q.2) - pairIsoW X q) *
    (deriv (fun y' => pairIsoZ X (y', q.2)) q.1) ^ 2

def meroTubeShift (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ | q ∈ W ∧ (q.1 - q.2, q.2) ∈ W ∧ (q.1 + q.2, q.2) ∈ W }

def collarBaseBox {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ | |q.1.im| < M.s_base ∧ ‖q.2‖ < M.r_base }

def collarHalfBaseBox {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ | |q.1.im| < M.s_base / 2 ∧ ‖q.2‖ < M.r_base / 2 }

structure SliceSymmetryWallData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) : Prop where
  real_base : ∀ x : ℝ,
    (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
    (x : ℂ) ∉ M.E_disc ∧
    M.a_mero x = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ x)
  a_periodic_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    s ∉ M.E_disc →
    s + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) →
    s + 2 * Real.pi ∉ M.E_disc →
    M.a_mero (s + 2 * Real.pi) = M.a_mero s
  a_conj_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    s ∉ M.E_disc →
    starRingEnd ℂ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) →
    starRingEnd ℂ s ∉ M.E_disc →
    M.a_mero (starRingEnd ℂ s) * starRingEnd ℂ (M.a_mero s) = 1
  order_ne_top : ∀ q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    meromorphicOrderAt M.a_mero q ≠ ⊤
  center_im_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    ∀ (n : ℤ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
      n ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ u p → u p ≠ 0 →
      (∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin p {p}ᶜ, M.a_mero z = (z - p) ^ n * u z) →
      p.im ≠ 0
  wall_top_and_global_odd : ∀ p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    p.im ≠ 0 →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < ε →
        (∀ i : Fin 2, M.Γ_slice (p - z) i = M.Γ_slice (p + z) i) ∧
        M.a_mero (p - z) = -M.a_mero (p + z)) →
      M.h_X 0 = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ s : ℂ, s ∉ M.E_disc → 2 * p - s ∉ M.E_disc → M.a_mero (2 * p - s) = -M.a_mero s

structure RawCenterFractionData (Γ_0 : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ) where
  δ : ℝ
  δ_pos : 0 < δ
  N : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  D : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  N_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (N i) (Metric.ball p δ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ)
  D_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (D i) (Metric.ball p δ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ)
  D_slice_ne_zero : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ y : ℂ, 0 < ‖y - p‖ → ‖y - p‖ < δ → D i (y, 0) ≠ 0
  slice_eq : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ y : ℂ, 0 < ‖y - p‖ → ‖y - p‖ < δ →
    N i (y, 0) = Γ_0 i y * D i (y, 0)
  even_eq : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - p‖ < δ → ‖t‖ < δ →
    N i (y, -t) * D i (y, t) = N i (y, t) * D i (y, -t)
  rank_one_on_reg : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p δ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ,
    (∀ i : Fin 2, D i q ≠ 0) →
    SatisfiesRankOneAt (fun i w => N i w / D i w) q
  iso_reflect_on_reg : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p δ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ,
    (q.1 - q.2, q.2) ∈ Metric.ball p δ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ →
    (q.1 + q.2, q.2) ∈ Metric.ball p δ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ →
    (∀ i : Fin 2, D i q ≠ 0 ∧ D i (q.1 - q.2, q.2) ≠ 0 ∧ D i (q.1 + q.2, q.2) ≠ 0) →
    SatisfiesIsoReflectAt (fun i w => N i w / D i w) q

def IsStripMeshExt (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m M₁)
    (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (_W : ℂ → ℂ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let σ_mesh := (1 - S.K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, X_ℂ 0 z = z ∧ X_ℂ q z = z + ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ j) (horizStrip σ_mesh) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ j x = realMesh q w x j) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, X_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = X_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, X_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (X_ℂ j z)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, X_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ : ℂ => X_ℂ j ζ - (ζ + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
        S.R_mesh)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ j) (horizStrip σ_mesh) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ j x = midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, μ_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = μ_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, μ_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (μ_ℂ j z)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, μ_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ : ℂ =>
            (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) - ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤
        S.R_mesh) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ : ℂ => μ_ℂ j ζ - (X_ℂ j ζ + (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) / 2)) z‖ ≤
        S.R_mesh))

noncomputable def deltaPhi_ℂ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (ζ₁ ζ₂ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (ζ₂ - ζ₁) * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (W (ζ₁ + (θ : ℂ) * (ζ₂ - ζ₁)))

noncomputable def cellKernelMinus_ℂ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X μ z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2 * (1 - Complex.cos (deltaPhi_ℂ W X z)) * Complex.exp (-2 * W z) -
    Complex.exp (W z) * (μ - z) *
      ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W X (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z))) *
          Complex.exp (-2 * W (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z)))

noncomputable def cellKernelPlus_ℂ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (Y μ z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2 * (1 - Complex.cos (deltaPhi_ℂ W z Y)) * Complex.exp (-2 * W z) -
    Complex.exp (W z) * (z - μ) *
      ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W (μ + (β : ℂ) * (z - μ)) Y) *
          Complex.exp (-2 * W (μ + (β : ℂ) * (z - μ)))

noncomputable def stripCellIntegrand_ℂ (n : ℤ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (α : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  let x_m := xInvMinus j α z
  let X_m := X_ℂ j x_m
  let μ_m := μ_ℂ j x_m
  let term_m : ℂ :=
    cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X_m μ_m z * (μ_m - X_m) *
      deriv (xInvMinus j α) z *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x_m - z))
  let x_p := xInvPlus j α z
  let Y_p := X_ℂ (j + 1) x_p
  let μ_p := μ_ℂ j x_p
  let term_p : ℂ :=
    cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y_p μ_p z * (Y_p - μ_p) *
      deriv (xInvPlus j α) z *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x_p - z))
  term_m + term_p

noncomputable def stripB_canon (n : ℤ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -(((n.natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n.natAbs,
      ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, stripCellIntegrand_ℂ n W X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus j z α

def IsHalfCellInvTuple (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (K_inv C_inv σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
    (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let σ_mesh := (1 - S.K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
  let σ_inv := (1 - K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
  ∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
    (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (xInvMinus j α) (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (xInvPlus j α) (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        xInvMinus j α z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh ∧
        xInvPlus j α z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α z) +
          (α : ℂ) * (μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α z) - X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α z)) = z ∧
        μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α z) +
          (α : ℂ) * (X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α z) - μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α z)) = z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        xInvMinus j α (z + 2 * Real.pi) = xInvMinus j α z + 2 * Real.pi ∧
        xInvPlus j α (z + 2 * Real.pi) = xInvPlus j α z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ,
        xInvMinus j α x = halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α x ∧
        deriv (xInvMinus j α) x = deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) x ∧
        xInvPlus j α x = halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α x ∧
        deriv (xInvPlus j α) x = deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) x) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ : ℂ =>
              xInvMinus j α ζ -
                (ζ - ((((j : ℝ) + α / 2) * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
          C_inv ∧
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ : ℂ =>
              xInvPlus j α ζ -
                (ζ - ((((j : ℝ) + (1 + α) / 2) * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
          C_inv)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
      ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (xInvMinus j α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (xInvPlus j α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))

def IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (K_inv C_inv σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w ∧
  IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W ∧
  IsStripMeshExt m (M + 1) S σ q w W X_ℂ μ_ℂ ∧
  IsHalfCellInvTuple m M S K_inv C_inv σ q w X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus

structure StripHalfCellInvSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1)) where
  K_inv : ℝ
  C_inv : ℝ
  N_inv : ℕ
  K_mesh_lt : S.K_mesh < K_inv
  C_inv_pos : 0 < C_inv
  N_mesh_le : S.N_mesh ≤ N_inv
  inv_ext : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_inv ≤ q →
    K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    IsStripMeshExt m (M + 1) S σ q w W X_ℂ μ_ℂ →
    ∃ (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
      IsHalfCellInvTuple m M S K_inv C_inv σ q w X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus
  inv_lip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ)
      (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
      (xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_inv ≤ q →
    K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S K_inv C_inv σ q w₁ W₁ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S K_inv C_inv σ q w₂ W₂ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ →
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => xInvMinus₁ j α ζ - xInvMinus₂ j α ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_inv * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ ∧
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => xInvPlus₁ j α ζ - xInvPlus₂ j α ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_inv * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂

structure StripKernelSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (H_inv : StripHalfCellInvSystem m M S) where
  C_ker : ℝ
  N_ker : ℕ
  C_ker_pos : 0 < C_ker
  N_inv_le : H_inv.N_inv ≤ N_ker
  real_eq : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    ∀ X Y z : ℝ,
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z
  diag_periodic : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    ∀ X Y μ z : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip σ → Y ∈ horizStrip σ → μ ∈ horizStrip σ → z ∈ horizStrip σ →
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (X + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X μ z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y μ z
  composed_props : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_ker ≤ q →
    H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w W
      X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus →
    let σ_inv := (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        let K_m : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) ζ
        let K_p : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          cellKernelPlus_ℂ W (X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)) ζ
        let h_m : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) - X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)
        let h_p : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) - μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)
        DifferentiableOn ℂ K_m (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ K_p (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ h_m (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ h_p (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                K_m ζ -
                  (((Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                    ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * α ^ 2 - 1 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_ker ∧
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                K_p ζ -
                  (((Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                    ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - α) ^ 2 - 1 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_ker ∧
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => h_m ζ - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_ker ∧
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => h_p ζ - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_ker)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        ContinuousOn
          (fun α : ℝ =>
            iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                cellKernelMinus_ℂ W
                  (X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) ζ) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn
          (fun α : ℝ =>
            iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                cellKernelPlus_ℂ W
                  (X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)) ζ) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn
          (fun α : ℝ =>
            iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) - X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn
          (fun α : ℝ =>
            iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) - μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
  composed_lip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ)
      (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)

    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w₂ W₂

    let σ_inv := (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ

      let K_p₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>

      let K_p₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        cellKernelPlus_ℂ W₂ (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ)) ζ

      let h_m₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>

      let h_p₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>

        X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ) - μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ)

structure ZeroSliceExtractedData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) where
  Γ_slice : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  a_mero : ℂ → ℂ
  f_mero : ℂ → ℂ
  E_disc : Set ℂ
  E_disc_sub : E_disc ⊆ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)
  E_disc_base_disjoint : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base, s ∉ E_disc
  E_disc_isolated : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0),
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball s r ⊆ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r, z ≠ s → z ∉ E_disc
  Γ_nf : MeromorphicNFOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 0) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)) ∧
    MeromorphicNFOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 1) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  Γ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 0) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)) ∧
    MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 1) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  a_mero_mero : MeromorphicOn a_mero (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  f_mero_mero : MeromorphicOn f_mero (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  slice_base_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base,
    Γ_slice s = glancingBoundaryCurve C s ∧
    a_mero s = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ s) ∧
    f_mero s = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s
  slice_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0), s ∉ E_disc →
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ a_mero s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ f_mero s ∧
    a_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    f_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s + Complex.I * deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s =
      Complex.I * C.c * a_mero s / (f_mero s) ^ 2 ∧
    deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s - Complex.I * deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s =
      -Complex.I * C.c / (a_mero s * (f_mero s) ^ 2) ∧
    deriv a_mero s = Complex.I * f_mero s * a_mero s ∧
    ∃ (r_s : ℝ) (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_s ∧
      Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s ⊆ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_X ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r_s, z ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧ z ∉ E_disc) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.X_mero i) (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r_s, X_loc i (z, 0) = Γ_slice z i)
  Γ_conj_nhdsNE : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0), ∀ i : Fin 2,
    ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ,
      Γ_slice (starRingEnd ℂ z) i = starRingEnd ℂ (Γ_slice z i)
  L_slice_holo_isolated : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0),
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball s r ⊆ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r, z ≠ s →
        ∃ (r_z : ℝ) (L_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          0 < r_z ∧
          Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z ⊆ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_loc i) (Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z)) ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i) (L_loc i) (Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z))

def slabBox (x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    |p.1.re - x_edge| < R_0 / 2 + 2 * δ_slab ∧
    |p.1.im - y_row| < 2 * δ_slab ∧
    ‖p.2‖ < 2 * δ_t }

structure LocalPatchSlabData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) (H₀ : ℝ) where
  x_edge : ℝ
  R_0 : ℝ
  y_row : ℝ
  δ_slab : ℝ
  δ_t : ℝ
  δ_rec : ℝ
  C_rec : ℝ
  C_init : ℝ
  H₀_ge : 2 * W.s_base ≤ H₀
  R_0_pos : 0 < R_0
  R_0_lt : R_0 < W.s_base / 2
  y_row_bounds : H₀ - R_0 / 16 < y_row ∧ y_row < H₀ - R_0 / 32
  δ_slab_pos : 0 < δ_slab
  δ_slab_lt_R : δ_slab < R_0 / 64
  δ_slab_lt_gap : y_row + 2 * δ_slab < H₀ - R_0 / 64
  δ_t_pos : 0 < δ_t
  δ_rec_pos : 0 < δ_rec
  C_rec_pos : 0 < C_rec
  C_init_pos : 0 < C_init
  G_succ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  L_line : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  V_slab : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  G_succ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_succ
    (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec)
  G_succ_cubic : ∀ V Δ : ℂ,
    V ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_0 →
    Δ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec →
    ‖G_succ (V, Δ) - Δ‖ ≤ C_rec * ‖Δ‖ ^ 3
  L_line_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_line i)
    (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec)
  V_slab_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V_slab (slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t)
  V_slab_quad : ∀ p ∈ slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t,
    ‖V_slab p - p.1‖ ≤ C_init * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2
  slab_recurrence : ∀ y t : ℂ,
    (y - t, t) ∈ slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t →
    (y, t) ∈ slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t →
    (y + t, t) ∈ slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t →
    V_slab (y, t) ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_0 ∧
    ‖V_slab (y, t) - V_slab (y - t, t)‖ < δ_rec ∧
    ‖V_slab (y + t, t) - V_slab (y, t)‖ < δ_rec ∧
    V_slab (y + t, t) - V_slab (y, t) =
      G_succ (V_slab (y, t), V_slab (y, t) - V_slab (y - t, t))
  slab_agrees_L : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i)
      (fun p => L_line i (V_slab p, V_slab (p.1 + p.2, p.2) - V_slab p))
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        |p.1.re - x_edge| < R_0 / 2 + δ_slab ∧
        |p.1.im - y_row| < δ_slab ∧
        ‖p.2‖ < δ_t }
  L_mero_even : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L,
    (p.1, -p.2) ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (min ((W.L_mero i).rad p) ((W.L_mero i).rad (p.1, -p.2))),
      (W.L_mero i).num p q * (W.L_mero i).den (p.1, -p.2) (q.1, -q.2) =
        (W.L_mero i).num (p.1, -p.2) (q.1, -q.2) * (W.L_mero i).den p q

def steepCorridorY (x_edge H₀ R_0 y_row δ_slab : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { y : ℂ |
    |y.re - x_edge| < R_0 / 8 ∧
    y_row - δ_slab / 2 < y.im ∧ y.im < H₀ + R_0 / 32 }

def steepSectorT (r_steep : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { t : ℂ | 0 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < r_steep ∧ ‖t‖ / 3 < |t.im| }

structure SteepCorridorDualLineData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)

  Λ_steep : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  Λ_steep_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,

            (steepSectorT r_steep ∩ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_μ))

noncomputable def divRoot_bfd (n j : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ)

noncomputable def activeRootIdx_bfd (d δ : ℝ) (b N : ℕ) (n : ℤ) : Finset ℤ :=
  (Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ)).filter
    (fun j : ℤ => j ≠ 0 ∧ |divRoot_bfd n j| < d - (b : ℝ) * δ)

noncomputable def sincInterp1D_bfd (d δ : ℝ) (b N : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ j ∈ activeRootIdx_bfd d δ b N n,
    f ((divRoot_bfd n j : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      sinc_ℂ ((n : ℂ) * (t - ((divRoot_bfd n j : ℝ) : ℂ)) / 2)

open Classical in
noncomputable def divMode1D_bfd (d δ : ℝ) (b N : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let G : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => f z - sincInterp1D_bfd d δ b N n f z
  if fourierDiffMult n t = 0 then deriv G t / deriv (fourierDiffMult n) t
  else G t / fourierDiffMult n t

def StripFourierAndDiffMultProp_bfd : Prop :=
  (∀ (σ M : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → 0 ≤ M → DifferentiableOn ℂ G (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, G (z + 2 * Real.pi) = G z ∧ ‖G z‖ ≤ M) →
    (∀ n : ℤ, ‖fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => G p.1) n 0‖ ≤ M * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * σ)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ,
      HasSum
        (fun n : ℤ =>
          fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => G p.1) n 0 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * y))
        (G y))) ∧
  (∀ (σ : ℝ) (t : ℂ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    |t.im| / 2 < σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y : ℂ => G (y, t)) (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, G (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = G (y, t)) →
    ∀ n : ℤ,
      fourierCoeff_ℂ (glancingDiffOp G) n t = fourierDiffMult n t * fourierCoeff_ℂ G n t)

def SincDivisorCalculusProp_bfd : Prop :=
  Differentiable ℂ sinc_ℂ ∧
  sinc_ℂ 0 = 1 ∧
  (∀ z : ℂ, z * sinc_ℂ z = Complex.sin z) ∧
  (∀ z : ℂ, sinc_ℂ (-z) = sinc_ℂ z) ∧
  (∀ z : ℂ, sinc_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (sinc_ℂ z)) ∧
  (∀ z : ℂ, ‖sinc_ℂ z‖ ≤ Real.exp |z.im| ∧ ‖deriv sinc_ℂ z‖ ≤ Real.exp |z.im|) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ),
    (∫ μ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ),
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (μ : ℂ) * t)) = sinc_ℂ ((n : ℂ) * t / 2)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 → sinc_ℂ ((Real.pi : ℂ) * (j : ℂ)) = 0) ∧
  (∀ n : ℤ,
    Differentiable ℂ (fourierDiffMult n) ∧
    (∀ t : ℂ, fourierDiffMult n (-t) = fourierDiffMult n t) ∧
    (∀ t : ℂ, fourierDiffMult (-n) (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (fourierDiffMult n t))) ∧
  (∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 →
    (∀ t : ℂ, fourierDiffMult n t = 0 ↔ ∃ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 ∧ t = ((divRoot_bfd n j : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 → deriv (fourierDiffMult n) ((divRoot_bfd n j : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℤ) (δ : ℝ) (t : ℂ),
    1 ≤ |n| → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 100 → ‖t‖ < 1 →
    (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 → (1 / 4 : ℝ) * min |(n : ℝ)|⁻¹ δ ≤ ‖t - ((divRoot_bfd n j : ℝ) : ℂ)‖) →
    fourierDiffMult n t ≠ 0 ∧
    ‖fourierDiffMult n t‖⁻¹ ≤ 36 * δ⁻¹ * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * |t.im| / 2))

def SingleModeSincDivProp_bfd : Prop :=
  ∀ (s d δ ν M η : ℝ) (N j₀ a b : ℕ) (n : ℤ),
    0 < s → 0 < d → d < 1 → d < s / 2 → 0 < δ → δ < d / 100 →
    (ν = 1 / 2 ∨ ν = 1) → 1 ≤ N →
    j₀ ≤ a → j₀ + 1 ≤ b → b ≤ 20 →
    0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ η →
    1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) →
    (∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ)) →
      (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ),
        ‖f t‖ ≤ M * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ - ν * |t.im|))) →
      (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 → |divRoot_bfd n j| < d - (b : ℝ) * δ →
        ‖f ((divRoot_bfd n j : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ η * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ))) →
      let R_n := sincInterp1D_bfd d δ b N n f
      let H_n := divMode1D_bfd d δ b N n f
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
      Differentiable ℂ R_n ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ H_n (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ)) ∧
      (∀ t : ℂ,
        ‖R_n t‖ + ((N : ℝ))⁻¹ * ‖deriv R_n t‖ ≤
          3 * Q * η * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ - |t.im| / 2))) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ),
        fourierDiffMult n t * H_n t = f t - R_n t ∧
        ‖H_n t‖ ≤
          324 * Q ^ 2 * (M + η) *
            Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ - (ν - 1 / 2) * |t.im|))) ∧
      ((∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ), f (-t) = f t) →
        ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ), H_n (-t) = H_n t)) ∧
    (∀ (f_pos f_neg : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f_pos (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f_neg (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ)) →
      (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ),
        f_neg (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (f_pos t)) →
      ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ),
        divMode1D_bfd d δ b N (-n) f_neg (starRingEnd ℂ t) =
          starRingEnd ℂ (divMode1D_bfd d δ b N n f_pos t))

def BufferedFourierDivMainProp_bfd : Prop :=
  ∃ (C_div : ℝ) (B_div : ℕ), 0 < C_div ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ν M η : ℝ) (N j₀ a b J : ℕ) (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → 0 < d → d < 1 → d < s / 2 → 0 < δ → δ < d / 100 →
      (ν = 1 / 2 ∨ ν = 1) → 1 ≤ N →
      j₀ ≤ a → j₀ + 1 ≤ b → max a (b + 1) + 1 ≤ J → J ≤ 20 →
      0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ η →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F (glancingDomain ν (s - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ)) →
      (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain ν (s - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) →
        F (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = F (y, t) ∧
        F (y, -t) = F (y, t) ∧
        F (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (F (y, t)) ∧
        ‖F (y, t)‖ ≤ M) →
      (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ →
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F ((x : ℂ), t)) = 0) →
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (j : ℤ),
        1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) → j ≠ 0 →
        |(2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ)| < d - (b : ℝ) * δ →
        ‖fourierCoeff_ℂ F n (((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
          η * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ))) →
      ∃ (H_mode R_mode : ℤ → ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ n : ℤ, n = 0 ∨ (N : ℤ) < |n| → ∀ t : ℂ, H_mode n t = 0 ∧ R_mode n t = 0) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, 1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (H_mode n)
            (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ)) ∧
          Differentiable ℂ (R_mode n) ∧
          (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ),
            fourierDiffMult n t * H_mode n t = fourierCoeff_ℂ F n t - R_mode n t ∧
            ‖R_mode n t‖ + ((N : ℝ))⁻¹ * ‖deriv (R_mode n) t‖ ≤
              C_div * (1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) ^ B_div * η *
                Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ - |t.im| / 2)))) ∧
        (let H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
          fun p =>
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ),
              H_mode n p.2 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * p.1)
         let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
         DifferentiableOn ℂ H
           (glancingDomain 0 (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ)) ∧
         (∀ y t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ →
           H (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = H (y, t) ∧
           H (y, -t) = H (y, t) ∧
           H (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (H (y, t)) ∧
           (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H ((x : ℂ), t)) = 0) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain (ν - 1 / 2) (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - (J : ℝ) * δ),
           ‖H p‖ ≤ C_div * Q ^ B_div * (M + η)) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain ν (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - (J : ℝ) * δ),
           ‖glancingDiffOp H p - F p‖ ≤
             C_div * Q ^ B_div * (η + M * Real.exp (-(N : ℝ) * δ))))

noncomputable def steepContActionA (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  J ^ 3 * (Phi (s, t * J) - (1 / 24 : ℂ))

noncomputable def steepContActionDJ (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun J' : ℂ => steepContActionA Phi s J' t) J

noncomputable def steepContActionDS (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun s' : ℂ => steepContActionA Phi s' J t) s

noncomputable def steepContPerturbG (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_0 t J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  steepContActionDJ Phi s_0 J t - t * steepContActionDS Phi s_0 J t

noncomputable def steepContResidual (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 8 : ℂ) * (J ^ 2 - J_m ^ 2) +
    steepContPerturbG Phi s_0 t J -
    steepContActionDJ Phi s_m J_m t

def steepContTripleDomain (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (η_SL : ℝ) :
    Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | (q.1, q.2.2 * q.2.1) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL }

noncomputable def steepContIterJ (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => (s_0 - s_m) / t
  | n + 1 =>
      let u := steepContIterJ Phi s_m s_0 t n
      u - (4 : ℂ) * steepContResidual Phi s_m ((s_0 - s_m) / t) s_0 t u

noncomputable def steepContSolJ (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (steepContIterJ Phi s_m s_0 t)

noncomputable def steepContChain (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_base : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (y_bot t : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ
  | 0 => (s_base (y_bot, t), s_base (y_bot + t, t))
  | j + 1 =>
      let prev := steepContChain Phi s_base y_bot t j
      (prev.2, prev.2 + t * steepContSolJ Phi prev.1 prev.2 t)

noncomputable def steepContPsi (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_base : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (N : ℕ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (steepContChain Phi s_base (y - ((N : ℂ) + 1) * t) t N).2

def SteepContJetProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop :=
  IsOpen (steepContTripleDomain S A.η_SL) ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => steepContActionDJ A.Phi q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
    (steepContTripleDomain S A.η_SL) ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => steepContActionDS A.Phi q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
    (steepContTripleDomain S A.η_SL) ∧
  (∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
    (s_m, t * J_m) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    (s_0, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J =
      (deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J' t) J -
        t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J t) s_0) -
      deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J' t) J_m) ∧
  (∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
    (s_0, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    HasDerivAt (fun J' => steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J')
      ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * J + deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J) J) ∧
  (∀ s_m s_0 J_m t : ℂ, ∀ ρ_s ρ_J M_a : ℝ,
    0 < ρ_s → 0 < ρ_J → 0 ≤ M_a → ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ ρ_J →
    (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall ((1 - (θ : ℂ)) * s_m + (θ : ℂ) * s_0) ρ_s,
      ∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 * ρ_J),
        (s', t * J') ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
        ‖steepContActionA A.Phi s' J' t‖ ≤ M_a) →
    (∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
      ‖deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J‖ ≤
        4 * M_a / ρ_J ^ 2 + 2 * ‖t‖ * M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J)) ∧
    ‖steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J_m t‖ ≤ M_a / ρ_s ∧
    ‖steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J_m t - steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_m J_m t‖ ≤
      (M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J)) * ‖s_0 - s_m‖)

def IsSteepContContractivePt (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) (ρ_J : ℝ) (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : Prop :=
  t ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < ρ_J ∧ ρ_J ≤ 1 / 32 ∧
  let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
  ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ ρ_J ∧
  (s_m, t * J_m) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
  (∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
    (s_0, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
    ‖deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J‖ ≤ 1 / 32) ∧
  ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ≤ ρ_J / 8

def SteepContSolverProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop :=
  (∀ ρ_J : ℝ, ∀ s_m s_0 t : ℂ,
    IsSteepContContractivePt S A ρ_J s_m s_0 t →
    let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
    let J_p := steepContSolJ A.Phi s_m s_0 t
    ‖J_p - J_m‖ ≤ 8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ∧
    deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J' t) J_p -
      t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J_p t) s_0 =
      deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J' t) J_m ∧
    (∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
      deriv (fun J'' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J'' t) J' -
        t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J' t) s_0 =
        deriv (fun J'' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J'' t) J_m →
      J' = J_p)) ∧
  (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (ρ_J : ℝ) (s_m s_0 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_m U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_0 U →
    (∀ p ∈ U, IsSteepContContractivePt S A ρ_J (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => steepContSolJ A.Phi (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2) U)

def SteepContBaseBoundsProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop :=
  ∀ δ_ceil : ℝ, 0 < δ_ceil → δ_ceil < S.H / 2 →
    ∃ r_base C_base : ℝ, 0 < r_base ∧ r_base < S.r_star ∧ 0 < C_base ∧
      ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| ≤ S.H - δ_ceil / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_base →
        (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        (y - t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        ‖S.𝔰 (y, t) - y‖ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 ∧
        (t ≠ 0 →
          let s_m := S.𝔰 (y - t, t)
          let s_0 := S.𝔰 (y, t)
          let s_p := S.𝔰 (y + t, t)
          let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
          let J_p := (s_p - s_0) / t
          ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 ∧
          ‖J_p - 1‖ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 ∧
          (s_m, s_0 - s_m) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
          (s_0, s_p - s_0) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
          deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J' t) J_p -
            t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J_p t) s_0 =
            deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J' t) J_m)

def SteepContStepAdmProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop :=
  (∀ β x_start Δ : ℝ, ∀ M : ℕ,
    1 < β → 0 < x_start → 0 < Δ →
    Δ * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, (x_start + (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Δ) ^ (-β)) ≤
      x_start ^ (1 - β) / (β - 1)) ∧
  (∀ α m_steep γ_steep δ_ceil δ_b K : ℝ,
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < m_steep → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    0 < δ_ceil → δ_ceil < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 → 0 < K →
    let L := 2 * (m_steep + 1 / γ_steep + 1)
    let ρ_J := 1 / (400 * (1 + 20 * K))
    ∃ Θ_adm C_res : ℝ, 0 < Θ_adm ∧ 0 < C_res ∧
      ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → 0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε →
        10 * K * d ^ (1 - α) + 10 * ε ≤ Θ_adm →
        (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
          |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
          r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
        ∀ z_0 t s_m s_0 : ℂ,
          γ_steep * ‖t‖ < t.im →
          d / 2 < wallDepth S (z_0 + t) →
          wallDepth S (z_0 - t) < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_ceil →
          |(z_0 + t).re - x₀| ≤ (m_steep + 1 / γ_steep) * wallDepth S (z_0 + t) →
          ‖t‖ < 10 * r * (wallDepth S (z_0 + t) / d) ^ α →
          ‖s_m - (z_0 - t)‖ ≤ (1 / (100 * (1 + 20 * K) ^ 2)) * wallDepth S (z_0 - t) →
          ‖s_0 - z_0‖ ≤ (1 / (100 * (1 + 20 * K) ^ 2)) * wallDepth S z_0 →
          ‖(s_0 - s_m) / t - 1‖ ≤ ρ_J →
          IsSteepContContractivePt S A ρ_J s_m s_0 t ∧
          8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m ((s_0 - s_m) / t) s_0 t ((s_0 - s_m) / t)‖ ≤
            C_res * ‖t‖ ^ 3 * (1 + (ε / r) * d ^ α) ^ 2 * (wallDepth S z_0) ^ (-2 * α - 1))

def SteepContUpwardProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∀ α m_steep γ_steep δ_ceil δ_b : ℝ,
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < m_steep → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    0 < δ_ceil → δ_ceil < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    let L := 2 * (m_steep + 1 / γ_steep + 1)
    ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K → ∃ C_st ε_st d_st : ℝ, 0 < C_st ∧ 0 < ε_st ∧ 0 < d_st ∧
      ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d_st → 0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε_st →
        (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
          |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
          r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
        ∃ s_up : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ s_up
            { p : ℂ × ℂ |
              d / 2 < S.H - p.1.im ∧ S.H - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
              |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) ∧
              ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
              γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < p.2.im } ∧
          (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
            d / 2 < S.H - p.1.im → S.H - p.1.im < δ_ceil →
            |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) →
            ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α →
            γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < p.2.im →
            s_up p ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
            ‖s_up p - p.1‖ ≤
              C_st * (1 + (ε / r) * d ^ α) ^ 2 * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (S.H - p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
            (p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X → s_up p = S.𝔰 p))

noncomputable def glancingIterDslopeAtZero : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, g => g
  | n + 1, g => dslope (glancingIterDslopeAtZero n g) 0

structure NormalizedGlancingData {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) where
  s₁ : ℝ
  r_in : ℝ
  s₁_pos : 0 < s₁
  s₁_le_s₀ : s₁ ≤ B.s₀
  r_in_pos : 0 < r_in
  r_in_lt_quarter_s₁ : r_in < s₁ / 4
  U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  U_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s₁ ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_in }
  U_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r_in →
    U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = U (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi
  U_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r_in → U (y, -t) = U (y, t)
  U_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → U (y, 0) = y
  U_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r_in →
    U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (U (y, t))
  U_maps_to_wide : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < (7 / 4 : ℝ) * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r_in →
    U (y, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀)
  U_real_deriv_pos : ∀ x t : ℝ, |t| < r_in →
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (U (x', t)).re) x
  U_real_step_pos : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_in →
    0 < (U (x + t, t)).re - (U (x, t)).re ∧
    0 < B.ϕ ((U (x + t, t)).re) - B.ϕ ((U (x, t)).re) ∧
    B.ϕ ((U (x + t, t)).re) - B.ϕ ((U (x, t)).re) < Real.pi
  glancing_stationary_wide : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r_in →
    -supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t, t))) =
      supportAction2_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y - t, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t)))

noncomputable def pderivA (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun z : ℂ => f (z, p.2)) p.1

noncomputable def pderivD (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun z : ℂ => f (p.1, z)) p.2

noncomputable def mvDerivA (Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single 0 1) Φ

noncomputable def mvDerivD (Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single 1 1) Φ

noncomputable def holoTaylor1D (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk (fun n => iteratedDeriv n g z₀ / (n.factorial : ℂ))

structure Holo2DAndTaylorToolkit : Prop where
  pderiv_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD f) U
  pderiv_comm : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
    ∀ p ∈ U, pderivA (pderivD f) p = pderivD (pderivA f) p
  iterDerivYT_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) U
  iterDerivYT_step : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ (α β : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ U,
      iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivA f) p ∧
      iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivD f) p ∧
      pderivA (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p ∧
      pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p
  taylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀
  eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D : ∀ {W V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
    ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = 0
  eqOn_zero_of_taylor2D_zero : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ W →
    ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → taylor2D f p₀ = 0 → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = 0
  taylor2D_algebra : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    (∀ c : ℂ, taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c) ∧
    (∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀)
  mvDeriv_rules :
    (∀ Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
      mvDerivA (Φ + Ψ) = mvDerivA Φ + mvDerivA Ψ ∧
      mvDerivD (Φ + Ψ) = mvDerivD Φ + mvDerivD Ψ ∧
      mvDerivA (Φ * Ψ) = mvDerivA Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDerivA Ψ ∧
      mvDerivD (Φ * Ψ) = mvDerivD Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDerivD Ψ) ∧
    (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
        mvDerivA (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderivA f) p₀ ∧
        mvDerivD (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderivD f) p₀)
  mvDeriv_compPowerSeries2D : ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
    mvDerivA (compPowerSeries2D f Ψ) =
      mvDerivA Ψ * compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) Ψ ∧
    mvDerivD (compPowerSeries2D f Ψ) =
      mvDerivD Ψ * compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) Ψ
  taylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W_ψ : Set ℂ},
    IsOpen U → IsOpen W_ψ → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W_ψ → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W_ψ) →
      taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
        compPowerSeries2D (holoTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀)
  compPowerSeries2D_inj : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → pderivA ψ p₀ ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (f₁ f₂ : PowerSeries ℂ),
      compPowerSeries2D f₁ (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) =
        compPowerSeries2D f₂ (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) →
      f₁ = f₂

noncomputable def webDiffCoeffA (A w : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, 0 => w
  | 0, _ + 1 => fun _ => 0
  | α + 1, 0 => pderivA (webDiffCoeffA A w α 0)
  | α + 1, k + 1 => fun p =>
      pderivA (webDiffCoeffA A w α (k + 1)) p + webDiffCoeffA A w α k p * A p

noncomputable def webDiffCoeff (A B_ψ w : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (α : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, k => webDiffCoeffA A w α k
  | β + 1, 0 => pderivD (webDiffCoeff A B_ψ w α β 0)
  | β + 1, k + 1 => fun p =>
      pderivD (webDiffCoeff A B_ψ w α β (k + 1)) p + webDiffCoeff A B_ψ w α β k p * B_ψ p

noncomputable def webVandermondeMat {m : ℕ} (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun r i =>
    w i p * (pderivA (ψ i) p) ^ (m - r.val) * (pderivD (ψ i) p) ^ r.val

def webODEDomain {m : ℕ} (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U₀ U_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) :
    Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p ∈ U₀ ∩ U_plus | (webVandermondeMat ψ w p).det ≠ 0 }

structure WebPDESystem {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (B : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (U₀ U_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) where
  M_a : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix (Fin m × Fin m) (Fin m × Fin m) ℂ
  M_δ : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix (Fin m × Fin m) (Fin m × Fin m) ℂ
  c_a : ℂ × ℂ → (Fin m × Fin m → ℂ)
  c_δ : ℂ × ℂ → (Fin m × Fin m → ℂ)
  isOpen_ode : IsOpen (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  ode_sub_U₀ : webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus ⊆ U₀
  ode_sub_U_plus : webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus ⊆ U_plus
  mem_ode_domain : ∀ p ∈ U₀ ∩ U_plus,
    (∀ i : Fin m, w i p ≠ 0) →
    (∀ i : Fin m, pderivA (ψ i) p ≠ 0) →
    Function.Injective (fun i : Fin m => pderivD (ψ i) p / pderivA (ψ i) p) →
    p ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus
  M_a_holo : ∀ idx j : Fin m × Fin m,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M_a p idx j) (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  M_δ_holo : ∀ idx j : Fin m × Fin m,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M_δ p idx j) (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  c_a_holo : ∀ idx : Fin m × Fin m,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c_a p idx) (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  c_δ_holo : ∀ idx : Fin m × Fin m,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c_δ p idx) (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  cross_rel : ∀ p ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus, ∀ V : Fin m × Fin m → ℂ, ∀ i : Fin m,
    pderivD (ψ i) p * ((M_a p).mulVec V + c_a p) (i, ⟨0, hm⟩) =
      pderivA (ψ i) p * ((M_δ p).mulVec V + c_δ p) (i, ⟨0, hm⟩)
  formal_ode : ∀ p₁ ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus, ∀ f : Fin m → PowerSeries ℂ,
    (∑ i : Fin m,
      taylor2D (w i) p₁ * compPowerSeries2D (f i) (centeredTaylor2D (ψ i) p₁) =
      taylor2D B p₁) →
    ∃ V_formal : Fin m × Fin m → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
      (∀ i : Fin m,
        V_formal (i, ⟨0, hm⟩) = compPowerSeries2D (f i) (centeredTaylor2D (ψ i) p₁)) ∧
      (∀ idx : Fin m × Fin m,
        mvDerivA (V_formal idx) =
          ∑ j : Fin m × Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => M_a p idx j) p₁ * V_formal j +
            taylor2D (fun p => c_a p idx) p₁ ∧
        mvDerivD (V_formal idx) =
          ∑ j : Fin m × Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => M_δ p idx j) p₁ * V_formal j +
            taylor2D (fun p => c_δ p idx) p₁)

noncomputable def collarBaseS {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) : ℝ :=
  hDet.s_det

noncomputable def collarBaseR {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) : ℝ :=
  min hDet.r_det (Real.pi / 2)

def IsCollarHeightWitness (s_base r_base : ℝ) (F_init : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (t : ℂ) (b : ℝ) : Prop :=
  s_base < b ∧
  ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ Metric.ball t δ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base ∧
    ∃ G : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D ({ y : ℂ | -s_base < y.im ∧ y.im < b } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ),
      ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (G i) (F_init i)
        ({ y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ)

noncomputable def meroStripWidth (s_base r_base : ℝ) (F_init : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (t : ℂ) : ENNReal :=
  sSup { x : ENNReal | ∃ b : ℝ, IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_init t b ∧
    x = ENNReal.ofReal b }

noncomputable def collarWidthX {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) : ℂ → ENNReal :=
  meroStripWidth (collarBaseS hDet) (collarBaseR hDet)
    (fun i p => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i)

noncomputable def collarWidthL {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) : ℂ → ENNReal :=
  meroStripWidth (collarBaseS hDet) (collarBaseR hDet)
    (fun i p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)

def HolomorphicDiskSupermeanProp (r_base : ℝ) (h_F : ℂ → ENNReal) : Prop :=
  ∀ (R_Φ : ℝ) (Φ : ℂ → ℂ),
    1 < R_Φ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ) →
    (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ, Φ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base) →
    deriv Φ 0 ≠ 0 →
    ∀ q : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous q → Function.Periodic q (2 * Real.pi) →
      (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ q θ ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (q θ) < h_F (Φ (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))) →
      ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q θ) ≤ h_F (Φ 0)

def lineChainBox {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < B.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < B.r_det / (k : ℝ) }

abbrev LineJetAll : Type := Fin 2 × Fin 2 × ℕ × ℕ

def lineJetEmb (M : ℕ) (w : LineJetVar M) : LineJetAll :=
  (w.1, w.2.1, w.2.2.1.1, w.2.2.2.1)

noncomputable def lineJetFnAll {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (v : LineJetAll) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if v.1 = 0 then
    iterDerivYT v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 (fun q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 v.2.1) p
  else
    iterDerivYT v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 (fun q => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 v.2.1) p

noncomputable def linePointField {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Subfield ℂ :=
  Subfield.closure
    (((⊥ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪
      Set.range (fun v : LineJetAll => lineJetFnAll C k v (Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))))

noncomputable def lineChainMid {k : ℕ} (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  (α i.castSucc + α i.succ) / 2

noncomputable def lineChainHalfStep {k : ℕ} (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  (α i.succ - α i.castSucc) / 2

noncomputable def lineChainAction {k : ℕ} (h_vec : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ)
    (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k, 2 * h_vec i (lineChainMid α i) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α i)

noncomputable def lineInteriorGrad {k : ℕ} (h_vec h'_vec : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ)
    (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (r : Fin (k - 1)) : ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  h'_vec i_L (lineChainMid α i_L) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α i_L) +
    h_vec i_L (lineChainMid α i_L) * Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α i_L) +
    h'_vec i_R (lineChainMid α i_R) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α i_R) -
    h_vec i_R (lineChainMid α i_R) * Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α i_R)

noncomputable def lineInteriorHess {k : ℕ} (h_vec h'_vec h''_vec : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ)
    (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) : Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let ψ_L := lineChainMid α i_L
    let d_L := lineChainHalfStep α i_L
    let ψ_R := lineChainMid α i_R
    let d_R := lineChainHalfStep α i_R
    if r.1 = s.1 then
      ((h''_vec i_L ψ_L - h_vec i_L ψ_L) / 2 * Complex.sin d_L +
        h'_vec i_L ψ_L * Complex.cos d_L) +
      ((h''_vec i_R ψ_R - h_vec i_R ψ_R) / 2 * Complex.sin d_R -
        h'_vec i_R ψ_R * Complex.cos d_R)
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
      (h_vec i_R ψ_R + h''_vec i_R ψ_R) / 2 * Complex.sin d_R
    else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
      (h_vec i_L ψ_L + h''_vec i_L ψ_L) / 2 * Complex.sin d_L
    else
      0

noncomputable def lineChartAlpha {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2

noncomputable def lineChartPsi {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChainMid (fun r => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r q) i

noncomputable def lineChartHalfStep {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChainHalfStep (fun r => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r q) i

noncomputable def lineChartWeight {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2 * Complex.sin (lineChartHalfStep C k Ψ i q)

noncomputable def lineChartAction {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChainAction (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun r => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r q)

structure LineGlancingChartData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) where
  a₀ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  δ_star : ℝ
  C₀ : ℝ
  a₀_eq : a₀ = C.ϕ 0
  R_pos : 0 < R
  δ_star_pos : 0 < δ_star
  C₀_pos : 0 < C₀
  C₀_δ_star_lt : C₀ * δ_star < R / 2
  V_W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  V_W_open : IsOpen V_W
  V_W_nonempty : V_W.Nonempty
  V_W_sub : V_W ⊆ lineChainBox C B k
  Ψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star))
  Ψ_maps_V_W : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    Ψ q ∈ V_W
  Φ_left_inv : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    glancingTheta C (Ψ q).1 (Ψ q).2 = q.1 ∧
    glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + (k : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 -
      glancingTheta C (Ψ q).1 (Ψ q).2 = q.2
  Φ_right_inv : ∀ p ∈ V_W,
    (glancingTheta C p.1 p.2,
      glancingTheta C (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 - glancingTheta C p.1 p.2) ∈
      Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star) ∧
    Ψ (glancingTheta C p.1 p.2,
      glancingTheta C (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 - glancingTheta C p.1 p.2) = p
  α_endpoints : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    lineChartAlpha C k Ψ 0 q = q.1 ∧
    lineChartAlpha C k Ψ (Fin.last k) q = q.1 + q.2
  α_holo : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r)
      (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star))
  ψ_maps_strip : ∀ i : Fin k,
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      lineChartPsi C k Ψ i q ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)
  stationary_on_chart : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
        (fun s => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ s q) r = 0
  action_deriv_a : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    iterDerivYT 1 0 (lineChartAction C k Ψ) q =
      glancingOffset C ((Ψ q).1 + (k : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 -
        glancingOffset C (Ψ q).1 (Ψ q).2
  action_deriv_d : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (lineChartAction C k Ψ) q =
      glancingOffset C ((Ψ q).1 + (k : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2
  α_at_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ a : ℝ, |a - a₀| < R →
    lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r ((a : ℂ), 0) = (a : ℂ) ∧
    deriv (fun z : ℂ => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r ((a : ℂ), z)) 0 = ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
  ψ_web_base : ∀ i : Fin k, ∀ q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star,
    (lineChartPsi C k Ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0 ∧
    |(lineChartPsi C k Ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re - q.1| ≤ C₀ * q.2 ∧
    1 / 2 ≤ (deriv (fun z : ℂ => lineChartPsi C k Ψ i (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)).re
  trapezoid_nondeg : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀,
    (∀ i : Fin k, lineChartWeight C k Ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ≠ 0) ∧
    Function.Injective (fun i : Fin k =>
      deriv (fun z : ℂ => lineChartPsi C k Ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), z)) (q.2 : ℂ) /
        deriv (fun z : ℂ => lineChartPsi C k Ψ i (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)) ∧
    (lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
      (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ))
      (fun s => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ s ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)))).det ≠ 0

abbrev LineGlancingChartData.U_a {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.ball (G.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * G.R)

abbrev LineGlancingChartData.U_d {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * G.δ_star)

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.α_fn {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ r q

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.ψ_fn {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChartPsi C k G.Ψ i q

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.d_fn {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChartHalfStep C k G.Ψ i q

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.w_fn {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChartWeight C k G.Ψ i q

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.A_line {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}

structure LineCoreEliminationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)

  coreTuple : Fin N_core → ℂ
  K_end_alg_over_pt : ∀ z : ℂ,

  cos_half_zero_mem : Complex.cos ((a₁ : ℂ) / 2) ∈ K_end
  sin_half_zero_mem : Complex.sin ((a₁ : ℂ) / 2) ∈ K_end
  cos_half_last_mem : Complex.cos (((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2) ∈ K_end
  sin_half_last_mem : Complex.sin (((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2) ∈ K_end

  half_angles_mem : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),

  support_jets_mem : ∀ (i : Fin k) (m : ℕ),

  core_entries_subset :

          z = iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))) }
  dualLine_mem_F_val : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j < k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,

      ((G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))).1 + (j : ℂ) * (G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))).2)
