structure LineTruncatedCoalescingModel (k p J : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ)
    (f_p : Fin k → ℂ) where
  W_n : Set ℂ
  W_n_open : IsOpen W_n
  a_mem : (a : ℂ) ∈ W_n
  h_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_n
  g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  g_holo : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_n
  g_lt_p : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < p → ∀ z ∈ W_n, g i l z = 0
  g_at_p : ∀ (i : Fin k) (hpJ : p < J + 1), g i ⟨p, hpJ⟩ (a : ℂ) = f_p i
  K : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ
  δ₀ : ℝ
  δ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀
  α₀ : ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  β : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  β_zero : ∀ (δ : ℝ) (r : Fin (k + 1)), β 0 δ r = 0
  α₀_endpoints : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀,
    α₀ δ 0 = (a : ℂ) ∧ α₀ δ (Fin.last k) = (a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ)
  β_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (δ : ℝ),
    β l δ 0 = 0 ∧ β l δ (Fin.last k) = 0
  α₀_tendsto : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (α₀ δ r - (a : ℂ)) / (δ : ℂ))
      (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)))
  α₀_maps_W_n : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid (α₀ δ) i ∈ W_n
  α₀_stat : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) (α₀ δ) r = 0
  grad_jet_zero : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ J →
    iteratedDeriv l
      (fun ε : ℂ =>
        lineInteriorGrad
          (fun i z => h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * g i m z)
          (fun i z => deriv h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * deriv (g i m) z)
          (fun s => α₀ δ s + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * β m δ s)
          r)
      0 = 0
  action_jet_const : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    iteratedDeriv (l : ℕ)
      (fun ε : ℂ =>
        lineChainAction
          (fun i z => h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * g i m z)
          (fun s => α₀ δ s + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * β m δ s))
      0 / ((l : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) = K l

structure LineContinuedDeformationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  p : ℕ
  p_pos : 1 ≤ p
  f_lead : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ
  i₀ : Fin k
  f_lead_i₀_ne_zero : f_lead i₀ ≠ 0
  W_lead : Set ℂ
  W_lead_open : IsOpen W_lead
  W_lead_preconn : IsPreconnected W_lead
  real_mem_W_lead : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - G.a₀| < G.R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_lead
  g_lead : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ
  g_lead_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_lead i) W_lead
  g_lead_taylor : ∀ i : Fin k,
    G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ W_lead ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv n (g_lead i) (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) / (n.factorial : ℂ) =
        PowerSeries.coeff n (f_lead i)
  trunc_models : ∀ J : ℕ, p ≤ J → ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioo (G.a₀ - G.R) (G.a₀ + G.R),
    Nonempty (LineTruncatedCoalescingModel k p J a C.h_ℂ (fun i => g_lead i (a : ℂ)))

noncomputable def normDiffQuot (F : ℂ → ℂ) (s h : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  dslope F s (s + h) / deriv F s

noncomputable def diffQuotCoeff (F : ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iteratedDeriv (k + 1) F s / (((k + 1).factorial : ℂ) * deriv F s)

noncomputable def reflDiffCoeff {n : ℕ} (G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n)
    (k₁ k₂ : ℕ) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (-1 : ℂ) ^ k₁ *
    (diffQuotCoeff G.Z_loc k₁ s * diffQuotCoeff G.Z_loc k₂ s -
     diffQuotCoeff G.W_loc k₁ s * diffQuotCoeff G.W_loc k₂ s)

structure ZeroSliceCenterData {n : ℕ} (G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n) where
  ne_three : n ≠ 3
  Z₀ : ℂ
  W₀ : ℂ
  u_Z : ℂ → ℂ
  u_W : ℂ → ℂ
  f_tilde : ℂ → ℂ
  δ₁ : ℝ
  δ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁
  δ₁_le : δ₁ ≤ G.δ₀
  u_Z_ball : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₁ → AnalyticAt ℂ u_Z z ∧ u_Z z ≠ 0
  u_W_ball : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₁ → AnalyticAt ℂ u_W z ∧ u_W z ≠ 0
  f_tilde_ball : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₁ → AnalyticAt ℂ f_tilde z ∧ f_tilde z ≠ 0
  f_tilde_zero : f_tilde 0 = -Complex.I * (n : ℂ)
  f_expansion : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ → G.f_loc z = z⁻¹ * f_tilde z
  Z_expansion : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ → G.Z_loc z - Z₀ = z ^ (n + 3) * u_Z z
  W_expansion : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
    G.W_loc z - W₀ = z ^ ((3 : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) * u_W z
  deriv_Z_ne_zero : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ → deriv G.Z_loc z ≠ 0
  deriv_W_ne_zero : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ → deriv G.W_loc z ≠ 0
  refl_coeff_analytic : ∀ k₁ k₂ : ℕ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
    AnalyticAt ℂ (reflDiffCoeff G k₁ k₂) z
  refl_coeff_mero_order : ∀ k₁ k₂ m : ℕ,
    MeromorphicAt (iteratedDeriv m (reflDiffCoeff G k₁ k₂)) 0 ∧
    ((-(k₁ : ℤ) - (k₂ : ℤ) - (m : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤
      meromorphicOrderAt (iteratedDeriv m (reflDiffCoeff G k₁ k₂)) 0
  refl_deg0 : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ → reflDiffCoeff G 0 0 z = 0
  refl_deg1 : ∀ z h_minus h_plus : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
    reflDiffCoeff G 1 0 z * h_minus + reflDiffCoeff G 0 1 z * h_plus =
      Complex.I * G.f_loc z * (h_plus - h_minus)
  refl_deg2 : ∀ z h_minus h_plus : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
    reflDiffCoeff G 2 0 z * h_minus ^ 2 +
      reflDiffCoeff G 1 1 z * h_minus * h_plus +
      reflDiffCoeff G 0 2 z * h_plus ^ 2 =
      -Complex.I * deriv G.f_loc z * (h_plus - h_minus) ^ 2
  refl_deg3 : ∀ z h_minus h_plus : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
    reflDiffCoeff G 3 0 z * h_minus ^ 3 +
      reflDiffCoeff G 2 1 z * h_minus ^ 2 * h_plus +
      reflDiffCoeff G 1 2 z * h_minus * h_plus ^ 2 +
      reflDiffCoeff G 0 3 z * h_plus ^ 3 =
      (h_plus - h_minus) *
        (reflDiffCoeff G 0 3 z * (h_plus ^ 2 + h_plus * h_minus + h_minus ^ 2) +
          reflDiffCoeff G 1 2 z * h_minus * h_plus)

structure PuncturedLiftData {n : ℕ} (G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n)
    (S : ZeroSliceCenterData G) where
  v_jet : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  v_jet_zero : ∀ z : ℂ, v_jet 0 z = 0
  v_jet_analytic : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < S.δ₁ → AnalyticAt ℂ (v_jet j) z
  v_jet_mero : ∀ j : ℕ, MeromorphicAt (v_jet j) 0
  local_lift : ∀ z₀ : ℂ, 0 < ‖z₀‖ → ‖z₀‖ < S.δ₁ →
    ∃ (r : ℝ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → 0 < ‖z‖ ∧ ‖z‖ < S.δ₁) ∧
      2 * r < G.δ₀ ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ v (Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r)) ∧
      (∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → ‖t‖ < 2 * r →
        0 < ‖v (z, t)‖ ∧ ‖v (z, t)‖ < S.δ₁ ∧
        G.D_ZW (z, t) ≠ 0 ∧
        v (z, -t) = v (z, t) ∧
        G.N_Z (z, t) / G.D_ZW (z, t) = G.Z_loc (v (z, t)) ∧
        G.N_W (z, t) / G.D_ZW (z, t) = G.W_loc (v (z, t))) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → v (z, 0) = z) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → ∀ k : ℕ,
        iteratedDeriv k (fun t => v (z, t) - z) 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
          if Even k then v_jet (k / 2) z else 0) ∧
      (∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < r → ‖t‖ < r →
        normDiffQuot G.Z_loc (v (z, t)) (-(v (z, t) - v (z - t, t))) *
          normDiffQuot G.Z_loc (v (z, t)) (v (z + t, t) - v (z, t)) -
        normDiffQuot G.W_loc (v (z, t)) (-(v (z, t) - v (z - t, t))) *
          normDiffQuot G.W_loc (v (z, t)) (v (z + t, t) - v (z, t)) = 0)

structure PoleBoundedLiftData {n : ℕ} {G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n}
    (S : ZeroSliceCenterData G) (L : PuncturedLiftData G S) where
  w_jet : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  w_jet_zero : ∀ z : ℂ, w_jet 0 z = 0
  w_jet_analytic : ∀ j : ℕ, AnalyticAt ℂ (w_jet j) 0
  v_jet_eq : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j →
    ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ,
      L.v_jet j z = z ^ ((1 : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ)) * w_jet j z

def HasRealWallPatch {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₀ x₀ H₁ ε δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∃ g : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
        ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε },
    ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g i) (W.X_mero i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
        |p.1.im - (H₁ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
        ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ }) ∨
  (∃ g : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
        ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε },
    ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g i) (W.L_mero i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
        |p.1.im - (H₁ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
        ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ })

structure FullBandPolyData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (H₁ η t₁ : ℝ) where
  r₁ : ℝ
  r₁_pos : 0 < r₁
  ball_sub_base : Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base
  h_L_lower : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁, ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - η) < W.h_L t
  N_cov : ℕ
  y_c : Fin N_cov → ℂ
  τ_c : Fin N_cov → ℂ
  ρ_y : Fin N_cov → ℝ
  ρ_t : Fin N_cov → ℝ
  ρ_pos : ∀ β : Fin N_cov, 0 < ρ_y β ∧ 0 < ρ_t β ∧
    Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β) ⊆ Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁
  covers_band : ∀ (x y_im : ℝ) (t : ℂ),
    x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) →
    y_im ∈ Set.Icc (H₁ - η) (H₁ + η) →
    t ∈ Metric.closedBall (t₁ : ℂ) (r₁ / 2) →
    ∃ β : Fin N_cov,
      ((x : ℂ) + (y_im : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ Metric.ball (y_c β) (3 * ρ_y β / 4) ∧
      t ∈ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (3 * ρ_t β / 4)
  deg : Fin N_cov → Fin 2 → ℕ
  deg_pos : ∀ β ι, 1 ≤ deg β ι
  C_coeff : ∀ (β : Fin N_cov) (ι : Fin 2), Fin (deg β ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  H_exc : Fin N_cov → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  coeff_holo : ∀ β ι d,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (C_coeff β ι d)
      (Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β))
  exc_holo : ∀ β,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (H_exc β)
      (Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β))
  exc_ne_zero : ∀ β,
    ∃ p ∈ Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β), H_exc β p ≠ 0
  lead_dvd_exc : ∀ β ι, ∃ G_div : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G_div
      (Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β),
      H_exc β q = C_coeff β ι (Fin.last (deg β ι)) q * G_div q
  separable_at : ∀ β ι,
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β),
      H_exc β q ≠ 0 →
      C_coeff β ι (Fin.last (deg β ι)) q ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ,
        ∑ d : Fin (deg β ι + 1), C_coeff β ι d q * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin (deg β ι),
          (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * C_coeff β ι d.succ q * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0
  primary_solves : ∀ β ι,
    ∀ p ∈ (Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β)) ∩
        meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L,
      ∃ r_p : ℝ, 0 < r_p ∧ r_p ≤ (W.L_mero ι).rad p ∧
        Metric.ball p r_p ⊆
          Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β) ∧
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r_p,
          ∑ d : Fin (deg β ι + 1),
            C_coeff β ι d q *
              ((W.L_mero ι).num p q) ^ (d : ℕ) *
              ((W.L_mero ι).den p q) ^ (deg β ι - (d : ℕ)) = 0

def WallRegAt {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ H₂ x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (δ_x δ_t : ℝ)
    (G : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
      (Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_x ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t)),
    0 < δ_x ∧ 0 < δ_t ∧
    Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (G i) (W.L_mero i)
      ({ y : ℂ | y ∈ Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_x ∧
          y.im < H₂ - δ_x / 2 } ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t)

structure AlignedWallDefectData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) (t₂ : ℝ) where
  t₂_mem : |t₂| < W.r_base
  t₂_irr : Irrational (t₂ / (2 * Real.pi))
  H₂ : ℝ
  h_L_eq_H₂ : W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₂
  H₂_ge : 2 * W.s_base ≤ H₂
  x_star : ℝ
  K : ℕ
  unaligned_wall_reg : ∀ q : ℤ, (q ≤ 0 ∨ K < q.natAbs) →
    WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x_star + (q : ℝ) * t₂)
  ρ₀ : ℝ
  ρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀
  ρ₀_lt : ρ₀ < W.s_base / 2
  loop_branch_one : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ →
    ∃ (δ_w δ_loop : ℝ) (Λ_loop : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < δ_w ∧ δ_w ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ 0 < δ_loop ∧
      Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base ∧
      let y_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I
      let w_start : ℂ := (Real.log ρ : ℂ) - ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      let p₀ : ℂ × ℂ := (y_star - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I + (t₂ : ℂ), (t₂ : ℂ))
      let LoopStrip : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { w : ℂ | |w.re - Real.log ρ| < δ_w ∧
            w.im ∈ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 8) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 8) } ×ˢ
          Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop
      p₀ ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Λ_loop ι) LoopStrip) ∧
      (∃ r_att : ℝ, 0 < r_att ∧
        ∀ w t : ℂ, ‖w - w_start‖ < r_att → ‖t - (t₂ : ℂ)‖ < r_att →
          (w, t) ∈ LoopStrip ∧
          ∀ ι : Fin 2,
            (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ ((W.L_mero ι).rad p₀) ∧
            (W.L_mero ι).num p₀ (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t) =
              Λ_loop ι (w, t) * (W.L_mero ι).den p₀ (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t)) ∧
      (∃ ι : Fin 2,
        ¬ ∀ᶠ p in nhds (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)),
            Λ_loop ι (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, p.2) = Λ_loop ι p)

abbrev SymJetVar (N_idx M : ℕ) : Type :=
  Fin N_idx × Fin 2 × Fin (M + 1) × Fin (M + 1)

noncomputable def symJetEnv {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) (M : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) :
    SymJetVar N_idx M → ℂ :=
  fun v =>
    iterDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1
      (fun r : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C (r.1 + (q_idx v.1 : ℂ) * r.2) r.2 v.2.1) p

def PolyReflectionProp {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (s_b r_b : ℝ) (K : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (N_idx M D : ℕ) (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
    (Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
    (∀ a : Fin N_idx, (q_idx a ≤ 0 ∨ K < (q_idx a).natAbs) ∧
      ∃ b : Fin N_idx, q_idx b = -q_idx a) →
    let J_bound : ℝ := ((Finset.univ.sup fun a : Fin N_idx => (q_idx a).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2
    let V_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_b / 2 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_b ∧ |p.2.im| < s_b / (2 * J_bound) }
    (∀ p ∈ V_dom,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (Q d) *
          (glancingDualLine C (p.1 + p.2) p.2 ι_star) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) →
    (∀ p ∈ V_dom,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (Q d) *
          (glancingDualLine C (p.1 - p.2) p.2 ι_star) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0)

noncomputable def expSlope_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    deriv W (X + (s : ℂ) * y) * Complex.exp (W (X + (s : ℂ) * y) - W X)

noncomputable def midStepOp_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X T ζ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  T *
    ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, (v : ℂ) * expSlope_C W X ((v : ℂ) * T)) -
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ζ) ^ 2 *
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (θ : ℂ) * expSlope_C W X ((θ : ℂ) * T * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ζ))))

noncomputable def zetaSeq_C (W X T : ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, z => midStepOp_C W (X z) (T z) (zetaSeq_C W X T n z)

noncomputable def zetaLim_C (W X T : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => zetaSeq_C W X T n z)

noncomputable def zMid_C (W X T : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) + zetaLim_C W X T z

noncomputable def midCanon_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (e_X τ_T : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let X : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ζ + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X ζ
  let T : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + τ_T ζ
  X z + T z * zMid_C W X T z

noncomputable def aCanon_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (Z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (7 * iteratedDeriv 2 W Z - 8 * (iteratedDeriv 1 W Z) ^ 2 - Complex.exp (2 * W Z)) / 384

noncomputable def rG_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
      ((iteratedDeriv 3 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) +
          3 * iteratedDeriv 1 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) * iteratedDeriv 2 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) +
          (iteratedDeriv 1 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y)) ^ 3) *
        Complex.exp (W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) - W X₀))

noncomputable def rH_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
      ((-2 * iteratedDeriv 3 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) +
          12 * iteratedDeriv 1 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) * iteratedDeriv 2 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) -
          8 * (iteratedDeriv 1 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y)) ^ 3) *
        Complex.exp (-2 * (W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) - W X₀)))

noncomputable def rSinc_C (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    (r : ℂ) ^ 3 *
      (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.sin (((s * r : ℝ) : ℂ) * u))

noncomputable def mFactor_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ T₀ z₀ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let α₀ := iteratedDeriv 1 W X₀
  let β₀ := iteratedDeriv 2 W X₀
  let z_jet := (1 / 2 : ℂ) + (α₀ / 8) * T₀ + (β₀ / 16) * T₀ ^ 2
  1 + (α₀ / 2) * T₀ * (z₀ + z_jet) +
    ((β₀ + α₀ ^ 2) / 6) * T₀ ^ 2 * (z₀ ^ 2 + z₀ * z_jet + z_jet ^ 2)

noncomputable def rZ_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ T₀ z₀ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let α₀ := iteratedDeriv 1 W X₀
  let β₀ := iteratedDeriv 2 W X₀
  let u_z := α₀ / 8 + (β₀ / 16) * T₀
  let Q_jet :=
    α₀ * β₀ / 32 + (α₀ / 2) * u_z ^ 2 +
      ((β₀ + α₀ ^ 2) / 6) *
        ((3 / 4 : ℂ) * u_z + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * T₀ * u_z ^ 2 + T₀ ^ 2 * u_z ^ 3)
  let R_L := ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (θ : ℂ) ^ 3 * rG_C W X₀ ((θ : ℂ) * T₀ * z₀)
  let R_R := (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, (v : ℂ) ^ 3 * rG_C W X₀ ((v : ℂ) * T₀)
  (R_R - z₀ ^ 4 * R_L - Q_jet) / mFactor_C W X₀ T₀ z₀

noncomputable def rK_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let α₀ := iteratedDeriv 1 W X₀
  let β₀ := iteratedDeriv 2 W X₀
  let A₀ := Complex.exp (W X₀)
  let p₁ := α₀ / 2
  let p₂ := (β₀ + α₀ ^ 2) / 6
  let R₁ := ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (s : ℂ) ^ 3 * rG_C W X₀ ((s : ℂ) * y)
  let G₁ := 1 + p₁ * y + p₂ * y ^ 2 + y ^ 3 * R₁
  let q₂ := -(A₀ ^ 2) / 6
  let R₂ :=
    q₂ * (p₁ + p₂ * y + y ^ 2 * R₁) * (G₁ + 1) +
      A₀ ^ 3 * G₁ ^ 3 * rSinc_C (A₀ * y * G₁)
  let h₁ := -2 * α₀
  let h₂ := 2 * α₀ ^ 2 - β₀
  let m₁ := p₁
  let m₂ := p₂ + q₂
  let R_m := p₁ * q₂ + p₂ * q₂ * y + R₂ * G₁ + R₁ * (1 + q₂ * y ^ 2)
  let M_val := 1 + m₁ * y + m₂ * y ^ 2 + y ^ 3 * R_m
  m₁ * h₂ + m₂ * h₁ + m₂ * h₂ * y +
    rH_C W X₀ y * M_val + R_m * (1 + h₁ * y + h₂ * y ^ 2)

noncomputable def rI_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ H : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (τ : ℂ) ^ 4 * rK_C W X₀ ((τ : ℂ) * H)

noncomputable def bPoint_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ T₀ z₀ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let α₀ := iteratedDeriv 1 W X₀
  let β₀ := iteratedDeriv 2 W X₀
  let A₀ := Complex.exp (W X₀)
  let r_z := rZ_C W X₀ T₀ z₀
  let c₂ := (7 * α₀ ^ 2 - 5 * β₀ - A₀ ^ 2) / 24
  let v_z := β₀ / 16 + T₀ * r_z
  let w_z := α₀ / 8 + T₀ * v_z
  ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * r_z + (α₀ / 8) * v_z + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * T₀ * v_z ^ 2) -
    ((3 * α₀ / 8) * v_z + (3 * α₀ / 4) * w_z ^ 2 + (α₀ / 2) * T₀ * w_z ^ 3) +
    c₂ *
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * w_z + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * T₀ * w_z ^ 2 +
        2 * T₀ ^ 2 * w_z ^ 3 + T₀ ^ 3 * w_z ^ 4) +
    z₀ ^ 5 * rI_C W X₀ (T₀ * z₀)

noncomputable def bCanon_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (ρ sgn : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (e_X τ_T : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let X : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ζ + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X ζ
  let T : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ((sgn * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) + τ_T ζ
  bPoint_C W (X z) (T z) (zMid_C W X T z)

noncomputable def shjCompConst : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | p + 1, B => max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * max B 0 * shjCompConst p B)

def IsStripBounded (p : ℕ) (σ' M : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv k f z‖ ≤ M

def IsStripHoloSymBounded (p : ℕ) (σ' M : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsStripBounded p σ' M f ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f (z + 2 * Real.pi) = f z) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (f z))

structure StripCalculusToolkit : Prop where
  vert_strip_maps_to : ∀ (σ σ' α ρ : ℝ) (e : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    0 < σ' →
    0 ≤ α →
    σ' ≤ (1 - 2 * α) * σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ e (horizStrip σ') →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', e (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (e z)) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖deriv e z‖ ≤ α) →
    ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', z + (ρ : ℂ) + e z ∈ horizStrip σ
  stripExt_iteratedDeriv_props : ∀ (r₀ d : ℕ) (σ M₁ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w W →
    d ≤ r₀ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv d W) (horizStrip σ) ∧
    (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ, iteratedDeriv d W (ζ + 2 * Real.pi) = iteratedDeriv d W ζ) ∧
    (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
      iteratedDeriv d W (starRingEnd ℂ ζ) = starRingEnd ℂ (iteratedDeriv d W ζ)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j + d ≤ r₀ → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv j (iteratedDeriv d W) ζ‖ ≤ M₁)
  stripDiffSup_nonneg_and_le : ∀ (r₀ : ℕ) (σ M₁ : ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →
    0 ≤ stripDiffSup r₀ σ W₁ W₂ ∧
    ∀ (j d : ℕ), j + d ≤ r₀ → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun z => iteratedDeriv d W₁ z - iteratedDeriv d W₂ z) ζ‖ ≤
        stripDiffSup r₀ σ W₁ W₂
  real_iteratedDeriv_eq : ∀ (r₀ : ℕ) (σ M₁ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded r₀ M₁ w →
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w W →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ r₀ → ∀ r : ℝ, iteratedDeriv k W (r : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k w r : ℝ) : ℂ)
  bounded_const : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' : ℝ) (c : ℂ),
    IsStripBounded p σ' ‖c‖ (fun _ => c)
  holo_const_real : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' c : ℝ),
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' |c| (fun _ => (c : ℂ))
  bounded_mono : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    M₁ ≤ M₂ → IsStripBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripBounded p σ' M₂ f
  holo_mono : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    M₁ ≤ M₂ → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₂ f
  bounded_add : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripBounded p σ' M₂ g →
    IsStripBounded p σ' (M₁ + M₂) (fun z => f z + g z)
  holo_add : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₂ g →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' (M₁ + M₂) (fun z => f z + g z)
  bounded_sub : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripBounded p σ' M₂ g →
    IsStripBounded p σ' (M₁ + M₂) (fun z => f z - g z)
  holo_sub : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₂ g →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' (M₁ + M₂) (fun z => f z - g z)
  bounded_neg : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripBounded p σ' M f → IsStripBounded p σ' M (fun z => -f z)
  holo_neg : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M f → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M (fun z => -f z)
  bounded_const_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M : ℝ} (c : ℂ) {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    0 ≤ M → IsStripBounded p σ' M f →
    IsStripBounded p σ' (‖c‖ * M) (fun z => c * f z)
  holo_real_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M : ℝ} (c : ℝ) {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    0 ≤ M → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M f →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' (|c| * M) (fun z => (c : ℂ) * f z)
  bounded_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripBounded p σ' M₂ g →
    IsStripBounded p σ' ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * M₁ * M₂) (fun z => f z * g z)
  holo_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₂ g →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * M₁ * M₂) (fun z => f z * g z)
  bounded_mul_diff : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M_f M_g Δf Δg : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripBounded p σ' M_f f₁ →
    IsStripBounded p σ' M_g g₂ →
    IsStripBounded p σ' Δf (fun z => f₁ z - f₂ z) →
    IsStripBounded p σ' Δg (fun z => g₁ z - g₂ z) →
    IsStripBounded p σ' ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (M_f * Δg + Δf * M_g))
      (fun z => f₁ z * g₁ z - f₂ z * g₂ z)
  holo_inv : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M_g : ℝ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
    0 ≤ M_g →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M_g g →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖g z - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ'
      ((((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2)) * shjCompConst p M_g)
      (fun z => (g z)⁻¹)
  bounded_inv_diff : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M_g Δg : ℝ} {g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
    0 ≤ M_g →
    0 ≤ Δg →
    IsStripBounded p σ' M_g g₁ →
    IsStripBounded p σ' M_g g₂ →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖g₁ z - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖g₂ z - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
    IsStripBounded p σ' Δg (fun z => g₁ z - g₂ z) →
    IsStripBounded p σ'
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2)) * shjCompConst p M_g * Δg)
      (fun z => (g₁ z)⁻¹ - (g₂ z)⁻¹)
  exp_ball_bound : ∀ (R : ℝ),
    0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Complex.exp (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) ∧
    (∀ w : ℂ, Complex.exp (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (Complex.exp w)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖iteratedDeriv j Complex.exp w‖ ≤ Real.exp R)
  sin_ball_bound : ∀ (R : ℝ),
    0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Complex.sin (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) ∧
    (∀ w : ℂ, Complex.sin (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (Complex.sin w)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖iteratedDeriv j Complex.sin w‖ ≤ Real.exp R)
  comp_bound : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' M_G B : ℝ) (V : Set ℂ) (G f : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen V →
    0 ≤ M_G →
    0 ≤ B →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G V →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv j G w‖ ≤ M_G) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f z ∈ V) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv j f z‖ ≤ B) →
    IsStripBounded p σ' (M_G * shjCompConst p B) (fun z => G (f z))
  comp_diff_bound : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' M_G ΔG B Δf : ℝ) (V : Set ℂ) (G₁ G₂ f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen V →
    Convex ℝ V →
    0 ≤ M_G →
    0 ≤ ΔG →
    0 ≤ B →
    0 ≤ Δf →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G₁ V →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G₂ V →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ => G₁ ζ - G₂ ζ) w‖ ≤ ΔG) →

noncomputable def realJetA (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (7 * iteratedDeriv 2 w X - 8 * (iteratedDeriv 1 w X) ^ 2 - Real.exp (2 * w X)) / 384

noncomputable def realActE (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 =>
      let μ := midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
      Real.exp (2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w μ)
  | 1 =>
      let μ := midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
      let μ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w μ)
      let L₀ := 2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w μ
      let L₁ := iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u) - 3 * iteratedDeriv 1 w μ * μ₁
      L₁ * Real.exp L₀
  | 2 =>
      let μ := midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
      let μ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w μ)
      let w₁_u := iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u)
      let w₁_μ := iteratedDeriv 1 w μ
      let μ₂ := μ₁ * (w₁_u - w₁_μ * μ₁)
      let L₀ := 2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w μ
      let L₁ := w₁_u - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₁
      let L₂ := iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u) - 3 * iteratedDeriv 2 w μ * μ₁ ^ 2 - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₂
      (L₂ + L₁ ^ 2) * Real.exp L₀
  | 3 =>
      let μ := midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
      let μ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w μ)
      let w₁_u := iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u)
      let w₂_u := iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u)
      let w₃_u := iteratedDeriv 3 w (X + u)
      let w₁_μ := iteratedDeriv 1 w μ
      let w₂_μ := iteratedDeriv 2 w μ
      let w₃_μ := iteratedDeriv 3 w μ
      let μ₂ := μ₁ * (w₁_u - w₁_μ * μ₁)
      let μ₃ := μ₂ * (w₁_u - w₁_μ * μ₁) + μ₁ * (w₂_u - w₂_μ * μ₁ ^ 2 - w₁_μ * μ₂)
      let L₀ := 2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w μ
      let L₁ := w₁_u - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₁
      let L₂ := w₂_u - 3 * w₂_μ * μ₁ ^ 2 - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₂
      let L₃ := w₃_u - 3 * w₃_μ * μ₁ ^ 3 - 9 * w₂_μ * μ₁ * μ₂ - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₃
      (L₃ + 3 * L₁ * L₂ + L₁ ^ 3) * Real.exp L₀
  | _ + 4 => 0

noncomputable def realActG (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X)
  | 1 => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      s * (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u) * Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X))
  | 2 => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      s ^ 2 * ((iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + s * u) + (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u)) ^ 2) *
        Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X))
  | 3 => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      s ^ 3 * ((iteratedDeriv 3 w (X + s * u) +
        3 * iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u) * iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + s * u) +
        (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u)) ^ 3) * Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X))
  | _ + 4 => 0

noncomputable def realActS (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 =>
      let ψ₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
      ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.cos (r * ψ₀)
  | 1 =>
      let ψ₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
      let ψ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u))
      let sc₁ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r * Real.sin (r * ψ₀))
      sc₁ * ψ₁
  | 2 =>
      let ψ₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
      let e_u := Real.exp (w (X + u))
      let ψ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * e_u
      let ψ₂ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u) * e_u
      let sc₁ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r * Real.sin (r * ψ₀))
      let sc₂ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r ^ 2 * Real.cos (r * ψ₀))
      sc₂ * ψ₁ ^ 2 + sc₁ * ψ₂
  | 3 =>
      let ψ₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
      let e_u := Real.exp (w (X + u))
      let w₁_u := iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u)
      let w₂_u := iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u)
      let ψ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * e_u
      let ψ₂ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * w₁_u * e_u
      let ψ₃ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (w₂_u + w₁_u ^ 2) * e_u
      let sc₁ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r * Real.sin (r * ψ₀))
      let sc₂ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r ^ 2 * Real.cos (r * ψ₀))
      let sc₃ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, r ^ 3 * Real.sin (r * ψ₀)
      sc₃ * ψ₁ ^ 3 + 3 * sc₂ * ψ₁ * ψ₂ + sc₁ * ψ₃
  | _ + 4 => 0

noncomputable def realActionH0 (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (realActE w X u 0 * realActG w X u 0 * realActS w X u 0)

noncomputable def realActionH3 (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let E := realActE w X u
  let G := realActG w X u
  let S := realActS w X u
  (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
    (E 3 * G 0 * S 0 + E 0 * G 3 * S 0 + E 0 * G 0 * S 3 +
      3 * (E 2 * G 1 * S 0 + E 2 * G 0 * S 1 + E 1 * G 2 * S 0 +
        E 0 * G 2 * S 1 + E 1 * G 0 * S 2 + E 0 * G 1 * S 2) +
      6 * (E 1 * G 1 * S 1))

noncomputable def realJetB (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, r ^ 4 *
    (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - τ) ^ 2 * realActionH3 w X (τ * r * T))

noncomputable def realMidpointDispU (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X T : ℝ → ℝ) (u_param x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpoint_ℝ w (X x) (X x + u_param * T x) - (X x + u_param * T x / 2)

structure RealActionTaylorData (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  primPhi_hasDerivAt : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (primPhi_ℝ w) (Real.exp (w z)) z
  primPhi_strictMono : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    StrictMono (primPhi_ℝ w)
  primPhi_contDiff : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ContDiff ℝ ((m + 16 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (primPhi_ℝ w)
  invPrimPhi_contDiff : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ContDiff ℝ ((m + 16 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w))
  invPrimPhi_hasDerivAt : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w))
      (Real.exp (-w (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w) y))) y
  midpoint_eq : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ X Y : ℝ, primPhi_ℝ w (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) = (primPhi_ℝ w X + primPhi_ℝ w Y) / 2
  midpoint_diag_periodic : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ X Y : ℝ, midpoint_ℝ w (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) =
      midpoint_ℝ w X Y + 2 * Real.pi
  action_factor : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ X T : ℝ, normAction1_ℝ w X (X + T) =
      T ^ 2 * (1 / 8 + realJetA w X * T ^ 2 + T ^ 3 * realJetB w X T)
  diff_global_bound : ∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    0 ≤ realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m + 15 → ∀ z : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv j (fun y => w₁ y - w₂ y) z| ≤ realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂

structure RealMidpointDispData (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  C_mid_R : ℝ
  N_mid : ℕ
  C_mid_R_pos : 0 < C_mid_R
  N_mid_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_mid
  midpoint_u_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ c_T : ℝ) (w e_X τ_T : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_mid ≤ q →
    |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
    let X : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X x
    let T : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => c_T + τ_T x
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (realMidpointDispU w X T p.1) p.2)) ∧
    ∀ u_param ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Function.Periodic (realMidpointDispU w X T u_param) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (realMidpointDispU w X T u_param) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |iteratedDeriv k (realMidpointDispU w X T u_param) x| ≤ C_mid_R
  midpoint_u_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ c_T Δe Δτ u_param : ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ)
      (e_X₁ τ_T₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_mid ≤ q →
    |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) →
    u_param ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    0 ≤ Δe →
    0 ≤ Δτ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₁ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₁ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₂ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₂ →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => e_X₁ y - e_X₂ y) x| ≤ Δe) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => τ_T₁ y - τ_T₂ y) x| ≤ Δτ) →
    let X₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X₁ x
    let T₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => c_T + τ_T₁ x
    let X₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X₂ x
    let T₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => c_T + τ_T₂ x
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        |iteratedDeriv k
          (fun y =>
            realMidpointDispU w₁ X₁ T₁ u_param y -
              realMidpointDispU w₂ X₂ T₂ u_param y) x| ≤
        C_mid_R * (Δe + (q : ℝ) * Δτ + realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂)

structure RealActionJetCompData (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  C_jet_R : ℝ
  B₀_jet : ℝ
  L₀_jet : ℝ
  N_jet : ℕ
  C_jet_R_pos : 0 < C_jet_R
  B₀_jet_pos : 0 < B₀_jet
  L₀_jet_pos : 0 < L₀_jet
  N_jet_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_jet
  jet_pt_bounds : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ X₁ X₂ T₁ T₂ : ℝ, |T₁| ≤ 2 → |T₂| ≤ 2 →
      |realJetA w X₁| ≤ B₀_jet ∧
      |realJetB w X₁ T₁| ≤ B₀_jet ∧
      |realJetA w X₁ - realJetA w X₂| ≤ L₀_jet * |X₁ - X₂| ∧
      |realJetB w X₁ T₁ - realJetB w X₂ T₂| ≤ L₀_jet * (|X₁ - X₂| + |T₁ - T₂|)
  jet_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ sgn : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (e_X τ_T : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_jet ≤ q →
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
    let X : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X x
    let T : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => sgn * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) + τ_T x
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) C_jet_R (fun x => realJetA w (X x)) ∧
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) C_jet_R (fun x => realJetB w (X x) (T x))
  jet_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ sgn Δe Δτ : ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ)
      (e_X₁ τ_T₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_jet ≤ q →
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
    0 ≤ Δe →
    0 ≤ Δτ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₁ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₁ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₂ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₂ →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => e_X₁ y - e_X₂ y) x| ≤ Δe) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => τ_T₁ y - τ_T₂ y) x| ≤ Δτ) →
    let X₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X₁ x
    let T₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => sgn * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) + τ_T₁ x
    let X₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X₂ x
    let T₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => sgn * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) + τ_T₂ x
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => realJetA w₁ (X₁ y) - realJetA w₂ (X₂ y)) x| ≤
        C_jet_R * (Δe + realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => realJetB w₁ (X₁ y) (T₁ y) - realJetB w₂ (X₂ y) (T₂ y)) x| ≤
        C_jet_R * (Δe + Δτ + realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂))

def pointChainBox {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < B.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < B.r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) }

abbrev PointJetAll : Type := Sum (Fin 2 × Fin 2 × ℕ × ℕ) ℕ

def pointJetEmb (M : ℕ) : PointJetVar M → PointJetAll
  | Sum.inl v => Sum.inl (v.1, v.2.1, v.2.2.1.1, v.2.2.2.1)
  | Sum.inr β => Sum.inr β.1

noncomputable def pointJetFnAll {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ) :
    PointJetAll → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  | Sum.inl v =>
      if v.1 = 0 then
        iterDerivYT v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 (fun q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 v.2.1)
      else
        iterDerivYT v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 (fun q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 v.2.1)
  | Sum.inr β =>
      fun p => iterDeriv1D β C.A p.2

noncomputable def pointBaseField {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Subfield ℂ :=
  Subfield.closure
    (((⊥ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪
      Set.range (fun v : PointJetAll => pointJetFnAll C k v (Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))))

def rotCoordX (rotIdx : Fin 4) (P : Fin 2 → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  match rotIdx with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => P 0
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => -P 0
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => P 1
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => -P 1

def rotCoordY (rotIdx : Fin 4) (P : Fin 2 → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  match rotIdx with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => P 1
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => -P 1
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => -P 0
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => P 0

def unrotPoint (rotIdx : Fin 4) (x Y : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  match rotIdx with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => ![x, Y]
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => ![-x, -Y]
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => ![-Y, x]
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => ![Y, -x]

noncomputable def sqrt1p (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (Complex.log (1 + u) / 2)

noncomputable def pointEdgeSq {k : ℕ} (F_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ)
    (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  (x_vec i.succ - x_vec i.castSucc) ^ 2 +
    (F_vec i.succ (x_vec i.succ) - F_vec i.castSucc (x_vec i.castSucc)) ^ 2

noncomputable def pointRelEdgeLen {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  ℓ_base i * sqrt1p ((pointEdgeSq F_vec x_vec i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2)

noncomputable def pointRelChainLen {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k, pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base F_vec x_vec i

noncomputable def pointRelInteriorGrad {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_vec F'_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) : ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let L_L := pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base F_vec x_vec i_L
  let L_R := pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base F_vec x_vec i_R
  ((x_vec i_L.succ - x_vec i_L.castSucc) +
      (F_vec i_L.succ (x_vec i_L.succ) - F_vec i_L.castSucc (x_vec i_L.castSucc)) *
        F'_vec i_L.succ (x_vec i_L.succ)) / L_L -
    ((x_vec i_R.succ - x_vec i_R.castSucc) +
      (F_vec i_R.succ (x_vec i_R.succ) - F_vec i_R.castSucc (x_vec i_R.castSucc)) *
        F'_vec i_R.castSucc (x_vec i_R.castSucc)) / L_R

noncomputable def pointInteriorHess {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F F' F'' : ℂ → ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let Δx_L := x_vec i_L.succ - x_vec i_L.castSucc
    let ΔY_L := F (x_vec i_L.succ) - F (x_vec i_L.castSucc)
    let L_L := ℓ_base i_L
    let n_L_succ := Δx_L + ΔY_L * F' (x_vec i_L.succ)
    let n_L_cast := Δx_L + ΔY_L * F' (x_vec i_L.castSucc)
    let Δx_R := x_vec i_R.succ - x_vec i_R.castSucc
    let ΔY_R := F (x_vec i_R.succ) - F (x_vec i_R.castSucc)
    let L_R := ℓ_base i_R
    let n_R_cast := Δx_R + ΔY_R * F' (x_vec i_R.castSucc)
    let n_R_succ := Δx_R + ΔY_R * F' (x_vec i_R.succ)
    if r.1 = s.1 then
      (((1 + F' (x_vec i_L.succ) ^ 2 + ΔY_L * F'' (x_vec i_L.succ)) * L_L ^ 2 -
          n_L_succ ^ 2) / L_L ^ 3) +
      (((1 + F' (x_vec i_R.castSucc) ^ 2 - ΔY_R * F'' (x_vec i_R.castSucc)) * L_R ^ 2 -
          n_R_cast ^ 2) / L_R ^ 3)
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
      ((-1 - F' (x_vec i_R.succ) * F' (x_vec i_R.castSucc)) * L_R ^ 2 +
        n_R_cast * n_R_succ) / L_R ^ 3
    else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
      ((-1 - F' (x_vec i_L.castSucc) * F' (x_vec i_L.succ)) * L_L ^ 2 +
        n_L_succ * n_L_cast) / L_L ^ 3
    else
      0

noncomputable def pointChartACoord {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rotCoordX rotIdx (glancingImpact C p.1 p.2)

noncomputable def pointChartBCoord {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rotCoordX rotIdx (glancingImpact C (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2) p.2)

noncomputable def pointChartDetAB {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iterDerivYT 1 0 (pointChartACoord C rotIdx) p *
      iterDerivYT 0 1 (pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx) p -
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (pointChartACoord C rotIdx) p *
      iterDerivYT 1 0 (pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx) p

noncomputable def pointChartX {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rotCoordX rotIdx (glancingImpact C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2)

noncomputable def pointChartAction {k : ℕ} (ℓ_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k, ℓ_fn i q

noncomputable def pointChartActionAB {k : ℕ} (ℓ_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q_ab : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  pointChartAction ℓ_fn (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1)

noncomputable def pointChartPsiWeb {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if h : r.1 < k - 1 then
    pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ q
  else if r.1 = k - 1 then
    q.1
  else
    q.1 + q.2

noncomputable def pointChartWWeb {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (F : ℂ → ℂ) (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (ℓ_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if h : r.1 < k - 1 then
    (F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ q) -
        F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1, by omega⟩ q)) /
      ℓ_fn ⟨r.1, by omega⟩ q -
    (F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1 + 2, by omega⟩ q) -
        F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ q)) /
      ℓ_fn ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ q
  else
    -1

structure PointGlancingChartData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) where
  rotIdx : Fin 4
  a₀ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  δ_star : ℝ
  C₀ : ℝ
  R_pos : 0 < R
  δ_star_pos : 0 < δ_star
  C₀_pos : 0 < C₀
  C₀_δ_star_lt : C₀ * δ_star < R / 2
  W_F : Set ℂ
  F : ℂ → ℂ
  W_F_open : IsOpen W_F
  W_F_preconn : IsPreconnected W_F
  F_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_F
  F_real : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - a₀| < R + 2 * δ_star →
    (x : ℂ) ∈ W_F ∧ (F (x : ℂ)).im = 0
  F_curv_real : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - a₀| < R →
    deriv (deriv F) (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ v_x : ℝ, deriv F (x : ℂ) = (v_x : ℂ)
  V_W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  ℓ_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  V_W_open : IsOpen V_W
  V_W_nonempty : V_W.Nonempty
  V_W_sub : V_W ⊆ pointChainBox C B k
  Ψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ
    (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star))
  Ψ_maps_V_W : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    Ψ q ∈ V_W
  Φ_left_inv : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    pointChartACoord C rotIdx (Ψ q) = q.1 ∧
    pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx (Ψ q) - pointChartACoord C rotIdx (Ψ q) = q.2
  Φ_right_inv : ∀ p ∈ V_W,
    (pointChartACoord C rotIdx p,
      pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx p - pointChartACoord C rotIdx p) ∈
      Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star) ∧
    Ψ (pointChartACoord C rotIdx p,
      pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx p - pointChartACoord C rotIdx p) = p
  det_ab_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ V_W, pointChartDetAB C k rotIdx p ≠ 0
  x_endpoints : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ 0 q = q.1 ∧
    pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ (Fin.last k) q = q.1 + q.2
  x_holo_maps : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r)
      (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r q ∈ W_F ∧
      rotCoordY rotIdx (glancingImpact C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2) =
        F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r q)
  ℓ_holo_sq : ∀ i : Fin k,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℓ_fn i)
      (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      (ℓ_fn i q) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (fun r => pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r q) i
  symplectic_mixed_deriv : ∀ q_ab : ℂ × ℂ,
    (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1) ∈
      Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star) →
    iterDerivYT 1 1 (pointChartActionAB ℓ_fn) q_ab =
      C.A (Ψ (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1)).2 /
        pointChartDetAB C k rotIdx (Ψ (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1))
  stationary_on_nondeg :
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      (∀ i : Fin k, ℓ_fn i q ≠ 0) →
      ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
        pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => ℓ_fn i q) (fun _ => F) (fun _ => deriv F)
          (fun s => pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ s q) r = 0
  x_at_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ a : ℝ, |a - a₀| < R →
    pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r ((a : ℂ), 0) = (a : ℂ) ∧
    deriv (fun z : ℂ => pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r ((a : ℂ), z)) 0 = ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
  ψ_web_base : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star,
    (pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0 ∧
    |(pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re - q.1| ≤ C₀ * q.2 ∧
    1 / 2 ≤
      (deriv (fun z : ℂ => pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)).re
  trapezoid_nondeg : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀,
    (Ψ ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).1.im = 0 ∧
    (Ψ ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).2.im = 0 ∧
    0 < (Ψ ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).2.re ∧
    (Ψ ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).2.re < B.r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k,
      0 < (ℓ_fn i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re ∧
      (ℓ_fn i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
      pointChartWWeb C k rotIdx F Ψ ℓ_fn r ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ≠ 0) ∧
    Function.Injective (fun r : Fin (k + 1) =>
      deriv (fun z : ℂ => pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r ((q.1 : ℂ), z)) (q.2 : ℂ) /
        deriv (fun z : ℂ => pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)) ∧
    (pointInteriorHess (fun i => ℓ_fn i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))) F (deriv F)
      (deriv (deriv F))
      (fun s => pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ s ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)))).det ≠ 0

structure PointCoreEliminationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)

  N_core : ℕ
  coreTuple : Fin N_core → ℂ
  endpoint_graph_jets_mem_K_pt : ∀ m : ℕ,
    iteratedDeriv m G.F (a₁ : ℂ) ∈ pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ ∧
    iteratedDeriv m G.F ((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁
  action_mixed_ab_mem_K_pt : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, 1 ≤ d 0 → 1 ≤ d 1 →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D G.A_point_ab ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁
  abscissa_mem_F_val : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  chord_len_mem_F_val : ∀ i : Fin k,
    G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  graph_jets_mem_F_val : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (m : ℕ),
    iteratedDeriv m G.F (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  abscissa_ab_taylor_mem_F_val : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d
      (centeredTaylor2D (fun q_ab => G.x_fn r (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1))
        ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  action_ab_taylor_mem_F_val : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ,
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D G.A_point_ab ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  core_entries_subset :

        (∃ r : Fin (k + 1), z = G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∨

structure PointTruncatedCoalescingModel (k p J : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) where
  W_n : Set ℂ
  W_n_open : IsOpen W_n
  a_mem : (a : ℂ) ∈ W_n
  F_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_n
  g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  g_holo : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g r l) W_n
  g_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (z : ℂ), g 0 l z = 0 ∧ g (Fin.last k) l z = 0
  g_lt_p : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < p → ∀ z ∈ W_n, g r l z = 0
  g_at_p : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (hpJ : p < J + 1), g r ⟨p, hpJ⟩ (a : ℂ) = f_p r
  U_split : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  V_split : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  UV_holo : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (U_split l) W_n ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (V_split l) W_n
  δ₀ : ℝ
  δ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀
  x₀ : ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  ℓ₀ : ℝ → Fin k → ℂ
  β : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  β_zero : ∀ (δ : ℝ) (r : Fin (k + 1)), β 0 δ r = 0
  x₀_endpoints : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀,
    x₀ δ 0 = (a : ℂ) ∧ x₀ δ (Fin.last k) = (a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ)
  β_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (δ : ℝ),
    β l δ 0 = 0 ∧ β l δ (Fin.last k) = 0
  x₀_real : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), (x₀ δ r).im = 0
  x₀_tendsto : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (x₀ δ r - (a : ℂ)) / (δ : ℂ))
      (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)))
  x₀_maps_W_n : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀,
    (a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ) ∈ W_n ∧ ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), x₀ δ r ∈ W_n
  ℓ₀_pos : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ i : Fin k,
    0 < (ℓ₀ δ i).re ∧ (ℓ₀ δ i).im = 0 ∧ (ℓ₀ δ i) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (x₀ δ) i
  x₀_stat : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    pointRelInteriorGrad (ℓ₀ δ) (fun _ => F) (fun _ => deriv F) (x₀ δ) r = 0
  grad_jet_zero : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ J →
    iteratedDeriv l
      (fun ε : ℂ =>
        pointRelInteriorGrad (ℓ₀ δ)
          (fun m z => F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * g m q z)
          (fun m z => deriv F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g m q) z)
          (fun m => x₀ δ m + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β q δ m)
          r)
      0 = 0
  len_jet_split : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    iteratedDeriv (l : ℕ)
      (fun ε : ℂ =>
        pointRelChainLen (ℓ₀ δ)
          (fun m z => F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * g m q z)
          (fun m => x₀ δ m + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β q δ m))
      0 / ((l : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) =
      U_split l (a : ℂ) + V_split l ((a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ))

structure PointContinuedDeformationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  p : ℕ
  p_pos : 1 ≤ p
  f_lead : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ
  r₀ : Fin (k - 1)
  f_lead_r₀_ne_zero : f_lead ⟨r₀.1 + 1, by have := r₀.2; omega⟩ ≠ 0
  W_lead : Set ℂ
  W_lead_open : IsOpen W_lead
  W_lead_preconn : IsPreconnected W_lead
  real_mem_W_lead : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - G.a₀| < G.R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_lead
  g_lead : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  g_lead_endpoints : ∀ z : ℂ, g_lead 0 z = 0 ∧ g_lead (Fin.last k) z = 0
  g_lead_holo : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_lead r) W_lead
  g_lead_taylor : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    G.x_fn ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ W_lead ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv n (g_lead ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)
        (G.x_fn ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) / (n.factorial : ℂ) =
        PowerSeries.coeff n (f_lead ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)
  trunc_models : ∀ J : ℕ, p ≤ J → ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioo (G.a₀ - G.R) (G.a₀ + G.R),
    Nonempty (PointTruncatedCoalescingModel k p J a G.F (fun r => g_lead r (a : ℂ)))

noncomputable def hcShiftPerturb (ρ : ℝ) (e : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  x + ρ + e x

noncomputable def hcShiftInv (ρ : ℝ) (e : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Function.invFun (hcShiftPerturb ρ e) z

noncomputable def hcShiftInvDisp (ρ : ℝ) (e : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  hcShiftInv ρ e z - (z - ρ)

def IsHcBoundedPeriodicPair (p : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (A B : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Function.Periodic A (2 * Real.pi) ∧
  Function.Periodic B (2 * Real.pi) ∧
  ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) A ∧
  ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) B ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k A x| ≤ ε ∧ |iteratedDeriv k B x| ≤ ε

def rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple (p q : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  d 0 = 0 ∧
  d q = 0 ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, q < j → d j = 0) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → IsRealJetPerturb p (B / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (d j)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
    IsRealJetPerturb p (B / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) (fun x : ℝ => d (j + 1) x - d j x))

noncomputable def rdmc_dirichletPrefix (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, f (i + 1) x

noncomputable def rdmc_dirichletSlope0 (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(q : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, rdmc_dirichletPrefix f r x

noncomputable def rdmc_dirichletInv (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if j ≤ q then
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, (rdmc_dirichletSlope0 q f x + rdmc_dirichletPrefix f r x)
  else 0

noncomputable def rdmc_elForcing {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_R : RealJetAndUniquenessData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (i : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  match i with
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 =>
    if j + 1 < q then
      let X : ℝ := x + 2 * Real.pi * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + d (j + 1) x;
      let τ_t : ℝ := d (j + 2) x - d (j + 1) x;
      let τ_s : ℝ := d (j + 1) x - d j x;
      let t : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + τ_t;
      let s : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + τ_s;
      let g₁ : ℝ := ((q : ℝ) / (4 * Real.pi)) * (τ_t + τ_s);
      let g₂ : ℝ := 8 * (t ^ 2 + s ^ 2) * J_R.a_R w X;
      (-(2 * (q : ℝ) / Real.pi)) *
        ((t ^ 5 * J_R.b_R w X t + s ^ 5 * J_R.b_R w X (-s)) *
          ((1 + g₁)⁻¹ * (1 + g₂)⁻¹))
    else 0

def IsStripCJetBounded (p : ℕ) (σ' B : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f (z + 2 * Real.pi) = f z) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (f z)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv k f z‖ ≤ B)

def IsStripMeshDispBall (p q : ℕ) (σ' R : ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  (∀ z : ℂ, d 0 z = 0 ∧ d q z = 0) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, q < j → ∀ z : ℂ, d j z = 0) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (d j) (horizStrip σ') ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', d j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = d j z) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', d j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (d j z)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (d j) z‖ ≤ R)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
    (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d (j + 1) ζ - d j ζ) z‖ ≤ R)

noncomputable def dirichletPartSum_ℂ (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, f (i + 1) z

noncomputable def dirichletSlope0_ℂ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -((q : ℂ)⁻¹) * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, dirichletPartSum_ℂ f r z

noncomputable def dirichletSlope_ℂ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  dirichletSlope0_ℂ q f z + dirichletPartSum_ℂ f r z

noncomputable def dirichletInv_ℂ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if j ≤ q then ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, dirichletSlope_ℂ q f r z else 0

noncomputable def stripForcingAt_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let ρ : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)
  let X : ℂ := z + (ρ : ℂ) + d (j + 1) z
  let τ_plus : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => d (j + 2) ζ - d (j + 1) ζ
  let τ_minus : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => d j ζ - d (j + 1) ζ
  let t : ℂ := ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + τ_plus z
  let s : ℂ := ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + (d (j + 1) z - d j z)
  let a_val : ℂ := J_C.a_C W X
  let b_plus : ℂ := J_C.b_C W ρ 1 q (d (j + 1)) τ_plus z
  let b_minus : ℂ := J_C.b_C W ρ (-1) q (d (j + 1)) τ_minus z
  (-(t ^ 5 * b_plus + s ^ 5 * b_minus)) /
    ((t + s) * (1 / 8 + (t ^ 2 + s ^ 2) * a_val))

noncomputable def stripMeshForcing_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 => if j + 1 < q then stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W d j else 0

noncomputable def stripMeshStep_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ :=
  dirichletInv_ℂ q (stripMeshForcing_ℂ J_C q W d)

noncomputable def stripMeshIter_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) :
    ℕ → (ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0 => fun _ _ => 0
  | n + 1 => stripMeshStep_ℂ J_C q W (stripMeshIter_ℂ J_C q W n)

noncomputable def stripCanonDisp_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if j ≤ q then Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => stripMeshIter_ℂ J_C q W n j z) else 0

noncomputable def stripCanonX_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if j ≤ q then
    z + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W j z
  else 0

noncomputable def stripCanonMu_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if j < q then
    J_C.mid_C W (2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)) q
      (stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W j)
      (fun ζ => stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W (j + 1) ζ - stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W j ζ) z
  else 0

structure StripDirichletInvProp : Prop where
  boundary_and_outside : ∀ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
    1 ≤ q →
    (∀ z : ℂ, dirichletInv_ℂ q f 0 z = 0 ∧ dirichletInv_ℂ q f q z = 0) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, q < j → ∀ z : ℂ, dirichletInv_ℂ q f j z = 0)
  diff_identities : ∀ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
    1 ≤ q →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ z : ℂ,
      dirichletInv_ℂ q f (j + 1) z - dirichletInv_ℂ q f j z = dirichletSlope_ℂ q f j z) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ∀ z : ℂ,
      dirichletInv_ℂ q f (j + 2) z - 2 * dirichletInv_ℂ q f (j + 1) z +
        dirichletInv_ℂ q f j z = f (j + 1) z)
  sub_eq : ∀ (q : ℕ) (f₁ f₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
    dirichletInv_ℂ q f₁ j z - dirichletInv_ℂ q f₂ j z =
      dirichletInv_ℂ q (fun i ζ => f₁ i ζ - f₂ i ζ) j z
  maps_to_ball : ∀ (p q : ℕ) (σ' M_f : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
    1 ≤ q →
    0 < σ' →
    0 ≤ M_f →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → IsStripCJetBounded p σ' M_f (f (j + 1))) →
    IsStripMeshDispBall p q σ' (2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 4 * M_f) (dirichletInv_ℂ q f)

structure StripForcingBoundData (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ)
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) where
  C_force : ℝ
  C_force_lip : ℝ
  N_force : ℕ
  C_force_pos : 0 < C_force
  C_force_lip_pos : 0 < C_force_lip
  N_force_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_force
  N_jet_le_N_force : J_C.N_jet_C ≤ N_force
  forcing_props : ∀ (σ σ' R : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    0 < R →
    N_force ≤ q →
    16 * R ≤ (q : ℝ) →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ (1 - (6 * R + J_C.K_eval) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w W →
    IsStripMeshDispBall (m + 2) q σ' R d →
    ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q →
      IsStripCJetBounded (m + 2) σ' (C_force / (q : ℝ) ^ 4)
        (stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W d j)
  real_stationary_of_sec_diff :
    ∀ (σ σ' R : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
      σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      0 < R →
      N_force ≤ q →
      16 * R ≤ (q : ℝ) →
      0 < σ' →
      σ' ≤ (1 - (6 * R + J_C.K_eval) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w W →
      IsStripMeshDispBall (m + 2) q σ' R d →
      ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ), j + 1 < q →
        d (j + 2) x - 2 * d (j + 1) x + d j x = stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W d j x →
        let X_r : ℕ → ℝ := fun r => x + 2 * Real.pi * (r : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + (d r x).re
        normAction1_ℝ w (X_r (j + 1)) (X_r (j + 2)) -
          normAction1_ℝ w (X_r (j + 1)) (X_r j) = 0
  forcing_lip :
    ∀ (σ σ' R Δ_star : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (d₁ d₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
      σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      0 < R →
      0 ≤ Δ_star →
      N_force ≤ q →
      16 * R ≤ (q : ℝ) →
      0 < σ' →
      σ' ≤ (1 - (6 * R + J_C.K_eval) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
      IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →
      IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →
      IsStripMeshDispBall (m + 2) q σ' R d₁ →
      IsStripMeshDispBall (m + 2) q σ' R d₂ →
      (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d₁ r ζ - d₂ r ζ) z‖ ≤ Δ_star) →
      (∀ r : ℕ, r < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
        (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ => (d₁ (r + 1) ζ - d₁ r ζ) - (d₂ (r + 1) ζ - d₂ r ζ)) z‖ ≤ Δ_star) →
      ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ =>
            stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W₁ d₁ j ζ - stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W₂ d₂ j ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_force_lip *
            (Δ_star / (q : ℝ) ^ 6 + stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ / (q : ℝ) ^ 4)

noncomputable def lineCoreIdx2D (a b : ℕ) : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ :=
  Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm ![a, b]

noncomputable def lineCoreDerivA (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) S

noncomputable def lineCoreDerivD (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + lineCoreIdx2D 0 1) S

noncomputable def lineCoreHoloTaylor1D (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun n => iteratedDeriv n g z₀ / (n.factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def lineCoreComp2D (F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a b) F *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b)

def lineCoreCoeffsIn (L : Subfield ℂ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, MvPowerSeries.coeff d S ∈ L

def lineCoreVanishesBelow (N : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 < N → MvPowerSeries.coeff d S = 0

structure LineCoreTaylor2DToolkit : Prop where
  iterDerivYT_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) U
  taylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀
  taylor2D_const : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c
  centeredTaylor2D_fst : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0
  centeredTaylor2D_snd : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1
  taylor2D_ring : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀
  deriv_taylor2D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
      lineCoreDerivA (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) p₀ ∧
      lineCoreDerivD (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) p₀
  taylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W_ψ : Set ℂ},
    IsOpen U → IsOpen W_ψ → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W_ψ → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W_ψ) →
      taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
        compPowerSeries2D (lineCoreHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀)
  taylor2D_comp_2D : ∀ {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f V → (∀ p ∈ U, Ψ p ∈ V) →
      taylor2D (fun p => f (Ψ p)) p₀ =
        lineCoreComp2D (taylor2D f (Ψ p₀))
          (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).1) p₀)
          (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).2) p₀)

structure LineCoreSubfieldSeriesToolkit : Prop where
  C_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {c : ℂ}, c ∈ L → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.C c)
  X_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) (s : Fin 2), lineCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.X s)

  sub_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    lineCoreCoeffsIn L S → lineCoreCoeffsIn L T → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (S - T)
  mul_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},

  derivA_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},

  derivD_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},

  comp1D_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {f : PowerSeries ℂ} {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},

  comp2D_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},

  pos_of_deriv_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},

  inv_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    S * T = 1 → lineCoreCoeffsIn L T → lineCoreCoeffsIn L S
  sqrt_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    S ^ 2 = T → lineCoreCoeffsIn L T → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 S ∈ L →

  mulVec_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} {x b : ι → ℂ},

    ∀ r : ι, x r ∈ L
  inv2D_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {Φ₁ Φ₂ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Φ₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Φ₂ = 0 →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ₂ = 0 →
    lineCoreCoeffsIn L Φ₁ → lineCoreCoeffsIn L Φ₂ →
    lineCoreComp2D Φ₁ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 →
    lineCoreComp2D Φ₂ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ = MvPowerSeries.X 1 →

  coeff_comp1D_pert : ∀ {n : ℕ}, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ)

    d 0 + d 1 = n → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₀ = 0 → lineCoreVanishesBelow n η →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D f (U₀ + η)) =
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D f U₀) +
        PowerSeries.coeff 1 f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d η
  coeff_mul_pert : ∀ {n : ℕ}, 1 ≤ n → ∀ {P P₀ Q Q₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ}
    {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
    d 0 + d 1 = n → lineCoreVanishesBelow n (P - P₀) → lineCoreVanishesBelow n (Q - Q₀) →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (P * Q) - MvPowerSeries.coeff d (P₀ * Q₀) =
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Q₀ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (P - P₀) +

  vanishesBelow_mul : ∀ {N₁ N₂ : ℕ} {A B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    lineCoreVanishesBelow N₁ A → lineCoreVanishesBelow N₂ B →
