  vanishesBelow_comp1D_taylor : ∀ {N₀ : ℕ}, 1 ≤ N₀ → ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ)
    {U₀ η : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₀ = 0 → lineCoreVanishesBelow N₀ η →
    lineCoreVanishesBelow (2 * N₀)
      (compPowerSeries2D f (U₀ + η) - compPowerSeries2D f U₀ -
        compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) U₀ * η)
  coeff_pow_linear : ∀ {M ν : ℕ}, 1 ≤ M → ν ≤ M → ∀ {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D (M - ν) ν) (U ^ M) =
      (M.choose ν : ℂ) * (MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) U) ^ (M - ν) *
        (MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D 0 1) U) ^ ν

noncomputable def lineCoreRadicals {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Fin 6 → ℂ :=
  let q₁ := Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  ![glancingOffset C q₁.1 q₁.2,
    glancingOffset C (q₁.1 + (k : ℂ) * q₁.2) q₁.2,
    Complex.cos ((a₁ : ℂ) / 2),
    Complex.sin ((a₁ : ℂ) / 2),
    Complex.cos (((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2),
    Complex.sin (((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2)]

noncomputable def lineCoreEndpointField {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Subfield ℂ :=
  Subfield.closure
    ((linePointField C k Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Set ℂ) ∪
      Set.range (lineCoreRadicals C k Ψ a₁ δ₁))

abbrev LineCoreIdx (k : ℕ) : Type :=
  Sum (Fin (k + 1) × Bool) (Fin k × Fin (max 2 k + 1))

noncomputable def lineCoreCard (k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Fintype.card (LineCoreIdx k)

noncomputable def lineCoreTuple {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Fin (lineCoreCard k) → ℂ :=
  fun idx =>
    match (Fintype.equivFin (LineCoreIdx k)).symm idx with
    | Sum.inl (r, false) => Complex.cos (G.α_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2)
    | Sum.inl (r, true) => Complex.sin (G.α_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2)
    | Sum.inr (i, m) => iteratedDeriv (m : ℕ) C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))

noncomputable def skrCos2 (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.cos ((t : ℂ) * u)

noncomputable def skrSinc (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.cos ((t : ℂ) * u)

noncomputable def skrRCos2 (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * (t : ℂ) ^ 2 * skrCos2 ((t : ℂ) * u)

noncomputable def skrRSinc (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (t : ℂ) ^ 2 * skrCos2 ((t : ℂ) * u)

noncomputable def skrExp1 (v : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * v)

noncomputable def skrSlopeW (W : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) (c : ℝ) (H : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (c : ℂ) * ∫ η in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv W (z + ((η * c : ℝ) : ℂ) * H)

noncomputable def skrKerRem1 (W : ℂ → ℂ) (τ : ℝ) (H z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let rI₁ : ℂ :=
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      let sw := skrSlopeW W z ((θ - 1) * τ) H
      sw * skrExp1 (H * sw)
  let I₁ : ℂ := 1 + H * rI₁
  let u₁ : ℂ := (τ : ℂ) * H * Complex.exp (W z) * I₁
  (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 *
    (2 * H * (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.exp (2 * W z) * I₁ ^ 4 * skrRCos2 u₁ +
      (I₁ + 1) * rI₁)

noncomputable def skrKerRem2Integrand (W : ℂ → ℂ) (τ β : ℝ) (H z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let γ : ℝ := τ + β * (1 - τ)
  let rI₂ : ℂ :=
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      let sw := skrSlopeW W z (θ * γ - τ) H
      sw * skrExp1 (H * sw)
  let I₂ : ℂ := 1 + H * rI₂
  let u₂ : ℂ := (γ : ℂ) * H * Complex.exp (W z) * I₂
  let rs : ℂ := ((γ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (W z) * I₂) ^ 2 * skrRSinc u₂
  let S₂ : ℂ := 1 + H ^ 2 * rs
  let sw_b : ℂ := -2 * skrSlopeW W z (β * (1 - τ)) H
  let rE₂ : ℂ := sw_b * skrExp1 (H * sw_b)
  let E₂ : ℂ := 1 + H * rE₂
  (γ : ℂ) * (rI₂ * S₂ * E₂ + H * rs * E₂ + rE₂)

noncomputable def skrKerRem (W : ℂ → ℂ) (τ : ℝ) (H z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  skrKerRem1 W τ H z -
    ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1, skrKerRem2Integrand W τ β H z

noncomputable def skrCompConst : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | p + 1, B => max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * max B 0 * skrCompConst p B)

def IsSkrStripBnd (p : ℕ) (σ' B : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv k f z‖ ≤ B

structure SkrCalcToolkit : Prop where
  horizStrip_open_convex : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) ∧ Convex ℝ (horizStrip H)
  mem_horizStrip_of_tau_seg : ∀ (σ τ c : ℝ) (z H : ℂ),
    τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    c ∈ Set.Icc (-τ) (1 - τ) →
    z - (τ : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
    z + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
    z + (c : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ
  stripExt_deriv_props : ∀ (r₀ d : ℕ) (σ M₁ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w W →
    d ≤ r₀ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv d W) (horizStrip σ) ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, j + d ≤ r₀ → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv j (iteratedDeriv d W) ζ‖ ≤ M₁
  stripDiffSup_nonneg_and_le : ∀ (r₀ : ℕ) (σ M₁ : ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →
    0 ≤ stripDiffSup r₀ σ W₁ W₂ ∧
    ∀ (j d : ℕ), j + d ≤ r₀ → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun z => iteratedDeriv d W₁ z - iteratedDeriv d W₂ z) ζ‖ ≤
        stripDiffSup r₀ σ W₁ W₂
  bnd_const : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' : ℝ) (c : ℂ),
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' ‖c‖ (fun _ => c)
  bnd_mono : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    B₁ ≤ B₂ → IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B₁ f → IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B₂ f
  bnd_add : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B₁ f → IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B₂ g →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' (B₁ + B₂) (fun z => f z + g z)
  bnd_sub : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B₁ f → IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B₂ g →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' (B₁ + B₂) (fun z => f z - g z)
  bnd_neg : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' B : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B f → IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B (fun z => -f z)
  bnd_const_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' B : ℝ} (c : ℂ) {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    0 ≤ B → IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B f →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' (‖c‖ * B) (fun z => c * f z)
  bnd_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B₁ f → IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B₂ g →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * B₁ * B₂) (fun z => f z * g z)
  bnd_mul_diff : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M_f M_g Δf Δg : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' M_f f₁ →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' M_g g₂ →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' Δf (fun z => f₁ z - f₂ z) →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' Δg (fun z => g₁ z - g₂ z) →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (M_f * Δg + Δf * M_g))
      (fun z => f₁ z * g₁ z - f₂ z * g₂ z)
  exp_ball_bnd : ∀ (R : ℝ),
    0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Complex.exp (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖iteratedDeriv j Complex.exp w‖ ≤ Real.exp R
  cos_ball_bnd : ∀ (R : ℝ),
    0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Complex.cos (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖iteratedDeriv j Complex.cos w‖ ≤ Real.exp R
  sin_ball_bnd : ∀ (R : ℝ),
    0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Complex.sin (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖iteratedDeriv j Complex.sin w‖ ≤ Real.exp R
  comp_bnd : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' M_G B : ℝ) (V : Set ℂ) (G f : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen V →
    0 ≤ M_G →
    0 ≤ B →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G V →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv j G w‖ ≤ M_G) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f z ∈ V) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv j f z‖ ≤ B) →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' (M_G * skrCompConst p B) (fun z => G (f z))
  comp_diff_bnd : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' M_G ΔG B Δf : ℝ) (V : Set ℂ) (G₁ G₂ f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen V →
    Convex ℝ V →
    0 ≤ M_G →
    0 ≤ ΔG →
    0 ≤ B →
    0 ≤ Δf →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G₁ V →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G₂ V →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ => G₁ ζ - G₂ ζ) w‖ ≤ ΔG) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p + 1 → ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv j G₂ w‖ ≤ M_G) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ (horizStrip σ') →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ (horizStrip σ') →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f₁ z ∈ V) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f₂ z ∈ V) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv j f₁ z‖ ≤ B) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv j f₂ z‖ ≤ B) →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' Δf (fun z => f₁ z - f₂ z) →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' (skrCompConst p B * (ΔG + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * M_G * Δf))
      (fun z => G₁ (f₁ z) - G₂ (f₂ z))
  comp_param_cont : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' : ℝ) (V : Set ℂ) (G : ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen V →
    0 < σ' →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G V →
    (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (f α) (horizStrip σ') ∧ ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f α z ∈ V) →
    (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv r (f α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => G (f α ζ)) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
  param_int_bnd : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' B : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ' →
    0 ≤ B →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ContinuousOn (fun t => F t z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B (F t)) →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B (fun z => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F t z) ∧
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      iteratedDeriv k (fun w => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F t w) z =
        (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, iteratedDeriv k (F t) z) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun t => iteratedDeriv k (F t) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
  param_int_cont : ∀ (B : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ),
    0 ≤ B →
    (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContinuousOn (g u) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContinuousOn (fun u => g u t) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
    (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖g u t‖ ≤ B) →
    ContinuousOn (fun u => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, g u t) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)

structure SkrPointwiseProp : Prop where
  plus_eq_minus : ∀ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (Y μ z : ℂ),
    cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y μ z = cellKernelMinus_ℂ W Y μ z
  real_eq : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    ContDiff ℝ (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) w →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ x : ℝ, W x = w x) →
    ∀ X Y z : ℝ,
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z
  diag_periodic : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, W (z + 2 * Real.pi) = W z) →
    ∀ X Y μ z : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip σ → Y ∈ horizStrip σ → μ ∈ horizStrip σ → z ∈ horizStrip σ →
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (X + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X μ z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y μ z
  factor_eq : ∀ (σ τ : ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (H z : ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W (horizStrip σ) →
    τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    z ∈ horizStrip σ →
    z - (τ : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
    z + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
    cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (z - (τ : ℂ) * H) (z + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H) z =
      (((3 / 2 : ℝ) * τ ^ 2 - 1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ^ 2 + H ^ 3 * skrKerRem W τ H z

structure SkrHalfStepSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (H_inv : StripHalfCellInvSystem m M S) where
  C_step : ℝ
  N_step : ℕ
  C_step_pos : 0 < C_step
  N_inv_le : H_inv.N_inv ≤ N_step
  step_props : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_step ≤ q →
    H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w W
      X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus →
    let σ_inv := (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      let h_m : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun α ζ =>
        μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) - X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)
      let h_p : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun α ζ =>
        X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) - μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (h_m α) (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (h_p α) (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          ζ ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
          X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) = ζ - (α : ℂ) * h_m α ζ ∧
          μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) = ζ + ((1 - α : ℝ) : ℂ) * h_m α ζ ∧
          X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) = ζ - ((1 - α : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-h_p α ζ) ∧
          μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ) = ζ + (α : ℂ) * (-h_p α ζ) ∧
          X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
          μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
          X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
          μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ) ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => h_m α ζ - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤
              C_step ∧
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => h_p α ζ - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤
              C_step)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (h_m α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (h_p α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
  step_lip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ)
      (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
      (xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_step ≤ q →
    H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w₁ W₁
      X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w₂ W₂
      X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ →
    let σ_inv := (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      let h_m₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ) - X_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ)
      let h_m₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ) - X_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ)
      let h_p₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ) - μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ)
      let h_p₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ) - μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ)
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => h_m₁ ζ - h_m₂ ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_step * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ ∧
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => h_p₁ ζ - h_p₂ ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_step * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂

structure SkrReducedKernelSystem (m : ℕ) (M B_H : ℝ) where
  C_red : ℝ
  N_red : ℕ
  C_red_pos : 0 < C_red
  N_red_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_red
  reduced_props : ∀ (σ σ' sgn τ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W H : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ σ →
    N_red ≤ q →
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H (horizStrip σ') →
    (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H ζ ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
      ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ζ ∈ horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ => H ζ - ((sgn * (Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ B_H) →
    let G : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H ζ) (ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ζ) ζ
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G (horizStrip σ') ∧
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ =>
            G ζ -
              (((Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * τ ^ 2 - 1 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_red
  reduced_param_cont : ∀ (σ σ' sgn : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
      (τ_fn : ℝ → ℝ) (H_fam : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ σ →
    N_red ≤ q →
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    ContinuousOn τ_fn (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      τ_fn α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (H_fam α) (horizStrip σ') ∧
      (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ',

        ζ + ((1 - τ_fn α : ℝ) : ℂ) * H_fam α ζ ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',

          ‖iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ => H_fam α ζ - ((sgn * (Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ B_H)) →
    (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv r (H_fam α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ContinuousOn
        (fun α : ℝ =>
          iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ =>
              cellKernelMinus_ℂ W
                (ζ - (τ_fn α : ℂ) * H_fam α ζ)
                (ζ + ((1 - τ_fn α : ℝ) : ℂ) * H_fam α ζ) ζ) z)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
  reduced_lip : ∀ (σ σ' sgn τ ΔH_scaled : ℝ) (q : ℕ)
      (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ H₁ H₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ σ →
    N_red ≤ q →
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
    0 ≤ ΔH_scaled →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w₁ W₁ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w₂ W₂ →
    τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H₁ (horizStrip σ') →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H₂ (horizStrip σ') →

      ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H₁ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
      ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H₁ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
      ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H₂ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
      ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H₂ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k

    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',

def HasCJetBound_fcks (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) f ∧
  0 ≤ B ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k f x| ≤ B

def HasDerivJetBound_fcks (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) f ∧
  0 ≤ B ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k f x| ≤ B

def compJetFactor_fcks : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | p + 1, B => 1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * B * compJetFactor_fcks p B

structure RealCJetToolkitProp_fcks : Prop where
  jet_const : ∀ (p : ℕ) (c : ℝ), HasCJetBound_fcks p |c| (fun _ => c)
  jet_mono : ∀ {p' p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ},
    p' ≤ p → B₁ ≤ B₂ → HasCJetBound_fcks p B₁ f → HasCJetBound_fcks p' B₂ f
  jet_add : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
    HasCJetBound_fcks p B₁ f → HasCJetBound_fcks p B₂ g →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => f x + g x)
  jet_sub : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
    HasCJetBound_fcks p B₁ f → HasCJetBound_fcks p B₂ g →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => f x - g x)
  jet_const_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (c : ℝ) {f : ℝ → ℝ},
    HasCJetBound_fcks p B f → HasCJetBound_fcks p (|c| * B) (fun x => c * f x)
  jet_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
    HasCJetBound_fcks p B₁ f → HasCJetBound_fcks p B₂ g →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * B₁ * B₂) (fun x => f x * g x)
  jet_mul_diff : ∀ {p : ℕ} {M_f M_g L_f L_g : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ},
    HasCJetBound_fcks p M_f f₁ → HasCJetBound_fcks p M_f f₂ →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p M_g g₁ → HasCJetBound_fcks p M_g g₂ →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p L_f (fun x => f₁ x - f₂ x) →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p L_g (fun x => g₁ x - g₂ x) →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (L_f * M_g + M_f * L_g))
      (fun x => f₁ x * g₁ x - f₂ x * g₂ x)
  jet_comp_on : ∀ (p : ℕ) (S : Set ℝ) (M_g B_f : ℝ) (g f : ℝ → ℝ),
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) g →
    0 ≤ M_g →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ y ∈ S, |iteratedDeriv k g y| ≤ M_g) →
    HasDerivJetBound_fcks p B_f f →
    (∀ x : ℝ, f x ∈ S) →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p (M_g * compJetFactor_fcks p B_f) (fun x => g (f x))
  jet_comp_diff_on : ∀ (p : ℕ) (S : Set ℝ) (M_g L_g B_f L_f : ℝ) (g₁ g₂ f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    Convex ℝ S →
    ContDiff ℝ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g₁ →
    ContDiff ℝ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g₂ →
    0 ≤ M_g → 0 ≤ L_g →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p + 1 → ∀ y ∈ S, |iteratedDeriv k g₂ y| ≤ M_g) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ y ∈ S, |iteratedDeriv k (fun z => g₁ z - g₂ z) y| ≤ L_g) →
    HasDerivJetBound_fcks p B_f f₁ →
    HasDerivJetBound_fcks p B_f f₂ →
    (∀ x : ℝ, f₁ x ∈ S ∧ f₂ x ∈ S) →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p L_f (fun x => f₁ x - f₂ x) →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p
      (L_g * compJetFactor_fcks p B_f + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * L_f * (M_g * compJetFactor_fcks p B_f))
      (fun x => g₁ (f₁ x) - g₂ (f₂ x))
  jet_unit_integral : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.uncurry G) →
    0 ≤ B →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasCJetBound_fcks p B (G t)) →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p B (fun x : ℝ => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, G t x)
  contDiff_unit_integral_2d : ∀ (p : ℕ) (G : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ),
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => G q.1 q.2) →
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, G t z)
  contDiff_iteratedDeriv_snd : ∀ (p : ℕ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.uncurry F) →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p →
      Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (F q.1) q.2)
  periodic_diff_jet : ∀ (r₀ : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    Function.Periodic w₁ (2 * Real.pi) →
    Function.Periodic w₂ (2 * Real.pi) →
    ContDiff ℝ (r₀ : WithTop ℕ∞) w₁ →
    ContDiff ℝ (r₀ : WithTop ℕ∞) w₂ →
    HasCJetBound_fcks r₀ (realDiffSup r₀ w₁ w₂) (fun x => w₁ x - w₂ x)

noncomputable def realSinc_fcks (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.cos (s * u)

noncomputable def realCos2_fcks (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) * Real.cos (s * u)

def cellDeltaW_fcks (w B H : ℝ → ℝ) (c x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  w (B x + c * H x) - w (B x)

noncomputable def cellExpAvgJ_fcks (w B H : ℝ → ℝ) (c x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (B x + (θ * c) * H x) - w (B x))

noncomputable def cellDeltaPhi_fcks (w B H : ℝ → ℝ) (c x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  c * H x * Real.exp (w (B x)) * cellExpAvgJ_fcks w B H c x

noncomputable def rescaledCellKernel_fcks (w B H : ℝ → ℝ) (β x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  H x ^ 2 *
    (2 * β ^ 2 * (cellExpAvgJ_fcks w B H β x) ^ 2 *
        realCos2_fcks (cellDeltaPhi_fcks w B H β x) *
        Real.exp (-2 * cellDeltaW_fcks w B H β x) -
      (1 - β) * ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        (let γ := β + (1 - β) * τ
         γ * cellExpAvgJ_fcks w B H γ x *
           realSinc_fcks (cellDeltaPhi_fcks w B H γ x) *
           Real.exp (cellDeltaW_fcks w B H β x - 2 * cellDeltaW_fcks w B H γ x)))

def IsCellBaseStepPair_fcks (p : ℕ) (R₀ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (σ_sgn : ℝ) (B H : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (σ_sgn = 1 ∨ σ_sgn = -1) ∧
  (∃ (ρ : ℝ) (d : ℝ → ℝ),
    (∀ x : ℝ, B x = x + ρ + d x) ∧
    HasCJetBound_fcks p (R₀ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) d) ∧
  HasCJetBound_fcks p (2 * R₀ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun x => H x - σ_sgn * Real.pi / (q : ℝ))

def IsCellBaseStepDiff_fcks (p : ℕ) (R₀ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (Δ : ℝ)
    (B₁ H₁ B₂ H₂ : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ Δ ∧
  HasCJetBound_fcks p ((R₀ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δ) (fun x => B₁ x - B₂ x) ∧
  HasCJetBound_fcks p ((2 * R₀ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δ) (fun x => H₁ x - H₂ x)

noncomputable def cellBaseMinus_fcks (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  realMesh q w x j

noncomputable def cellStepMinus_fcks (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) - realMesh q w x j

noncomputable def cellBasePlus_fcks (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  realMesh q w x (j + 1)

noncomputable def cellStepPlus_fcks (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) - realMesh q w x (j + 1)

noncomputable abbrev lineArcHoloTaylor1D : (ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
  holoTaylor1D

noncomputable def lineArcEpsJet (m : ℕ) (F : ℂ → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iteratedDeriv m F 0 / (m.factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def lineArcPertSupport {k J : ℕ} (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * g i m z

noncomputable def lineArcPertSupportDeriv {k J : ℕ} (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * deriv (g i m) z

noncomputable def lineArcPertAngles {k J : ℕ} (α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (s : Fin (k + 1)) : ℂ :=
