noncomputable def lineArcPack2D1D (F : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d => PowerSeries.mk (fun l => MvPowerSeries.coeff d (F l))

noncomputable def lineArcSlice2D1D (l : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => PowerSeries.coeff l (MvPowerSeries.coeff d S)

noncomputable def lineArcComp2D1D (g_seq : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d =>
    PowerSeries.mk (fun m =>
      PowerSeries.coeff m
        (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g_seq l))) * Z ^ n)))

noncomputable def lineArcPsSin0 : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  lineArcHoloTaylor1D Complex.sin 0

noncomputable def lineArcPsCos0 : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  lineArcHoloTaylor1D Complex.cos 0

noncomputable def lineArcCompConst2D1D (φ : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  lineArcComp2D1D (fun l => if l = 0 then φ else 0) Z

noncomputable def lineArcFormalMid2D1D {k : ℕ}
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  lineArcPack2D1D (fun l => (β_seq l i.castSucc + β_seq l i.succ) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ))

noncomputable def lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D {k : ℕ}
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  lineArcPack2D1D (fun l => (β_seq l i.succ - β_seq l i.castSucc) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ))

noncomputable def lineArcFormalSin2D1D {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i)) *
      lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i) +
    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i)) *
      lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i)

noncomputable def lineArcFormalCos2D1D {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i)) *
      lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i) -
    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i)) *
      lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i)

noncomputable def lineArcFormalAction2D1D {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    2 * lineArcComp2D1D (f_seq i) (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i) *
      lineArcFormalSin2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i

noncomputable def lineArcFormalGrad2D1D {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  lineArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i_L l))
      (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i_L) *
      lineArcFormalSin2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i_L +
    lineArcComp2D1D (f_seq i_L) (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i_L) *
      lineArcFormalCos2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i_L +
    lineArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i_R l))
      (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i_R) *
      lineArcFormalSin2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i_R -
    lineArcComp2D1D (f_seq i_R) (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i_R) *
      lineArcFormalCos2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i_R

noncomputable def lineArcTruncSupport {k : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
    (f_full : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
  fun i l => if l ≤ J then f_full i l else 0

noncomputable def lineArcTruncBeta {k : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
    (β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun l r => if l ≤ J then β_full l r else 0

structure LineArcJetAndTaylorToolkit : Prop where
  taylor2D_const : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c
  taylor2D_linear_coords : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
    centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 ∧
    centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1
  taylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀
  taylor2D_ring : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀
  taylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → IsOpen W →
    ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U → ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W) →
      taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
        compPowerSeries2D (lineArcHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀)
  epsJet_trunc_eq : ∀ {k J₁ J₂ l : ℕ} (_hJ : J₁ ≤ J₂) (_hl1 : 1 ≤ l) (_hlJ : l ≤ J₁)
    {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
    {g₁ : Fin k → Fin (J₁ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} {g₂ : Fin k → Fin (J₂ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hg₁ : ∀ i m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g₁ i m) W_ψ)
    (_hg₂ : ∀ i m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g₂ i m) W_ψ)
    (_hg₁0 : ∀ i z, g₁ i 0 z = 0) (_hg₂0 : ∀ i z, g₂ i 0 z = 0)
    (_hg_eq : ∀ i (m : Fin (J₁ + 1)), ∀ z ∈ W_ψ, g₂ i ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ z = g₁ i m z)
    {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} (_hmid : ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid α₀ i ∈ W_ψ)
    {β₁ : Fin (J₁ + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} {β₂ : Fin (J₂ + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hβ₁0 : ∀ s, β₁ 0 s = 0) (_hβ₂0 : ∀ s, β₂ 0 s = 0)
    (_hβ_eq : ∀ (m : Fin (J₁ + 1)) s, β₂ ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ s = β₁ m s),
    lineArcEpsJet l
        (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₂ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₂ ε)) =
      lineArcEpsJet l
        (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₁ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₁ ε)) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      lineArcEpsJet l
          (fun ε =>
            lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₂ ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g₂ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₂ ε) r) =
        lineArcEpsJet l
          (fun ε =>
            lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₁ ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g₁ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₁ ε) r)
  epsJet_holo : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) (_hV : IsOpen V) {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
    {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} (_hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ i z, g i 0 z = 0) {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hα₀ : ∀ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (α₀ s) V)
    (_hmid : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i ∈ W_ψ)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hβ : ∀ l s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l s) V) (_hβ0 : ∀ s q, β 0 s q = 0),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q =>
        lineArcEpsJet m
          (fun ε =>
            lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
              (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε)))
      V ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q =>
          lineArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε =>
              lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
                (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g ε)
                (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε) r))
        V
  epsJet_succ_split : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (_hk : 2 ≤ k) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ)
    {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
    {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} {g_top : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)
    (_hg_top : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_top i) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ i z, g i 0 z = 0) {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hmid : ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid α₀ i ∈ W_ψ)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} {β_top : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hβ0 : ∀ s, β 0 s = 0) (_hβ_top_end : β_top 0 = 0 ∧ β_top (Fin.last k) = 0),
    let g_ext : Fin k → Fin (J + 1 + 1) → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => Fin.snoc (g i) (g_top i)
    let β_ext : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β β_top
    let β_zero_top : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β (fun _ => 0)
    lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
        (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g_ext ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β_ext ε)) =
      lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
        (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β ε)) +
      (∑ i : Fin k, 2 * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) * g_top i (lineChainMid α₀ i)) +
      (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
        lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) α₀ r *
          β_top ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
          (fun ε =>
            lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g_ext ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g_ext ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β_ext ε) r) =
        lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
          (fun ε =>
            lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g_ext ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g_ext ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β_zero_top ε) r) +
        ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
          lineInteriorHess (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv (deriv h_ℂ))
            α₀ r s * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
  taylor2D_epsJet_eq : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {p₁ : ℂ × ℂ}
    (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) (_hV : IsOpen V) (_hp₁ : p₁ ∈ V)
    {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
    {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} (_hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ i z, g i 0 z = 0) {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hα₀ : ∀ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (α₀ s) V)
    (_hmid : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i ∈ W_ψ)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hβ : ∀ l s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l s) V) (_hβ0 : ∀ s q, β 0 s q = 0),
    let sin_d0 := fun i => Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
    let cos_d0 := fun i => Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
    let f_seq : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i l =>
      if l = 0 then lineArcHoloTaylor1D h_ℂ (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
      else if hl : l < J + 1 then lineArcHoloTaylor1D (g i ⟨l, hl⟩) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
      else 0
    let β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun l s =>
      if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D (α₀ s) p₁
      else if hl : l < J + 1 then taylor2D (β ⟨l, hl⟩ s) p₁
      else 0
    taylor2D
        (fun q =>
          lineArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε =>
              lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
                (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε)))
        p₁ =
      lineArcSlice2D1D m (lineArcFormalAction2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_seq β_seq) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      taylor2D
          (fun q =>
            lineArcEpsJet m
              (fun ε =>
                lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
                  (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g ε)
                  (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε) r))
          p₁ =
        lineArcSlice2D1D m (lineArcFormalGrad2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_seq β_seq r)

structure LineArcFormalDeformationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  p : ℕ
  p_pos : 1 ≤ p
  i₀ : Fin k
  f_full : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ
  β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ
  K_seq : ℕ → ℂ
  f_zero : ∀ i : Fin k, f_full i 0 = lineArcHoloTaylor1D C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
  β_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full 0 r = centeredTaylor2D (G.α_fn r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  β_endpoints : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → β_full l 0 = 0 ∧ β_full l (Fin.last k) = 0
  f_lead_ne_zero : f_full i₀ p ≠ 0
  vanish_lt_p : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l < p →
    (∀ i : Fin k, f_full i l = 0) ∧ (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full l r = 0) ∧ K_seq l = 0
  formal_web_step : ∀ J : ℕ,
    lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (lineArcFormalAction2D1D
          (fun i => Complex.sin (G.d_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))))
          (fun i => Complex.cos (G.d_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))))
          (lineArcTruncSupport J f_full)
          (lineArcTruncBeta J β_full)) +
      ∑ i : Fin k,
        taylor2D (G.w_fn i) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
          compPowerSeries2D (f_full i (J + 1))
            (centeredTaylor2D (G.ψ_fn i) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (K_seq (J + 1))
  formal_hess_step : ∀ J : ℕ, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (lineArcFormalGrad2D1D
          (fun i => Complex.sin (G.d_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))))
          (fun i => Complex.cos (G.d_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))))
          (lineArcTruncSupport (J + 1) f_full)
          (lineArcTruncBeta J β_full)
          r) +
      ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
        taylor2D
          (fun q =>
            lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
              (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun u => G.α_fn u q) r s)
          ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
        β_full (J + 1) ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ = 0

structure LineArcStepAnalyticData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) (D_form : LineArcFormalDeformationData C B k G a₁ δ₁) (J : ℕ) where
  W_ψ : Set ℂ
  V_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  W_ψ_open : IsOpen W_ψ
  W_ψ_preconn : IsPreconnected W_ψ
  W_ψ_sub_strip : W_ψ ⊆ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)
  real_mem_W_ψ : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - G.a₀| < G.R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_ψ
  base_ψ_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ W_ψ
  V_plus_open : IsOpen V_plus
  V_plus_preconn : IsPreconnected V_plus
  V_plus_sub : V_plus ⊆ G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d
  trapezoid_mem_V_plus : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀,
    ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_plus
  ψ_maps_W_ψ : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ i : Fin k, G.ψ_fn i q ∈ W_ψ
  hess_det_ne_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus,
    (lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
      (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun s => G.α_fn s q)).det ≠ 0
  g_holo : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ
  g_lt_p : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < D_form.p → ∀ z : ℂ, g i l z = 0
  g_taylor : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    lineArcHoloTaylor1D (g i l) (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) = D_form.f_full i (l : ℕ)
  β_holo : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l r) V_plus
  β_zero : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β 0 r q = 0
  β_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β l 0 q = 0 ∧ β l (Fin.last k) q = 0
  β_taylor : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    taylor2D (β l r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) = D_form.β_full (l : ℕ) r
  grad_jet_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ J →
    lineArcEpsJet l
      (fun ε =>
        lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport C.h_ℂ g ε)
          (lineArcPertSupportDeriv C.h_ℂ g ε)
          (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => G.α_fn s q) (fun m s => β m s q) ε) r) = 0
  action_jet_const : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    lineArcEpsJet (l : ℕ)
      (fun ε =>
        lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport C.h_ℂ g ε)
          (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => G.α_fn s q) (fun m s => β m s q) ε)) =
      D_form.K_seq (l : ℕ)

noncomputable def shciShiftMinus (q j : ℕ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((j : ℝ) + α / 2) * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ))

noncomputable def shciShiftPlus (q j : ℕ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((j : ℝ) + (1 + α) / 2) * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ))

noncomputable def shciPerturbMinus (q : ℕ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (X_ℂ j ζ + (α : ℂ) * (μ_ℂ j ζ - X_ℂ j ζ)) - (ζ + (shciShiftMinus q j α : ℂ))

noncomputable def shciPerturbPlus (q : ℕ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (μ_ℂ j ζ + (α : ℂ) * (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - μ_ℂ j ζ)) - (ζ + (shciShiftPlus q j α : ℂ))

def IsShciShiftPerturb (r_max : ℕ) (σ₁ δ_e ρ : ℝ) (g_ℝ : ℝ → ℝ) (e : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ e (horizStrip σ₁) ∧
  (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁, e (ζ + 2 * Real.pi) = e ζ) ∧
  (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁, e (starRingEnd ℂ ζ) = starRingEnd ℂ (e ζ)) ∧
  (∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) + (ρ : ℂ) + e x = (g_ℝ x : ℂ)) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ r_max → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁, ‖iteratedDeriv r e ζ‖ ≤ δ_e)

def IsShciShiftRightInv (σ₁ σ₂ ρ : ℝ) (e x_inv : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ x_inv (horizStrip σ₂) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, x_inv z ∈ horizStrip σ₁) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, x_inv z + (ρ : ℂ) + e (x_inv z) = z)

noncomputable def shciPicardSeq (ρ : ℝ) (e : ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, z => -e (z - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z)

noncomputable def shciShiftInv (ρ : ℝ) (e : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  z - (ρ : ℂ) + Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => shciPicardSeq ρ e n z)

noncomputable def shciInvOneAdd (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 + w)⁻¹

noncomputable def shciCompConst : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | s + 1, B => (2 : ℝ) ^ s * B * shciCompConst s B

noncomputable def shciCompDiffConst : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | s + 1, B => (2 : ℝ) ^ s * (B * shciCompDiffConst s B + shciCompConst s B)

noncomputable def shciJetB : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 2
  | k + 1 =>
      let B := shciJetB k
      let G := shciCompConst k B
      max B ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) * G * shciCompConst k G)

noncomputable def shciJetL : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 2
  | k + 1 =>
      let B := shciJetB k
      let G := shciCompConst k B
      let L := shciJetL k
      let D := L * shciCompDiffConst k B + shciCompConst k B
      max L ((((k + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2)) * D * shciCompDiffConst k G)

noncomputable def trapPDE_seg (z₀ z : ℂ) (s : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (1 - s) • z₀ + s • z

noncomputable def trapPDE_picardIter {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (z₀ : ℂ) (M : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (c : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) (v₀ : ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) :
    ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)
  | 0, p => v₀ p.1
  | n + 1, p => fun idx =>
      v₀ p.1 idx +
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          (p.2 - z₀) *
            (((M (p.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ p.2 s)).mulVec
                (trapPDE_picardIter z₀ M c v₀ n (p.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ p.2 s)) +
              c (p.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ p.2 s)) idx)

noncomputable def trapPDE_picardSol {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (z₀ : ℂ) (M : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (c : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) (v₀ : ℂ → (ι → ℂ))
    (p : ℂ × ℂ) (idx : ι) : ℂ :=
  v₀ p.1 idx +
    ∑' n : ℕ,
      (trapPDE_picardIter z₀ M c v₀ (n + 1) p idx -
        trapPDE_picardIter z₀ M c v₀ n p idx)

structure TrapPDE_ODEKit : Prop where
  solve_param_D :
    ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
      (Ω_par Ω_z : Set ℂ),
      IsOpen Ω_par → IsOpen Ω_z → Convex ℝ Ω_z →
      ∀ (z₀ : ℂ), z₀ ∈ Ω_z →
      ∀ (M : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (c : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) (v₀ : ℂ → (ι → ℂ)),
        (∀ idx j : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M p idx j) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z)) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c p idx) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z)) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => v₀ w idx) Ω_par) →
        ∃ u : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ),
          (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => u p idx) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z)) ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Ω_par, u (w, z₀) = v₀ w) ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Ω_par, ∀ z ∈ Ω_z, ∀ idx : ι,
            pderivD (fun q => u q idx) (w, z) =
              ((M (w, z)).mulVec (u (w, z)) + c (w, z)) idx)
  solve_param_A :
    ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
      (Ω_z Ω_par : Set ℂ),
      IsOpen Ω_z → Convex ℝ Ω_z → IsOpen Ω_par →
      ∀ (z₀ : ℂ), z₀ ∈ Ω_z →
      ∀ (M : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (c : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) (v₀ : ℂ → (ι → ℂ)),
        (∀ idx j : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M p idx j) (Ω_z ×ˢ Ω_par)) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c p idx) (Ω_z ×ˢ Ω_par)) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => v₀ w idx) Ω_par) →
        ∃ u : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ),
          (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => u p idx) (Ω_z ×ˢ Ω_par)) ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Ω_par, u (z₀, w) = v₀ w) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ Ω_z, ∀ w ∈ Ω_par, ∀ idx : ι,
            pderivA (fun q => u q idx) (z, w) =
              ((M (z, w)).mulVec (u (z, w)) + c (z, w)) idx)
  unique_1D :
    ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
      (Ω_z : Set ℂ), IsOpen Ω_z → Convex ℝ Ω_z →
      ∀ (z₀ : ℂ), z₀ ∈ Ω_z →
      ∀ (M_z : ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (c_z : ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) (u₁ u₂ : ℂ → (ι → ℂ)),
        (∀ idx j : ι, ContinuousOn (fun z => M_z z idx j) Ω_z) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => u₁ z idx) Ω_z) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => u₂ z idx) Ω_z) →
        u₁ z₀ = u₂ z₀ →
        (∀ z ∈ Ω_z, ∀ idx : ι,
          deriv (fun ζ => u₁ ζ idx) z = ((M_z z).mulVec (u₁ z) + c_z z) idx) →
        (∀ z ∈ Ω_z, ∀ idx : ι,
          deriv (fun ζ => u₂ ζ idx) z = ((M_z z).mulVec (u₂ z) + c_z z) idx) →
        ∀ z ∈ Ω_z, u₁ z = u₂ z

def trapCrect (x_lo x_hi η : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { z : ℂ | x_lo - η < z.re ∧ z.re < x_hi + η ∧ |z.im| < η }

structure TrapPDE_AnchoredChart {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) (U_ode : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (M_a M_δ : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (c_a c_δ : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ))
    (v_init : ι → ℂ) where
  R_a : Set ℂ
  R_δ : Set ℂ
  R_δ_spine : Set ℂ
  γ : ℂ → (ι → ℂ)
  W : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)
  hRa_open : IsOpen R_a
  hRa_conv : Convex ℝ R_a
  hRδ_open : IsOpen R_δ
  hRδ_conv : Convex ℝ R_δ
  hRδ_sp_open : IsOpen R_δ_spine
  hRδ_sp_conv : Convex ℝ R_δ_spine
  ha₁_mem : (a₁ : ℂ) ∈ R_a
  hδ₁_mem : (δ₁ : ℂ) ∈ R_δ_spine
  hRδ_sub_sp : R_δ ⊆ R_δ_spine
  hsp_sub_U : ∀ δ ∈ R_δ_spine, ((a₁ : ℂ), δ) ∈ U_ode
  hrect_sub_U : R_a ×ˢ R_δ ⊆ U_ode
  hγ_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun δ => γ δ idx) R_δ_spine
  hγ_init : γ (δ₁ : ℂ) = v_init
  hγ_ode : ∀ δ ∈ R_δ_spine, ∀ idx : ι,
    deriv (fun ζ => γ ζ idx) δ =
      ((M_δ ((a₁ : ℂ), δ)).mulVec (γ δ) + c_δ ((a₁ : ℂ), δ)) idx
  hW_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => W p idx) (R_a ×ˢ R_δ)
  hW_spine : ∀ δ ∈ R_δ, W ((a₁ : ℂ), δ) = γ δ
  hW_pde_a : ∀ p ∈ R_a ×ˢ R_δ, ∀ idx : ι,
    pderivA (fun q => W q idx) p = ((M_a p).mulVec (W p) + c_a p) idx
  hW_pde_δ : ∀ p ∈ R_a ×ˢ R_δ, ∀ idx : ι,
    pderivD (fun q => W q idx) p = ((M_δ p).mulVec (W p) + c_δ p) idx

noncomputable def pointCoreIdx2D (a b : ℕ) : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ :=
  Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm ![a, b]

noncomputable def pointCoreComp2D (F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) F *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b)

def pointCoreCoeffsIn (L : Subfield ℂ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, MvPowerSeries.coeff d S ∈ L

def pointCoreVanishesBelow (N : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 < N → MvPowerSeries.coeff d S = 0

noncomputable def pointCoreInvSqrt1p (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (sqrt1p u)⁻¹

abbrev PointCoreIdx (k : ℕ) : Type :=
  Sum (Fin (k + 1)) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin (k + 1) × Fin (max 2 k + 1)))

noncomputable def pointCoreCard (k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Fintype.card (PointCoreIdx k)

noncomputable def pointCoreTuple {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Fin (pointCoreCard k) → ℂ :=
  fun idx =>
    match (Fintype.equivFin (PointCoreIdx k)).symm idx with
    | Sum.inl r => G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inl i) => G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr (r, m)) =>
        iteratedDeriv (m : ℕ) G.F (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))

structure PointCoreSeriesToolkit : Prop where
  centeredTaylor2D_fst : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0
  centeredTaylor2D_snd : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1
  taylor2D_comp_2D : ∀ {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f V → (∀ p ∈ U, Ψ p ∈ V) →
      taylor2D (fun p => f (Ψ p)) p₀ =
        pointCoreComp2D (taylor2D f (Ψ p₀))
          (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).1) p₀)
          (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).2) p₀)
  C_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {c : ℂ}, c ∈ L → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.C c)
  X_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) (s : Fin 2), pointCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.X s)
  add_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L S → pointCoreCoeffsIn L T → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (S + T)
  sub_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L S → pointCoreCoeffsIn L T → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (S - T)
  mul_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L S → pointCoreCoeffsIn L T → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (S * T)
  mvDerivA_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L S → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (mvDerivA S)
  mvDerivD_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L S → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (mvDerivD S)
  comp1D_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {f : PowerSeries ℂ} {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    (∀ n : ℕ, PowerSeries.coeff n f ∈ L) → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 →
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L U → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (compPowerSeries2D f U)
  comp2D_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L F → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₂ = 0 →
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L U₁ → pointCoreCoeffsIn L U₂ →
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L (pointCoreComp2D F U₁ U₂)
  mixed_of_derivAD_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L (mvDerivD (mvDerivA S)) →
    ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, 1 ≤ d 0 → 1 ≤ d 1 → MvPowerSeries.coeff d S ∈ L
  inv_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    S * T = 1 → pointCoreCoeffsIn L T → pointCoreCoeffsIn L S
  sqrt_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    S ^ 2 = T → pointCoreCoeffsIn L T → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 S ∈ L →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 S ≠ 0 → pointCoreCoeffsIn L S
  mulVec_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} {x b : ι → ℂ},
    (∀ r s : ι, A r s ∈ L) → A.det ≠ 0 → (∀ r : ι, b r ∈ L) → A.mulVec x = b →
    ∀ r : ι, x r ∈ L
  inv2D_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {Φ₁ Φ₂ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Φ₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Φ₂ = 0 →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ₂ = 0 →
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L Φ₁ → pointCoreCoeffsIn L Φ₂ →
    pointCoreComp2D Φ₁ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 →
    pointCoreComp2D Φ₂ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ = MvPowerSeries.X 1 →
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L Ψ₁ ∧ pointCoreCoeffsIn L Ψ₂
  coeff_comp1D_pert : ∀ {n : ℕ}, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ)
    {U₀ η : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
    d 0 + d 1 = n → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₀ = 0 → pointCoreVanishesBelow n η →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D f (U₀ + η)) =
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D f U₀) +
        PowerSeries.coeff 1 f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d η
  coeff_mul_pert : ∀ {n : ℕ}, 1 ≤ n → ∀ {P P₀ Q Q₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ}
    {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
    d 0 + d 1 = n → pointCoreVanishesBelow n (P - P₀) → pointCoreVanishesBelow n (Q - Q₀) →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (P * Q) - MvPowerSeries.coeff d (P₀ * Q₀) =
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Q₀ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (P - P₀) +
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 P₀ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Q - Q₀)
  vanishesBelow_mul : ∀ {N₁ N₂ : ℕ} {A B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreVanishesBelow N₁ A → pointCoreVanishesBelow N₂ B →
    pointCoreVanishesBelow (N₁ + N₂) (A * B)
  vanishesBelow_comp1D_taylor : ∀ {N₀ : ℕ}, 1 ≤ N₀ → ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ)
    {U₀ η : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₀ = 0 → pointCoreVanishesBelow N₀ η →
    pointCoreVanishesBelow (2 * N₀)
      (compPowerSeries2D f (U₀ + η) - compPowerSeries2D f U₀ -
        compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) U₀ * η)
  coeff_pow_linear : ∀ {M ν : ℕ}, 1 ≤ M → ν ≤ M → ∀ {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D (M - ν) ν) (U ^ M) =
      (M.choose ν : ℂ) * (MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 1 0) U) ^ (M - ν) *
        (MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 0 1) U) ^ ν

def c1_moab : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | p + 1, B => (1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * max 1 B) * c1_moab p B

def c2_moab : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | p + 1, B => 1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (c1_moab p B + max 1 B * c2_moab p B)

def cCalc_moab (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  max (c1_moab p B) (c2_moab p B)

def HasCJetℂ_moab (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) F ∧
  0 ≤ B ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k F z‖ ≤ B

noncomputable def rawCellIntegrand_moab (n : ℤ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α z : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  let q := n.natAbs
  let x_m := halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z
  let X_m := realMesh q w x_m j
  let Y_m := realMesh q w x_m (j + 1)
  let μ_m := midpoint_ℝ w X_m Y_m
  let term_m : ℂ :=
    ((cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X_m Y_m z * (μ_m - X_m) *
      deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x_m - z : ℝ) : ℂ))
  let x_p := halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z
  let X_p := realMesh q w x_p j
  let Y_p := realMesh q w x_p (j + 1)
  let μ_p := midpoint_ℝ w X_p Y_p
  let term_p : ℂ :=
    ((cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X_p Y_p z * (Y_p - μ_p) *
      deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x_p - z : ℝ) : ℂ))
  term_m + term_p

noncomputable def leadCellIntegrand_moab (n : ℤ) (α : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  let q : ℝ := (n.natAbs : ℝ)
  let σ_n : ℝ := (n : ℝ) / q
  ((Real.pi / q ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    ((k0Minus α : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * α : ℝ) : ℂ)) +
     (k0Plus α : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * (1 + α) : ℝ) : ℂ)))

noncomputable def sqmcFluxOp (t₀ : ℝ) (a ξ : ℕ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 =>
      ((t₀ : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 2 *
        (a (j + 1) * (ξ (j + 2) - ξ (j + 1)) - a j * (ξ (j + 1) - ξ j))

noncomputable def sqmcFluxCumSum (t₀ : ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (t₀ : ℂ) ^ 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, F (i + 1)

noncomputable def sqmcFluxInit (q : ℕ) (t₀ : ℝ) (a F : ℕ → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -(∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, (a j)⁻¹ * sqmcFluxCumSum t₀ F j) /
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, (a j)⁻¹)

noncomputable def sqmcFluxInv (q : ℕ) (t₀ : ℝ) (a F : ℕ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  if k ≤ q then
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k,
      (a j)⁻¹ * (sqmcFluxInit q t₀ a F + sqmcFluxCumSum t₀ F j)
  else 0

def SqmcFluxInvProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : ℕ) (t₀ : ℝ), 2 ≤ q → t₀ ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (a F : ℕ → ℂ),
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ‖4 * a j - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) →
      (sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F 0 = 0 ∧
       sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F q = 0 ∧
       (∀ k : ℕ, q < k → sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F k = 0)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q →
        sqmcFluxOp t₀ a (sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F) (j + 1) = F (j + 1)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ,
        sqmcFluxInv q t₀
          (fun j => starRingEnd ℂ (a j))
          (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (F i)) k =
          starRingEnd ℂ (sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F k))) ∧
    (∀ (a ξ : ℕ → ℂ),
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ‖4 * a j - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) →
      ξ 0 = 0 → ξ q = 0 → (∀ k : ℕ, q < k → ξ k = 0) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a (sqmcFluxOp t₀ a ξ) k = ξ k) ∧
    (∀ (a F₁ F₂ : ℕ → ℂ) (k : ℕ),
      sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a (fun i => F₁ i - F₂ i) k =
        sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F₁ k - sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F₂ k) ∧
    (∀ (a F : ℕ → ℂ) (M_F : ℝ),
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ‖4 * a j - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) →
      0 ≤ M_F →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ‖F (j + 1)‖ ≤ M_F) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ‖sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F k‖ ≤ 24 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 * M_F) ∧
    (∀ (W : Set ℂ) (a_y F_y : ℂ → ℕ → ℂ),
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => a_y y j) W) →
      (∀ y ∈ W, ∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ‖4 * a_y y j - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => F_y y (j + 1)) W) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => sqmcFluxInv q t₀ (a_y y) (F_y y) k) W)

noncomputable def sqmcMeshPt (u : ℂ → ℂ) (z w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  u z + deriv u z * w

noncomputable def sqmcStencil {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (u : ℂ → ℂ) (t₀ : ℝ) (z w_m w_0 w_p : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((t₀ : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 3 * deriv u z *
    (normAction1_ℂ B (sqmcMeshPt u z w_0) (sqmcMeshPt u (z + (t₀ : ℂ)) w_p) +
     normAction2_ℂ B (sqmcMeshPt u (z - (t₀ : ℂ)) w_m) (sqmcMeshPt u z w_0))

noncomputable def sqmcPotential {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (t₀ : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let u : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => U (w, (t₀ : ℂ))
  deriv (fun w : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (w, (t₀ : ℂ))) z -
    (deriv (deriv u) z / deriv u z) * glancingResidualOp B U (z, (t₀ : ℂ))

noncomputable def sqmcLinear {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (t₀ : ℝ) (z w_m w_0 w_p : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((t₀ : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 2 *
    (glancingLinCoeff B U (z + (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) * (w_p - w_0) -
     glancingLinCoeff B U (z - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) * (w_0 - w_m)) +
  sqmcPotential B U t₀ z * w_0

noncomputable def sqmcRem {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (t₀ : ℝ) (z w_m w_0 w_p : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let u : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => U (w, (t₀ : ℂ))
  sqmcStencil B u t₀ z w_m w_0 w_p -
    sqmcStencil B u t₀ z 0 0 0 -
    sqmcLinear B U t₀ z w_m w_0 w_p

noncomputable def sqmcForcing {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (q : ℕ) (u : ℂ → ℂ) (t₀ : ℝ) (y : ℂ) (ξ : ℕ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 =>
      if j + 1 < q then
        sqmcStencil B u t₀ (y + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ))
          (ξ j) (ξ (j + 1)) (ξ (j + 2))
      else 0

def SqmcStencilProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  ∀ (s d δ ε t₀ : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
    0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → 0 < t₀ → t₀ < d →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
    (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
    let u : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => U (w, (t₀ : ℂ))
    let R₀ : ℝ := B.s₀ / 4
    let C_hess : ℝ := 40 * S.M_act / R₀ ^ 2
    DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip s) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv u) (horizStrip s) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ horizStrip s,
      3 / 4 ≤ ‖deriv u w‖ ∧
      ‖deriv u w‖ ≤ 5 / 4 ∧
      u (w + 2 * Real.pi) = u w + 2 * Real.pi ∧
      deriv u (w + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv u w ∧
      u (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (u w) ∧
      deriv u (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv u w)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun w : ℂ => glancingLinCoeff B U (w, (t₀ : ℂ))) (horizStrip s) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ horizStrip s,
      glancingLinCoeff B U (w + 2 * Real.pi, (t₀ : ℂ)) =
        glancingLinCoeff B U (w, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∧
      glancingLinCoeff B U (starRingEnd ℂ w, (t₀ : ℂ)) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U (w, (t₀ : ℂ))) ∧
      ‖4 * glancingLinCoeff B U (w, (t₀ : ℂ)) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) ∧
    (∀ (σ' : ℝ) (w_m w_0 w_p : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < σ' → σ' ≤ s →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ w_m (horizStrip σ') →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ w_0 (horizStrip σ') →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ w_p (horizStrip σ') →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖w_m z‖ ≤ R₀ ∧ ‖w_0 z‖ ≤ R₀ ∧ ‖w_p z‖ ≤ R₀) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun z => sqmcStencil B u t₀ z (w_m z) (w_0 z) (w_p z))
        (horizStrip σ')) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip s, ∀ wm w0 wp : ℂ,
      ‖wm‖ ≤ R₀ → ‖w0‖ ≤ R₀ → ‖wp‖ ≤ R₀ →
      sqmcStencil B u t₀ (z + 2 * Real.pi) wm w0 wp =
        sqmcStencil B u t₀ z wm w0 wp ∧
      sqmcStencil B u t₀ (starRingEnd ℂ z)
        (starRingEnd ℂ wm) (starRingEnd ℂ w0) (starRingEnd ℂ wp) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (sqmcStencil B u t₀ z wm w0 wp)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip (s - δ),
      sqmcStencil B u t₀ z 0 0 0 = glancingResidualOp B U (z, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∧
      ‖sqmcStencil B u t₀ z 0 0 0‖ ≤ ε ∧
      ‖sqmcPotential B U t₀ z‖ ≤ (2 * δ⁻¹ + 1) * ε ∧
      sqmcRem B U t₀ z 0 0 0 = 0) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip (s - δ), ∀ (r M_Δ : ℝ) (w_m w_0 w_p w_m' w_0' w_p' : ℂ),
      0 ≤ r → r ≤ R₀ / 4 → 0 ≤ M_Δ →
      ‖w_m‖ ≤ r → ‖w_0‖ ≤ r → ‖w_p‖ ≤ r →
      ‖w_m'‖ ≤ r → ‖w_0'‖ ≤ r → ‖w_p'‖ ≤ r →
      ‖w_m' - w_m‖ ≤ M_Δ → ‖w_0' - w_0‖ ≤ M_Δ → ‖w_p' - w_p‖ ≤ M_Δ →
      ‖sqmcRem B U t₀ z w_m' w_0' w_p' -
         sqmcRem B U t₀ z w_m w_0 w_p‖ ≤
        C_hess * (t₀⁻¹) ^ 3 * r * M_Δ)

def IsSqmcPinned (q : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (ξ : ℕ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ξ 0 = 0 ∧ ξ q = 0 ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, q < k → ξ k = 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q → ‖ξ k‖ ≤ r)

noncomputable def sqmcPicardIter (q : ℕ) (Φ : ℂ → (ℕ → ℂ) → (ℕ → ℂ)) :
    ℕ → ℂ → ℕ → ℂ
  | 0, _, _ => 0
  | n + 1, y, k => if k ≤ q then Φ y (sqmcPicardIter q Φ n y) k else 0

def SqmcContractionProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (σ r M₀ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (Φ : ℂ → (ℕ → ℂ) → (ℕ → ℂ)),
    0 < σ → 0 ≤ M₀ → 2 * M₀ ≤ r →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ ξ : ℕ → ℂ, IsSqmcPinned q r ξ →
      Φ y ξ 0 = 0 ∧ Φ y ξ q = 0 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, q < k → Φ y ξ k = 0) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q → ‖Φ y (fun _ => 0) k‖ ≤ M₀) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ (ξ₁ ξ₂ : ℕ → ℂ) (M_Δ : ℝ),
      IsSqmcPinned q r ξ₁ → IsSqmcPinned q r ξ₂ → 0 ≤ M_Δ →
      (∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ q → ‖ξ₁ m - ξ₂ m‖ ≤ M_Δ) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q → ‖Φ y ξ₁ k - Φ y ξ₂ k‖ ≤ (1 / 2) * M_Δ) →
    (∀ ξ_fn : ℂ → ℕ → ℂ,
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, IsSqmcPinned q r (ξ_fn y)) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => ξ_fn y k) (horizStrip σ)) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => Φ y (ξ_fn y) k) (horizStrip σ)) →
    (∀ ξ_fn : ℂ → ℕ → ℂ,
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, IsSqmcPinned q r (ξ_fn y)) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q →
        ξ_fn (y + 2 * Real.pi) k = ξ_fn y k ∧
        ξ_fn (starRingEnd ℂ y) k = starRingEnd ℂ (ξ_fn y k)) →
      ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q →
        Φ (y + 2 * Real.pi) (ξ_fn (y + 2 * Real.pi)) k = Φ y (ξ_fn y) k ∧
        Φ (starRingEnd ℂ y) (ξ_fn (starRingEnd ℂ y)) k = starRingEnd ℂ (Φ y (ξ_fn y) k)) →
    ∃ ξ_lim : ℂ → ℕ → ℂ,
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, IsSqmcPinned q r (ξ_lim y)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => ξ_lim y k) (horizStrip σ)) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ,
        ξ_lim (y + 2 * Real.pi) k = ξ_lim y k ∧
        ξ_lim (starRingEnd ℂ y) k = starRingEnd ℂ (ξ_lim y k)) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ, Φ y (ξ_lim y) k = ξ_lim y k)

def PointArcIterHoloProp : Prop :=
  ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) W

noncomputable abbrev pointArcHoloTaylor1D : (ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
  holoTaylor1D

noncomputable def pointArcEpsJet (m : ℕ) (F : ℂ → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iteratedDeriv m F 0 / (m.factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def pointArcInvSqrt1p (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (-Complex.log (1 + u) / 2)

noncomputable def pointArcPertGraph {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * g r q z

noncomputable def pointArcPertGraphDeriv {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g r q) z

noncomputable def pointArcPertAbscissa {k J : ℕ} (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) : ℂ :=
  x₀ r + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β q r

noncomputable def pointArcComp2D (S Φ₀ Φ₁ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 a + Finsupp.single 1 b) S *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Φ₀ ^ a * Φ₁ ^ b)

noncomputable def pointArcPack2D1D (F : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d => PowerSeries.mk (fun l => MvPowerSeries.coeff d (F l))

noncomputable def pointArcSlice2D1D (l : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => PowerSeries.coeff l (MvPowerSeries.coeff d S)

noncomputable def pointArcComp2D1D (g_seq : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d =>
    PowerSeries.mk (fun m =>
      PowerSeries.coeff m
        (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g_seq l))) * Z ^ n)))

noncomputable def pointArcCompConst2D1D (φ : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  pointArcComp2D1D (fun l => if l = 0 then φ else 0) Z

noncomputable def pointArcPsSqrt1p : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  pointArcHoloTaylor1D sqrt1p 0

noncomputable def pointArcPsInvSqrt1p : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  pointArcHoloTaylor1D pointArcInvSqrt1p 0

noncomputable def pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D {k : ℕ}
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  pointArcPack2D1D (fun l => β_seq l r)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalDx2D1D {k : ℕ} (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (x_star i.succ - x_star i.castSucc)) +
    (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i.succ - pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalDy2D1D {k : ℕ}
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  pointArcComp2D1D (f_seq i.succ) (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i.succ) -
    pointArcComp2D1D (f_seq i.castSucc) (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalEdgeSq2D1D {k : ℕ} (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  (pointArcFormalDx2D1D x_star β_seq i) ^ 2 + (pointArcFormalDy2D1D f_seq β_seq i) ^ 2

noncomputable def pointArcFormalEdgeRel2D1D {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ)
    (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  (pointArcFormalEdgeSq2D1D x_star f_seq β_seq i -
      MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star i) ^ 2))) *
    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (((ℓ_star i) ^ 2)⁻¹))

noncomputable def pointArcFormalLen2D1D {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ)
    (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (ℓ_star i)) *
      pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsSqrt1p
        (pointArcFormalEdgeRel2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq i)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalInvEdgeLen2D1D {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ)
    (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star i)⁻¹)) *
    pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsInvSqrt1p
      (pointArcFormalEdgeRel2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq i)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalGrad2D1D {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ)
    (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  (pointArcFormalDx2D1D x_star β_seq i_L +
      pointArcFormalDy2D1D f_seq β_seq i_L *
        pointArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i_L.succ l))
          (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i_L.succ)) *
      pointArcFormalInvEdgeLen2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq i_L -
    (pointArcFormalDx2D1D x_star β_seq i_R +
      pointArcFormalDy2D1D f_seq β_seq i_R *
        pointArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i_R.castSucc l))
          (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i_R.castSucc)) *
      pointArcFormalInvEdgeLen2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq i_R

noncomputable def pointArcTruncGraph {k : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
    (f_full : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
  fun r l => if l ≤ J then f_full r l else 0

noncomputable def pointArcTruncBeta {k : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
    (β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun l r => if l ≤ J then β_full l r else 0

structure PointArcJetAndTaylorToolkit : Prop where
  taylor2D_const : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c
  taylor2D_linear_coords : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
    centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 ∧
    centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1
  taylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀
  taylor2D_ring : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀
  taylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → IsOpen W →
    ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U → ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W) →
      taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
        compPowerSeries2D (pointArcHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀)
  taylor2D_comp_2D : ∀ {U U' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → IsOpen U' →
    ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U → ∀ {φ₀ φ₁ F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ φ₀ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ φ₁ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ F U' →
      (∀ p ∈ U, (φ₀ p, φ₁ p) ∈ U') →
      taylor2D (fun p => F (φ₀ p, φ₁ p)) p₀ =
        pointArcComp2D (taylor2D F (φ₀ p₀, φ₁ p₀))
          (centeredTaylor2D φ₀ p₀) (centeredTaylor2D φ₁ p₀)
  psSqrt1p_laws :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff pointArcPsSqrt1p = 1 ∧
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff pointArcPsInvSqrt1p = 1 ∧
    pointArcPsSqrt1p ^ 2 = 1 + PowerSeries.X ∧
    pointArcPsSqrt1p * pointArcPsInvSqrt1p = 1
  epsJet_trunc_eq : ∀ {k J₁ J₂ l : ℕ} (_hJ : J₁ ≤ J₂) (_hl1 : 1 ≤ l) (_hlJ : l ≤ J₁)
    {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) {F : ℂ → ℂ} (_hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_ψ)
    {g₁ : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J₁ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ}
    {g₂ : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J₂ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hg₁ : ∀ r m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g₁ r m) W_ψ)
    (_hg₂ : ∀ r m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g₂ r m) W_ψ)
    (_hg₁0 : ∀ r z, g₁ r 0 z = 0) (_hg₂0 : ∀ r z, g₂ r 0 z = 0)
    (_hg_eq : ∀ r (m : Fin (J₁ + 1)), ∀ z ∈ W_ψ, g₂ r ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ z = g₁ r m z)
    {ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ} (_hℓ_ne : ∀ i, ℓ₀ i ≠ 0)
    {x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} (_hx₀ : ∀ r, x₀ r ∈ W_ψ)
    (_hℓ_sq : ∀ i, (ℓ₀ i) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) x₀ i)
    {β₁ : Fin (J₁ + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} {β₂ : Fin (J₂ + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hβ₁0 : ∀ s, β₁ 0 s = 0) (_hβ₂0 : ∀ s, β₂ 0 s = 0)
    (_hβ_eq : ∀ (m : Fin (J₁ + 1)) s, β₂ ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ s = β₁ m s),
    pointArcEpsJet l
        (fun ε =>
          pointRelChainLen ℓ₀ (pointArcPertGraph F g₂ ε) (pointArcPertAbscissa x₀ β₂ ε)) =
      pointArcEpsJet l
        (fun ε =>
          pointRelChainLen ℓ₀ (pointArcPertGraph F g₁ ε) (pointArcPertAbscissa x₀ β₁ ε)) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      pointArcEpsJet l
          (fun ε =>
            pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ₀ (pointArcPertGraph F g₂ ε)
              (pointArcPertGraphDeriv F g₂ ε) (pointArcPertAbscissa x₀ β₂ ε) r) =
        pointArcEpsJet l
          (fun ε =>
            pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ₀ (pointArcPertGraph F g₁ ε)
              (pointArcPertGraphDeriv F g₁ ε) (pointArcPertAbscissa x₀ β₁ ε) r)
  epsJet_holo : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) (_hV : IsOpen V) {F : ℂ → ℂ} (_hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_ψ)
    {g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} (_hg : ∀ r l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g r l) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ r z, g r 0 z = 0) {ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hℓ₀ : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℓ₀ i) V) (_hℓ_ne : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i, ℓ₀ i q ≠ 0)
    {x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (_hx₀ : ∀ r, DifferentiableOn ℂ (x₀ r) V)
    (_hx_maps : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ r, x₀ r q ∈ W_ψ)
    (_hℓ_sq : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i, (ℓ₀ i q) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (fun r => x₀ r q) i)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hβ : ∀ l r, DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l r) V) (_hβ0 : ∀ r q, β 0 r q = 0),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q =>
        pointArcEpsJet m
          (fun ε =>
            pointRelChainLen (fun i => ℓ₀ i q) (pointArcPertGraph F g ε)
              (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q) ε)))
      V ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q =>
          pointArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε =>
              pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => ℓ₀ i q) (pointArcPertGraph F g ε)
                (pointArcPertGraphDeriv F g ε)
                (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q) ε) r))
        V
  epsJet_succ_split : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (_hk : 2 ≤ k) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ)
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (_hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_ψ)
    {g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} {g_top : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hg : ∀ r l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g r l) W_ψ)
    (_hg_top : ∀ r, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_top r) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ r z, g r 0 z = 0)
    (_hg_top_end : ∀ z, g_top 0 z = 0 ∧ g_top (Fin.last k) z = 0)
    {ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ} (_hℓ_ne : ∀ i, ℓ₀ i ≠ 0)
    {x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} (_hx₀ : ∀ r, x₀ r ∈ W_ψ)
    (_hℓ_sq : ∀ i, (ℓ₀ i) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) x₀ i)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} {β_top : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hβ0 : ∀ s, β 0 s = 0) (_hβ_top_end : β_top 0 = 0 ∧ β_top (Fin.last k) = 0),
    let g_ext : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1 + 1) → ℂ → ℂ := fun r => Fin.snoc (g r) (g_top r)
    let β_ext : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β β_top
    let β_zero_top : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β (fun _ => 0)
    pointArcEpsJet (J + 1)
        (fun ε =>
          pointRelChainLen ℓ₀ (pointArcPertGraph F g_ext ε)
            (pointArcPertAbscissa x₀ β_ext ε)) =
      pointArcEpsJet (J + 1)
        (fun ε =>
          pointRelChainLen ℓ₀ (pointArcPertGraph F g ε)
            (pointArcPertAbscissa x₀ β ε)) +
      (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
        ((F (x₀ ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) - F (x₀ ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)) /
            ℓ₀ ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ -
          (F (x₀ ⟨r.1 + 2, by have := r.2; omega⟩) - F (x₀ ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)) /
            ℓ₀ ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) *
          g_top ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ (x₀ ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)) +
      (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
        pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ₀ (fun _ => F) (fun _ => deriv F) x₀ r *
          β_top ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      pointArcEpsJet (J + 1)
          (fun ε =>
            pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ₀ (pointArcPertGraph F g_ext ε)
              (pointArcPertGraphDeriv F g_ext ε) (pointArcPertAbscissa x₀ β_ext ε) r) =
        pointArcEpsJet (J + 1)
          (fun ε =>
            pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ₀ (pointArcPertGraph F g_ext ε)
              (pointArcPertGraphDeriv F g_ext ε) (pointArcPertAbscissa x₀ β_zero_top ε) r) +
        ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
          pointInteriorHess ℓ₀ F (deriv F) (deriv (deriv F)) x₀ r s *
            β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
  taylor2D_epsJet_eq : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {p₁ : ℂ × ℂ}
    (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) (_hV : IsOpen V) (_hp₁ : p₁ ∈ V)
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (_hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_ψ)
    {g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} (_hg : ∀ r l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g r l) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ r z, g r 0 z = 0) {ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hℓ₀ : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℓ₀ i) V) (_hℓ_ne : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i, ℓ₀ i q ≠ 0)
    {x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (_hx₀ : ∀ r, DifferentiableOn ℂ (x₀ r) V)
    (_hx_maps : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ r, x₀ r q ∈ W_ψ)
    (_hℓ_sq : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i, (ℓ₀ i q) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (fun r => x₀ r q) i)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hβ : ∀ l r, DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l r) V) (_hβ0 : ∀ r q, β 0 r q = 0),
    let ℓ_star := fun i => ℓ₀ i p₁
    let x_star := fun r => x₀ r p₁
    let f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun r l =>
      if l = 0 then pointArcHoloTaylor1D F (x_star r)
      else if hl : l < J + 1 then pointArcHoloTaylor1D (g r ⟨l, hl⟩) (x_star r)
      else 0
    let β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun l r =>
      if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D (x₀ r) p₁
      else if hl : l < J + 1 then taylor2D (β ⟨l, hl⟩ r) p₁
      else 0
    taylor2D
        (fun q =>
          pointArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε =>
              pointRelChainLen (fun i => ℓ₀ i q) (pointArcPertGraph F g ε)
                (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q) ε)))
        p₁ =
      pointArcSlice2D1D m (pointArcFormalLen2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      taylor2D
          (fun q =>
            pointArcEpsJet m
              (fun ε =>
                pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => ℓ₀ i q) (pointArcPertGraph F g ε)
                  (pointArcPertGraphDeriv F g ε)
                  (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q) ε) r))
          p₁ =
        pointArcSlice2D1D m (pointArcFormalGrad2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq r)

structure PointArcFormalDeformationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  p : ℕ
  p_pos : 1 ≤ p
  r₀ : Fin (k - 1)
  f_full : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ
  U_formal : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ
  V_formal : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ
  β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ
  f_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    f_full r 0 = pointArcHoloTaylor1D G.F (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
  f_endpoints : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → f_full 0 l = 0 ∧ f_full (Fin.last k) l = 0
  β_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full 0 r = centeredTaylor2D (G.x_fn r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  β_endpoints : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → β_full l 0 = 0 ∧ β_full l (Fin.last k) = 0
  f_lead_ne_zero : f_full ⟨r₀.1 + 1, by have := r₀.2; omega⟩ p ≠ 0
  vanish_lt_p : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l < p →
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), f_full r l = 0) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full l r = 0) ∧
    U_formal l = 0 ∧ V_formal l = 0
  formal_web_step : ∀ J : ℕ,
    ∑ r : Fin (k + 1),
      taylor2D (G.w_web r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
        compPowerSeries2D
          (if h : r.1 < k - 1 then f_full ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ (J + 1)
           else if r.1 = k - 1 then U_formal (J + 1)
           else V_formal (J + 1))
          (centeredTaylor2D (G.ψ_web r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) =
      -pointArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (pointArcFormalLen2D1D
          (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (fun r => G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (pointArcTruncGraph J f_full)
          (pointArcTruncBeta J β_full))
  formal_hess_step : ∀ J : ℕ, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    pointArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (pointArcFormalGrad2D1D
          (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (fun u => G.x_fn u ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (pointArcTruncGraph (J + 1) f_full)
          (pointArcTruncBeta J β_full)
          r) +
      ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
        taylor2D
          (fun q =>
            pointInteriorHess (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) G.F (deriv G.F) (deriv (deriv G.F))
              (fun u => G.x_fn u q) r s)
          ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
        β_full (J + 1) ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ = 0

structure PointArcStepAnalyticData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) (D_form : PointArcFormalDeformationData C B k G a₁ δ₁) (J : ℕ) where
  W_ψ : Set ℂ
  V_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  U_split : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  V_split : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  W_ψ_open : IsOpen W_ψ
  W_ψ_preconn : IsPreconnected W_ψ
  W_ψ_sub_W_F : W_ψ ⊆ G.W_F
  real_mem_W_ψ : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - G.a₀| < G.R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_ψ
  V_plus_open : IsOpen V_plus
  V_plus_preconn : IsPreconnected V_plus
  V_plus_sub : V_plus ⊆ G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d
  trapezoid_mem_V_plus : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀,
    ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_plus
  ψ_maps_W_ψ : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), G.ψ_web r q ∈ W_ψ
  chord_ne_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ i : Fin k, G.ℓ_fn i q ≠ 0
  hess_det_ne_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus,
    (pointInteriorHess (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) G.F (deriv G.F) (deriv (deriv G.F))
      (fun s => G.x_fn s q)).det ≠ 0
  g_holo : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g r l) W_ψ
  g_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (z : ℂ), g 0 l z = 0 ∧ g (Fin.last k) l z = 0
  g_lt_p : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < D_form.p → ∀ z : ℂ, g r l z = 0
  g_taylor : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    pointArcHoloTaylor1D (g r l) (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) = D_form.f_full r (l : ℕ)
  UV_holo : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (U_split l) W_ψ ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (V_split l) W_ψ
  UV_lt_p : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1), (l : ℕ) < D_form.p → ∀ z : ℂ, U_split l z = 0 ∧ V_split l z = 0
  UV_taylor : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    pointArcHoloTaylor1D (U_split l) (a₁ : ℂ) = D_form.U_formal (l : ℕ) ∧
    pointArcHoloTaylor1D (V_split l) ((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) = D_form.V_formal (l : ℕ)
  β_holo : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l r) V_plus
  β_zero : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β 0 r q = 0
  β_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β l 0 q = 0 ∧ β l (Fin.last k) q = 0
  β_taylor : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    taylor2D (β l r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) = D_form.β_full (l : ℕ) r
  grad_jet_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ J →
    pointArcEpsJet l
      (fun ε =>
        pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) (pointArcPertGraph G.F g ε)
          (pointArcPertGraphDeriv G.F g ε)
          (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun s => G.x_fn s q) (fun m s => β m s q) ε) r) = 0
  len_jet_split : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    pointArcEpsJet (l : ℕ)
      (fun ε =>
        pointRelChainLen (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) (pointArcPertGraph G.F g ε)
          (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun s => G.x_fn s q) (fun m s => β m s q) ε)) =
      U_split l q.1 + V_split l (q.1 + q.2)

def IsTriangularHoloMap (W₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsOpen W₁ ∧
  ∃ (U_v : Set ℂ) (h φ : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U_v ∧ IsPreconnected U_v ∧
    (∀ p ∈ W₁, p.2 ∈ U_v ∧ Υ p = (p.1 + h p.2, φ p.2)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ h U_v ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ φ U_v ∧
    ∃ v₀ ∈ U_v, deriv φ v₀ ≠ 0

structure Mero2DPullbackGluingToolkit : Prop where
  ofHolo : ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
    ∃ H : MeroOn2D U, MeroAgreesHolo H f U ∧
      ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : MeroOn2D W) (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
        IsOpen V → V ⊆ U →
        (MeroAgreesHolo F f V ↔ MeroEqOn F H V)
  eqOn_symm : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
    (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₁ U
  eqOn_mono : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
    {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, V ⊆ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V
  eqOn_trans : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂) (F₃ : MeroOn2D W₃)
    (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₃ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₃ U
  eqOn_of_isPreconnected : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂) (V V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsOpen V → IsPreconnected V → V ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
    IsOpen V₀ → V₀.Nonempty → V₀ ⊆ V →
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₀ → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V
  restrictOpen : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W) (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsOpen V → V ⊆ W → ∃ G : MeroOn2D V, MeroEqOn G F V
  glueCover : ∀ {ι : Type} (U : ι → Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (G : ∀ α, MeroOn2D (U α)),
    (∀ α, IsOpen (U α)) → IsOpen W → W ⊆ (⋃ α, U α) →
    (∀ α β, MeroEqOn (G α) (G β) (U α ∩ U β)) →
    ∃ F : MeroOn2D W, ∀ α, MeroEqOn F (G α) (W ∩ U α)
  glueBinary : ∀ {U₁ U₂ W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G₁ : MeroOn2D U₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D U₂),
    IsOpen U₁ → IsOpen U₂ → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U₁ ∪ U₂ →
    MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ (U₁ ∩ U₂) →
    ∃ F : MeroOn2D W, MeroEqOn F G₁ (W ∩ U₁) ∧ MeroEqOn F G₂ (W ∩ U₂)
  triangular_mono : ∀ {W₁ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
    IsOpen U → U ⊆ W₁ → IsTriangularHoloMap W₁ Υ → IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ
  eqOn_iff_pullback_id : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
    (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U ↔ MeroEqOnPullback F₁ F₂ id U
  pullback_mono : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G : MeroOn2D W₁) (F : MeroOn2D W₂)
    (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    V ⊆ U → MeroEqOnPullback G F Υ U → MeroEqOnPullback G F Υ V
  eqOn_pullback_left : ∀ {W₁ W₁' W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₁') (F : MeroOn2D W₂)
    (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ →
    MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ U → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F Υ U → MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F Υ U
  pullback_exists : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (F : MeroOn2D W₂),
    IsTriangularHoloMap W₁ Υ → Set.MapsTo Υ W₁ W₂ →
    ∃ G : MeroOn2D W₁, MeroEqOnPullback G F Υ W₁
  pullback_right_eqOn : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₂' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (G : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₂) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂')
    (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U V₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ → Set.MapsTo Υ U V₂ →
    MeroEqOnPullback G F₁ Υ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₂ → MeroEqOnPullback G F₂ Υ U
  pullback_comp : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂) (F : MeroOn2D W₃)
    (Υ₁ Υ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U₁ U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsTriangularHoloMap U₁ Υ₁ → IsTriangularHoloMap U₂ Υ₂ →
    Set.MapsTo Υ₁ U₁ U₂ →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₁ G₂ Υ₁ U₁ → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F Υ₂ U₂ →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F (Υ₂ ∘ Υ₁) U₁
  pullback_congr_eqOn : ∀ {W₁ W₁' W₂ W₂' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₁') (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₂) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂')
    (Υ₁ Υ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U V₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ₁ → (∀ p ∈ U, Υ₁ p = Υ₂ p) → Set.MapsTo Υ₁ U V₂ →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F₁ Υ₁ U → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F₂ Υ₂ U →
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₂ → MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ U

noncomputable def rjCompConst_rajcb : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n + 1, B => max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * (max B 0 + 1)) * rjCompConst_rajcb n B

def IsParamJetBounded_rajcb {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α) (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ)
    (F : α → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ a ∈ S, ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (F a)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p →
    ContinuousOn (fun q : α × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (F q.1) q.2) (S ×ˢ Set.univ)) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (F a) x| ≤ B)

def IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α) (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ)
    (Φ : α → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ a ∈ S, ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (Φ a)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p →
    ContinuousOn (fun q : α × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (Φ q.1) q.2) (S ×ˢ Set.univ)) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j (Φ a) x| ≤ B)

def IsParamJetPair_rajcb {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α) (p : ℕ)
    (Δ B L : ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧
  IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F₁ ∧
  IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F₂ ∧

structure RjCalcToolkit_rajcb : Prop where
  compConst_ge_one : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 1 ≤ rjCompConst_rajcb p B
  compConst_max_zero : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ), rjCompConst_rajcb p (max B 0) = rjCompConst_rajcb p B
  congr : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
      {F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, F₁ a x = F₂ a x) →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F₁ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F₂
  congr_inner : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
      {Φ₁ Φ₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, Φ₁ a x = Φ₂ a x) →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ₁ → IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ₂
  mono : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
      {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    B₁ ≤ B₂ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₁ F → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₂ F
  param_const : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} (p : ℕ) {B : ℝ}
      {c : α → ℝ},
    0 ≤ B → ContinuousOn c S → (∀ a ∈ S, |c a| ≤ B) →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B (fun a _ => c a)
  add : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
      {F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₁ F₁ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₂ F₂ →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (B₁ + B₂) (fun a x => F₁ a x + F₂ a x)
  sub : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
      {F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₁ F₁ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₂ F₂ →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (B₁ + B₂) (fun a x => F₁ a x - F₂ a x)
  neg : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
      {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B (fun a x => -F a x)
  param_mul : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {C B : ℝ}
      {c : α → ℝ} {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    0 ≤ C → 0 ≤ B → ContinuousOn c S → (∀ a ∈ S, |c a| ≤ C) →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (C * B) (fun a x => c a * F a x)
  mul : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
      {F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    0 ≤ B₁ → 0 ≤ B₂ →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₁ F₁ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₂ F₂ →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * B₁ * B₂) (fun a x => F₁ a x * F₂ a x)
  pullback : ∀ {α β : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β]
      {S : Set α} {T : Set β} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ} {φ : β → α} {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    ContinuousOn φ T → Set.MapsTo φ T S →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb T p B (fun b x => F (φ b) x)
  pullback_inner : ∀ {α β : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β]
      {S : Set α} {T : Set β} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ} {φ : β → α} {Φ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    ContinuousOn φ T → Set.MapsTo φ T S →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb T p B (fun b x => Φ (φ b) x)
  inner_of_bounded : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
      {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F → IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B F
  inner_add : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
      {Φ₁ Φ₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B₁ Φ₁ → IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B₂ Φ₂ →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p (B₁ + B₂) (fun a x => Φ₁ a x + Φ₂ a x)
  comp_bound : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} (p : ℕ) {M_g B : ℝ}
      {g : ℝ → ℝ} {Φ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) g →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ →
    0 ≤ M_g →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j g (Φ a x)| ≤ M_g) →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (M_g * rjCompConst_rajcb p B) (fun a x => g (Φ a x))
  param_integral : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
      {F : (α × ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ},
    0 ≤ B →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb (S ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) p B F →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B (fun a x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F (a, t) x)
  comp_diff_bound : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} (p : ℕ) {M_g Δg B ΔΦ : ℝ}
      {g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ} {Φ₁ Φ₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    ContDiff ℝ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g₁ →
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) g₂ →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ₁ →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ₂ →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p ΔΦ (fun a x => Φ₁ a x - Φ₂ a x) →
    0 ≤ M_g → 0 ≤ Δg → 0 ≤ ΔΦ →
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p + 1 → ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv j g₁ (Φ₂ a x + s * (Φ₁ a x - Φ₂ a x))| ≤ M_g) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv j (fun y => g₁ y - g₂ y) (Φ₂ a x)| ≤ Δg) →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (M_g * rjCompConst_rajcb p B) * ΔΦ + Δg * rjCompConst_rajcb p B)
      (fun a x => g₁ (Φ₁ a x) - g₂ (Φ₂ a x))

def lineCoalescingTridiag (m : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    if r.1 = s.1 then 2
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 ∨ r.1 = s.1 + 1 then -1
    else 0

def lineCoalescingIntVtx {k : ℕ} (s : Fin (k - 1)) : Fin (k + 1) :=
  ⟨s.1 + 1, Nat.add_lt_add_right (lt_of_lt_of_le s.2 (Nat.sub_le k 1)) 1⟩

noncomputable def lineCoalescingDslopeIter (F : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  | 0 => F
  | n + 1 => dslope (lineCoalescingDslopeIter F z₀ n) z₀

noncomputable def lineCoalescingFormalSeq (k : ℕ) (r_a : ℂ) (f_p : Fin k → ℂ) :
    ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  | 0 => fun s => ((s.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
  | q + 1 =>
      let prev : Fin (q + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ :=
        fun m =>
          have _ := m.2
          lineCoalescingFormalSeq k r_a f_p m.1
      let Δ : Fin (q + 1) → Fin k → ℂ :=
        fun m i => prev m i.succ - prev m i.castSucc
      let quad : Fin k → ℂ :=
        fun i =>
          ∑ a ∈ (Finset.Ico 1 (q + 1)).attach,
            Δ ⟨a.1, (Finset.mem_Ico.mp a.2).2⟩ i *
              Δ ⟨q + 1 - a.1, by have := Finset.mem_Ico.mp a.2; omega⟩ i
      let rhs : Fin (k - 1) → ℂ :=
        fun r =>
          if hk : 2 ≤ k then
            -(r_a / 8) *
                (quad ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ -
                  quad ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) +
              (if q = 0 then
                f_p ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ -
                  f_p ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
              else 0)
          else 0
      let A₀ : Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
        (-(r_a / (4 * (k : ℂ)))) • lineCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)
      let sol : Fin (k - 1) → ℂ := (A₀.det)⁻¹ • A₀.cramer (-rhs)
      fun s =>
        if _hs0 : s.1 = 0 then 0
        else if _hsk : s.1 < k then sol ⟨s.1 - 1, by omega⟩
        else 0

noncomputable def lcJetMid2D {k : ℕ}
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (β i.castSucc + β i.succ)

noncomputable def lcJetHalfStep2D {k : ℕ}
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (β i.succ - β i.castSucc)

noncomputable def lcJetAction2D {k : ℕ}
    (h_ser S_ser : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    MvPowerSeries.C (2 : ℂ) *
      compPowerSeries2D (h_ser i) (lcJetMid2D β i) *
      compPowerSeries2D (S_ser i) (lcJetHalfStep2D β i)

noncomputable def lcJetEdgePlus2D
    (h_i S_i C_i : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (ψ_i d_i : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative h_i) ψ_i * compPowerSeries2D S_i d_i +
    compPowerSeries2D h_i ψ_i * compPowerSeries2D C_i d_i

noncomputable def lcJetEdgeMinus2D
    (h_i S_i C_i : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (ψ_i d_i : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative h_i) ψ_i * compPowerSeries2D S_i d_i -
    compPowerSeries2D h_i ψ_i * compPowerSeries2D C_i d_i

noncomputable def lcJetGrad2D {k : ℕ}
    (h_ser S_ser C_ser : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (r : Fin (k - 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  lcJetEdgePlus2D (h_ser i_L) (S_ser i_L) (C_ser i_L)
      (lcJetMid2D β i_L) (lcJetHalfStep2D β i_L) +
    lcJetEdgeMinus2D (h_ser i_R) (S_ser i_R) (C_ser i_R)
      (lcJetMid2D β i_R) (lcJetHalfStep2D β i_R)

noncomputable def lcJetFormalHess {k : ℕ}
    (h_ser : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ) (s_d c_d : Fin k → ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let h0_L := PowerSeries.coeff 0 (h_ser i_L)
    let h1_L := PowerSeries.coeff 1 (h_ser i_L)
    let h2_L := 2 * PowerSeries.coeff 2 (h_ser i_L)
    let h0_R := PowerSeries.coeff 0 (h_ser i_R)
    let h1_R := PowerSeries.coeff 1 (h_ser i_R)
    let h2_R := 2 * PowerSeries.coeff 2 (h_ser i_R)
    if r.1 = s.1 then
      ((h2_L - h0_L) / 2 * s_d i_L + h1_L * c_d i_L) +
        ((h2_R - h0_R) / 2 * s_d i_R - h1_R * c_d i_R)
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
      (h0_R + h2_R) / 2 * s_d i_R
    else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
      (h0_L + h2_L) / 2 * s_d i_L
    else
      0

noncomputable def lcJetTrunc1D (K : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m => if m ≤ K then PowerSeries.coeff m f else 0

noncomputable def lcJetTruncAngles {k : ℕ} (N₀ : ℕ)
    (α : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun u =>
    if r.1 = 0 ∨ r.1 = k then MvPowerSeries.coeff u (α r)
    else if u 0 + u 1 < N₀ then MvPowerSeries.coeff u (α r)
    else 0

def sjcHoloLipPair (p : ℕ) (σ' M L Δ : ℝ) (f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=

  IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M f₁ ∧
  IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M f₂ ∧
