noncomputable def sjcPowM (p : ℕ) (M : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | d + 1 => (2 : ℝ) ^ p * sjcPowM p M d * M

noncomputable def sjcPowL (p : ℕ) (M L : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 0
  | d + 1 => (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (sjcPowM p M d * L + sjcPowL p M L d * M)

noncomputable def sjcInvM (p : ℕ) (M_g : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2)) * shjCompConst p M_g

noncomputable def sjcInvL (p : ℕ) (M_g L_g : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ p * sjcInvM p M_g * L_g

noncomputable def sjcDivM (p : ℕ) (M_f M_g : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ p * M_f * sjcInvM p M_g

noncomputable def sjcDivL (p : ℕ) (M_f L_f M_g L_g : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (M_f * sjcInvL p M_g L_g + L_f * sjcInvM p M_g)

noncomputable def sjcExpM (p : ℕ) (M_f : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (M_f + 1) * shjCompConst p M_f

noncomputable def sjcExpL (p : ℕ) (M_f L_f : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  shjCompConst p M_f * ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * Real.exp (M_f + 1) * L_f)

noncomputable def sjcSincM (p : ℕ) (M_f : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * sjcExpM p M_f

noncomputable def sjcSincL (p : ℕ) (M_f L_f : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * sjcExpL p M_f L_f

def sjcAdmissibleEval (m : ℕ) (M₁ σ σ' Δ : ℝ)
    (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ X₁ T₁ z₀₁ X₂ T₂ z₀₂ : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  0 < σ ∧ 0 < σ' ∧ 0 ≤ Δ ∧
  IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₁ W₁ ∧
  IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₂ W₂ ∧
  sjcHoloLipPair (m + 2) σ' 1 1 Δ T₁ T₂ ∧
  sjcHoloLipPair (m + 2) σ' 1 1 Δ z₀₁ z₀₂ ∧
  sjcHoloLipPair (m + 2) σ' 1 (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 2)) Δ
    (fun z => T₁ z * z₀₁ z) (fun z => T₂ z * z₀₂ z) ∧
  (∀ c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
    (X₁ z + (c : ℂ) * T₁ z ∈ horizStrip σ ∧ X₂ z + (c : ℂ) * T₂ z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
    (X₁ z + (c : ℂ) * (T₁ z * z₀₁ z) ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
      X₂ z + (c : ℂ) * (T₂ z * z₀₂ z) ∈ horizStrip σ)) ∧
  (∀ (L_y : ℝ) (y₁ y₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    sjcHoloLipPair (m + 2) σ' 1 L_y Δ y₁ y₂ →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', X₁ z + y₁ z ∈ horizStrip σ ∧ X₂ z + y₂ z ∈ horizStrip σ) →
    ∀ d : ℕ, d ≤ 3 →
      sjcHoloLipPair (m + 2) σ'
        (M₁ * shjCompConst (m + 2) 3)
        (shjCompConst (m + 2) 3 * (1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 2) * M₁ * (1 + L_y)))
        Δ
        (fun z => iteratedDeriv d W₁ (X₁ z + y₁ z))
        (fun z => iteratedDeriv d W₂ (X₂ z + y₂ z))) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
    ‖mFactor_C W₁ (X₁ z) (T₁ z) (z₀₁ z) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
    ‖mFactor_C W₂ (X₂ z) (T₂ z) (z₀₂ z) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2)

noncomputable def glancingPrelimLift (t₀ : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star : ℂ → ℂ)
    (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  U p + (U_star p.1 - U (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ)))

noncomputable def glancingAffineCand (t₀ : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star z : ℂ → ℂ)
    (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  U p + (U_star p.1 - U (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ))) +
    (p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)) * (deriv U_star p.1 * z p.1)

noncomputable def glancingJetWitness (t₀ : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star z : ℂ → ℂ)
    (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((U_star p.1 - U (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ))) +
    (p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)) * (deriv U_star p.1 * z p.1)) /
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', p.2)) p.1

def PrelimCyclicJetSolveProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  CyclicJetAndDiffOpProp →
  ∃ C_z : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_z ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ε η_slice : ℝ) (N l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 →
      0 ≤ η_slice → η_slice ≤ S.η_adm / 8 → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
      1 ≤ l → 2 ≤ q → q ≤ N →
      let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
      t₀ < d - 2 * δ →
      ExactRationalSliceAt B s δ η_slice l q U U_star →
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
      let η_tot := ε + η_slice
      ∃ z : ℂ → ℂ,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ z (horizStrip (s - 6 * δ)) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ), z (y + 2 * Real.pi) = z y) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ), ‖z y‖ ≤ C_z * Q ^ 5 * η_tot) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ),
          glancingDiffOp
            (fun p =>
              glancingLinCoeff B (fun r => U_star r.1) (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) *
                (glancingDiffOp
                  (fun r =>
                    deriv (fun t : ℂ => U (r.1, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) / deriv U_star r.1 + z r.1)
                  (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹))
            (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0)

def AffineJetRegularityProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  CyclicJetAndDiffOpProp →
  ∀ (s d δ η_slice M_z t₀ : ℝ) (l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star z : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
    0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 ≤ η_slice → 0 ≤ M_z →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
    0 < t₀ → t₀ < d - 2 * δ →
    t₀ = (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) →
    ExactRationalSliceAt B s δ η_slice l q U U_star →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ z (horizStrip (s - 6 * δ)) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ), z (y + 2 * Real.pi) = z y ∧ ‖z y‖ ≤ M_z) →
    let Q₀ := 1 + δ⁻¹
    let ρ_jet := η_slice + 10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z
    let U_tilde := glancingAffineCand t₀ U U_star z
    let W_plus := glancingJetWitness t₀ U U_star z
    let g_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingLinCoeff B U p * glancingDiffOp W_plus p
    let H_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingResidualOp B U p + glancingDiffOp g_plus p
    ρ_jet ≤ S.η_adm / 8 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U_tilde
      (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W_plus
      (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4),
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - U (y', t)) w‖ ≤ ρ_jet ∧
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - y') w‖ ≤ 7 * S.η_adm / 8) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4),
      ‖W_plus (w, t)‖ ≤ (4 / 3 : ℝ) * ρ_jet) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W_plus
      (horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
      W_plus (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = W_plus (y, t)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ g_plus
      (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
      g_plus (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = g_plus (y, t) ∧
      ‖g_plus (y, t)‖ ≤ 6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet ∧
      ‖glancingDiffOp W_plus (y, t)‖ ≤ 6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H_plus
      (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H_plus
      (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun y : ℂ => deriv (fun t : ℂ => H_plus (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ))
      (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ))

def ExactJetQuadCompatProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  ∀ (s d δ ε η_slice ρ_jet t₀ : ℝ) (l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star z : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
    0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → 0 ≤ η_slice → 0 ≤ ρ_jet → ρ_jet ≤ S.η_adm / 8 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
    (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
    0 < t₀ → t₀ < d - 2 * δ →
    t₀ = (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) →
    ExactRationalSliceAt B s δ η_slice l q U U_star →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ z (horizStrip (s - 6 * δ)) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ),
      glancingDiffOp
        (fun p =>
          glancingLinCoeff B (fun r => U_star r.1) (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) *
            (glancingDiffOp
              (fun r =>
                deriv (fun t : ℂ => U (r.1, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) / deriv U_star r.1 + z r.1)
              (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹))
        (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0) →
    let U_tilde := glancingAffineCand t₀ U U_star z
    let W_plus := glancingJetWitness t₀ U U_star z
    let g_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingLinCoeff B U p * glancingDiffOp W_plus p
    let H_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingResidualOp B U p + glancingDiffOp g_plus p
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U_tilde
      (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W_plus
      (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4),
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - U (y', t)) w‖ ≤ ρ_jet ∧
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - y') w‖ ≤ 7 * S.η_adm / 8) →
    (∀ w ∈ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4),
      ‖W_plus (w, t)‖ ≤ (4 / 3 : ℝ) * ρ_jet) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H_plus
      (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)) →
    let Q₀ := 1 + δ⁻¹
    let M_quad_raw := 8 * Q₀ * (3 * Q₀ * ε * ρ_jet + S.C_quad * ρ_jet ^ 2)
    ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 10 * δ),
      ‖H_plus (y, (t₀ : ℂ))‖ ≤ M_quad_raw ∧
      ‖deriv (fun t : ℂ => H_plus (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ M_quad_raw

def IsIsolatedGraphSlicedAt (y_c τ_c : ℂ) (ρ_y ρ_t : ℝ) (H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (t₂ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ({ y : ℂ | y ∈ Metric.closedBall y_c (3 * ρ_y / 4) ∧ H (y, (t₂ : ℂ)) = 0 }).Finite ∧
  ∀ y_star ∈ Metric.ball y_c (3 * ρ_y / 4),
    ∃ (r_u r_t : ℝ) (z : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_u ∧ 0 < r_t ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ z (Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) r_t) ∧
      z (t₂ : ℂ) = y_star ∧
      ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_u, ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) r_t,
        (z t + u, t) ∈ Metric.ball y_c ρ_y ×ˢ Metric.ball τ_c ρ_t ∧
        (u ≠ 0 → H (z t + u, t) ≠ 0)

def SeparableRectRootContProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ) (t_c : ℂ) (r_t : ℝ) (D : ℕ),
    a₁ < a₂ → b₁ < b₂ → 0 < r_t → 1 ≤ D →
    let R_w : Set ℂ := { w : ℂ | a₁ < w.re ∧ w.re < a₂ ∧ b₁ < w.im ∧ w.im < b₂ }
    let U : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := R_w ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c r_t
    ∀ (A : Fin (D + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ d : Fin (D + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (A d) U) →
      (∀ q ∈ U,
        A (Fin.last D) q ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ z : ℂ,
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), A d q * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
          ∑ d : Fin D, (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * A d.succ q * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0) →
      ((∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (g₁ g₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
          IsOpen V → IsPreconnected V → V ⊆ U → q₀ ∈ V →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ V → DifferentiableOn ℂ g₂ V →
          (∀ q ∈ V, ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), A d q * (g₁ q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) →
          (∀ q ∈ V, ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), A d q * (g₂ q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) →
          g₁ q₀ = g₂ q₀ →
          ∀ q ∈ V, g₁ q = g₂ q) ∧
        (∀ (a₁' a₂' b₁' b₂' : ℝ) (w₀ z₀ : ℂ),
          a₁ < a₁' → a₁' < a₂' → a₂' < a₂ →
          b₁ < b₁' → b₁' < b₂' → b₂' < b₂ →
          a₁' < w₀.re → w₀.re < a₂' → b₁' < w₀.im → w₀.im < b₂' →
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), A d (w₀, t_c) * z₀ ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
          let R_w' : Set ℂ := { w : ℂ | a₁' < w.re ∧ w.re < a₂' ∧ b₁' < w.im ∧ w.im < b₂' }
          ∃ (δ_t : ℝ) (Λ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
            0 < δ_t ∧ δ_t ≤ r_t ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ Λ (R_w' ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c δ_t) ∧
            Λ (w₀, t_c) = z₀ ∧
            ∀ q ∈ R_w' ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c δ_t,
              ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), A d q * (Λ q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0))

def DualLineTubePeriodicProp {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : ℤ) (i : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
    p ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L →
    let shift_k : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
      fun q => (q.1 + ((2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ), q.2)
    shift_k p ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (min ((W.L_mero i).rad p) ((W.L_mero i).rad (shift_k p))),
      (W.L_mero i).num (shift_k p) (shift_k q) * (W.L_mero i).den p q =
        (W.L_mero i).num p q * (W.L_mero i).den (shift_k p) (shift_k q)

def HasLoopBranchDefectAt {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ H₂ x_star : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ ρ₀ < W.s_base / 2 ∧
    ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ →
      ∃ (δ_w δ_loop : ℝ) (Λ_loop : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < δ_w ∧ δ_w ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ 0 < δ_loop ∧
        Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base ∧
        let y_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I
        let w_start : ℂ := (Real.log ρ : ℂ) - ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
        let p₀ : ℂ × ℂ := (y_star - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I + (t₂ : ℂ), (t₂ : ℂ))
        let LoopStrip : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
          { w : ℂ | |w.re - Real.log ρ| < δ_w ∧
              w.im ∈ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 8) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 8) } ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop
        p₀ ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Λ_loop ι) LoopStrip) ∧
        (∃ r_att : ℝ, 0 < r_att ∧
          ∀ w t : ℂ, ‖w - w_start‖ < r_att → ‖t - (t₂ : ℂ)‖ < r_att →
            (w, t) ∈ LoopStrip ∧
            ∀ ι : Fin 2,
              (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ ((W.L_mero ι).rad p₀) ∧
              (W.L_mero ι).num p₀ (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t) =
                Λ_loop ι (w, t) * (W.L_mero ι).den p₀ (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t)) ∧
        (∃ ι : Fin 2,
          ¬ ∀ᶠ p in nhds (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)),
              Λ_loop ι (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, p.2) = Λ_loop ι p)

def pointCoalescingTridiag (m : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    if r.1 = s.1 then 2
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 ∨ r.1 = s.1 + 1 then -1
    else 0

def pointCoalescingExtend {R : Type*} [Zero R] [One R] {k : ℕ}
    (u : Fin (k - 1) → R) (s : Fin (k + 1)) : R :=
  if hs0 : s.1 = 0 then 0
  else if hs : s.1 < k then u ⟨s.1 - 1, by omega⟩
  else 1

def pointCoalescingStep {R : Type*} [Ring R] {k : ℕ}
    (u : Fin (k - 1) → R) (i : Fin k) : R :=
  pointCoalescingExtend u i.succ - pointCoalescingExtend u i.castSucc

noncomputable def pointFormalEdgeLambda {k : ℕ} (r_a : ℂ) (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (z : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ) (i : Fin k) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  -PowerSeries.C (r_a ^ 2 / 8) * (z i) ^ 2 -
    PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * PowerSeries.X -
    PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * ((z i)⁻¹) ^ 2

noncomputable def pointFormalDerivSeries {k : ℕ} (r_a : ℂ) (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (u : Fin (k - 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  let z := pointCoalescingStep u
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    (-PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * z i +
      PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2) * PowerSeries.X * (z i)⁻¹)

structure PointCoalescingFormalData (k : ℕ) (r_a : ℂ) (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) where
  tridiag_det_ne : (pointCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)).det ≠ 0
  u_ps : Fin (k - 1) → PowerSeries ℂ
  const_eq : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (u_ps r) = ((r.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
  coeff_rec : ∀ (q : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    let u_trunc : Fin (k - 1) → Polynomial ℂ := fun s =>
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range q, Polynomial.C (PowerSeries.coeff m (u_ps s)) * Polynomial.X ^ m
    let z_trunc : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i =>
      ((pointCoalescingStep u_trunc i : Polynomial ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ)
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    ((-(r_a ^ 2 / (4 * (k : ℂ)))) • pointCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)).mulVec
        (fun s => PowerSeries.coeff q (u_ps s)) r +
      PowerSeries.coeff q
        (pointFormalEdgeLambda r_a f_p z_trunc i_L -
          pointFormalEdgeLambda r_a f_p z_trunc i_R) = 0
  zero_of_higher_deriv_vanish :
    (∀ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d → PowerSeries.coeff d (pointFormalDerivSeries r_a f_p u_ps) = 0) →
      ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), f_p r = 0

noncomputable def pointLimEdgeLambda {k : ℕ} (r_a : ℂ) (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (w : ℂ) (Z : Fin k → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  -(r_a ^ 2 / 8) * (Z i) ^ 2 -
    (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * w -
    ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) * w ^ 2 * ((Z i) ^ 2)⁻¹

noncomputable def pointCoalescingTermII {k J : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ)
    (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let F_pert : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun m z => F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * g m q z
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    ((F_pert i.succ (x_vec i.succ) - F_pert i.castSucc (x_vec i.castSucc)) /
        pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base F_pert x_vec i) *
      ∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
        if p ≤ (q : ℕ) then
          ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * ε ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
            (g i.succ q (x_vec i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_vec i.castSucc))
        else 0

noncomputable def rl6_impactDotYY (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_loc 0) q) ^ 2 + (iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_loc 1) q) ^ 2

noncomputable def rl6_impactDotTY (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iterDerivYT 0 1 (X_loc 0) q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_loc 0) q +
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (X_loc 1) q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_loc 1) q

noncomputable def rl6_impactDetYYY (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_loc 0) q * iterDerivYT 2 0 (X_loc 1) q -
    iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_loc 1) q * iterDerivYT 2 0 (X_loc 0) q

def rl6_IsLocalRegularImpactChart {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (p : ℂ × ℂ) (r : ℝ)
    (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  0 < r ∧
  Metric.ball p r ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X ∧
  (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_loc i) (Metric.ball p r)) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (M.X_mero i) (X_loc i) (Metric.ball p r)) ∧
  rl6_impactDotYY X_loc p ≠ 0 ∧
  rl6_impactDetYYY X_loc p ≠ 0

def rl6_regularLocusSet {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X |
    ∃ (r : ℝ) (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      rl6_IsLocalRegularImpactChart M p r X_loc }

open Classical in
noncomputable def rl6_regularImpactMap {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (i : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if h : p ∈ rl6_regularLocusSet M then (Classical.choose h.2.choose_spec) i p else 0

noncomputable def rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (rl6_impactDetYYY (rl6_regularImpactMap M) p) ^ 4 /
    ((C.c : ℂ) ^ 2 * (rl6_impactDotYY (rl6_regularImpactMap M) p) ^ 3)

noncomputable def rl6_sixthRootRatioR {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rl6_impactDotTY (rl6_regularImpactMap M) p /
    rl6_impactDotYY (rl6_regularImpactMap M) p

structure rl6_Holo2DRegularToolkit : Prop where
  eqOn_of_preconnected_2D : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {r₀ : ℝ},
    IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W →
    p₀ ∈ W → 0 < r₀ → Metric.ball p₀ r₀ ⊆ W →
    (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀, f q = g q) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = g p
  iterDerivYT_holo : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) W ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) W ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 2 0 f) W
  iterDerivYT_comm : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W →
    ∀ p ∈ W, iterDerivYT 0 1 (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) p = iterDerivYT 1 0 (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) p
  punctured_ball_chain : ∀ {p₀ a b : ℂ × ℂ} {r₀ : ℝ} {h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    0 < r₀ → DifferentiableOn ℂ h (Metric.ball p₀ r₀) →
    a ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀ → b ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀ →
    h a ≠ 0 → h b ≠ 0 →
    ∃ (M_len : ℕ) (c : Fin (M_len + 1) → ℂ × ℂ) (ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε ∧
      c 0 = a ∧
      c (Fin.last M_len) = b ∧
      (∀ k : Fin (M_len + 1), Metric.ball (c k) ε ⊆ { q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀ | h q ≠ 0 }) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin M_len,
        (Metric.ball (c k.castSucc) ε ∩ Metric.ball (c k.succ) ε).Nonempty)

structure SixthRootChainSolution {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (Reg : RegularCollarLocusData C M K)
    (N : ℕ) (c : Fin (N + 1) → ℂ × ℂ) (ρ : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ) where
  c_zero : c 0 = ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))
  ρ_zero : ρ 0 = Reg.r_origin
  balls_valid : ∀ k : Fin (N + 1), 0 < ρ k ∧ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k) ⊆ Reg.U_reg
  overlaps_nonempty : ∀ k : Fin N,
    (Metric.ball (c k.castSucc) (ρ k.castSucc) ∩ Metric.ball (c k.succ) (ρ k.succ)).Nonempty
  𝔰 : Fin (N + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  𝔰_zero_eq : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c 0) (ρ 0), 𝔰 0 q = K.𝔰_init q
  𝔰_holo : ∀ k : Fin (N + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (𝔰 k) (Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k))
  𝔰_ode : ∀ k : Fin (N + 1), ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k),
    (iterDerivYT 1 0 (𝔰 k) q) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q ∧
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (𝔰 k) q = Reg.R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (𝔰 k) q
  𝔰_overlap_eq : ∀ k : Fin N,
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c k.castSucc) (ρ k.castSucc) ∩ Metric.ball (c k.succ) (ρ k.succ),
      𝔰 k.castSucc q = 𝔰 k.succ q

structure IrrShiftSlabCover (x₀ θ₀ t₁ ρ : ℝ) where
  N_slab : ℕ
  N_slab_pos : 1 ≤ N_slab
  x_c : Fin N_slab → ℝ
  a_step : Fin N_slab → ℕ
  b_step : Fin N_slab → ℕ
  p_per : Fin N_slab → ℤ
  q_per : Fin N_slab → ℤ
  step_bounds : ∀ α : Fin N_slab, 1 ≤ a_step α ∧ 2 ≤ b_step α
  covers_period : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
    ∃ α : Fin N_slab, |x - x_c α| < ρ
  back_approx : ∀ α : Fin N_slab,
    |(x_c α + θ₀ - (a_step α : ℝ) * t₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (p_per α : ℝ)) - x₀| < ρ
  fwd_approx : ∀ α : Fin N_slab,
    |(x_c α + θ₀ + (b_step α : ℝ) * t₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (q_per α : ℝ)) - x₀| < ρ

def bandUnshearedSlab (s_base H₁ ε x_c t₁ r₁ : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    |p.1.re - x_c| < ε / 16 ∧
    -s_base / 2 < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < H₁ + 3 * ε / 16 ∧
    ‖p.2 - (t₁ : ℂ)‖ < r₁ }

def bandShearedSlab (s_base H₁ ε x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ | (q.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q.2, q.2) ∈ bandUnshearedSlab s_base H₁ ε x_c t₁ r₁ }

def bandShearedBaseBox (s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ |
    |(q.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q.2).re - x_c| < ε / 16 ∧
    |(q.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q.2).im| < s_base / 2 ∧
    ‖q.2 - (t₁ : ℂ)‖ < r₁ }

noncomputable def bandBaseEndpointFn {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (is_point : Bool) (y t : ℂ) (i : Fin 2) : ℂ :=
  if is_point then glancingImpact C y t i else glancingDualLine C y t i

structure ShearedSlabEndpointPkg {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (H₁ ε t₁ : ℝ) (is_point : Bool) where
  r₁ : ℝ
  r₁_pos : 0 < r₁
  ball_sub_base : Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base
  h_L_lower : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁, ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 16) < W.h_L t
  N_slab : ℕ
  N_slab_pos : 1 ≤ N_slab
  x_c : Fin N_slab → ℝ
  k_span : Fin N_slab → ℕ
  j_idx : Fin N_slab → ℕ
  s_minus : Fin N_slab → ℝ
  idx_bounds : ∀ α : Fin N_slab,
    2 ≤ k_span α ∧ 0 < j_idx α ∧
    (if is_point then j_idx α ≤ k_span α else j_idx α < k_span α) ∧
    s_minus α + (if is_point then (j_idx α : ℝ) - 1 / 2 else (j_idx α : ℝ)) = 0
  shift_small : ∀ α : Fin N_slab,
    (|s_minus α| + (k_span α : ℝ)) * r₁ < W.s_base / 4
  covers_period : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
    ∃ α : Fin N_slab, |x - x_c α| < ε / 16
  E_left : ∀ α : Fin N_slab, Fin 2 →
    MeroOn2D (bandShearedSlab W.s_base H₁ ε (x_c α) (s_minus α) t₁ r₁)
  E_right : ∀ α : Fin N_slab, Fin 2 →
    MeroOn2D (bandShearedSlab W.s_base H₁ ε (x_c α) (s_minus α) t₁ r₁)
  left_agrees_base : ∀ (α : Fin N_slab) (i : Fin 2),
    MeroAgreesHolo (E_left α i)
      (fun q => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point q.1 q.2 i)
      (bandShearedBaseBox W.s_base (x_c α) (s_minus α) t₁ r₁ ε)
  right_agrees_base : ∀ (α : Fin N_slab) (i : Fin 2),
    MeroAgreesHolo (E_right α i)
      (fun q => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point (q.1 + (k_span α : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 i)
      (bandShearedBaseBox W.s_base (x_c α) (s_minus α) t₁ r₁ ε)

noncomputable def rmdCompConst : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | k + 1, B => max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * B) * rmdCompConst k B

def rmdJetBnd (k : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) f ∧
  0 ≤ B ∧
  ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j f x| ≤ B

def rmdDerivBnd (k : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) f ∧
  0 ≤ B ∧
  ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j f x| ≤ B

noncomputable def rmdK0 (w : ℝ → ℝ) (M₀ d : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * d) - w M₀)

noncomputable def rmdKsym (w : ℝ → ℝ) (M₀ h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) *
    (deriv w (M₀ + s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
     deriv w (M₀ - s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀))

noncomputable def rmdK1 (w : ℝ → ℝ) (M₀ h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    (deriv w (M₀ + s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
     deriv w (M₀ - s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀))

noncomputable def rmdK2 (w : ℝ → ℝ) (M₀ h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) *
    ((iteratedDeriv 2 w (M₀ + s * h) + (deriv w (M₀ + s * h)) ^ 2) *
       Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
     (iteratedDeriv 2 w (M₀ - s * h) + (deriv w (M₀ - s * h)) ^ 2) *
       Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀))

noncomputable def rmdKlin (w : ℝ → ℝ) (M₀ d : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv w (M₀ + s * d) * Real.exp (w M₀ - w (M₀ + s * d))

noncomputable def rmdOdeRhs (w : ℝ → ℝ) (M₀ h d M₀' h' : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let Ed := Real.exp (w M₀ - w (M₀ + d))
  (h ^ 2 * (Ed * rmdK2 w M₀ h) + d * rmdKlin w M₀ d) * M₀' +
    (h * h') * (Ed * rmdK1 w M₀ h)

noncomputable def rmdSingleSeq (M₁ C₀ : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => C₀
  | r + 1 =>
      let C_r := rmdSingleSeq M₁ C₀ r
      let B_r := 3 + C_r / 16
      let K_c := rmdCompConst r B_r
      let M_E := Real.exp (2 * M₁) * rmdCompConst r (2 * M₁ * K_c)
      let M_K1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * M_E
      let M_K2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * (M₁ * K_c)) * M_E
      let M_EdK2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_E * M_K2
      let M_EdK1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_E * M_K1
      let C_step :=
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r *
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ r * (21 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r) * M_EdK2 + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * C_r * M_K1) * 2 +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_EdK1
      max C_r C_step

noncomputable def rmdLipSeq (M₁ C_single L₀ : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => L₀
  | r + 1 =>
      let L_r := rmdLipSeq M₁ C_single L₀ r
      let B_star := 3 + C_single / 16
      let K_c := rmdCompConst r B_star
      let M_E := Real.exp (2 * M₁) * rmdCompConst r (2 * M₁ * K_c)
      let M_K1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * M_E
      let M_K2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * (M₁ * K_c)) * M_E
      let M_EdK2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_E * M_K2
      let M_EdK1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_E * M_K1
      let M_P12 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (21 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r) * M_EdK2 + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * C_single * M_K1
      let κ_r := 1 + L_r / 16
      let D_w := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M₁ * K_c * κ_r + K_c
      let D_E := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * rmdCompConst r (2 * M₁ * K_c) * (2 * D_w)
      let D_K1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_w * M_E + (M₁ * K_c) * D_E)
      let D_w2 := D_w + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_w * (M₁ * K_c) + (M₁ * K_c) * D_w)
      let D_K2 :=
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_w2 * M_E + (M₁ * K_c + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * (M₁ * K_c)) * D_E)
      let D_EdK2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_E * M_K2 + M_E * D_K2)
      let D_EdK1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_E * M_K1 + M_E * D_K1)
      let D_P12 :=
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_EdK2 + 21 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * D_EdK2) +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (L_r * M_K1 + C_single * D_K1)
      let L_step :=
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_P12 * 2 + M_P12 * 1) +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (3 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_EdK1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * D_EdK1)
      max L_r L_step

def slabBoxWide (x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    |p.1.re - x_edge| < R_0 / 2 + 4 * δ_slab ∧
    |p.1.im - y_row| < 4 * δ_slab ∧
    ‖p.2‖ < 4 * δ_t }

noncomputable def polyReflectVec (L : Fin 2 → ℂ) (N₀ N₁ : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  let dotLN := L 0 * N₀ + L 1 * N₁
  let dotNN := N₀ ^ 2 + N₁ ^ 2
  ![2 * dotLN * N₀ - dotNN * L 0, 2 * dotLN * N₁ - dotNN * L 1]

structure RegularEdgeLazutkinChart {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (H₀ : ℝ) (Z₀ : ZeroSliceExtractedData W) where
  x_edge : ℝ
  R_0 : ℝ
  H₀_ge : 2 * W.s_base ≤ H₀
  R_0_pos : 0 < R_0
  R_0_lt : R_0 < W.s_base / 2
  g_nf : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ_loc : ℂ → ℂ
  U_θ : Set ℂ
  ϕ_inv : ℂ → ℂ
  h_loc : ℂ → ℂ
  τ_proj : ℂ → ℂ
  U_τ : Set ℂ
  τ_inv : ℂ → ℂ
  g_nf_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_nf i)
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0))
  g_nf_eq_slice : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0) ∩ horizStrip H₀,
      g_nf i z = Z₀.Γ_slice z i
  ϕ_loc_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_loc
    (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0))
  ϕ_deriv_ne_zero : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
    deriv ϕ_loc z ≠ 0
  U_θ_open : IsOpen U_θ
  ϕ_maps_to : Set.MapsTo ϕ_loc
    (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0)) U_θ
  ϕ_open_image : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 2 * R_0 →
    IsOpen (ϕ_loc '' Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) r)
  ϕ_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_inv U_θ
  ϕ_left_inv : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
    ϕ_inv (ϕ_loc z) = z
  ϕ_right_inv : ∀ θ ∈ U_θ,
    ϕ_inv θ ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0) ∧
    ϕ_loc (ϕ_inv θ) = θ
  h_loc_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_loc U_θ
  h_loc_ne_zero : ∀ θ ∈ U_θ, h_loc θ ≠ 0
  g_nf_support_eq : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
    g_nf 0 z = h_loc (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) -
      deriv h_loc (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) ∧
    g_nf 1 z = h_loc (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) +
      deriv h_loc (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z)
  g_nf_deriv_eq : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
    deriv (g_nf 0) z = -(C.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) / (deriv ϕ_loc z) ^ 2 ∧
    deriv (g_nf 1) z = (C.c : ℂ) * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) / (deriv ϕ_loc z) ^ 2
  lazutkin_ode : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
    (h_loc (ϕ_loc z) + deriv (deriv h_loc) (ϕ_loc z)) * (deriv ϕ_loc z) ^ 3 = (C.c : ℂ)
  τ_def : ∀ z : ℂ,
    τ_proj z =
      -g_nf 0 z * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) +
        g_nf 1 z * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
  τ_deriv_ne_zero : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
    deriv τ_proj z ≠ 0
  U_τ_open : IsOpen U_τ
  τ_maps_to : Set.MapsTo τ_proj
    (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0)) U_τ
  τ_open_image : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 2 * R_0 →
    IsOpen (τ_proj '' Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) r)
  τ_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ τ_inv U_τ
  τ_left_inv : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
    τ_inv (τ_proj z) = z
  τ_right_inv : ∀ w ∈ U_τ,
    τ_inv w ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0) ∧
    τ_proj (τ_inv w) = w

structure CubicStepSuccessorData (c : ℝ) (s_edge : ℂ) (R_0 : ℝ)
    (ϕ_loc h_loc : ℂ → ℂ) where
  δ_rec : ℝ
  C_rec : ℝ
  δ_rec_pos : 0 < δ_rec
  δ_rec_lt : δ_rec < R_0
  C_rec_pos : 0 < C_rec
  G_succ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  L_line : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  G_succ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_succ
    (Metric.ball s_edge R_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec)
  G_succ_cubic : ∀ V Δ : ℂ,
    V ∈ Metric.ball s_edge R_0 →
    Δ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec →
    ‖G_succ (V, Δ) - Δ‖ ≤ C_rec * ‖Δ‖ ^ 3
  L_line_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_line i)
    (Metric.ball s_edge R_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec)
  L_line_eq : ∀ V Δ : ℂ,
    V ∈ Metric.ball s_edge R_0 →
    Δ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec →
    L_line 0 (V, Δ) =
      Complex.cos (ϕ_loc V) / (-supportAction1_ℂ h_loc (ϕ_loc V) (ϕ_loc (V + Δ))) ∧
    L_line 1 (V, Δ) =
      Complex.sin (ϕ_loc V) / (-supportAction1_ℂ h_loc (ϕ_loc V) (ϕ_loc (V + Δ)))
  forward_step_unique : ∀ V Δ_m Δ_p : ℂ,
    V ∈ Metric.ball s_edge R_0 →
    Δ_m ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec →
    Δ_p ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec →
    (Δ_p + Δ_m ≠ 0 ∨ (Δ_m = 0 ∧ Δ_p = 0)) →
    -supportAction1_ℂ h_loc (ϕ_loc V) (ϕ_loc (V + Δ_p)) =
      supportAction2_ℂ h_loc (ϕ_loc (V - Δ_m)) (ϕ_loc V) →
    Δ_p = G_succ (V, Δ_m)

structure SlabBilliardHoloData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (Z₀ : ZeroSliceExtractedData W) (H₀ x_edge R_0 : ℝ) where
  y_row : ℝ
  δ_slab : ℝ
  δ_t0 : ℝ
  y_row_bounds : H₀ - R_0 / 16 < y_row ∧ y_row < H₀ - R_0 / 32
  δ_slab_pos : 0 < δ_slab
  δ_slab_lt_R : δ_slab < R_0 / 256
  δ_slab_lt_gap : y_row + 4 * δ_slab < H₀ - R_0 / 64
  δ_t0_pos : 0 < δ_t0
  L_slab : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  X_slab : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  L_slab_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_slab i) (slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0)
  X_slab_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_slab i) (slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0)
  L_slab_agrees : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i) (L_slab i) (slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0)
  X_slab_zero : ∀ y : ℂ,
    (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0 →
    ∀ i : Fin 2, X_slab i (y, 0) = Z₀.Γ_slice y i
  L_slab_even : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ y t : ℂ,
    (y, t) ∈ slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0 →
    L_slab i (y, -t) = L_slab i (y, t)
  slab_incidence : ∀ y t : ℂ,
    (y, t) ∈ slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0 →
    (y - t / 2, t) ∈ slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0 →
    (y + t / 2, t) ∈ slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0 →
    (L_slab 0 (y - t / 2, t) * X_slab 0 (y, t) +
      L_slab 1 (y - t / 2, t) * X_slab 1 (y, t) = 1) ∧
    (L_slab 0 (y + t / 2, t) * X_slab 0 (y, t) +
      L_slab 1 (y + t / 2, t) * X_slab 1 (y, t) = 1)
  slab_rank_one : ∀ p ∈ slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0,
    iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab 0) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (X_slab 1) p =
      iterDerivYT 0 1 (X_slab 0) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab 1) p
  slab_reflection : ∀ y t : ℂ,
    (y, t) ∈ slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0 →
    (y - t / 2, t) ∈ slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0 →
    (y + t / 2, t) ∈ slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0 →
    ∀ i : Fin 2,
      let W_vec := polyReflectVec (fun j => L_slab j (y - t / 2, t))
        (iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab 1) (y, t)) (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab 0) (y, t))
      L_slab i (y + t / 2, t) * (W_vec 0 * X_slab 0 (y, t) + W_vec 1 * X_slab 1 (y, t)) =
        W_vec i
  L_mero_even : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L,
    (p.1, -p.2) ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (min ((W.L_mero i).rad p) ((W.L_mero i).rad (p.1, -p.2))),
      (W.L_mero i).num p q * (W.L_mero i).den (p.1, -p.2) (q.1, -q.2) =
        (W.L_mero i).num (p.1, -p.2) (q.1, -q.2) * (W.L_mero i).den p q

structure SlabAngleBridgeData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}

    (H₀ : ℝ) (Z₀ : ZeroSliceExtractedData W)
    (E : RegularEdgeLazutkinChart C W H₀ Z₀)
    (S_rec : CubicStepSuccessorData C.c
      ((E.x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) E.R_0 E.ϕ_loc E.h_loc)
    (H_slab : SlabBilliardHoloData W Z₀ H₀ E.x_edge E.R_0) where
  δ_t : ℝ
  C_init : ℝ
  δ_t_pos : 0 < δ_t
  C_init_pos : 0 < C_init
  V_slab : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  V_slab_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V_slab
    (slabBox E.x_edge E.R_0 H_slab.y_row H_slab.δ_slab δ_t)
  V_slab_quad : ∀ p ∈ slabBox E.x_edge E.R_0 H_slab.y_row H_slab.δ_slab δ_t,
    ‖V_slab p - p.1‖ ≤ C_init * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2
  slab_recurrence : ∀ y t : ℂ,
    (y - t, t) ∈ slabBox E.x_edge E.R_0 H_slab.y_row H_slab.δ_slab δ_t →
    (y, t) ∈ slabBox E.x_edge E.R_0 H_slab.y_row H_slab.δ_slab δ_t →
    (y + t, t) ∈ slabBox E.x_edge E.R_0 H_slab.y_row H_slab.δ_slab δ_t →
    V_slab (y, t) ∈ Metric.ball ((E.x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) E.R_0 ∧
    ‖V_slab (y, t) - V_slab (y - t, t)‖ < S_rec.δ_rec ∧
    ‖V_slab (y + t, t) - V_slab (y, t)‖ < S_rec.δ_rec ∧
    V_slab (y + t, t) - V_slab (y, t) =
      S_rec.G_succ (V_slab (y, t), V_slab (y, t) - V_slab (y - t, t))
  slab_agrees_L : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i)
      (fun p => S_rec.L_line i (V_slab p, V_slab (p.1 + p.2, p.2) - V_slab p))
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        |p.1.re - E.x_edge| < E.R_0 / 2 + H_slab.δ_slab ∧
        |p.1.im - H_slab.y_row| < H_slab.δ_slab ∧
        ‖p.2‖ < δ_t }

noncomputable def dualLineShift {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (q : ℤ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p => glancingDualLine C (p.1 + (q : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 ι

noncomputable def homIntersect (E F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  | 0, p => F 1 p - E 1 p
  | 1, p => E 0 p - F 0 p
  | 2, p => E 0 p * F 1 p - E 1 p * F 0 p

noncomputable def homRankOneDet (W : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  W 0 p * (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 1) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 2) p -
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 1) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 2) p) -
  W 1 p * (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 0) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 2) p -
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 0) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 2) p) +
  W 2 p * (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 0) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 1) p -
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 0) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 1) p)

noncomputable def homReflectOut (E : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (W : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p =>
    let T₀ := W 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 0) p - W 0 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 2) p
    let T₁ := W 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 1) p - W 1 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 2) p
    let N₀ := T₁
    let N₁ := -T₀
    let dotLN := E 0 p * N₀ + E 1 p * N₁
    let dotNN := N₀ * N₀ + N₁ * N₁
    2 * dotLN * (if ι = 0 then N₀ else N₁) - dotNN * E ι p

noncomputable def homReflectRes (E F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p =>
    let W := homIntersect E F
    let V := homReflectOut E W
    W 2 p * V ι p - (V 0 p * W 0 p + V 1 p * W 1 p) * F ι p

def symCollarDom (s_b r_b : ℝ) {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  let J_bound : ℝ := ((Finset.univ.sup fun a : Fin N_idx => (q_idx a).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_b / 2 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_b ∧ |p.2.im| < s_b / (2 * J_bound) }

structure BaseCollarBilliardData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) where
  dualLine_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det → ‖t‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det →
    ∀ ι : Fin 2, glancingDualLine C y (-t) ι = glancingDualLine C y t ι
  symJet_neg_t : ∀ {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) (neg_idx : Fin N_idx → Fin N_idx)
      (M : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
    (∀ a : Fin N_idx, q_idx (neg_idx a) = -q_idx a) →
    ‖p.2‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det →
    (∀ a : Fin N_idx,
      |(p.1 + (q_idx a : ℂ) * p.2).im| < 2 * hDet.s_det ∧
      |(p.1 - (q_idx a : ℂ) * p.2).im| < 2 * hDet.s_det) →
    ∀ v : SymJetVar N_idx M,
      symJetEnv C q_idx M (p.1, -p.2) v =
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ v.2.2.2.1 *
          symJetEnv C q_idx M p (neg_idx v.1, v.2.1, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2)
  primary_rank_one : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det →
    homRankOneDet (homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)) p = 0
  primary_reflect : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det →
    ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) ι p = 0
  primary_w2_ne_zero : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ min (hDet.s_det / 2) (hDet.r_det / 2) →
    ∃ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < r ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r ∧ p.2.im = 0 ∧
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p ≠ 0
  primary_not_isotropic_line : ∀ (r : ℝ) (s_iso c_star : ℂ),
    0 < r → r ≤ min (hDet.s_det / 2) (hDet.r_det / 2) →
    (s_iso = 1 ∨ s_iso = -1) →
    ∃ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < r ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r ∧ p.2.im = 0 ∧
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 0 p +
        s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 1 p -
        c_star * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p ≠ 0
  primary_step_distinct : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ min (hDet.s_det / 2) (hDet.r_det / 2) →
    ∃ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < r ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r ∧ p.2.im = 0 ∧
      let W₁ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)
      let W₀ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0)
      W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p ≠ 0 ∨
      W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p ≠ 0
  envelope_quad_factor : ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
    ∃ (r_s r_env : ℝ) (s_minus s_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (Q_inc : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_env ∧ r_env ≤ r_s ∧ r_s < min (hDet.s_det / 4) (hDet.r_det / 4) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ s_minus (Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ s_plus (Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env,
        s_minus p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_s ∧
        s_plus p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_s ∧
        glancingBoundaryCurve C (s_minus p) = glancingImpact C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2 ∧
        glancingBoundaryCurve C (s_plus p) = glancingImpact C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_s,
        ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env,
          Q_inc s p ≠ 0 ∧
          dualLineShift C 0 0 p * glancingBoundaryCurve C s 0 +
            dualLineShift C 0 1 p * glancingBoundaryCurve C s 1 - 1 =
            (s - s_minus p) * (s - s_plus p) * Q_inc s p) ∧
      (∀ (B : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen B → B ⊆ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env →
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F ι) B) →
        (∀ q ∈ B,
          let W := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) F
          W 2 q ≠ 0 ∧
          W 0 q = W 2 q * glancingImpact C (q.1 + q.2 / 2) q.2 0 ∧
          W 1 q = W 2 q * glancingImpact C (q.1 + q.2 / 2) q.2 1 ∧
          ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) F ι q = 0) →
        ∀ q ∈ B, ∀ ι : Fin 2, F ι q = dualLineShift C 1 ι q)

structure PuncturedGlancingBridgeData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ : ℝ) (D_wall : AlignedWallDefectData W t₂)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) where
  y₀ : ℝ
  r_y : ℝ
  r_t : ℝ
  t_end : ℝ
  r_end : ℝ
  r_y_pos : 0 < r_y
  r_t_pos : 0 < r_t
  t_end_pos : 0 < t_end

  bidisk_sub_dom :

  ball_end_sub :

      Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) (3 * r_y / 4) ×ˢ
        { t : ℂ | 0 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * r_t / 4 }
  D_det : Fin 2 → ℕ
  D_det_pos : ∀ ι : Fin 2, 1 ≤ D_det ι
  A_coeff : ∀ ι : Fin 2, Fin (D_det ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  m_t : ℕ
  H_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  coeff_holo : ∀ ι d,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (A_coeff ι d)
      (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t)
  H_tilde_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H_tilde
      (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t)
  H_tilde_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t,

  lead_dvd : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∃ G_div : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G_div
      (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t) ∧
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t,
      p.2 ^ m_t * H_tilde p = A_coeff ι (Fin.last (D_det ι)) p * G_div p
  separable_punc : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t \ {0}),
      A_coeff ι (Fin.last (D_det ι)) p ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ,
        ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), A_coeff ι d p * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι),
          (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * A_coeff ι d.succ p * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0
  M₁_end : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  M₁_end_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (M₁_end ι) (Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end)
  M₁_end_solves : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
    ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), A_coeff ι d p * (M₁_end ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0
  M₁_ne_primary : ∃ ι_def : Fin 2, ∃ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
    M₁_end ι_def p ≠ dualLineShift C 1 ι_def p
  fwd_rank_one :
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det →
      homRankOneDet (homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)) p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      homRankOneDet (homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end) p = 0
  fwd_reflect :
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det →
      ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) ι p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end ι p = 0
  rev_w2_zero :
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 2 p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p = 0
  rev_iso_line : ∀ s_iso c_star : ℂ,
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 0 p +
        s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 1 p -
        c_star * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 2 p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 0 p +
        s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 1 p -
        c_star * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p = 0
  rev_prev_eq :
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      let W₁ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end
      let W₀ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0)
      W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
      W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,
      let W₁ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)
      let W₀ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0)
      W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
      W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0
  poly_transfer : ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
      (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
    (∀ p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff d) *
          (dualLineShift C 1 ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ↔
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff d) *
          (M₁_end ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0)

structure CompactAnnulusEvenData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ : ℝ) (D_wall : AlignedWallDefectData W t₂)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ)
    (Br : PuncturedGlancingBridgeData W t₂ D_wall q_idx) where
  y_ann : ℝ
  δ_y : ℝ
  t_near : ℝ
  r_match : ℝ
  δ_y_pos : 0 < δ_y
  t_near_pos : 0 < t_near
  r_match_pos : 0 < r_match
  ann_sub_dom :
    Metric.ball (y_ann : ℂ) δ_y ×ˢ
      { t : ℂ | t_near / 2 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * t_near / 2 } ⊆
      symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx
  match_ball_sub :
    Metric.ball ((y_ann : ℂ), (t_near : ℂ)) r_match ⊆
      Metric.ball (y_ann : ℂ) δ_y ×ˢ
        { t : ℂ | t_near / 2 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * t_near / 2 }
  M_even : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  M_even_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_even ι)
      (Metric.ball (y_ann : ℂ) δ_y ×ˢ
        { t : ℂ | t_near / 2 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * t_near / 2 })
  M_even_symm : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y_ann : ℂ) δ_y ×ˢ
        { t : ℂ | t_near / 2 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * t_near / 2 },
      M_even ι (p.1, -p.2) = M_even ι p
  poly_transfer : ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
      (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((Br.y₀ : ℂ), (Br.t_end : ℂ)) Br.r_end,

        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff d) *
          (Br.M₁_end ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ↔
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y_ann : ℂ), (t_near : ℂ)) r_match,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff d) *
          (M_even ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0)

noncomputable def pointRotAngleR (rotIdx : Fin 4) : ℝ :=
  match rotIdx with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => 0
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => Real.pi
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => -Real.pi / 2
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => Real.pi / 2

noncomputable def pointRotAngle (rotIdx : Fin 4) : ℂ :=
  (pointRotAngleR rotIdx : ℂ)

noncomputable def pointSupportCurve {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (θ : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  ![C.h_ℂ θ * Complex.cos θ - deriv C.h_ℂ θ * Complex.sin θ,
    C.h_ℂ θ * Complex.sin θ + deriv C.h_ℂ θ * Complex.cos θ]

noncomputable def pointPhiMap {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (pointChartACoord C rotIdx p,
    pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx p - pointChartACoord C rotIdx p)

noncomputable def pointChartEll {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) {k : ℕ}
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let y := (Ψ q).1
  let t := (Ψ q).2
  let P_curr := glancingImpact C (y + ((i : ℕ) : ℂ) * t) t
  let P_next := glancingImpact C (y + (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t) t
  let Θ_i := glancingTheta C (y + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * t) t
  (-(P_next 0 - P_curr 0)) * Complex.sin Θ_i + (P_next 1 - P_curr 1) * Complex.cos Θ_i

noncomputable def pointTridiagMat (m : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    if r.1 = s.1 then 2
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then -1
    else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then -1
    else 0

noncomputable def pointDivZero (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, iterDerivYT 0 1 F (q.1, (τ : ℂ) * q.2)

structure PointLocalGraphData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) where
  rotIdx : Fin 4
  a₀ : ℝ
  ρ_x : ℝ
  ρ_x_pos : 0 < ρ_x
  sin_rot_base_gt : 1 / 2 < -Real.sin (C.ϕ 0 + pointRotAngleR rotIdx)
  a₀_eq : (a₀ : ℂ) = rotCoordX rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C (C.ϕ 0 : ℂ))
  W_θ : Set ℂ
  W_θ_open : IsOpen W_θ
  θ₀_mem_W_θ : ((C.ϕ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ W_θ
  W_θ_sub_strip : W_θ ⊆ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)
  F : ℂ → ℂ
  θ_inv : ℂ → ℂ
  F_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x)
  θ_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ θ_inv (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x)
  θ_inv_base : θ_inv (a₀ : ℂ) = ((C.ϕ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  θ_inv_maps : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x, θ_inv z ∈ W_θ
  θ_left_inv : ∀ θ ∈ W_θ,
    rotCoordX rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C θ) ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x ∧
    θ_inv (rotCoordX rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C θ)) = θ ∧
    rotCoordY rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C θ) =
      F (rotCoordX rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C θ))
  θ_right_inv : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x,
    rotCoordX rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C (θ_inv z)) = z ∧
    rotCoordY rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C (θ_inv z)) = F z
  W_θ_nondeg : ∀ θ ∈ W_θ,
    1 / 4 < (-Complex.sin (θ + pointRotAngle rotIdx)).re ∧
    C.h_ℂ θ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ ≠ 0
  F_deriv_eq : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x,
    deriv F z =
      Complex.cos (θ_inv z + pointRotAngle rotIdx) /
        (-Complex.sin (θ_inv z + pointRotAngle rotIdx))
  F_deriv2_eq : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x,
    deriv (deriv F) z =
      1 / ((C.h_ℂ (θ_inv z) + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (θ_inv z)) *
        (-Complex.sin (θ_inv z + pointRotAngle rotIdx)) ^ 3)
  F_real : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - a₀| < ρ_x →
    (x : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x ∧
    (F (x : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧
    deriv (deriv F) (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 ∧
    ∃ v_x : ℝ, deriv F (x : ℂ) = (v_x : ℂ)

structure PointRawChartData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G_gr : PointLocalGraphData C) where
  R₀ : ℝ
  δ₀ : ℝ
  R₀_pos : 0 < R₀
  δ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀
  two_R₀_le : 2 * R₀ ≤ G_gr.ρ_x
  V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  V₀_open : IsOpen V₀
  V₀_sub : V₀ ⊆ pointChainBox C B k
  Φ_holo_V₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pointPhiMap C k G_gr.rotIdx) V₀
  Ψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ
    (Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀))
  Ψ_maps_V₀ :
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
      Ψ q ∈ V₀
  Φ_left_inv :
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
      pointPhiMap C k G_gr.rotIdx (Ψ q) = q
  Φ_right_inv : ∀ p ∈ V₀,
    pointPhiMap C k G_gr.rotIdx p ∈
      Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀) ∧
    Ψ (pointPhiMap C k G_gr.rotIdx p) = p
  det_ab_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ V₀, pointChartDetAB C k G_gr.rotIdx p ≠ 0
  Ψ_det :
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
      iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun q' => (Ψ q').1) q *
          iterDerivYT 0 1 (fun q' => (Ψ q').2) q -
        iterDerivYT 0 1 (fun q' => (Ψ q').1) q *
          iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun q' => (Ψ q').2) q =
        (pointChartDetAB C k G_gr.rotIdx (Ψ q))⁻¹
  x_holo_maps : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r)
      (Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
      glancingMidAngle C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 ∈ G_gr.W_θ ∧
      pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r q ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) G_gr.ρ_x ∧
      G_gr.θ_inv (pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r q) =
        glancingMidAngle C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 ∧
      rotCoordY G_gr.rotIdx
        (glancingImpact C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2) =
        G_gr.F (pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r q)
  Θ_edge_holo_maps : ∀ i : Fin k,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q => glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2)
      (Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
      glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 ∈ G_gr.W_θ
  ℓ_holo_vec : ∀ i : Fin k,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (pointChartEll C Ψ i)
      (Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
      (pointChartEll C Ψ i q) ^ 2 =
        pointEdgeSq (fun _ => G_gr.F) (fun r => pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r q) i ∧
      pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ i.succ q -
          pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ i.castSucc q =
        pointChartEll C Ψ i q *
          (-Complex.sin
            (glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 +
              pointRotAngle G_gr.rotIdx)) ∧
      G_gr.F (pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ i.succ q) -
          G_gr.F (pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ i.castSucc q) =
        pointChartEll C Ψ i q *
          Complex.cos
            (glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 +
              pointRotAngle G_gr.rotIdx)
  real_slice : ∀ a δ : ℝ,
    ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) ∈
      Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀) →
    (Ψ ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))).1.im = 0 ∧
    (Ψ ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))).2.im = 0 ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), (pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))).im = 0) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, (pointChartEll C Ψ i ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))).im = 0)
  zero_slice : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀),
    (Ψ (z, 0)).2 = 0 ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r (z, 0) = z) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
      glancingMidAngle C ((Ψ (z, 0)).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ (z, 0)).2) (Ψ (z, 0)).2 =
        G_gr.θ_inv z) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k,
      glancingTheta C ((Ψ (z, 0)).1 + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (Ψ (z, 0)).2)

  x_deriv_d_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀),
    deriv (fun w : ℂ => pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r (z, w)) 0 =
      ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
  base_derivs_at_a₀ :
    let r₀ : ℝ := C.h (C.ϕ 0) + deriv (deriv C.h) (C.ϕ 0)
    let s₀ : ℝ := -Real.sin (C.ϕ 0 + pointRotAngleR G_gr.rotIdx)
    Ψ ((G_gr.a₀ : ℂ), 0) = (0, 0) ∧
    deriv (fun w : ℂ => (Ψ ((G_gr.a₀ : ℂ), w)).2) 0 =
      1 / ((k : ℂ) * ((r₀ * s₀ * deriv C.ϕ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    ∀ i : Fin k,
      deriv (fun w : ℂ =>
        glancingTheta C
          ((Ψ ((G_gr.a₀ : ℂ), w)).1 + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (Ψ ((G_gr.a₀ : ℂ), w)).2)
          (Ψ ((G_gr.a₀ : ℂ), w)).2) 0 =
        (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) / ((k : ℂ) * ((r₀ * s₀ : ℝ) : ℂ))

noncomputable def lineRecPsExpScale (c : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk (fun n => c ^ n / (n.factorial : ℂ))

noncomputable def lineRecPsExp1D (c : ℂ) (θ : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (lineArcCompConst2D1D (lineRecPsExpScale c) (MvPowerSeries.C θ))

noncomputable def lineRecPsCos (θ : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 (MvPowerSeries.C θ))

noncomputable def lineRecPsSin (θ : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 (MvPowerSeries.C θ))

noncomputable def lineRecCircleAngle (c₀ s₀ : ℂ) (C S : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  let u := PowerSeries.C c₀ * C + PowerSeries.C s₀ * S
  let v := PowerSeries.C c₀ * S - PowerSeries.C s₀ * C
  PowerSeries.mk (fun n =>
    match n with
    | 0 => 0
    | m + 1 =>
        PowerSeries.coeff m (u * PowerSeries.derivative v - v * PowerSeries.derivative u) /
          ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ))

def lineRecVanishesBelow (k : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m : ℕ), d 0 + d 1 + m < k →
    PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d S) = 0

open Classical in
noncomputable def lineRecLiftArcFn (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    PowerSeries ℂ :=
  if hz : z ∈ F then Φ ⟨z, hz⟩ else PowerSeries.C z

noncomputable def lineRecLiftMv2D (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d => lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ)

noncomputable def lineRecJetSeq (A : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) (Δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (l : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk (fun n =>
    PowerSeries.coeff l
      (∑ r ∈ Finset.range (l + 1),
        PowerSeries.C (1 / ((n.factorial : ℂ) * (r.factorial : ℂ))) * A (n + r) * (-Δ) ^ r))

noncomputable def lineRecIota0 :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.map PowerSeries.C

noncomputable def lineRecXeps (j : ℕ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.X ^ j)

def lineRecEqMod (j : ℕ) (S₁ S₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ≤ j, lineArcSlice2D1D l S₁ = lineArcSlice2D1D l S₂

def lineRecIsEpsConst (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d S) = 0

noncomputable def lineRecMid0 {k : ℕ}
    (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  (β₀ i.castSucc + β₀ i.succ) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ)

noncomputable def lineRecHalfStep0 {k : ℕ}
    (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  (β₀ i.succ - β₀ i.castSucc) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ)

noncomputable def lineRecSin0 {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i) * compPowerSeries2D lineArcPsCos0 (lineRecHalfStep0 β₀ i) +
    MvPowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i) * compPowerSeries2D lineArcPsSin0 (lineRecHalfStep0 β₀ i)

noncomputable def lineRecCos0 {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i) * compPowerSeries2D lineArcPsCos0 (lineRecHalfStep0 β₀ i) -
    MvPowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i) * compPowerSeries2D lineArcPsSin0 (lineRecHalfStep0 β₀ i)

noncomputable def lineRecGrad0 {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f₀ : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ) (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_L)) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_L) *
      lineRecSin0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_L +
    compPowerSeries2D (f₀ i_L) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_L) *
      lineRecCos0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_L +
    compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_R)) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_R) *
      lineRecSin0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_R -
    compPowerSeries2D (f₀ i_R) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_R) *
      lineRecCos0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_R

noncomputable def lineRecHess0 {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f₀ : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ) (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r s : Fin (k - 1)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let H_L := compPowerSeries2D (f₀ i_L) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_L)
  let H'_L := compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_L)) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_L)
  let H''_L := compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_L)))
    (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_L)
  let H_R := compPowerSeries2D (f₀ i_R) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_R)
  let H'_R := compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_R)) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_R)
  let H''_R := compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_R)))
    (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_R)
  let S_L := lineRecSin0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_L
  let C_L := lineRecCos0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_L
  let S_R := lineRecSin0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_R
  let C_R := lineRecCos0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_R
  if r.1 = s.1 then
    ((H''_L - H_L) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * S_L + H'_L * C_L) +
      ((H''_R - H_R) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * S_R - H'_R * C_R)
  else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
    (H_R + H''_R) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * S_R
  else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
    (H_L + H''_L) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * S_L
  else
    0

structure LineRecFormalTrigToolkit : Prop where
  trig_coeff_mem : ∀ (K : Subfield ℂ) (n : ℕ),
    PowerSeries.coeff n lineArcPsSin0 ∈ K ∧ PowerSeries.coeff n lineArcPsCos0 ∈ K
  trig_deriv :
    PowerSeries.derivative lineArcPsSin0 = lineArcPsCos0 ∧
    PowerSeries.derivative lineArcPsCos0 = -lineArcPsSin0
  circle_lift : ∀ (c₀ s₀ : ℂ) (C S : PowerSeries ℂ),
    c₀ ^ 2 + s₀ ^ 2 = 1 →
    C ^ 2 + S ^ 2 = 1 →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff C = c₀ →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff S = s₀ →
    let θ := lineRecCircleAngle c₀ s₀ C S
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff θ = 0 ∧
    C = PowerSeries.C c₀ * lineRecPsCos θ - PowerSeries.C s₀ * lineRecPsSin θ ∧
    S = PowerSeries.C s₀ * lineRecPsCos θ + PowerSeries.C c₀ * lineRecPsSin θ ∧
    (θ = 0 ↔ C = PowerSeries.C c₀ ∧ S = PowerSeries.C s₀)
  half_step_diff : ∀ (c₁ s₁ c₂ s₂ : ℂ) (C₁ S₁ C₂ S₂ : PowerSeries ℂ),
    c₁ ^ 2 + s₁ ^ 2 = 1 →
    c₂ ^ 2 + s₂ ^ 2 = 1 →
    C₁ ^ 2 + S₁ ^ 2 = 1 →
    C₂ ^ 2 + S₂ ^ 2 = 1 →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff C₁ = c₁ →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff S₁ = s₁ →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff C₂ = c₂ →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff S₂ = s₂ →
    let θ₁ := lineRecCircleAngle c₁ s₁ C₁ S₁
    let θ₂ := lineRecCircleAngle c₂ s₂ C₂ S₂
    S₂ * C₁ - C₂ * S₁ =
      PowerSeries.C (s₂ * c₁ - c₂ * s₁) * lineRecPsCos (θ₂ - θ₁) +
        PowerSeries.C (c₂ * c₁ + s₂ * s₁) * lineRecPsSin (θ₂ - θ₁) ∧
    C₂ * C₁ + S₂ * S₁ =
      PowerSeries.C (c₂ * c₁ + s₂ * s₁) * lineRecPsCos (θ₂ - θ₁) -
        PowerSeries.C (s₂ * c₁ - c₂ * s₁) * lineRecPsSin (θ₂ - θ₁)
  comp_trig_add_2D1D : ∀ (w : PowerSeries ℂ) (B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)),
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff w = 0 →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 B = 0 →
    lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 (MvPowerSeries.C w + B) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (lineRecPsCos w) * lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 B -
        MvPowerSeries.C (lineRecPsSin w) * lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 B ∧
    lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 (MvPowerSeries.C w + B) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (lineRecPsSin w) * lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 B +
        MvPowerSeries.C (lineRecPsCos w) * lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 B

structure LineRecFormalLiftToolkit : Prop where
  jetSeq_zero : ∀ (A : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) (Δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (n : ℕ),

  jetSeq_eq_C_of_zero_shift : ∀ (A : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ),
    (∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → lineRecJetSeq A 0 l = 0) →

  liftArcFn_props : ∀ (K F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (hKF : K ≤ F),

      lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (x + y) = lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ x + lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ y ∧
      lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (x - y) = lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ x - lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ y ∧

  liftMv2D_ring : ∀ (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ),
    (∀ c : ℂ, lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (MvPowerSeries.C c) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ c)) ∧
    (∀ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
      (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₁ ∈ F) →
      (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₂ ∈ F) →
      lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ₁ + Ψ₂) = lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ + lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂ ∧
      lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ₁ - Ψ₂) = lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ - lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂ ∧
      lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ₁ * Ψ₂) = lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ * lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂)
  liftMv2D_comp_const : ∀ (K F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (hKF : K ≤ F),
    (∀ (x : ℂ) (hx : x ∈ K), Φ ⟨x, hKF hx⟩ = PowerSeries.C x) →
    ∀ (g : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      (∀ n, PowerSeries.coeff n g ∈ K) →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
      (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ ∈ F) →
      lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (compPowerSeries2D g Ψ) =
        lineArcCompConst2D1D g (lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ)
  liftMv2D_comp_recenter : ∀ (K F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (hKF : K ≤ F),
    (∀ (x : ℂ) (hx : x ∈ K), Φ ⟨x, hKF hx⟩ = PowerSeries.C x) →
    ∀ (H_star : ℕ → ℂ) (Δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      (∀ m, H_star m ∈ F) →
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff Δ = 0 →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
      (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ ∈ F) →
      lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ
          (compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.mk (fun n => H_star n / (n.factorial : ℂ))) Ψ) =
        lineArcComp2D1D
          (lineRecJetSeq (fun m => lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (H_star m)) Δ)
          (MvPowerSeries.C Δ + lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ)

  slice_pos_zero_of_pos_zero : ∀ {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)

def PuncturedSliceRemovableProp {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M) : Prop :=
  M.h_X 0 = ⊤ →
  ∀ (u₀ : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) (v_sl : ℂ → ℂ) (n d : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < δ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ v_sl (Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀}) →
    (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (n i) (Metric.ball u₀ δ) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (d i) (Metric.ball u₀ δ)) →
    (∀ u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀}, ∃ s : ℂ,
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * s) = v_sl u ∧ K.f s ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 2, d i u ≠ 0 ∧ n i u = K.Γ s i * d i u) →
    ∃ L : ℂ, L ≠ 0 ∧ Filter.Tendsto v_sl (nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ) (nhds L)

    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)

    (ExpLift : RegularExponentialLiftData C M K Reg) where

  V_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ

  V_minus_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V_minus (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X)
  V_mul_one : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, V_plus p * V_minus p = 1
  V_plus_reg_eq : ∀ p ∈ Reg.U_reg, V_plus p = ExpLift.v p
  V_wall_strict : ∀ H₀ : ℝ, M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H₀ →
    0 < H₀ ∧ ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,

  action_holo_and_conv : ∀ T : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ →

        ∃ N_holo : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_holo,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => p_seq n T q.1 q.2)
            (U_Z ×ˢ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4)) ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => p_seq n T q.1 J') q.2)
            (U_Z ×ˢ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4))) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ) => p_seq n T q.1 q.2)
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deepPureFrozenAction Phi_sq W T q.1 q.2)
        Filter.atTop (K_Z ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8)) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (fun J' => p_seq n T q.1 J') q.2)
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => deepPureFrozenAction Phi_sq W T q.1 J') q.2)
        Filter.atTop (K_Z ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8)) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (fun Z' => p_seq n T Z' q.2) q.1)
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun Z' => deepPureFrozenAction Phi_sq W T Z' q.2) q.1)
        Filter.atTop (K_Z ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8))
  recurrence_eq : ∀ R_top : ℝ, 3 * D_rec < R_top →
    ∀ T : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ → T ≠ 0 →
      ∃ N_rec : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_rec,
        ∀ Y : ℂ, 2 * D_rec < -Y.im → -Y.im < R_top - 2 → |Y.re| < (A₀ + 2) * (-Y.im) →
          let h_n : ℂ := T / (B_seq n : ℂ)
          let J_p : ℂ := (S_seq n (T, Y + h_n) - S_seq n (T, Y)) / h_n
          let J_m : ℂ := (S_seq n (T, Y) - S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)) / h_n
          ‖J_p - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16 ∧ ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16 ∧
          D_rec < -(S_seq n (T, Y)).im ∧
          |(S_seq n (T, Y)).re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-(S_seq n (T, Y)).im) ∧
          D_rec < -(S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)).im ∧
          |(S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)).re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-(S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)).im) ∧
          deriv (fun J' => p_seq n T (S_seq n (T, Y)) J') J_p -
            deriv (fun J' => p_seq n T (S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)) J') J_m =
            h_n * deriv (fun Z' => p_seq n T Z' J_p) (S_seq n (T, Y))

noncomputable def pcJetEdgeDX {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (x_base i.succ - x_base i.castSucc) + (β i.succ - β i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pcJetEdgeDY {k : ℕ} (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  compPowerSeries2D (F_ser i.succ) (β i.succ) -
    compPowerSeries2D (F_ser i.castSucc) (β i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pcJetEdgeU {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (((ℓ_base i) ^ 2)⁻¹) *
    ((pcJetEdgeDX x_base β i) ^ 2 + (pcJetEdgeDY F_ser β i) ^ 2 -
      MvPowerSeries.C ((ℓ_base i) ^ 2))

noncomputable def pcJetAction2D {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (S_ser : PowerSeries ℂ) (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    MvPowerSeries.C (ℓ_base i) *
      compPowerSeries2D S_ser (pcJetEdgeU x_base ℓ_base F_ser β i)

noncomputable def pcJetNumSucc {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  pcJetEdgeDX x_base β i +
    pcJetEdgeDY F_ser β i *
      compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (F_ser i.succ)) (β i.succ)

noncomputable def pcJetNumCast {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  pcJetEdgeDX x_base β i +
    pcJetEdgeDY F_ser β i *
      compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (F_ser i.castSucc)) (β i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pcJetEdgeTermSucc {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (I_ser : PowerSeries ℂ) (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C ((ℓ_base i)⁻¹) *
    pcJetNumSucc x_base F_ser β i *
    compPowerSeries2D I_ser (pcJetEdgeU x_base ℓ_base F_ser β i)

noncomputable def pcJetEdgeTermCast {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (I_ser : PowerSeries ℂ) (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C ((ℓ_base i)⁻¹) *
    pcJetNumCast x_base F_ser β i *
    compPowerSeries2D I_ser (pcJetEdgeU x_base ℓ_base F_ser β i)

noncomputable def pcJetGrad2D {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (I_ser : PowerSeries ℂ) (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (r : Fin (k - 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  pcJetEdgeTermSucc x_base ℓ_base I_ser F_ser β i_L -
    pcJetEdgeTermCast x_base ℓ_base I_ser F_ser β i_R

noncomputable def pcJetVertexWeight {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) (s : Fin (k - 1)) : ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨s.1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
  (PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_L.succ) - PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_L.castSucc)) /
      ℓ_base i_L -
    (PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_R.succ) - PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_R.castSucc)) /
      ℓ_base i_R

noncomputable def pcJetFormalHess {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let Δx_L := x_base i_L.succ - x_base i_L.castSucc
    let ΔY_L := PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_L.succ) - PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_L.castSucc)
    let L_L := ℓ_base i_L
    let F1_L_succ := PowerSeries.coeff 1 (F_ser i_L.succ)
    let F1_L_cast := PowerSeries.coeff 1 (F_ser i_L.castSucc)
    let F2_L_succ := 2 * PowerSeries.coeff 2 (F_ser i_L.succ)
    let n_L_succ := Δx_L + ΔY_L * F1_L_succ
    let n_L_cast := Δx_L + ΔY_L * F1_L_cast
    let Δx_R := x_base i_R.succ - x_base i_R.castSucc
    let ΔY_R := PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_R.succ) - PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_R.castSucc)
    let L_R := ℓ_base i_R
    let F1_R_cast := PowerSeries.coeff 1 (F_ser i_R.castSucc)
    let F1_R_succ := PowerSeries.coeff 1 (F_ser i_R.succ)
    let F2_R_cast := 2 * PowerSeries.coeff 2 (F_ser i_R.castSucc)
    let n_R_cast := Δx_R + ΔY_R * F1_R_cast
    let n_R_succ := Δx_R + ΔY_R * F1_R_succ
    if r.1 = s.1 then
      (((1 + F1_L_succ ^ 2 + ΔY_L * F2_L_succ) * L_L ^ 2 - n_L_succ ^ 2) / L_L ^ 3) +
        (((1 + F1_R_cast ^ 2 - ΔY_R * F2_R_cast) * L_R ^ 2 - n_R_cast ^ 2) / L_R ^ 3)
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
      ((-1 - F1_R_succ * F1_R_cast) * L_R ^ 2 + n_R_cast * n_R_succ) / L_R ^ 3
    else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
      ((-1 - F1_L_cast * F1_L_succ) * L_L ^ 2 + n_L_succ * n_L_cast) / L_L ^ 3
    else
      0

noncomputable def pcJetTrunc1D (K : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m => if m ≤ K then PowerSeries.coeff m f else 0

noncomputable def pcJetTruncAbscissas {k : ℕ} (N₀ : ℕ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun u =>
    if r.1 = 0 ∨ r.1 = k then MvPowerSeries.coeff u (β r)
    else if u 0 + u 1 < N₀ then MvPowerSeries.coeff u (β r)
    else 0

noncomputable def sfcaBivarDiv (f : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (b₀ b₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  dslope (fun z₀ => dslope (fun z₁ => f z₀ z₁) 0 b₁) 0 b₀

def IsSfcaBivarHoloVanish (f : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ × ℂ => f z.1 z.2)
    (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) sfcaRhoB ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) sfcaRhoB) ∧
  (∀ z₁ : ℂ, ‖z₁‖ < sfcaRhoB → f 0 z₁ = 0) ∧
  (∀ z₀ : ℂ, ‖z₀‖ < sfcaRhoB → f z₀ 0 = 0)

noncomputable def puisDualLine0 {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (d : ℕ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p => dualLineShift C 0 ι (p.1, p.2 ^ d)

structure PuiseuxCoverGermData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ : ℝ) (D_wall : AlignedWallDefectData W t₂)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ)
    (Br : PuncturedGlancingBridgeData W t₂ D_wall q_idx) where
  d : ℕ
  d_pos : 1 ≤ d
  r_yp : ℝ
  r_τ : ℝ
  K_p : ℕ
  r_yp_pos : 0 < r_yp
  r_yp_le : r_yp ≤ Br.r_y / 2
  r_τ_pos : 0 < r_τ
  r_τ_pow_lt : r_τ ^ d < Br.r_t / 2
  M_puis : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  N_puis : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  M_puis_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_puis ι)
      (Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}))
  N_puis_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (N_puis ι)
      (Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ)
  N_puis_eq : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ,
      p.2 ≠ 0 → N_puis ι p = p.2 ^ K_p * M_puis ι p
  puis_rank_one :
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}),
      homRankOneDet (homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis) p = 0
  puis_reflect :
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}),
      ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis ι p = 0
  not_w2_zero :
    ¬ ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}),
        homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 2 p = 0
  not_iso_line : ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (s_iso c_star : ℂ),
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty →
    V ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}) →
    (s_iso = 1 ∨ s_iso = -1) →
    ¬ ∀ p ∈ V,
        homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 0 p +
          s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 1 p -
          c_star * homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 2 p = 0
  not_prev_eq : ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty →
    V ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}) →
    ¬ ∀ p ∈ V,
        let W₁ := homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis
        let W₀ : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun k q =>
          homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0) k (q.1, q.2 ^ d)
        W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
        W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0
  not_primary : ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty →
    V ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}) →
    ¬ ∀ p ∈ V, ∀ ι : Fin 2, M_puis ι p = dualLineShift C 1 ι (p.1, p.2 ^ d)
  puis_poly_transfer : ∀ (y_m t_m r_m : ℝ) (M_cand : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < t_m → 0 < r_m →
    Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m ⊆
      symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx →
    (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_cand ι) (Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m)) →
    (∃ V_τ : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen V_τ ∧ V_τ.Nonempty ∧
      V_τ ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ V_τ, (q.1, q.2 ^ d) ∈ Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m ∧
        ∀ ι : Fin 2, M_puis ι q = M_cand ι (q.1, q.2 ^ d))) →
    ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
      (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((Br.y₀ : ℂ), (Br.t_end : ℂ)) Br.r_end,
        ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff deg) *
            (Br.M₁_end ι_star p) ^ (deg : ℕ) = 0) ↔
      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m,
        ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff deg) *
            (M_cand ι_star p) ^ (deg : ℕ) = 0)

structure RegularAffineIntersectionData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ : ℝ) (D_wall : AlignedWallDefectData W t₂)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ)
    (Br : PuncturedGlancingBridgeData W t₂ D_wall q_idx)
    (G : PuiseuxCoverGermData W t₂ D_wall q_idx Br) where
  y₁ : ℝ
  ρ₁ : ℝ
  m_star : ℕ
  ρ₁_pos : 0 < ρ₁
  ball_y₁_sub : Metric.ball (y₁ : ℂ) ρ₁ ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp
  ρ₁_le_τ : ρ₁ ≤ G.r_τ
  W_tilde : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  Z : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  W_tilde_holo : ∀ k : Fin 3,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (W_tilde k) (Metric.ball (y₁ : ℂ) ρ₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₁)
  W_tilde_puis_eq : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₁ : ℂ) ρ₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₁,
    p.2 ≠ 0 → ∀ k : Fin 3,
      p.2 ^ m_star * W_tilde k p =
        p.2 ^ G.K_p * homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C G.d) G.M_puis k p
  W_tilde_two_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₁ : ℂ) ρ₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₁,
    W_tilde 2 p ≠ 0
  Z_eq : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₁ : ℂ) ρ₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₁,
    Z ι p = W_tilde ι.castSucc p / W_tilde 2 p
  Z_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (Z ι) (Metric.ball (y₁ : ℂ) ρ₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₁)
  Z_incidence : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₁ : ℂ) ρ₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₁,
    puisDualLine0 C G.d 0 p * Z 0 p + puisDualLine0 C G.d 1 p * Z 1 p = 1
  Z_rank_one : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₁ : ℂ) ρ₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₁,
    pderivA (Z 0) p * pderivD (Z 1) p = pderivD (Z 0) p * pderivA (Z 1) p

structure TransverseNonisotropicArcData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
