    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ : ℝ) (D_wall : AlignedWallDefectData W t₂)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ)
    (Br : PuncturedGlancingBridgeData W t₂ D_wall q_idx)
    (G : PuiseuxCoverGermData W t₂ D_wall q_idx Br)
    (R : RegularAffineIntersectionData W t₂ D_wall q_idx Br G) where
  y₂ : ℝ
  δ_s : ℝ
  δ₂ : ℝ
  δ_s_pos : 0 < δ_s
  δ₂_pos : 0 < δ₂
  δ₂_le_s : δ₂ ≤ δ_s
  ball_y₂_s_sub : Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ_s ⊆ Metric.ball (R.y₁ : ℂ) R.ρ₁
  δ₂_le_ρ₁ : δ₂ ≤ R.ρ₁
  Z_zero : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ
  σ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  Z_zero_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Z_zero ι) (Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ_s)
  Z_zero_incidence_zero : ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ_s,
    dualLineShift C 0 0 (s, 0) * Z_zero 0 s + dualLineShift C 0 1 (s, 0) * Z_zero 1 s = 1
  Z_zero_nonisotropic_at : (deriv (Z_zero 0) (y₂ : ℂ)) ^ 2 + (deriv (Z_zero 1) (y₂ : ℂ)) ^ 2 ≠ 0
  Z_zero_transverse_at :
    dualLineShift C 0 0 ((y₂ : ℂ), 0) * deriv (Z_zero 0) (y₂ : ℂ) +
      dualLineShift C 0 1 ((y₂ : ℂ), 0) * deriv (Z_zero 1) (y₂ : ℂ) ≠ 0
  σ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ σ (Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₂)
  σ_maps_to : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₂,
    σ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ_s
  σ_at_zero : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ₂, σ (y, 0) = y
  σ_pderivA_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₂,
    pderivA σ p ≠ 0
  Z_eq_comp_σ : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₂,
    R.Z ι p = Z_zero ι (σ p)

noncomputable def rp_iterDslope (w₁ : ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  | 0 => g
  | k + 1 => dslope (rp_iterDslope w₁ g k) w₁

noncomputable def rp_substPS (f Ψ : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m =>
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), PowerSeries.coeff r f * PowerSeries.coeff m (Ψ ^ r)

noncomputable def rp_jetVSeries (u : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m =>
    if m % 2 = 0 ∧ 2 ≤ m then u (m / 2) z else 0

noncomputable def rp_jetHPlusSeries (u : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m =>
    (if m = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) +
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal m,
        if p.1 % 2 = 0 ∧ 2 ≤ p.1 ∧ 1 ≤ p.2 then
          iteratedDeriv p.2 (u (p.1 / 2)) z / (p.2.factorial : ℂ)
        else 0

noncomputable def rp_jetHMinusSeries (u : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m =>
    (if m = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) +
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal m,
        if p.1 % 2 = 0 ∧ 2 ≤ p.1 ∧ 1 ≤ p.2 then
          (-1 : ℂ) ^ (p.2 + 1) * (iteratedDeriv p.2 (u (p.1 / 2)) z / (p.2.factorial : ℂ))
        else 0

noncomputable def rp_reflPolySeries {n : ℕ} (G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n)
    (N : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
      rp_substPS (holoTaylor1D (reflDiffCoeff G k.1 k.2) z) (rp_jetVSeries u z) *
        (rp_jetHMinusSeries u z) ^ k.1 * (rp_jetHPlusSeries u z) ^ k.2

def rp_truncJet (u : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (j i : ℕ) : ℂ → ℂ :=
  if 1 ≤ i ∧ i < j then u i else fun _ => 0

def rp_VanishesToOrderPS (M : ℕ) (P : PowerSeries ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : ℕ, m < M → PowerSeries.coeff m P = 0

def rp_HasPSLaurentWeight (w : ℤ) (Ψ : ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ β : ℕ,
    MeromorphicAt (fun z => PowerSeries.coeff β (Ψ z)) 0 ∧
      ((w - (β : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤
        meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => PowerSeries.coeff β (Ψ z)) 0

noncomputable def pculTaylorRem2 (F : ℂ → ℂ) (z d : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv (deriv F) (z + (t : ℂ) * d)

noncomputable def pculSlopeSpeed (v_a : ℝ) (m : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (Real.sqrt (1 + v_a ^ 2) : ℂ) *
    sqrt1p ((m ^ 2 - (v_a : ℂ) ^ 2) / ((1 + v_a ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))

noncomputable def pculGammaQuot (v_a : ℝ) (m₁ m₂ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let σ₁ := pculSlopeSpeed v_a m₁
  let σ₂ := pculSlopeSpeed v_a m₂
  (1 - m₁ * m₂ + σ₁ * σ₂) / (σ₁ * σ₂ * (σ₁ + σ₂))

noncomputable def pculPsiQuadQuot (v_a : ℝ) (μ m : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let σ_m := pculSlopeSpeed v_a m
  let σ_μ := pculSlopeSpeed v_a μ
  (σ_m * (1 + μ * m + σ_m * σ_μ))⁻¹

def PculUnifBdd (φ : Filter ℝ) (D : Set ℂ) (F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  TendstoUniformlyOn F f φ D ∧ ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ e ∈ D, ‖f e‖ ≤ M

def wallBridgeB (K : ℕ) : ℕ := K + 2

def wallUnalignedShifts (K : ℕ) {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) : Finset ℤ :=
  ({(-1 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ), ((wallBridgeB K : ℕ) : ℤ)} : Finset ℤ) ∪ Finset.univ.image q_idx

def wallAllShifts (K : ℕ) {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) : Finset ℤ :=
  insert (1 : ℤ) (wallUnalignedShifts K q_idx)

noncomputable def wallAllJBound (K : ℕ) {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) : ℝ :=
  (((wallAllShifts K q_idx).sup (fun q : ℤ => q.natAbs) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2

def wallUnifiedDom (s_b r_b : ℝ) (K : ℕ) {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_b / 2 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_b ∧
      |p.2.im| < s_b / (2 * wallAllJBound K q_idx) }

def wallShiftPair (q : ℤ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (p.1 + (q : ℂ) * p.2, p.2)

noncomputable def fieldSymJetEnv {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) (M : ℕ)
    (E : ℤ → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : SymJetVar N_idx M → ℂ :=
  fun v => iterDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (E (q_idx v.1) v.2.1) p

structure RootDetourChain {D_det : Fin 2 → ℕ}
    (U_reg : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (C_poly : ∀ ι : Fin 2, Fin (D_det ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (p_a : ℂ × ℂ) (r_a : ℝ) (M_a : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (p_b : ℂ × ℂ) (r_b : ℝ) (M_b : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) where
  L_ch : ℕ
  c_ch : Fin (L_ch + 1) → ℂ × ℂ
  r_ch : Fin (L_ch + 1) → ℝ
  M_ch : Fin (L_ch + 1) → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  r_ch_pos : ∀ j, 0 < r_ch j
  ball_sub_reg : ∀ j, Metric.ball (c_ch j) (r_ch j) ⊆ U_reg
  start_eq : c_ch 0 = p_a ∧ Metric.ball (c_ch 0) (r_ch 0) ⊆ Metric.ball p_a r_a ∧
    ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c_ch 0) (r_ch 0), M_ch 0 ι q = M_a ι q
  end_eq : c_ch (Fin.last L_ch) = p_b ∧ r_ch (Fin.last L_ch) = r_b ∧
    ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_b r_b, M_ch (Fin.last L_ch) ι q = M_b ι q
  step_overlap : ∀ j : Fin L_ch,
    (Metric.ball (c_ch j.castSucc) (r_ch j.castSucc) ∩
      Metric.ball (c_ch j.succ) (r_ch j.succ)).Nonempty ∧
    ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c_ch j.castSucc) (r_ch j.castSucc) ∩
          Metric.ball (c_ch j.succ) (r_ch j.succ),
        M_ch j.castSucc ι q = M_ch j.succ ι q
  holo_and_solves : ∀ j (ι : Fin 2),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_ch j ι) (Metric.ball (c_ch j) (r_ch j)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c_ch j) (r_ch j),
      ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), C_poly ι d q * (M_ch j ι q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0

structure ZeroAvoidingRootContKit : Prop where
  isPreconnected_compl_zero : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ H U →
    IsPreconnected { p ∈ U | H p ≠ 0 }
  exists_nonzero_finset_on_open : ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) {W V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      (f : ι → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
    (∀ i ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f i) W ∧ ∃ p ∈ W, f i p ≠ 0) →
    ∃ p ∈ V, ∀ i ∈ s, f i p ≠ 0
  detour_root_chain : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {D_det : Fin 2 → ℕ}
      (C_poly : ∀ ι : Fin 2, Fin (D_det ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (p_a p_b : ℂ × ℂ) (r_a : ℝ) (M_a : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ H U →
    (∀ ι : Fin 2, 1 ≤ D_det ι) →
    (∀ ι d, DifferentiableOn ℂ (C_poly ι d) U) →
    (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ q ∈ U, H q ≠ 0 →
      C_poly ι (Fin.last (D_det ι)) q ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ,
        ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), C_poly ι d q * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι),
          (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * C_poly ι d.succ q * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0) →
    p_a ∈ U → H p_a ≠ 0 → p_b ∈ U → H p_b ≠ 0 →
    0 < r_a → Metric.ball p_a r_a ⊆ U →
    (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_a ι) (Metric.ball p_a r_a)) →
    (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_a r_a,
      ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), C_poly ι d q * (M_a ι q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) →
    ∃ (r_b : ℝ) (M_b : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_b ∧ Metric.ball p_b r_b ⊆ { q ∈ U | H q ≠ 0 } ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_b ι) (Metric.ball p_b r_b)) ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_b r_b,
        ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), C_poly ι d q * (M_b ι q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ∧
      Nonempty (RootDetourChain { q ∈ U | H q ≠ 0 } C_poly p_a r_a M_a p_b r_b M_b)

structure EndpointClearingAndBidiskData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (K : ℕ) {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) where
  M_det : Fin 2 → ℕ
  D_det : Fin 2 → ℕ
  D_det_pos : ∀ ι : Fin 2, 1 ≤ D_det ι
  Q_det : ∀ ι : Fin 2, Fin (D_det ι + 1) → MvPolynomial (LineJetVar (M_det ι)) ℂ
  Disc_det : ∀ ι : Fin 2, MvPolynomial (LineJetVar (M_det ι)) ℂ
  A_coeff : ∀ ι : Fin 2, Fin (D_det ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  Δ_base : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  A_coeff_def : ∀ ι d p,
    A_coeff ι d p =
      MvPolynomial.eval
        (lineJetEnv (M_det ι) (dualLineShift C 0)
          (dualLineShift C (wallBridgeB K : ℤ)) p)
        (Q_det ι d)
  Δ_base_def : ∀ ι p,
    Δ_base ι p =
      MvPolynomial.eval
        (lineJetEnv (M_det ι) (dualLineShift C 0)
          (dualLineShift C (wallBridgeB K : ℤ)) p)
        (Disc_det ι)
  univ_separable : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (env : LineJetVar (M_det ι) → ℂ) (z : ℂ),
    MvPolynomial.eval env (Q_det ι (Fin.last (D_det ι))) ≠ 0 →
    MvPolynomial.eval env (Disc_det ι) ≠ 0 →
    ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), MvPolynomial.eval env (Q_det ι d) * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
    ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι),
      (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPolynomial.eval env (Q_det ι d.succ) * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0
  base_coeff_holo : ∀ ι d,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (A_coeff ι d) (wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx)
  base_disc_holo : ∀ ι,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (Δ_base ι) (wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx)
  base_lead_witness : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∃ p ∈ wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx, A_coeff ι (Fin.last (D_det ι)) p ≠ 0
  base_disc_witness : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∃ p ∈ wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx, Δ_base ι p ≠ 0
  base_primary_solves : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∀ p ∈ wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx,
      ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), A_coeff ι d p * (dualLineShift C 1 ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0
  y₀ : ℝ
  r_y : ℝ
  r_t : ℝ
  t_end : ℝ
  m_t : ℕ
  H_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  r_y_pos : 0 < r_y
  r_t_pos : 0 < r_t
  t_end_pos : 0 < t_end
  t_end_lt : t_end < 3 * r_t / 4
  bidisk_sub_unified :
    Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t ⊆
      wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx
  H_tilde_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H_tilde (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t)
  H_tilde_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t,
    H_tilde p ≠ 0
  H_base_factor : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t,
    p.2 ^ m_t * H_tilde p =
      A_coeff 0 (Fin.last (D_det 0)) p * Δ_base 0 p *
        A_coeff 1 (Fin.last (D_det 1)) p * Δ_base 1 p
  separable_punc : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t \ {0}),
      A_coeff ι (Fin.last (D_det ι)) p ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ,
        ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), A_coeff ι d p * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι),
          (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * A_coeff ι d.succ p * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0
  clear_pair : ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (N₀ D₀ N_b D_b : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U →
    (∀ c : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (N₀ c) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (D₀ c) U ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (N_b c) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (D_b c) U) →
    ∃ (C_cl : ∀ ι : Fin 2, Fin (D_det ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (Δ_cl : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (S_cl S_disc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ ι d, DifferentiableOn ℂ (C_cl ι d) U) ∧
      (∀ ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Δ_cl ι) U) ∧
      (∀ ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_cl ι) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_disc ι) U) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ U, (∀ c : Fin 2, D₀ c p ≠ 0 ∧ D_b c p ≠ 0) →
        ∀ ι : Fin 2,
          S_cl ι p ≠ 0 ∧ S_disc ι p ≠ 0 ∧
          (∀ d, C_cl ι d p = S_cl ι p *
            MvPolynomial.eval
              (lineJetEnv (M_det ι) (fun c q => N₀ c q / D₀ c q)
                (fun c q => N_b c q / D_b c q) p)
              (Q_det ι d)) ∧
          Δ_cl ι p = S_disc ι p *
            MvPolynomial.eval
              (lineJetEnv (M_det ι) (fun c q => N₀ c q / D₀ c q)
                (fun c q => N_b c q / D_b c q) p)
              (Disc_det ι)

noncomputable def wallAnchorPt (x_star H₂ ρ t₂ : ℝ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  ((x_star : ℂ) + ((H₂ - ρ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, (t₂ : ℂ))

noncomputable def wallAnchorField {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (x_star H₂ ρ t₂ : ℝ) (q : ℤ) (c : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let c_q := wallShiftPair q (wallAnchorPt x_star H₂ ρ t₂)
  (W.L_mero c).num c_q (wallShiftPair q p) /
    (W.L_mero c).den c_q (wallShiftPair q p)

structure WallLoopTopBranchData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ : ℝ) (D_wall : AlignedWallDefectData W t₂)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) where
  ρ : ℝ
  r_anchor : ℝ
  H_top_guard : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  M₁_top : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  ρ_pos : 0 < ρ
  ρ_lt : ρ < W.s_base / 2
  r_anchor_pos : 0 < r_anchor
  anchor_in_chart : ∀ q ∈ wallAllShifts D_wall.K q_idx, ∀ c : Fin 2,
    let c_q := wallShiftPair q (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂)
    c_q ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor,
      wallShiftPair q p ∈ Metric.ball c_q ((W.L_mero c).rad c_q)
  guard_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_top_guard
    (Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor)
  guard_witness : ∃ p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor,
    H_top_guard p ≠ 0
  guard_den_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor,
    H_top_guard p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ q ∈ wallAllShifts D_wall.K q_idx, ∀ c : Fin 2,
      (W.L_mero c).den (wallShiftPair q (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂))
        (wallShiftPair q p) ≠ 0
  M₁_top_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (M₁_top ι)
      (Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor)
  M₁_top_ne_primary : ∃ ι_def : Fin 2,
    ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), IsOpen V → V.Nonempty →
      V ⊆ { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor |
              H_top_guard p ≠ 0 } →
      ∃ p ∈ V, M₁_top ι_def p ≠
        wallAnchorField W D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂ 1 ι_def p
  loop_root_transfer : ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι : Fin 2)
      (Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M) ℂ),
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor |
                     H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂
    (∀ p ∈ Ω_anc,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv M (F_anc 0) (F_anc (wallBridgeB D_wall.K : ℤ)) p) (Q d) *
          (F_anc 1 ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) →
    (∀ p ∈ Ω_anc,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv M (F_anc 0) (F_anc (wallBridgeB D_wall.K : ℤ)) p) (Q d) *
          (M₁_top ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0)
  loop_fwd_rank_one :
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor |
                     H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂
    (∀ p ∈ Ω_anc, homRankOneDet (homIntersect (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1)) p = 0) →
    (∀ p ∈ Ω_anc, homRankOneDet (homIntersect (F_anc 0) M₁_top) p = 0)
  loop_fwd_reflect :
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor |
                     H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂
    (∀ p ∈ Ω_anc, ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1) ι p = 0) →
    (∀ p ∈ Ω_anc, ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (F_anc 0) M₁_top ι p = 0)
  loop_rev_w2_zero :
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor |
                     H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂
    ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ Ω_anc →
      (∀ p ∈ V, homIntersect (F_anc 0) M₁_top 2 p = 0) →
      ∀ p ∈ Ω_anc, homIntersect (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1) 2 p = 0
  loop_rev_iso_line : ∀ s_iso c_star : ℂ,
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor |
                     H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂
    ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ Ω_anc →
      (∀ p ∈ V,
        homIntersect (F_anc 0) M₁_top 0 p +
          s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (F_anc 0) M₁_top 1 p -
          c_star * homIntersect (F_anc 0) M₁_top 2 p = 0) →
      ∀ p ∈ Ω_anc,
        homIntersect (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1) 0 p +
          s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1) 1 p -
          c_star * homIntersect (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1) 2 p = 0
  loop_rev_prev_eq :
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor |
                     H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂
    ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ Ω_anc →
      (∀ p ∈ V,
        let W₁ := homIntersect (F_anc 0) M₁_top
        let W₀ := homIntersect (F_anc (-1)) (F_anc 0)
        W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
        W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0) →
      ∀ p ∈ Ω_anc,
        let W₁ := homIntersect (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1)
        let W₀ := homIntersect (F_anc (-1)) (F_anc 0)
        W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
        W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0
  loop_poly_transfer : ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
      (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor |
                     H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ ρ t₂
    ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ Ω_anc →
      ((∀ p ∈ Ω_anc,
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (fieldSymJetEnv q_idx M F_anc p) (P_coeff d) *
              (F_anc 1 ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ↔
        (∀ p ∈ V,
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (fieldSymJetEnv q_idx M F_anc p) (P_coeff d) *
              (M₁_top ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0))

structure VerticalChainDescentData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ H₂ x_star : ℝ) (K : ℕ) {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ)
    (E_base : EndpointClearingAndBidiskData W K q_idx)
    (ρ r_anchor : ℝ) (H_top_guard : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) where
  primary_solves_at_anchor : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt x_star H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor | H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W x_star H₂ ρ t₂
    ∀ p ∈ Ω_anc,
      ∑ d : Fin (E_base.D_det ι + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval
          (lineJetEnv (E_base.M_det ι) (F_anc 0) (F_anc (wallBridgeB K : ℤ)) p)
          (E_base.Q_det ι d) *
        (F_anc 1 ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0
  ascend_rank_one :
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt x_star H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor | H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W x_star H₂ ρ t₂
    (∀ p ∈ wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx,
      homRankOneDet (homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)) p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ Ω_anc, homRankOneDet (homIntersect (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1)) p = 0
  ascend_reflect :
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt x_star H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor | H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W x_star H₂ ρ t₂
    (∀ p ∈ wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx,
      ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) ι p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ Ω_anc, ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1) ι p = 0
  descend_primary_w2_zero :
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt x_star H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor | H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W x_star H₂ ρ t₂
    (∀ p ∈ Ω_anc, homIntersect (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1) 2 p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p = 0
  descend_primary_iso_line : ∀ s_iso c_star : ℂ,
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt x_star H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor | H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W x_star H₂ ρ t₂
    (∀ p ∈ Ω_anc,
      homIntersect (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1) 0 p +
        s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1) 1 p -
        c_star * homIntersect (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1) 2 p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 0 p +
        s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 1 p -
        c_star * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p = 0
  descend_primary_prev_eq :
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt x_star H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor | H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W x_star H₂ ρ t₂
    (∀ p ∈ Ω_anc,
      let W₁ := homIntersect (F_anc 0) (F_anc 1)
      let W₀ := homIntersect (F_anc (-1)) (F_anc 0)
      W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
      W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx,
      let W₁ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)
      let W₀ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0)
      W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
      W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0
  primary_poly_transfer : ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
      (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt x_star H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor | H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W x_star H₂ ρ t₂
    (∀ p ∈ wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff d) *
          (dualLineShift C 1 ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ↔
    (∀ p ∈ Ω_anc,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (fieldSymJetEnv q_idx M F_anc p) (P_coeff d) *
          (F_anc 1 ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0)
  descend_branch : ∀ (M_top : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    let Ω_anc := { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt x_star H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor | H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
    let F_anc := wallAnchorField W x_star H₂ ρ t₂
    (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_top ι)
      (Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt x_star H₂ ρ t₂) r_anchor)) →
    (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ Ω_anc,
      ∑ d : Fin (E_base.D_det ι + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval
          (lineJetEnv (E_base.M_det ι) (F_anc 0) (F_anc (wallBridgeB K : ℤ)) p)
          (E_base.Q_det ι d) *
        (M_top ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) →
    (∃ ι_def : Fin 2, ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ Ω_anc →
      ∃ p ∈ V, M_top ι_def p ≠ F_anc 1 ι_def p) →
    ∃ (V_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (r_end : ℝ) (M₁_end : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen V_init ∧ V_init.Nonempty ∧ V_init ⊆ Ω_anc ∧
      0 < r_end ∧
      Metric.ball ((E_base.y₀ : ℂ), (E_base.t_end : ℂ)) r_end ⊆
        Metric.ball (E_base.y₀ : ℂ) (3 * E_base.r_y / 4) ×ˢ
          { t : ℂ | 0 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * E_base.r_t / 4 } ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M₁_end ι)
        (Metric.ball ((E_base.y₀ : ℂ), (E_base.t_end : ℂ)) r_end)) ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((E_base.y₀ : ℂ), (E_base.t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
        ∑ d : Fin (E_base.D_det ι + 1), E_base.A_coeff ι d p * (M₁_end ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ∧
      (∃ ι_def : Fin 2, ∃ p ∈ Metric.ball ((E_base.y₀ : ℂ), (E_base.t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
        M₁_end ι_def p ≠ dualLineShift C 1 ι_def p) ∧
      ((∀ p ∈ Ω_anc, homRankOneDet (homIntersect (F_anc 0) M_top) p = 0) →
        ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((E_base.y₀ : ℂ), (E_base.t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
          homRankOneDet (homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end) p = 0) ∧
      ((∀ p ∈ Ω_anc, ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (F_anc 0) M_top ι p = 0) →
        ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((E_base.y₀ : ℂ), (E_base.t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
          ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end ι p = 0) ∧
      ((∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((E_base.y₀ : ℂ), (E_base.t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
          homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 2 p = 0) →
        ∀ p ∈ V_init, homIntersect (F_anc 0) M_top 2 p = 0) ∧
      (∀ s_iso c_star : ℂ,
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((E_base.y₀ : ℂ), (E_base.t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
          homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 0 p +
            s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 1 p -
            c_star * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 2 p = 0) →
        ∀ p ∈ V_init,
          homIntersect (F_anc 0) M_top 0 p +
            s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (F_anc 0) M_top 1 p -
            c_star * homIntersect (F_anc 0) M_top 2 p = 0) ∧
      ((∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((E_base.y₀ : ℂ), (E_base.t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
          let W₁ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end
          let W₀ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0)
          W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
          W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0) →
        ∀ p ∈ V_init,
          let W₁ := homIntersect (F_anc 0) M_top
          let W₀ := homIntersect (F_anc (-1)) (F_anc 0)
          W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
          W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0) ∧
      (∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
          (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
        (∀ p ∈ V_init,
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (fieldSymJetEnv q_idx M F_anc p) (P_coeff d) *
              (M_top ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ↔
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((E_base.y₀ : ℂ), (E_base.t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff d) *
              (M₁_end ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0))

def RefSteepContinuationProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (X : ExpStripData), IsOpen X.D_strip →
  ∀ (P : ChordActionPackage X) (α γ_steep : ℝ),
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    ∃ (C_st η_st : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_st ∧ 0 < η_st ∧ η_st < 1 / 16 ∧
      ∀ (x₀ h_ref m_steep d δ_ceil Δ_slab r M_scale C_init : ℝ)
        (s_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < m_steep → 0 < d → 0 < Δ_slab → 2 * Δ_slab ≤ δ_ceil →
        4 * d ≤ δ_ceil - Δ_slab → 0 < r → 0 < M_scale → 0 ≤ C_init →
        12 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α ≤ Δ_slab / 16 →
        r / d ≤ η_st →
        r * d ^ (-α) * M_scale ≤ η_st →
        C_init * (1 + 8 * δ_ceil / (γ_steep * Δ_slab)) ≤
          M_scale ^ 2 * δ_ceil ^ (1 - 2 * α) →
        (let L_in : ℝ := 2 * m_steep + 2 / γ_steep + 4
         let S_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             δ_ceil - Δ_slab < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < L_in * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < 12 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α }
         let W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             d / 2 < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_ceil - Δ_slab / 4 ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
             γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| }
         (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ h_ref - s.im → h_ref - s.im ≤ (5 / 4) * δ_ceil →
           |s.re - x₀| ≤ L_in * (h_ref - s.im) →
           s ∈ X.D_strip ∧
           ‖X.f s‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - s.im) ^ (-α) ∧
           Real.sqrt ‖X.q s‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - s.im) ^ (-α)) →
         DifferentiableOn ℂ s_init S_init →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ S_init →
           s_init (y, -t) = s_init (y, t) ∧
           ‖s_init (y, t) - y‖ ≤ C_init * ‖t‖ ^ 2) →
         (∀ y : ℂ, (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ S_init → s_init (y, 0) = y) →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, t ≠ 0 →
           (y - t, t) ∈ S_init → (y, t) ∈ S_init → (y + t, t) ∈ S_init →
           let s_prev := s_init (y - t, t)
           let s_curr := s_init (y, t)
           let s_next := s_init (y + t, t)
           let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
           let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
           deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
             t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
             deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev) →
         ∃ s_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
           DifferentiableOn ℂ s_steep W_steep ∧
           (∀ p ∈ W_steep, s_steep p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_steep →
             s_steep (y, -t) = s_steep (y, t) ∧
             ‖s_steep (y, t) - y‖ ≤
               C_st * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_steep →
             δ_ceil - (3 / 4) * Δ_slab < h_ref - y.im →
             s_steep (y, t) = s_init (y, t)) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, γ_steep * ‖t‖ < t.im →
             (y - t, t) ∈ W_steep → (y, t) ∈ W_steep → (y + t, t) ∈ W_steep →
             let s_prev := s_steep (y - t, t)
             let s_curr := s_steep (y, t)
             let s_next := s_steep (y + t, t)
             let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
             let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
             deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
               t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
               deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev))

def SchwarzPoissonBumpProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (M_dip η_plus γ₀ : ℝ),
    0 < M_dip → 0 < η_plus → 0 < γ₀ → γ₀ < 1 / 8 →
    ∃ (C_bump C_err γ_steep : ℝ),
      0 < C_bump ∧ 0 < C_err ∧ 0 < γ_steep ∧ γ_steep < γ₀ ∧
      ∀ (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ), ‖c‖ < 1 / 3 → 1 / 2 ≤ r → r < 1 →
        ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / r)) ∧
          g 0 = 0 ∧
          (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
            ‖g ζ‖ ≤ C_bump ∧ -M_dip ≤ (g ζ).im ∧ (g ζ).im ≤ η_plus) ∧
          (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1,
            |(c + ζ).im| ≤ (6 / 5) * γ_steep * ‖c + ζ‖ →
            0 ≤ M_dip + (g ζ).im ∧ M_dip + (g ζ).im ≤ C_err * (1 - r))

def RefDyadicConeFillingProp : Prop :=
  ∀ α : ℝ, 1 / 2 < α → α < 1 →
    ∃ (D_dip C_bump M_ceil γ_dyad : ℝ),
      2 ≤ D_dip ∧ 0 < C_bump ∧ 8 < M_ceil ∧ 0 < γ_dyad ∧ γ_dyad < 1 / 8 ∧
      ∀ (X : ExpStripData), IsOpen X.D_strip → Convex ℝ X.D_strip →
      ∀ (x₀ h_ref m₀ d δ₀ r M_scale C_st A₀ : ℝ)
        (s_band₀ s_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < m₀ → 0 < d → d < δ₀ → 0 < r → 0 < M_scale → 0 < C_st → 0 ≤ A₀ →
        (let m_aux : ℝ := max m₀ ((C_bump + 4) / (D_dip - 1))
         let m_steep : ℝ := 2 * (m_aux + C_bump + 2)
         let A_ind : ℝ := max A₀ (2 ^ (2 * α - 1) * C_st)
         let Ω_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             δ₀ < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < M_ceil * δ₀ ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m_aux * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α }
         let W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             d / 2 < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < M_ceil * δ₀ ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
             γ_dyad * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| }
         let Ω_out : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             d < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < 2 * δ₀ ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m₀ * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α }
         DifferentiableOn ℂ s_band₀ Ω_init →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ Ω_init →
           s_band₀ (y, -t) = s_band₀ (y, t) ∧
           ‖s_band₀ (y, t) - y‖ ≤
             A₀ * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) →
         (∀ y : ℂ, (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ Ω_init → s_band₀ (y, 0) = y) →
         DifferentiableOn ℂ s_steep W_steep →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_steep →
           s_steep (y, -t) = s_steep (y, t) ∧
           ‖s_steep (y, t) - y‖ ≤
             C_st * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) →
         (∀ p ∈ Ω_init ∩ W_steep, s_band₀ p = s_steep p) →
         (∀ y : ℂ, d < h_ref - y.im → h_ref - y.im < 2 * δ₀ →
           |y.re - x₀| < m₀ * (h_ref - y.im) →
           Metric.ball y
             (2 * A_ind * r ^ 2 * d ^ (-2 * α) * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im)) ⊆
             X.D_strip) →
         ∃ s_cone : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
           DifferentiableOn ℂ s_cone Ω_out ∧
           (∀ p ∈ Ω_out, s_cone p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ Ω_out →
             s_cone (y, -t) = s_cone (y, t) ∧
             ‖s_cone (y, t) - y‖ ≤
               A_ind * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
           (∀ y : ℂ, (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ Ω_out → s_cone (y, 0) = y) ∧
           (∀ p ∈ Ω_out ∩ Ω_init, s_cone p = s_band₀ p) ∧
           (∀ p ∈ Ω_out ∩ W_steep, s_cone p = s_steep p))

def DeepPassageAnchorData (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ T_max : ℝ, 0 < T_max →
    ∃ (D_anc C_anc α : ℝ),
      0 < D_anc ∧ 0 < C_anc ∧ 1 / 2 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧
      ∀ A D_top : ℝ, 0 < A → D_anc + 2 < D_top →
        ∃ (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
          (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ),
          ∀ n ≥ N_init,
            let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
            let coneSet : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
              { p : ℂ × ℂ |
                D_anc < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top ∧
                |p.1.re| < A * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max }
            IsOpen (U_phys n) ∧
            0 < δ_base n ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → 0 ≤ y.im →
              ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im →
                ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → (y, -t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → s_tilde n (y, -t) = s_tilde n (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < T_max / seq.m_seq n →
              (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ (y, t) ∈ X.Tube ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ y : ℂ, (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n →
              D_anc < -y.im → -y.im < D_top → |y.re| < A * (-y.im) →
              s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y, 0) =
                s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ coneSet,
              (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n ∧
              0 < (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1).im ∧
              ‖(s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) - s_n) /
                  (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) - p.1‖ ≤
                C_anc * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (-p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
            (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
              (Y, T) ∈ coneSet →
              (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
              (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
              let t : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
              let y : ℂ := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y
              let s_prev : ℂ := s_tilde n (y - t, t)
              let s_curr : ℂ := s_tilde n (y, t)
              let s_next : ℂ := s_tilde n (y + t, t)
              let J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
              let J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
              deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
                t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
                deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev)

noncomputable def sgaRealArcMinusChord (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∫ ξ in u..v, S.c / (S.f (ξ : ℂ)).re ^ 2) -
    Real.sqrt (((S.Γ (v : ℂ) 0).re - (S.Γ (u : ℂ) 0).re) ^ 2 +
      ((S.Γ (v : ℂ) 1).re - (S.Γ (u : ℂ) 1).re) ^ 2)

noncomputable def ssbpcBaseJetEnv {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M k : ℕ) (is_point : Bool) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : PointJetVar M → ℂ :=
  pointJetEnv M
    (fun i r => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point r.1 r.2 i)
    (fun i r => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point (r.1 + (k : ℂ) * r.2) r.2 i)
    C.A q

structure SsbpcBaseDetPkg {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (is_point : Bool) (ι : Fin 2) where
  M : ℕ
  D : ℕ
  D_pos : 1 ≤ D
  Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ
  Disc : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ
  base_left_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point q.1 q.2 i)
      (bandShearedBaseBox s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε)
  base_right_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 i)
      (bandShearedBaseBox s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε)
  base_solves : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
    (p.1 + (s_minus : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ bandShearedBaseBox s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε →
    ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
      MvPolynomial.eval
        (ssbpcBaseJetEnv C M k is_point (p.1 + (s_minus : ℂ) * p.2, p.2))
        (Q d) *
      (glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 ι) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0
  lead_ne_zero_on_base : ∀ V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
    IsOpen V₀ → V₀.Nonempty →
    V₀ ⊆ bandShearedBaseBox s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε →
    ∃ q ∈ V₀, MvPolynomial.eval (ssbpcBaseJetEnv C M k is_point q) (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0
  disc_ne_zero_on_base : ∀ V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
    IsOpen V₀ → V₀.Nonempty →
    V₀ ⊆ bandShearedBaseBox s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε →
    ∃ q ∈ V₀, MvPolynomial.eval (ssbpcBaseJetEnv C M k is_point q) Disc ≠ 0
  univ_separable : ∀ (env : PointJetVar M → ℂ) (z : ℂ),
    MvPolynomial.eval env (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 →
    MvPolynomial.eval env Disc ≠ 0 →
    ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d) * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
    ∑ d : Fin D,
      (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d.succ) * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0

noncomputable def ssbpcQuotNumY (D : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, N => N
  | m + 1, N => fun q =>
      pderivA (ssbpcQuotNumY D m N) q * D q -
        ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ssbpcQuotNumY D m N q * pderivA D q

noncomputable def ssbpcQuotNumYT (D : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (a : ℕ) : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, N => ssbpcQuotNumY D a N
  | m + 1, N => fun q =>
      pderivD (ssbpcQuotNumYT D a m N) q * D q -
        ((a + m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ssbpcQuotNumYT D a m N q * pderivD D q

noncomputable def ssbpcPolyDeg {σ : Type} [Fintype σ] (P : MvPolynomial σ ℂ) : ℕ :=
  P.support.sup (fun m => ∑ v : σ, m v)

noncomputable def ssbpcHomogEval {σ : Type} [Fintype σ] (R : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ ℂ)
    (M_num : σ → ℂ) (D_den : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ m ∈ P.support,
    P.coeff m * (∏ v : σ, (M_num v) ^ (m v)) * D_den ^ (R - ∑ v : σ, m v)

noncomputable def ssbpcPairChartRad {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℝ :=
  min (min ((E₀ 0).rad p) ((E₀ 1).rad p)) (min ((E₁ 0).rad p) ((E₁ 1).rad p))

noncomputable def ssbpcPairNum {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) (ci : Fin 2 × Fin 2) : ℂ :=
  if ci.1 = 0 then (E₀ ci.2).num p q else (E₁ ci.2).num p q

noncomputable def ssbpcPairDen {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) (ci : Fin 2 × Fin 2) : ℂ :=
  if ci.1 = 0 then (E₀ ci.2).den p q else (E₁ ci.2).den p q

noncomputable def ssbpcPairDenProd {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∏ ci : Fin 2 × Fin 2, ssbpcPairDen E₀ E₁ p q ci

noncomputable def ssbpcClearedJetEnv {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (M : ℕ)
    (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom) (A : ℂ → ℂ) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) : PointJetVar M → ℂ
  | Sum.inl v =>
      let ci : Fin 2 × Fin 2 := (v.1, v.2.1)
      ssbpcQuotNumYT (fun r => ssbpcPairDen E₀ E₁ p r ci) v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1
          (fun r => ssbpcPairNum E₀ E₁ p r ci) q *
        (ssbpcPairDen E₀ E₁ p q ci) ^ ((2 * M + 1) - (v.2.2.1.1 + v.2.2.2.1 + 1)) *
        ∏ cj ∈ Finset.univ.erase ci, (ssbpcPairDen E₀ E₁ p q cj) ^ (2 * M + 1)
  | Sum.inr β =>
      iterDeriv1D β.1 A q.2 * (ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p q) ^ (2 * M + 1)

noncomputable def ssbpcClearedPoly {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (M R : ℕ)
    (P : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ) (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom)
    (A : ℂ → ℂ) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ssbpcHomogEval R P (ssbpcClearedJetEnv M E₀ E₁ A p q)
    ((ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p q) ^ (2 * M + 1))

structure SsbpcMeroJetClearedProp {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (B_base : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom) (g₀ g₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (A : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop where
  rad_pos : ∀ p ∈ Ω_dom, 0 < ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p ∧
    Metric.ball p (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p) ⊆ Ω_dom
  denProd_holo : ∀ p ∈ Ω_dom,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p)
      (Metric.ball p (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p))
  denProd_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ Ω_dom, ∀ V : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ Metric.ball p (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p) →
    ∃ q ∈ V, ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p q ≠ 0
  cleared_holo : ∀ (M R : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
    ∀ p ∈ Ω_dom,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (ssbpcClearedPoly M R P E₀ E₁ A p)
        (Metric.ball p (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p))
  eval_at_reg : ∀ (M R : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
    ssbpcPolyDeg P ≤ R →
    ∀ p ∈ Ω_dom, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p),
      ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p q ≠ 0 →
      let D_com := (ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p q) ^ (2 * M + 1)
      let env : PointJetVar M → ℂ := fun v => ssbpcClearedJetEnv M E₀ E₁ A p q v / D_com
      ssbpcClearedPoly M R P E₀ E₁ A p q = D_com ^ R * MvPolynomial.eval env P
  chart_compat : ∀ (M R : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
    ssbpcPolyDeg P ≤ R →
    ∀ p₁ ∈ Ω_dom, ∀ p₂ ∈ Ω_dom,
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p₁) ∩
          Metric.ball p₂ (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p₂),
        ssbpcClearedPoly M R P E₀ E₁ A p₁ q *
          ((ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p₂ q) ^ (2 * M + 1)) ^ R =
        ssbpcClearedPoly M R P E₀ E₁ A p₂ q *
          ((ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p₁ q) ^ (2 * M + 1)) ^ R
  agrees_on_base : ∀ (M R : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
    ssbpcPolyDeg P ≤ R →
    ∀ p ∈ B_base, ∃ r_ag : ℝ,
      0 < r_ag ∧ r_ag ≤ ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p ∧ Metric.ball p r_ag ⊆ B_base ∧
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r_ag,
        ssbpcClearedPoly M R P E₀ E₁ A p q =
          MvPolynomial.eval (pointJetEnv M g₀ g₁ A q) P *
            ((ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p q) ^ (2 * M + 1)) ^ R
  cleared_ne_zero_of_base : ∀ (M R : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
    ssbpcPolyDeg P ≤ R →
    (∀ V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen V₀ → V₀.Nonempty → V₀ ⊆ B_base →
      ∃ q ∈ V₀, MvPolynomial.eval (pointJetEnv M g₀ g₁ A q) P ≠ 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ Ω_dom, ∀ V : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
      IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ Metric.ball p (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p) →
      ∃ q ∈ V, ssbpcClearedPoly M R P E₀ E₁ A p q ≠ 0

structure SsbpcBandChartBidiskCover (s_base H₁ ε t₁ r₁ : ℝ) (N_slab : ℕ)
    (x_c s_minus : Fin N_slab → ℝ)
    (r_chart : Fin N_slab → ℂ × ℂ → ℝ) where
  N_cov : ℕ
  α_of : Fin N_cov → Fin N_slab
  y_c : Fin N_cov → ℂ
  τ_c : Fin N_cov → ℂ
  ρ : Fin N_cov → ℝ
  ρ_pos : ∀ β : Fin N_cov, 0 < ρ β ∧
    Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ β) ⊆ Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁
  covers_band : ∀ (x y_im : ℝ) (t : ℂ),
    x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) →
    y_im ∈ Set.Icc (H₁ - ε / 16) (H₁ + ε / 16) →
    t ∈ Metric.closedBall (t₁ : ℂ) (r₁ / 2) →
    ∃ β : Fin N_cov,
      ((x : ℂ) + (y_im : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ Metric.ball (y_c β) (3 * ρ β / 4) ∧
      t ∈ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (3 * ρ β / 4)
  center_in_sheared : ∀ β : Fin N_cov,
    ((y_c β) + (s_minus (α_of β) : ℂ) * (τ_c β), τ_c β) ∈
      bandShearedSlab s_base H₁ ε (x_c (α_of β)) (s_minus (α_of β)) t₁ r₁
  bidisk_in_unsheared : ∀ β : Fin N_cov,
    Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ β) ⊆
      bandUnshearedSlab s_base H₁ ε (x_c (α_of β)) t₁ r₁
  sheared_in_chart_ball : ∀ β : Fin N_cov,
    let p_sh := ((y_c β) + (s_minus (α_of β) : ℂ) * (τ_c β), τ_c β)
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ β),
      (q.1 + (s_minus (α_of β) : ℂ) * q.2, q.2) ∈
        Metric.ball p_sh (r_chart (α_of β) p_sh)

noncomputable def firstFieldSinc (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * z ^ (2 * m) / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def firstFieldG (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, 6 * (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * m) /
    ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def secondFieldSinhc (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, z ^ (2 * m) / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def secondFieldGNum (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, 6 * (4 : ℂ) ^ m * z ^ (2 * m) / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)

structure FrozenCalculusProp : Prop where
  sinc_entire : Differentiable ℂ firstFieldSinc
  gF_entire : Differentiable ℂ firstFieldG
  sinhc_entire : Differentiable ℂ secondFieldSinhc
  gQ_entire : Differentiable ℂ secondFieldGNum
  sinc_zero : firstFieldSinc 0 = 1
  gF_zero : firstFieldG 0 = 1
  sinhc_zero : secondFieldSinhc 0 = 1
  gQ_zero : secondFieldGNum 0 = 1
  sinc_mul : ∀ z : ℂ, z * firstFieldSinc z = Complex.sin z
  gF_mul : ∀ z : ℂ, z ^ 3 * firstFieldG z = 3 * (Complex.sin z - z * Complex.cos z)
  sinhc_mul : ∀ z : ℂ, z * secondFieldSinhc z = Complex.sinh z
  gQ_mul : ∀ z : ℂ,
    2 * z ^ 3 * secondFieldGNum z = 3 * (Complex.sinh z * Complex.cosh z - z)
  energy_first : ∀ lam J : ℂ,
    frozenEnergyE .firstField lam J = (J ^ 3 / 12) * firstFieldG (lam * J / 2)
  twist_first : ∀ lam J : ℂ,
    deriv (deriv (frozenActionP .firstField lam)) J =
      (J / 4) * firstFieldSinc (lam * J / 2)
  energy_second : ∀ lam J : ℂ, Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 →
    frozenEnergyE .secondField lam J =
      (J ^ 3 / (12 * Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ^ 2)) * secondFieldGNum (lam * J / 2)
  twist_second : ∀ lam J : ℂ, Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 →
    deriv (deriv (frozenActionP .secondField lam)) J =
      (J * secondFieldSinhc (lam * J / 2)) / (4 * Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ^ 3)
  local_J_inj : ∃ δ_E : ℝ, 0 < δ_E ∧
    ∀ (kind : ExpProfileKind) (lam J₁ J₂ : ℂ),
      ‖lam‖ < δ_E → ‖J₁ - 1‖ < δ_E → ‖J₂ - 1‖ < δ_E →
      frozenEnergyE kind lam J₁ = frozenEnergyE kind lam J₂ → J₁ = J₂

structure ModelDiskInput (kind : ExpProfileKind) where
  v_c : ℝ
  P : ℂ → ℂ
  M : ℂ → ℂ
  p_even : ℕ → ℝ
  v_c_pos : 0 < v_c
  p_zero : p_even 0 = 1
  p_one_pos : 0 < p_even 1
  p_nonneg : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ p_even m
  P_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ P (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) v_c)
  P_ne_zero : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) v_c, P v ≠ 0
  P_hasSum : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) v_c,
    HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (p_even m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) (P v)
  M_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ M (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) v_c)
  M_zero : M 0 = 0
  M_even : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) v_c, M (-v) = M v
  M_real : ∀ r : ℝ, |r| < v_c → (M (r : ℂ)).im = 0
  disk_energy_reg : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) v_c,
    let lam := 2 * v * Complex.exp (M v)
    let J := P v * (1 + v * deriv M v)
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  real_bridge :
    match kind with
    | .firstField =>
        v_c = Real.pi ∧
        ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi,
          ((Real.exp ((M (r : ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 = firstFieldG (r : ℂ) ∧
          (Real.sin r / r) * (P (r : ℂ)).re = Real.exp (2 * (M (r : ℂ)).re)
    | .secondField =>
        v_c = 1 ∧
        (∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, (P (r : ℂ)).re = Real.exp (2 * (M (r : ℂ)).re)) ∧
        (∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
          (((2 * Real.tanh z * Real.exp ((M (Real.tanh z : ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 3 =
            12 * ((Real.tanh z : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) / (Complex.cosh (z : ℂ)) ^ 2))

structure InnerDiskModelPackage (kind : ExpProfileKind) (I : ModelDiskInput kind) where
  R : ℝ
  r_uniq : ℝ
  Δ_ball : ℂ → ℂ
  w_real : ℝ → ℝ
  R_pos : 0 < R
  r_uniq_pos : 0 < r_uniq
  r_uniq_lt : r_uniq < R
  Δ_ball_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_ball (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R)
  Δ_ball_zero : Δ_ball 0 = 0
  Δ_ball_even : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, Δ_ball (-w) = Δ_ball w
  ball_regular_energy : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R,
    let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_ball w)
    let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_ball w
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  local_uniqueness : ∀ (w_coeff : ℂ) (D₁ : ℝ) (S_loc : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < D₁ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ S_loc { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im } →
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ D₂ : ℝ, D₁ < D₂ ∧ ∀ Y : ℂ, D₂ < -Y.im → ‖S_loc Y - Y‖ < ε) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im → ‖w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)‖ < r_uniq) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
      frozenEnergyE kind
        (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_loc Y))
        (deriv S_loc Y) = 1 / 12) →
    ∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
      S_loc Y = Y + Δ_ball (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y))
  w_real_cont : ContinuousOn w_real (Set.Ico 0 I.v_c)
  w_real_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto w_real (nhdsWithin I.v_c (Set.Iio I.v_c)) (nhds R)
  w_real_props : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) I.v_c,
    0 < w_real r ∧ w_real r < R ∧
    HasDerivAt w_real (w_real r / (r * (I.P (r : ℂ)).re)) r ∧
    Δ_ball (w_real r : ℂ) =
      Complex.I * Complex.log (((2 * r * Real.exp ((I.M (r : ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ) / (w_real r : ℂ))

def slitInDomain (R r_patch : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | w ∈ Metric.ball (R : ℂ) r_patch ∧ (R : ℂ) - w ∈ Complex.slitPlane }

def slitOutDomain (R r_patch : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | w ∈ Metric.ball (R : ℂ) r_patch ∧ w - (R : ℂ) ∈ Complex.slitPlane }

def LocalSlitChartProp (kind : ExpProfileKind) (R : ℝ) (Δ_ball : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r_patch ε_ov : ℝ) (Δ_slit_in Δ_slit_out : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < r_patch ∧ r_patch < R ∧ 0 < ε_ov ∧ ε_ov < r_patch ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_slit_in (slitInDomain R r_patch) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_slit_out (slitOutDomain R r_patch) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (R - ε_ov) R, Δ_slit_in (x : ℂ) = Δ_ball (x : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch,
      let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_slit_in w)
      let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_slit_in w
      frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_slit_out w)
      let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_slit_out w
      frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch ∩ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      0 < w.im → Δ_slit_out w = Δ_slit_in w) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch ∩ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      w.im < 0 → Δ_slit_out w ≠ Δ_slit_in w)

def IsDownwardVertConvex (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) : Prop :=
  IsOpen U ∧
  ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U → 0 ≤ y.im →
    ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im →
      ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ U

noncomputable def expBasePt {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I

noncomputable def rescaledLift {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (s_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (Y T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (s_fn (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y, T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) -
    expBasePt seq n) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ)

def SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    {kind : ExpProfileKind} (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (Y T : ℂ) : Prop :=
  let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let t : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
  let s_prev : ℂ := expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_fn (Y - a_n)
  let s_curr : ℂ := expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_fn Y
  let s_next : ℂ := expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_fn (Y + a_n)
  let J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
  let J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
  deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
    t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
    deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev

def IsRegularFrozenModel {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsOpen V_mod ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ S_star V_mod ∧
  ∀ p ∈ V_mod,
    let lam : ℂ := p.2 * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star p)
    let J : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', p.2)) p.1
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J

noncomputable def circleAvgCont (f₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (Φ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ)
    (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    ∫ ϕ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f₀ (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))

structure DiskContinuationToolkitProp : Prop where
  vertical_tube_uniqueness :
    ∀ (U₁ U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y₀ t₀ : ℂ) (δ₀ : ℝ),
      IsDownwardVertConvex U₁ →
      IsDownwardVertConvex U₂ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ U₁ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ U₂ →
      (y₀, t₀) ∈ U₁ ∩ U₂ →
      0 ≤ y₀.im →
      0 < δ₀ →
      (∀ y : ℂ, ‖y - (y₀.re : ℂ)‖ < δ₀ → f₁ (y, t₀) = f₂ (y, t₀)) →
      f₁ (y₀, t₀) = f₂ (y₀, t₀)
  binomial_dip_poly :
    ∀ (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ C_dip η_plus : ℝ),
      0 < C_dip → 0 < η_plus →
      ∃ (δ_ϕ : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < δ_ϕ ∧
        Differentiable ℂ g ∧
        g 0 = 0 ∧
        (∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 → ‖g ζ‖ ≤ 8 * C_dip ∧ (g ζ).im ≤ η_plus) ∧
        (∀ ϕ : ℝ,
          (∃ k : ℤ, |ϕ - ϕ₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ ∨
                    |ϕ - ϕ₂ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ) →
          (g (Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im ≤ -C_dip)
  circle_average_disk_continuation :
    ∀ (W U₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (Φ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
      IsOpen W →
      IsOpen U₀ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₀ U₀ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (W ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (3 / 2)) →
      (∀ p ∈ W, Φ (p, 0) = p) →
      (∀ p ∈ W, ∀ ϕ : ℝ, Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ∈ U₀) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (circleAvgCont f₀ Φ) W ∧
      (∀ p ∈ W, (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, Φ (p, ζ) ∈ U₀) →
        circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p = f₀ p) ∧
      (∀ (U_star : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen U_star →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f_star U_star →
        ∀ p ∈ W, (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, Φ (p, ζ) ∈ U_star) →
          ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
            (∀ ϕ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
              ‖f₀ (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) -
                f_star (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))‖ ≤ B) →
            ‖circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p - f_star p‖ ≤ B) ∧
      (∀ (X : ExpStripData), IsExpObstructionStrip X →
        (∀ q ∈ U₀, f₀ q ∈ X.D_strip) →
        ∀ p ∈ W, circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p ∈ X.D_strip)
  partial_derivs_holo_3d :
    ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ F U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun S' => F (S', q.2.1, q.2.2)) q.1) U ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => F (q.1, J', q.2.2)) q.2.1) U

structure RegularCorridorTrackingProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop where
  horizontal_chain_tracking :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (T₀ Y_plus : ℂ)
      (ε_plus L_max : ℝ) (S_init : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (N_base : ℕ) (N_step : ℕ → ℕ),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      T₀ ≠ 0 → 0 < ε_plus → 0 < L_max →
      Metric.closedBall Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) ×ˢ ({T₀} : Set ℂ) ⊆ V_mod →
      (∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall Y_plus ε_plus, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) L_max,
        (Z + (τ : ℂ) * T₀, T₀) ∈ V_mod) →
      (∀ n ≥ N_base, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_init n) (Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus))) →
      (∀ n ≥ N_base, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (2 * ε_plus),
        Z - T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) →
        Z + T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) →
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (S_init n) n Z T₀) →
      TendstoUniformlyOn S_init (fun Z => S_star (Z, T₀))
        Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall Y_plus (2 * ε_plus)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, (N_step n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max) →
      ∃ (N_tr : ℕ) (S_chain : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
        N_base ≤ N_tr ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ j ≤ N_step n,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_chain n j) (Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
          let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          S_chain n 0 Z = S_init n Z ∧ S_chain n 1 Z = S_init n (Z + a_n)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ j < N_step n, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
          let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          Z + a_n ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus →
          S_chain n (j + 1) Z = S_chain n j (Z + a_n)) ∧
        (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₁ ≥ N_tr, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ j ≤ N_step n,
          ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
            let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            ‖S_chain n j Z - S_star (Z + (j : ℂ) * a_n, T₀)‖ < ε)
  steep_vertical_passage :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (σ η T_max : ℝ) (U_T : Set ℂ) (x_lo x_hi y_bot y_top : ℝ)
      (K_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → 0 < η → 0 < T_max →
      IsOpen U_T →
      U_T ⊆ { T : ℂ | η < σ * T.im ∧ ‖T‖ < T_max } →
      x_lo < x_hi → y_bot < y_top →
      (let B_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
          y_bot < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < y_top ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T }
       let y_mid : ℝ := (y_bot + y_top) / 2
       let δ_y : ℝ := (y_top - y_bot) / 4
       B_init ⊆ V_mod →
       IsCompact K_steep →
       K_steep ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
         x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
         y_bot + δ_y ≤ p.1.im ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T } →
       (∀ p ∈ K_steep, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc y_mid (max y_mid p.1.im),
         let Y_vert : ℂ := (p.1.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
         let s_end : ℝ := (τ - y_mid) / (σ * p.2.im)
         (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s_end,
           (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ V_mod) ∧
         x_lo < (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2).re ∧
         (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2).re < x_hi) →
       ∃ W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
         IsOpen W_steep ∧
         K_steep ⊆ W_steep ∧
         W_steep ⊆ V_mod ∧
         W_steep ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
           x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
           y_bot + δ_y / 2 < p.1.im ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T } ∧
         (∀ Y T : ℂ, (Y, T) ∈ W_steep →
           ∀ τ : ℝ, y_bot + δ_y ≤ τ → τ ≤ Y.im →
             ((Y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, T) ∈ W_steep) ∧
         ∀ (N₀ : ℕ) (S_low : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
           (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_low n) B_init) →
           (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
             (Y, T) ∈ B_init →
             (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_init →
             (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_init →
             SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_low n (Z, T)) n Y T) →
           (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ B_init →
             TendstoUniformlyOn S_low S_star Filter.atTop K) →
           ∃ (N_st : ℕ) (S_ext : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
             N₀ ≤ N_st ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_ext n) W_steep) ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ p ∈ W_steep,
               expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_ext n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ p ∈ W_steep, p.1.im < y_top - δ_y →
               S_ext n p = S_low n p) ∧
             TendstoUniformlyOn S_ext S_star Filter.atTop K_steep)

structure RadialBypassPatchesData (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind) where
  ν' : ℝ
  ε_patch : ℝ
  N_patch : ℕ
  U_plus : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  U_minus : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  s_plus : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  s_minus : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  δ_zero : ℕ → ℝ
  ν'_pos : 0 < ν'
  ν'_lt : ν' < M.ν
  ε_patch_pos : 0 < ε_patch
  ε_patch_lt_ν : ε_patch < ν' / 12
  ε_patch_lt_δ : ε_patch < M.δ_θ / 12
  patch_props : ∀ n ≥ N_patch,
    let T_star : ℝ := (‖seq.c₀‖)⁻¹
    let α_c : ℝ := Complex.arg seq.c₀
    let t₀_n : ℝ := T_star / seq.m_seq n
    let x₀_plus_n : ℝ := seq.x_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * (α_c - M.θ)
    let x₀_minus_n : ℝ := seq.x_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * (α_c + M.θ)
    let b_plus_n : ℝ := seq.h_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * (Real.log M.R + 3 * ν' / 4)
    let Y_plus : ℂ :=
      ((α_c - M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let Y_minus : ℂ :=
      ((α_c + M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    IsDownwardVertConvex (U_plus n) ∧
    IsDownwardVertConvex (U_minus n) ∧
    0 < δ_zero n ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_plus n) (U_plus n) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ U_plus n, s_plus n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_minus n) (U_minus n) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ U_minus n, s_minus n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - (x₀_plus_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n → ‖t - (t₀_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n →
      (y, t) ∈ U_plus n ∧ s_plus n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - (x₀_minus_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n → ‖t - (t₀_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n →
      (y, t) ∈ U_minus n ∧ s_minus n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ b_plus_n →
      ((x₀_plus_n : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ U_plus n) ∧
    (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_patch),
      (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ U_plus n) ∧
    (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_minus (3 * ε_patch),
      (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ U_minus n) ∧
    (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (2 * ε_patch),
      Z - (T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
        Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_patch) →
      Z + (T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
        Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_patch) →
      SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq
        (fun W => rescaledLift seq (s_plus n) n W (T_star : ℂ)) n Z (T_star : ℂ))
  conv_plus :
    let T_star : ℝ := (‖seq.c₀‖)⁻¹
    let α_c : ℝ := Complex.arg seq.c₀
    let Y_plus : ℂ :=
      ((α_c - M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z => rescaledLift seq (s_plus n) n Z (T_star : ℂ))
      (fun Z => Z + M.Δ_inner ((T_star : ℂ) * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)))
      Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall Y_plus (2 * ε_patch))
  conv_minus :
    let T_star : ℝ := (‖seq.c₀‖)⁻¹
    let α_c : ℝ := Complex.arg seq.c₀
    let Y_minus : ℂ :=
      ((α_c + M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z => rescaledLift seq (s_minus n) n Z (T_star : ℂ))
      (fun Z => Z + M.Δ_inner ((T_star : ℂ) * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)))
      Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall Y_minus (2 * ε_patch))

structure paJetHoloAtZero (H : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop where
  out : ∃ U : Set ℂ, IsOpen U ∧ (0 : ℂ) ∈ U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ H U

def paJetPsEqUpTo (l : ℕ) (P Q : PowerSeries ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n ≤ l, PowerSeries.coeff n P = PowerSeries.coeff n Q

structure paJetPsHoloOn (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (P : (ℂ × ℂ) → PowerSeries ℂ) : Prop where
  out : ∀ m : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff m (P q)) V

def paJetVanish2D1D (k : ℕ) (W : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m : ℕ), d 0 + d 1 + m < k →
    PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d W) = 0

noncomputable def paJetT2D1D (p₁ : ℂ × ℂ) (P : (ℂ × ℂ) → PowerSeries ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  pointArcPack2D1D (fun m => taylor2D (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff m (P q)) p₁)

noncomputable def pointArcPolyShift {J : ℕ} (c : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.C (c l) * PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ)

noncomputable def pointArcPolyComp (φ Z : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m =>
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      PowerSeries.coeff n φ * PowerSeries.coeff m (Z ^ n)

noncomputable def pointArcPolyGraph {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  pointArcPolyComp (pointArcHoloTaylor1D F (x₀ r)) (pointArcPolyShift (fun l => β l r)) +
    ∑ l : Fin (J + 1),
      PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
        pointArcPolyComp (pointArcHoloTaylor1D (g r l) (x₀ r))
          (pointArcPolyShift (fun q => β q r))

noncomputable def pointArcPolyGraphDeriv {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  pointArcPolyComp (pointArcHoloTaylor1D (deriv F) (x₀ r)) (pointArcPolyShift (fun l => β l r)) +
    ∑ l : Fin (J + 1),
      PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
        pointArcPolyComp (pointArcHoloTaylor1D (deriv (g r l)) (x₀ r))
          (pointArcPolyShift (fun q => β q r))

noncomputable def pointArcPolyDx {k J : ℕ} (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.C (x₀ i.succ - x₀ i.castSucc) +
    (pointArcPolyShift (fun l => β l i.succ) - pointArcPolyShift (fun l => β l i.castSucc))

noncomputable def pointArcPolyDy {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  pointArcPolyGraph F g x₀ β i.succ - pointArcPolyGraph F g x₀ β i.castSucc

noncomputable def pointArcPolyEdgeSq {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  (pointArcPolyDx x₀ β i) ^ 2 + (pointArcPolyDy F g x₀ β i) ^ 2

noncomputable def pointArcPolyEdgeRel {k J : ℕ} (ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  (pointArcPolyEdgeSq F g x₀ β i - PowerSeries.C ((ℓ₀ i) ^ 2)) *
    PowerSeries.C (((ℓ₀ i) ^ 2)⁻¹)

noncomputable def pointArcPolyLen {k J : ℕ} (ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    PowerSeries.C (ℓ₀ i) *
      pointArcPolyComp pointArcPsSqrt1p (pointArcPolyEdgeRel ℓ₀ F g x₀ β i)

noncomputable def pointArcPolyInvEdgeLen {k J : ℕ} (ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.C ((ℓ₀ i)⁻¹) *
    pointArcPolyComp pointArcPsInvSqrt1p (pointArcPolyEdgeRel ℓ₀ F g x₀ β i)

noncomputable def pointArcPolyGrad {k J : ℕ} (ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (r : Fin (k - 1)) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  (pointArcPolyDx x₀ β i_L +
      pointArcPolyDy F g x₀ β i_L * pointArcPolyGraphDeriv F g x₀ β i_L.succ) *
      pointArcPolyInvEdgeLen ℓ₀ F g x₀ β i_L -
    (pointArcPolyDx x₀ β i_R +
      pointArcPolyDy F g x₀ β i_R * pointArcPolyGraphDeriv F g x₀ β i_R.castSucc) *
      pointArcPolyInvEdgeLen ℓ₀ F g x₀ β i_R

noncomputable def volterraIter (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (init : ℝ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ
  | 0, w => init w
  | m + 1, w => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * volterraIter Q init m v

noncomputable def c0Kernel (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, volterraIter Q (fun _ => 1) m w

noncomputable def c0Deriv (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * c0Kernel Q v

noncomputable def k0Kernel (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, volterraIter Q (fun v => (v : ℂ)) m w

noncomputable def k0Deriv (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  1 + ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * k0Kernel Q v

noncomputable def pertPotential (sgn : ℂ) (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  let Fw := a₀ * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w
  let Fpw := a₀ * c0Deriv Q w + a₁ * k0Deriv Q w
  Q w - sgn * (3 * Complex.I / 2) * Fpw - (1 / 4 : ℂ) * Fw ^ 2

noncomputable def kPlusVal (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  k0Kernel (pertPotential 1 Q a₀ a₁) 1

noncomputable def kMinusVal (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  k0Kernel (pertPotential (-1) Q a₀ a₁) 1

noncomputable def canonRoot (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let kp := kPlusVal Q a₀ a₁
  let km := kMinusVal Q a₀ a₁
  ((kp + km) / 2) *
    Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (4 * kp * km / (kp + km) ^ 2))

noncomputable def slNumerator (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w₀ w₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  k0Kernel Q 1 - canonRoot Q w₀ ((w₁ - w₀ * c0Kernel Q 1) / k0Kernel Q 1)

noncomputable def slDivided (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let b₀ := a₀
  let b₁ := a₀ * c0Kernel Q 1 + a₁ * k0Kernel Q 1
  if b₀ ≠ 0 ∧ b₁ ≠ 0 then
    (k0Kernel Q 1 - canonRoot Q a₀ a₁) / (b₀ * b₁)
  else
    (1 / 2 : ℂ) * dslope (fun w₀ => dslope (fun w₁ => slNumerator Q w₀ w₁) 0 b₁) 0 b₀ +
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * dslope (fun w₁ => dslope (fun w₀ => slNumerator Q w₀ w₁) 0 b₀) 0 b₁

noncomputable def stripPotential (X : ExpStripData) (s h : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  h ^ 2 * X.q (s + (w : ℂ) * h)

noncomputable def chordPhi (X : ExpStripData) (s h : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if h = 0 then (1 / 24 : ℂ)
  else @ite _ (s ∈ X.D_strip ∧ s + h ∈ X.D_strip ∧ k0Kernel (stripPotential X s h) 1 ≠ 0)
    (Classical.propDecidable _)
    (slDivided (stripPotential X s h) (h * X.f s) (h ^ 2 * deriv X.f s))
    (1 / 24 : ℂ)

noncomputable def chordActionP (X : ExpStripData) (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  J ^ 3 * chordPhi X s (t * J)

def VolterraDivisionProp : Prop :=
  (∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    c0Kernel Q 0 = 1 ∧
    c0Deriv Q 0 = 0 ∧
    k0Kernel Q 0 = 0 ∧
    k0Deriv Q 0 = 1 ∧
    ContinuousOn (c0Kernel Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ContinuousOn (c0Deriv Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ContinuousOn (k0Kernel Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ContinuousOn (k0Deriv Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivWithinAt (c0Kernel Q) (c0Deriv Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt (c0Deriv Q) (Q w * c0Kernel Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt (k0Kernel Q) (k0Deriv Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt (k0Deriv Q) (Q w * k0Kernel Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w) ∧
    (∀ y y' : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn y (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn y' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivWithinAt y (y' w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
        HasDerivWithinAt y' (Q w * y w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w) →
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        y w = y 0 * c0Kernel Q w + y' 0 * k0Kernel Q w ∧
        y' w = y 0 * c0Deriv Q w + y' 0 * k0Deriv Q w) ∧
    (∀ g g' : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn g' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        g w ≠ 0 ∧
        HasDerivWithinAt g (g' w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
        HasDerivWithinAt g' (Q w * g w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w) →
      k0Kernel Q 1 = g 0 * g 1 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w)⁻¹ ^ 2)) ∧
  ((∀ (M Δ : ℝ) (Q₁ Q₂ : ℝ → ℂ),
      0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ Δ →
      ContinuousOn Q₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn Q₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₁ w‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖Q₂ w‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ ≤ Δ) →
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖c0Kernel Q₁ w‖ ≤ Real.exp M ∧
        ‖k0Kernel Q₁ w‖ ≤ Real.exp M ∧
        ‖c0Deriv Q₁ w‖ ≤ M * Real.exp M ∧
        ‖k0Deriv Q₁ w‖ ≤ 1 + M * Real.exp M ∧
        ‖c0Kernel Q₁ w - c0Kernel Q₂ w‖ ≤ Real.exp M * Δ ∧
        ‖k0Kernel Q₁ w - k0Kernel Q₂ w‖ ≤ Real.exp M * Δ ∧
        ‖c0Deriv Q₁ w - c0Deriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ (1 + M) * Real.exp M * Δ ∧
        ‖k0Deriv Q₁ w - k0Deriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ (1 + M) * Real.exp M * Δ) ∧
    (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U →
      ContinuousOn (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => Q q.1 q.2) (U ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => Q p w) U) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ a₀ U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ a₁ U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c0Kernel (Q p) 1) U ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => k0Kernel (Q p) 1) U ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => kPlusVal (Q p) (a₀ p) (a₁ p)) U ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => kMinusVal (Q p) (a₀ p) (a₁ p)) U)) ∧
  ((∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      k0Kernel (fun w => Q (1 - w)) 1 = k0Kernel Q 1 ∧
      kPlusVal Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = kMinusVal Q a₀ a₁ ∧
      kMinusVal Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = kPlusVal Q a₀ a₁ ∧
      canonRoot Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = canonRoot Q a₀ a₁ ∧
      ∀ w₀ w₁ : ℂ, slNumerator Q (-w₀) (-w₁) = slNumerator Q w₀ w₁) ∧
    (∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      k0Kernel Q 1 ≠ 0 →
      let b₁ := a₀ * c0Kernel Q 1 + a₁ * k0Kernel Q 1
      let b₁' := a₀ * c0Deriv Q 1 + a₁ * k0Deriv Q 1
      slDivided (fun w => Q (1 - w)) (-b₁) b₁' = slDivided Q a₀ a₁) ∧
    slDivided (fun _ => 0) 0 0 = (1 / 24 : ℂ)) ∧
  (∀ Q₀ : ℝ → ℂ,
    ContinuousOn Q₀ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    k0Kernel Q₀ 1 ≠ 0 →
    ∃ δ_Q r_b M_num : ℝ,
      0 < δ_Q ∧ 0 < r_b ∧ 0 < M_num ∧
      (∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ,
        ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q) →
        k0Kernel Q 1 ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ w₀ w₁ : ℂ, ‖w₀‖ ≤ r_b → ‖w₁‖ ≤ r_b →
          ‖slNumerator Q w₀ w₁‖ ≤ M_num ∧
          slNumerator Q 0 w₁ = 0 ∧
          slNumerator Q w₀ 0 = 0) ∧
        (∀ a₀ a₁ : ℂ,
          let b₀ := a₀
          let b₁ := a₀ * c0Kernel Q 1 + a₁ * k0Kernel Q 1
          ‖b₀‖ < r_b / 2 → ‖b₁‖ < r_b / 2 →
          slDivided Q a₀ a₁ =
            (((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
              ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                  slNumerator Q
                    ((r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
                    ((r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) /
                  (((r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - b₀) *
                    ((r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - b₁)))) ∧
      (∀ (Q₁ Q₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (Δ : ℝ),
        0 ≤ Δ →
        ContinuousOn Q₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        ContinuousOn Q₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖Q₁ w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q ∧ ‖Q₂ w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q ∧ ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ ≤ Δ) →
        ∀ w₀ w₁ : ℂ, ‖w₀‖ ≤ r_b → ‖w₁‖ ≤ r_b →
          ‖slNumerator Q₁ w₀ w₁ - slNumerator Q₂ w₀ w₁‖ ≤ M_num * Δ) ∧
      (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen U →
        ContinuousOn (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => Q q.1 q.2) (U ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => Q p w) U) →
        (∀ p ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q p w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ a₀ U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ a₁ U →
        (∀ p ∈ U,
          ‖a₀ p‖ < r_b / 2 ∧
          ‖a₀ p * c0Kernel (Q p) 1 + a₁ p * k0Kernel (Q p) 1‖ < r_b / 2) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => slDivided (Q p) (a₀ p) (a₁ p)) U))

noncomputable def qdDiskMap (d x₀ σ : ℝ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  ((x₀ : ℂ) + (σ : ℂ) * Complex.I - ((d : ℂ) * Complex.I / 4) * q.2 ^ 2 + q.1,
   (d : ℂ) * q.2)

noncomputable def qdDiskInv (d x₀ σ : ℝ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (σ : ℂ) * Complex.I) + (Complex.I / (4 * (d : ℂ))) * p.2 ^ 2,
   p.2 / (d : ℂ))

def qdFullDisk (d : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d / 50) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (51 / 50)

def qdAnnulus (d : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d / 50) ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | 49 / 50 < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < 51 / 50 }

def qdAnnulusUp (d : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ | q ∈ qdAnnulus d ∧ -‖q.2‖ / 20 < q.2.im }

def qdAnnulusLo (d : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ | q ∈ qdAnnulus d ∧ q.2.im < ‖q.2‖ / 20 }

noncomputable def qdStepShift (d : ℝ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (q.1 + ((d / 100 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, q.2)

noncomputable def qdStepShiftInv (d : ℝ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (q.1 - ((d / 100 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, q.2)

noncomputable def qdCollarShiftMap (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (p.1 - b_shift p.2, p.2)

noncomputable def qdCollarUnshiftMap (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (p.1 + b_shift p.2, p.2)

noncomputable def qdWallPatchToQuad (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (d x₀ H : ℝ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  qdDiskInv d x₀ H (qdCollarUnshiftMap b_shift p)

def qdBridgeDisk (d : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.ball (-((d / 200 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (d / 125)

def qdLowerHalfDisk (d ε : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | ‖w‖ < (9 / 500 : ℝ) * d ∧ w.im < -ε / 8 }

def qdWallPatchBidisk (x₀ H ε : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
    ‖p.2 - ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ < ε }

def qdWallPatchOverlap (x₀ H ε δ : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
    |p.1.im - (H - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
    ‖p.2 - ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ < δ }

def QdHasContTwoSidedInvOn (Φ Φ_inv : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) : Prop :=
  IsOpen U ∧ IsOpen W ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ U ∧ Set.MapsTo Φ U W ∧
  ContinuousOn Φ_inv W ∧ (∀ p ∈ U, Φ_inv (Φ p) = p) ∧ (∀ q ∈ W, Φ (Φ_inv q) = q)

structure QdMero2DPullbackGluingToolkit : Prop where

      {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₁ U

      {F₃ : MeroOn2D W₃} {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₃ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₃ U

  glue_two : ∀ {U₁ U₂ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
