    ∀ (G₁ : MeroOn2D U₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D U₂),
      MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ (U₁ ∩ U₂) →
      ∃ G : MeroOn2D U, MeroEqOn G G₁ U₁ ∧ MeroEqOn G G₂ U₂
  exists_pullback : ∀ {U W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {Φ Φ_inv : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ},
    QdHasContTwoSidedInvOn Φ Φ_inv U W →
    ∀ F : MeroOn2D W, ∃ G : MeroOn2D U, MeroEqOnPullback G F Φ U
  pullback_id_self : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W),
    MeroEqOnPullback F F id W
  pullback_congr : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁}
      {G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {F : MeroOn2D W₃} {Φ Φ' : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ},
    IsOpen V → V ⊆ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ' V → (∀ q ∈ V, Φ' q = Φ q) →
    MeroEqOn G₂ G₁ V → MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F Φ U →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F Φ' V
  pullback_comp : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ U₁ U₂ V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁}
      {G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {G₃ : MeroOn2D W₃} {Φ₁ Φ₁_inv Φ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ},
    QdHasContTwoSidedInvOn Φ₁ Φ₁_inv U₁ W₂ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ₂ U₂ →
    IsOpen V → V ⊆ U₁ → Set.MapsTo Φ₁ V U₂ →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₁ G₂ Φ₁ U₁ → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ G₃ Φ₂ U₂ →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₁ G₃ (Φ₂ ∘ Φ₁) V
  pullback_meroEqOn : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ W₄ U₁ U₂ V O : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      {G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₃} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₄}
      {Φ₁ Φ₁_inv Φ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ},
    IsOpen V → V ⊆ U₁ ∩ U₂ →
    QdHasContTwoSidedInvOn Φ₁ Φ₁_inv V W₃ →
    (∀ q ∈ V, Φ₂ q = Φ₁ q) →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F₁ Φ₁ U₁ → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F₂ Φ₂ U₂ →
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ O → Set.MapsTo Φ₁ V O →
    MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ V
  pullback_of_isPreconnected : ∀ {W₁ W₂ U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {Φ Φ_inv : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ},
    IsPreconnected U → U ⊆ W₁ →
    QdHasContTwoSidedInvOn Φ Φ_inv U W₂ →
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ U →
    MeroEqOnPullback F₁ F₂ Φ V → MeroEqOnPullback F₁ F₂ Φ U

def PointRecPsSqrtLawsProp : Prop :=
  PowerSeries.constantCoeff pointArcPsSqrt1p = 1 ∧
  PowerSeries.constantCoeff pointArcPsInvSqrt1p = 1 ∧
  pointArcPsSqrt1p ^ 2 = 1 + PowerSeries.X ∧
  pointArcPsSqrt1p * pointArcPsInvSqrt1p = 1

structure PointRecSqrtSplitToolkit : Prop where
  psSqrt1p_deriv :
    PowerSeries.derivative pointArcPsSqrt1p =
      PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * pointArcPsInvSqrt1p ∧
    PowerSeries.derivative pointArcPsInvSqrt1p =
      PowerSeries.C (-1 / 2 : ℂ) * pointArcPsInvSqrt1p ^ 3
  unit_sqrt_2D1D :
    ∀ (ℓ_star : ℂ) (Q L L_inv : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)),
      ℓ_star ≠ 0 →
      L ^ 2 = Q →
      L_inv * L = 1 →
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff (MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 L) = ℓ_star →
      let U := (Q - MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (ℓ_star ^ 2))) *
        MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star ^ 2)⁻¹))
      PowerSeries.coeff 0 (MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U) = 0 ∧
      L = MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ℓ_star) *
        pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsSqrt1p U ∧
      L_inv = MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ℓ_star⁻¹) *
        pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsInvSqrt1p U
  unit_sqrt_2D :
    ∀ (ℓ_star : ℂ) (Q₀ L₀ L₀_inv : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      ℓ_star ≠ 0 →
      L₀ ^ 2 = Q₀ →
      L₀_inv * L₀ = 1 →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 L₀ = ℓ_star →
      let U₀ := (Q₀ - MvPowerSeries.C (ℓ_star ^ 2)) * MvPowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star ^ 2)⁻¹)
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₀ = 0 ∧
      L₀ = MvPowerSeries.C ℓ_star * compPowerSeries2D pointArcPsSqrt1p U₀ ∧
      L₀_inv = MvPowerSeries.C ℓ_star⁻¹ * compPowerSeries2D pointArcPsInvSqrt1p U₀
  ab_split_unique :
    ∀ (U V : PowerSeries ℂ),
      PowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 →
      compPowerSeries2D U (MvPowerSeries.X 0) +
        compPowerSeries2D V (MvPowerSeries.X 0 + MvPowerSeries.X 1) = 0 →
      U = 0 ∧ V = 0

open Classical in
noncomputable def pointRecLiftArcFn (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    PowerSeries ℂ :=
  if hz : z ∈ F then Φ ⟨z, hz⟩ else PowerSeries.C z

noncomputable def pointRecLiftMv2D (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d => pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ)

noncomputable def pointRecJetSeq (A : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) (Δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (l : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk (fun n =>
    PowerSeries.coeff l
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (l + 1),
        PowerSeries.C (1 / ((n.factorial : ℂ) * (m.factorial : ℂ))) * A (n + m) * (-Δ) ^ m))

noncomputable def pointRecFormalU (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ)
    (S_ab : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (l : ℕ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  if l = 0 then 0
  else PowerSeries.mk (fun n =>
    if n = 0 then 0
    else PowerSeries.coeff l (pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 n) S_ab)))

noncomputable def pointRecFormalV (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ)
    (S_ab : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (l : ℕ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  if l = 0 then 0
  else PowerSeries.mk (fun n =>
    PowerSeries.coeff l (pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single 1 n) S_ab)))

structure PointRecFormalLiftToolkit : Prop where
  jetSeq_zero :
    ∀ (A : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) (Δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (n : ℕ),
      PowerSeries.coeff n (pointRecJetSeq A Δ 0) =
        PowerSeries.constantCoeff (A n) / (n.factorial : ℂ)
  jetSeq_deriv :
    ∀ (A : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) (Δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (l : ℕ),
      PowerSeries.derivative (pointRecJetSeq A Δ l) =
        pointRecJetSeq (fun m => A (m + 1)) Δ l
  jetSeq_eq_C_of_zero_shift :
    ∀ (A : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ),
      (∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → pointRecJetSeq A 0 l = 0) →
      ∀ m : ℕ, A m = PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (A m))
  liftArcFn_props :
    ∀ (K F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (hKF : K ≤ F),
      (∀ (x : ℂ) (hx : x ∈ K), Φ ⟨x, hKF hx⟩ = PowerSeries.C x) →
      (∀ y : ↥F, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (Φ y) = (y : ℂ)) →
      (∀ z : ℂ, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ z) = z) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ x = PowerSeries.C x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F,
        pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ (x + y) =
          pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ x + pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ y ∧
        pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ (x - y) =
          pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ x - pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ y ∧
        pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ (x * y) =
          pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ x * pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ y) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ F, z ≠ 0 →
        (pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ z) ^ 2 = (PowerSeries.C z) ^ 2 →
        pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ z = PowerSeries.C z)
  liftMv2D_ring :
    ∀ (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ),
      (∀ c : ℂ,
        pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ (MvPowerSeries.C c) =
          MvPowerSeries.C (pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ c)) ∧
      (∀ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
        (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₁ ∈ F) →
        (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₂ ∈ F) →
        pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ₁ + Ψ₂) =
          pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ + pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂ ∧
        pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ₁ - Ψ₂) =
          pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ - pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂ ∧
        pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ₁ * Ψ₂) =
          pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ * pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂)
  liftMv2D_comp_recenter :
    ∀ (K F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (hKF : K ≤ F),
      (∀ (x : ℂ) (hx : x ∈ K), Φ ⟨x, hKF hx⟩ = PowerSeries.C x) →
      ∀ (H_star : ℕ → ℂ) (Δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        (∀ m, H_star m ∈ F) →
        PowerSeries.constantCoeff Δ = 0 →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
        (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ ∈ F) →
        pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ
            (compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.mk (fun n => H_star n / (n.factorial : ℂ))) Ψ) =
          pointArcComp2D1D
            (pointRecJetSeq (fun m => pointRecLiftArcFn F Φ (H_star m)) Δ)
            (MvPowerSeries.C Δ + pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ)
  liftMv2D_comp2D_ab_split :
    ∀ (K F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (hKF : K ≤ F),
      (∀ (x : ℂ) (hx : x ∈ K), Φ ⟨x, hKF hx⟩ = PowerSeries.C x) →
      ∀ (S_ab : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d S_ab ∈ F) →
        (∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, 1 ≤ d 0 → 1 ≤ d 1 → MvPowerSeries.coeff d S_ab ∈ K) →
        ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l →
          PowerSeries.coeff 0 (pointRecFormalU F Φ S_ab l) = 0 ∧
          pointArcSlice2D1D l
              (pointRecLiftMv2D F Φ
                (pointArcComp2D S_ab (MvPowerSeries.X 0)
                  (MvPowerSeries.X 0 + MvPowerSeries.X 1))) =
            compPowerSeries2D (pointRecFormalU F Φ S_ab l) (MvPowerSeries.X 0) +
              compPowerSeries2D (pointRecFormalV F Φ S_ab l)
                (MvPowerSeries.X 0 + MvPowerSeries.X 1)

noncomputable def pointRecDx0 {k : ℕ} (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (x_star i.succ - x_star i.castSucc) + (β₀ i.succ - β₀ i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pointRecDy0 {k : ℕ} (f₀ : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  compPowerSeries2D (f₀ i.succ) (β₀ i.succ) - compPowerSeries2D (f₀ i.castSucc) (β₀ i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pointRecEdgeSq0 {k : ℕ} (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f₀ : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  (pointRecDx0 x_star β₀ i) ^ 2 + (pointRecDy0 f₀ β₀ i) ^ 2

noncomputable def pointRecEdgeRel0 {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ) (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f₀ : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  (pointRecEdgeSq0 x_star f₀ β₀ i - MvPowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star i) ^ 2)) *
    MvPowerSeries.C (((ℓ_star i) ^ 2)⁻¹)

noncomputable def pointRecLen0 {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ) (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f₀ : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (ℓ_star i) *
    compPowerSeries2D pointArcPsSqrt1p (pointRecEdgeRel0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i)

noncomputable def pointRecInvLen0 {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ) (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f₀ : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star i)⁻¹) *
    compPowerSeries2D pointArcPsInvSqrt1p (pointRecEdgeRel0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i)

noncomputable def pointRecWeight0 {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ) (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f₀ : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  pointRecDy0 f₀ β₀ i_L * pointRecInvLen0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i_L -
    pointRecDy0 f₀ β₀ i_R * pointRecInvLen0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i_R

noncomputable def pointRecGrad0 {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ) (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f₀ : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  (pointRecDx0 x_star β₀ i_L +
      pointRecDy0 f₀ β₀ i_L *
        compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_L.succ)) (β₀ i_L.succ)) *
      pointRecInvLen0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i_L -
    (pointRecDx0 x_star β₀ i_R +
      pointRecDy0 f₀ β₀ i_R *
        compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_R.castSucc)) (β₀ i_R.castSucc)) *
      pointRecInvLen0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i_R

noncomputable def pointRecHess0 {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ) (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f₀ : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r s : Fin (k - 1)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let Δx_L := pointRecDx0 x_star β₀ i_L
  let ΔY_L := pointRecDy0 f₀ β₀ i_L
  let L_L := pointRecLen0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i_L
  let invL_L := pointRecInvLen0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i_L
  let F'_L_succ := compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_L.succ)) (β₀ i_L.succ)
  let F'_L_cast := compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_L.castSucc)) (β₀ i_L.castSucc)
  let F''_L_succ :=
    compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_L.succ))) (β₀ i_L.succ)
  let n_L_succ := Δx_L + ΔY_L * F'_L_succ
  let n_L_cast := Δx_L + ΔY_L * F'_L_cast
  let Δx_R := pointRecDx0 x_star β₀ i_R
  let ΔY_R := pointRecDy0 f₀ β₀ i_R
  let L_R := pointRecLen0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i_R
  let invL_R := pointRecInvLen0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i_R
  let F'_R_cast := compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_R.castSucc)) (β₀ i_R.castSucc)
  let F'_R_succ := compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_R.succ)) (β₀ i_R.succ)
  let F''_R_cast :=
    compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_R.castSucc)))
      (β₀ i_R.castSucc)
  let n_R_cast := Δx_R + ΔY_R * F'_R_cast
  let n_R_succ := Δx_R + ΔY_R * F'_R_succ
  if r.1 = s.1 then
    (((1 + F'_L_succ ^ 2 + ΔY_L * F''_L_succ) * L_L ^ 2 - n_L_succ ^ 2) * invL_L ^ 3) +
      (((1 + F'_R_cast ^ 2 - ΔY_R * F''_R_cast) * L_R ^ 2 - n_R_cast ^ 2) * invL_R ^ 3)
  else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
    ((-1 - F'_R_succ * F'_R_cast) * L_R ^ 2 + n_R_cast * n_R_succ) * invL_R ^ 3
  else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
    ((-1 - F'_L_cast * F'_L_succ) * L_L ^ 2 + n_L_succ * n_L_cast) * invL_L ^ 3
  else
    0

structure PointRecTopSplitToolkit : Prop where
  len_top_split :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (_hk : 2 ≤ k) (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ) (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
      (f_full : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
      (β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      (∀ i : Fin k, ℓ_star i ≠ 0) →
      (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (β_full 0 r) = 0) →
      (∀ i : Fin k,
        (ℓ_star i) ^ 2 =
          (x_star i.succ - x_star i.castSucc) ^ 2 +
            (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (f_full i.succ 0) -
              PowerSeries.constantCoeff (f_full i.castSucc 0)) ^ 2) →
      (∀ J : ℕ, f_full 0 (J + 1) = 0 ∧ f_full (Fin.last k) (J + 1) = 0) →
      (∀ J : ℕ, β_full (J + 1) 0 = 0 ∧ β_full (J + 1) (Fin.last k) = 0) →
      ∀ J : ℕ,
        pointArcSlice2D1D (J + 1) (pointArcFormalLen2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_full β_full) =
          pointArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
              (pointArcFormalLen2D1D ℓ_star x_star
                (pointArcTruncGraph J f_full) (pointArcTruncBeta J β_full)) +
            (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
              pointRecWeight0 ℓ_star x_star (fun u => f_full u 0) (β_full 0) r *
                compPowerSeries2D
                  (f_full ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ (J + 1))
                  (β_full 0 ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)) +
            ∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
              pointRecGrad0 ℓ_star x_star (fun u => f_full u 0) (β_full 0) r *
                β_full (J + 1) ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  grad_top_split :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (_hk : 2 ≤ k) (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ) (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
      (f_full : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
      (β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      (∀ i : Fin k, ℓ_star i ≠ 0) →
      (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (β_full 0 r) = 0) →
      (∀ i : Fin k,
        (ℓ_star i) ^ 2 =
          (x_star i.succ - x_star i.castSucc) ^ 2 +
            (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (f_full i.succ 0) -
              PowerSeries.constantCoeff (f_full i.castSucc 0)) ^ 2) →
      (∀ J : ℕ, β_full (J + 1) 0 = 0 ∧ β_full (J + 1) (Fin.last k) = 0) →
      ∀ (J : ℕ) (r : Fin (k - 1)),
        pointArcSlice2D1D (J + 1) (pointArcFormalGrad2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_full β_full r) =
          pointArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
              (pointArcFormalGrad2D1D ℓ_star x_star
                (pointArcTruncGraph (J + 1) f_full) (pointArcTruncBeta J β_full) r) +
            ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
              pointRecHess0 ℓ_star x_star (fun u => f_full u 0) (β_full 0) r s *
                β_full (J + 1) ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
  slice_pos_zero_of_pos_zero :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ) (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
      (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
      (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
      (m : ℕ),
      1 ≤ m →
      (∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : ℕ), 1 ≤ l → f_seq r l = 0) →
      (∀ (l : ℕ) (r : Fin (k + 1)), 1 ≤ l → β_seq l r = 0) →
      pointArcSlice2D1D m (pointArcFormalLen2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq) = 0 ∧
      ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
        pointArcSlice2D1D m (pointArcFormalGrad2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq r) = 0

structure DfmcFrozenKernelData (kind : ExpProfileKind) where
  tildePhi : ℂ → ℂ
  G_ker : ℂ → ℂ
  r_reg : ℝ
  r_reg_pos : 0 < r_reg
  r_reg_le_one : r_reg ≤ 1
  tildePhi_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ tildePhi (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1)
  G_ker_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_ker (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1)
  tildePhi_even : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, tildePhi (-u) = tildePhi u
  G_ker_even : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, G_ker (-u) = G_ker u
  tildePhi_zero : tildePhi 0 = 1 / 24
  G_ker_zero : G_ker 0 = 1
  action_eq : ∀ lam J : ℂ, frozenActionP kind lam J = J ^ 3 * tildePhi (lam * J / 2)
  energy_eq : ∀ lam J : ℂ, ‖lam * J / 2‖ < 1 →
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = (J ^ 3 / 12) * G_ker (lam * J / 2)
  regular_of_small : ∀ lam J : ℂ, J ≠ 0 → ‖lam * J / 2‖ < r_reg →
    IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  frozen_action_holo_2d : ∀ (c₀ T : ℂ),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q : ℂ × ℂ =>
        frozenActionP kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1)) q.2)
      { q : ℂ × ℂ | ‖T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1) * q.2 / 2‖ < 1 }
  legendre_deriv_zero : ∀ (V : Set ℂ) (S_star : ℂ → ℂ) (c₀ T : ℂ),
    IsOpen V →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ S_star V →
    (∀ Y ∈ V, ‖T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y) * deriv S_star Y / 2‖ < 1) →
    (∀ Y ∈ V,
      deriv (fun Y' =>
        deriv (fun J' =>
          frozenActionP kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y')) J')
          (deriv S_star Y')) Y =
      deriv (fun S' =>
        frozenActionP kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S')) (deriv S_star Y))
        (S_star Y)) →
    ∀ Y ∈ V,
      deriv (fun Y' =>
        frozenEnergyE kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y'))
          (deriv S_star Y')) Y = 0

structure DfmcAnalyticModelPackage (kind : ExpProfileKind) where
  ρ_mod : ℝ
  r_lam : ℝ
  ρ_J : ℝ
  C_Δ : ℝ
  Δ₀ : ℂ → ℂ
  ρ_mod_pos : 0 < ρ_mod
  r_lam_pos : 0 < r_lam
  ρ_J_pos : 0 < ρ_J
  ρ_J_lt : ρ_J < 1 / 4
  C_Δ_pos : 0 < C_Δ
  Δ₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ₀ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod)
  Δ₀_zero : Δ₀ 0 = 0
  Δ₀_even : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod, Δ₀ (-w) = Δ₀ w
  Δ₀_bound : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod, ‖Δ₀ w‖ ≤ C_Δ * ‖w‖ ^ 2
  model_energy : ∀ (w_coeff Y : ℂ),
    ‖w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)‖ < ρ_mod →
    frozenEnergyE kind
      (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I *
        (Y + Δ₀ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)))))
      (deriv (fun Y' => Y' + Δ₀ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y'))) Y) = 1 / 12
  regular_on_polydisk : ∀ lam J : ℂ, ‖lam‖ < r_lam → ‖J - 1‖ < ρ_J →
    ‖lam * J / 2‖ < 1 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  cone_ode_uniqueness : ∀ (w_coeff : ℂ) (D₁ A₁ : ℝ) (S_star : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < D₁ → 0 < A₁ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ S_star { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < A₁ * (-Y.im) } →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun τ : ℝ => S_star (-(τ : ℂ) * Complex.I) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₁ * (-Y.im) →
      ‖w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)‖ < ρ_mod ∧
      ‖w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y)‖ < r_lam ∧
      ‖deriv S_star Y - 1‖ < ρ_J ∧
      frozenEnergyE kind (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y))
        (deriv S_star Y) = 1 / 12) →
    ∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₁ * (-Y.im) →
      S_star Y = Y + Δ₀ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y))

def DfmcAnchorWitnessAt (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (T_bound D_anc C_anc α A' D_top' : ℝ)
    (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n ≥ N_init,
    let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let coneSet : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        D_anc < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top' ∧
        |p.1.re| < A' * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_bound }
    IsOpen (U_phys n) ∧
    0 < δ_base n ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → 0 ≤ y.im →
      ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im →
        ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → (y, -t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → s_tilde n (y, -t) = s_tilde n (y, t)) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < T_bound / seq.m_seq n →
      (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ (y, t) ∈ X.Tube ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n →
      D_anc < -y.im → -y.im < D_top' → |y.re| < A' * (-y.im) →
      s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y, 0) =
        s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ coneSet,
      (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n ∧
      0 < (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1).im ∧
      ‖(s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) - s_n) /
          (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) - p.1‖ ≤
        C_anc * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (-p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
    (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
      (Y, T) ∈ coneSet →
      (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
      (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
      let t : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
      let y : ℂ := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y
      let s_prev : ℂ := s_tilde n (y - t, t)
      let s_curr : ℂ := s_tilde n (y, t)
      let s_next : ℂ := s_tilde n (y + t, t)
      let J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
      let J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
      deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
        t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
        deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev)

def DfmcHasAnchorAt (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (T_bound D_anc C_anc α : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A' D_top' : ℝ, 0 < A' → D_anc + 2 < D_top' →
    ∃ (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
      (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ),
      DfmcAnchorWitnessAt X P kind seq T_bound D_anc C_anc α A' D_top'
        N_init U_phys s_tilde δ_base

structure DfmcExtractedLimit (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (D₀ C_anc α A T_max : ℝ) where
  Y_star : ℂ
  T_star : ℂ
  S_star : ℂ → ℂ
  φ : ℕ → ℕ
  F_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  T_star_ne : T_star ≠ 0
  T_star_lt : ‖T_star‖ < T_max
  Y_star_mem : D₀ < -Y_star.im ∧ |Y_star.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y_star.im)
  φ_strictMono : StrictMono φ
  S_star_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_star
    { Y : ℂ | D₀ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y.im) }
  S_star_bound : ∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y.im) →
    ‖S_star Y - Y‖ ≤ C_anc * ‖T_star‖ ^ 2 * (-Y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)
  F_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn F_seq S_star Filter.atTop
    { Y : ℂ | D₀ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y.im) }
  F_deriv_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun k => deriv (F_seq k)) (deriv S_star)
    Filter.atTop { Y : ℂ | D₀ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y.im) }
  local_holo_and_recurrence :
    ∀ (Y₀ : ℂ) (r₀ : ℝ), 0 < r₀ →
      Metric.closedBall Y₀ (2 * r₀) ⊆
        { Y : ℂ | D₀ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y.im) } →
      ∃ K₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K₀,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_seq k) (Metric.ball Y₀ (2 * r₀)) ∧
        (let n := φ k
         let a_n : ℂ := T_star / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
         let t : ℂ := T_star / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
         let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
         ‖a_n‖ < r₀ / 2 ∧
         ∀ Y ∈ Metric.ball Y₀ r₀,
           let s_prev := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * F_seq k (Y - a_n)
           let s_curr := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * F_seq k Y
           let J_prev := (F_seq k Y - F_seq k (Y - a_n)) / a_n
           let J_curr := (F_seq k (Y + a_n) - F_seq k Y) / a_n
           deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
             t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
             deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev)

noncomputable def refSteepActionA {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  P.p_act s J t - J ^ 3 / 24

noncomputable def refSteepActionDJ {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun J' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s J' t) J

noncomputable def refSteepActionDS {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun s' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s' J t) s

noncomputable def refSteepPerturbG {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_0 t J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  refSteepActionDJ P s_0 J t - t * refSteepActionDS P s_0 J t

noncomputable def refSteepResidual {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 8 : ℂ) * (J ^ 2 - J_m ^ 2) +
    refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t J -
    refSteepActionDJ P s_m J_m t

def refSteepPolydisk (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.1 - 1‖ < 1 / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.2‖ < r_t }

noncomputable def refSteepIterJ {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => (s_0 - s_m) / t
  | n + 1 =>
      let u := refSteepIterJ P s_m s_0 t n
      u - (4 : ℂ) * refSteepResidual P s_m ((s_0 - s_m) / t) s_0 t u

noncomputable def refSteepSolJ {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (refSteepIterJ P s_m s_0 t)

noncomputable def refSteepChain {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y_bot t : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ
  | 0 => (s_init (y_bot, t), s_init (y_bot + t, t))
  | j + 1 =>
      let prev := refSteepChain P s_init y_bot t j
      (prev.2, prev.2 + t * refSteepSolJ P prev.1 prev.2 t)

noncomputable def refSteepPsi {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (refSteepChain P s_init (y - ((N : ℂ) + 1) * t) t N).2

def RefSteepJetProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X) : Prop :=
  (∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s → 0 < r_t →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
    ∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
      ‖s_m - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 → ‖J_m - 1‖ < 1 / 4 →
      ‖s_0 - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      refSteepResidual P s_m J_m s_0 t J =
        (deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_0 J' t) J -
          t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J t) s_0) -
        deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_m J' t) J_m) ∧
  (∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s → 0 < r_t →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
    ∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
      ‖s_0 - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 8 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      HasDerivAt (fun J' => refSteepResidual P s_m J_m s_0 t J')
        ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * J + deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) J) J) ∧
  (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (s_fn J_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_fn U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ J_fn U →
    (∀ p₀ ∈ U, ∃ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s ∧ 0 < r_t ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) ∧
      ‖s_fn p₀ - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧ ‖J_fn p₀ - 1‖ < 1 / 8 ∧ ‖p₀.2‖ < r_t) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepActionDJ P (s_fn p) (J_fn p) p.2) U ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepActionDS P (s_fn p) (J_fn p) p.2) U) ∧
  (∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t ρ_s M_a : ℝ) (s_m s_0 J_m t : ℂ),
    0 < r_s → 0 < r_t → 0 < ρ_s → 0 ≤ M_a →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
    ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 32 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
    (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall ((1 - (θ : ℂ)) * s_m + (θ : ℂ) * s_0) ρ_s,
        ‖s' - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧
        ∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 / 32),
          ‖refSteepActionA P s' J' t‖ ≤ M_a) →
    (∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m (1 / 32),
      ‖deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) J‖ ≤
        4096 * M_a + 64 * ‖t‖ * M_a / ρ_s) ∧
    ‖refSteepActionDS P s_0 J_m t‖ ≤ M_a / ρ_s ∧
    ‖refSteepActionDJ P s_0 J_m t - refSteepActionDJ P s_m J_m t‖ ≤
      (32 * M_a / ρ_s) * ‖s_0 - s_m‖)

def IsRefSteepContractivePt (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : Prop :=
  t ≠ 0 ∧
  let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
  ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 32 ∧
  (∃ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s ∧ 0 < r_t ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) ∧
    ‖s_m - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧ ‖s_0 - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧ ‖t‖ < r_t) ∧
  (∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m (1 / 32),
    ‖deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) J‖ ≤ 1 / 32) ∧
  ‖refSteepResidual P s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ≤ 1 / 256

def RefSteepSolverProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X) : Prop :=
  (∀ s_m s_0 t : ℂ,
    IsRefSteepContractivePt X P s_m s_0 t →
    let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
    let J_p := refSteepSolJ P s_m s_0 t
    ‖J_p - J_m‖ ≤ 8 * ‖refSteepResidual P s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ∧
    deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_0 J' t) J_p -
      t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_p t) s_0 =
      deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_m J' t) J_m ∧
    (∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m (1 / 32),
      deriv (fun J'' => P.p_act s_0 J'' t) J' -
        t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J' t) s_0 =
        deriv (fun J'' => P.p_act s_m J'' t) J_m →
      J' = J_p)) ∧
  (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (s_m s_0 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_m U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_0 U →
    (∀ p ∈ U, IsRefSteepContractivePt X P (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepSolJ P (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2) U)

def RefSteepStepAdmProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X) : Prop :=
  (∀ β x_start Δ : ℝ, ∀ M : ℕ,
    1 < β → 0 < x_start → 0 < Δ →
    Δ * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, (x_start + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Δ) ^ (-β)) ≤
      x_start ^ (1 - β) / (β - 1)) ∧
  (∀ (α γ_steep x₀ h_ref m_steep d δ_ceil Δ_slab r M_scale C_init : ℝ)
     (s_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    0 < m_steep → 0 < d → 0 < Δ_slab → 2 * Δ_slab ≤ δ_ceil →
    0 < r → 0 < M_scale → 0 ≤ C_init →
    C_init * (1 + 8 * δ_ceil / (γ_steep * Δ_slab)) ≤
      M_scale ^ 2 * δ_ceil ^ (1 - 2 * α) →
    let L_in : ℝ := 2 * m_steep + 2 / γ_steep + 4
    let S_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        δ_ceil - Δ_slab < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
        |p.1.re - x₀| < L_in * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
        ‖p.2‖ < 12 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α }
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_init S_init →
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ S_init → ‖s_init (y, t) - y‖ ≤ C_init * ‖t‖ ^ 2) →
    ∀ z_bot t : ℂ,
