def RefUpwardSteepProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X) : Prop :=
  ∀ (α γ_steep : ℝ),
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    ∃ (C_st η_st : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_st ∧ 0 < η_st ∧ η_st < 1 / 16 ∧
      ∀ (x₀ h_ref m_steep d δ_ceil Δ_slab r M_scale C_init : ℝ)
        (s_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < m_steep → 0 < d → 0 < Δ_slab → 2 * Δ_slab ≤ δ_ceil →
        4 * d ≤ δ_ceil - Δ_slab → 0 < r → 0 < M_scale → 0 ≤ C_init →
        12 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α ≤ Δ_slab / 16 →
        r / d ≤ η_st →
        r * d ^ (-α) * M_scale ≤ η_st →
        C_init * (1 + 8 * δ_ceil / (γ_steep * Δ_slab)) ≤
          M_scale ^ 2 * δ_ceil ^ (1 - 2 * α) →
        (let L_in : ℝ := 2 * m_steep + 2 / γ_steep + 4
         let S_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             δ_ceil - Δ_slab < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < L_in * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < 12 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α }
         let W_up : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             d / 2 < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_ceil - Δ_slab / 4 ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
             γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < p.2.im }
         (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ h_ref - s.im → h_ref - s.im ≤ (5 / 4) * δ_ceil →
           |s.re - x₀| ≤ L_in * (h_ref - s.im) →
           s ∈ X.D_strip ∧
           ‖X.f s‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - s.im) ^ (-α) ∧
           Real.sqrt ‖X.q s‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - s.im) ^ (-α)) →
         DifferentiableOn ℂ s_init S_init →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ S_init →
           ‖s_init (y, t) - y‖ ≤ C_init * ‖t‖ ^ 2) →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, t ≠ 0 →
           (y - t, t) ∈ S_init → (y, t) ∈ S_init → (y + t, t) ∈ S_init →
           let s_prev := s_init (y - t, t)
           let s_curr := s_init (y, t)
           let s_next := s_init (y + t, t)
           let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
           let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
           deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
             t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
             deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev) →
         ∃ s_up : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
           DifferentiableOn ℂ s_up W_up ∧
           (∀ p ∈ W_up, s_up p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_up →
             ‖s_up (y, t) - y‖ ≤
               C_st * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_up →
             δ_ceil - (3 / 4) * Δ_slab < h_ref - y.im →
             s_up (y, t) = s_init (y, t)) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, γ_steep * ‖t‖ < t.im →
             (y - t, t) ∈ W_up → (y, t) ∈ W_up → (y + t, t) ∈ W_up →
             let s_prev := s_up (y - t, t)
             let s_curr := s_up (y, t)
             let s_next := s_up (y + t, t)
             let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
             let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
             deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
               t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
               deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev))

def EntireAffineBandInitProp : Prop :=
  SchwarzPoissonBumpProp → ∀ (α K₀ γ₀ : ℝ),
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 8 < K₀ → 0 < γ₀ → γ₀ < 1 / 8 →
    ∃ (C_bump_init γ_init : ℝ),
      0 < C_bump_init ∧ 0 < γ_init ∧ γ_init < γ₀ ∧
      ∀ (x₀ h_ref s_base ρ_base m_aux d r M_scale C_st C_init : ℝ)
        (s_base_fn U_base s_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < s_base → s_base ≤ h_ref → 0 < ρ_base → 0 < m_aux →
        0 < d → 4 * d ≤ h_ref / (2 * K₀) → 0 < r → 0 < M_scale →
        0 < C_st → 0 ≤ C_init →
        8 * r * (2 * h_ref / d) ^ α ≤ ρ_base →
        C_init ≤ M_scale ^ 2 * (2 * h_ref) ^ (1 - 2 * α) →
        (let m_steep_init : ℝ := 2 * (m_aux + (4 * K₀ + 1) * C_bump_init + 2)
         let A₀ : ℝ := max 1 ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * α - 1) * C_st)
         let δ_seed : ℝ := s_base / (16 * (1 + C_bump_init))
         let U_base_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < ρ_base }
         let W_steep_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             d / 2 < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < h_ref + s_base / 2 ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep_init * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
             γ_init * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| }
         let Ω_mid : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             h_ref / (2 * K₀) < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < h_ref + δ_seed ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m_aux * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α }
         DifferentiableOn ℂ U_base U_base_dom →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_base_dom →
           s_base_fn (y, t) - y = t ^ 2 * U_base (y, t) ∧
           U_base (y, -t) = U_base (y, t) ∧
           ‖U_base (y, t)‖ ≤ C_init) →
         DifferentiableOn ℂ s_steep W_steep_init →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_steep_init →
           s_steep (y, -t) = s_steep (y, t) ∧
           ‖s_steep (y, t) - y‖ ≤
             C_st * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) →
         (∀ p ∈ W_steep_init, |p.1.im| < s_base / 2 → ‖p.2‖ < ρ_base →
           s_steep p = s_base_fn p) →
         ∃ s_band₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
           DifferentiableOn ℂ s_band₀ Ω_mid ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ Ω_mid →
             s_band₀ (y, -t) = s_band₀ (y, t) ∧
             ‖s_band₀ (y, t) - y‖ ≤
               A₀ * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
           (∀ y : ℂ, (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ Ω_mid → s_band₀ (y, 0) = y) ∧
           (∀ p ∈ Ω_mid, |p.1.im| < δ_seed → s_band₀ p = s_base_fn p) ∧
           (∀ p ∈ Ω_mid ∩ W_steep_init, s_band₀ p = s_steep p))

def EntireConeParamRecurrenceProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (X : ExpStripData), X.D_strip = Set.univ →
  ∀ (P : ChordActionPackage X) (α γ_rec : ℝ),
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < γ_rec → γ_rec < 1 / 4 →
    ∀ (x₀ h_ref d δ_top m₀ R_par M_scale C_disp : ℝ)
      (s_cone : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < d → 4 * d < δ_top → 1 ≤ m₀ → 0 < R_par → 0 < M_scale → 0 ≤ C_disp →
      (let Ω_rec : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
         { p : ℂ × ℂ |
           d < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_top ∧
           |p.1.re - x₀| < m₀ * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
           ‖p.2‖ < R_par }
       (∀ w : ℂ, d ≤ h_ref - w.im → h_ref - w.im ≤ (3 / 2) * δ_top →
         ‖X.f w‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - w.im) ^ (-α) ∧
         Real.sqrt ‖X.q w‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - w.im) ^ (-α)) →
       DifferentiableOn ℂ s_cone Ω_rec →
       (∀ z t : ℂ, (z, t) ∈ Ω_rec →
         ‖s_cone (z, t) - z‖ ≤ C_disp * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * (h_ref - z.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) →
       (∀ z t : ℂ, γ_rec * ‖t‖ < t.im →
         (z - t, t) ∈ Ω_rec → (z, t) ∈ Ω_rec → (z + t, t) ∈ Ω_rec →
         let s_prev := s_cone (z - t, t)
         let s_curr := s_cone (z, t)
         let s_next := s_cone (z + t, t)
         let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
         let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
         deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
           t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
           deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev) →
       ∀ y t₀ : ℂ,
         let δ_y : ℝ := h_ref - y.im
         2 * d ≤ δ_y → (5 / 4) * δ_y < δ_top →
         |y.re - x₀| < ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * m₀ - 1 / 4) * δ_y →
         t₀ ≠ 0 → ‖t₀‖ < R_par / 2 → R_par ≤ δ_y / 32 →
         4 * R_par * M_scale * δ_y ^ (-α) ≤ P.η_sf →
         64 * C_disp * R_par ^ 2 * δ_y ^ (-2 * α) ≤ 1 / 16 →
         let s_prev := s_cone (y - t₀, t₀)
         let s_curr := s_cone (y, t₀)
         let s_next := s_cone (y + t₀, t₀)
         let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t₀
         let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t₀
         deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t₀) J_curr -
           t₀ * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t₀) s_curr =
           deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t₀) J_prev)

noncomputable def expParamStar {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : ℝ :=
  (‖seq.c₀‖)⁻¹

noncomputable def expArgC0 {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : ℝ :=
  Complex.arg seq.c₀

noncomputable def expShearOffset (T_star : ℝ) (T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -Complex.I * Complex.log (T / (T_star : ℂ))

noncomputable def expShearedModelW (α_c : ℝ) (Y_tilde : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Y_tilde - (α_c : ℂ)))

noncomputable def expShearedInnerModel {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  p.1 + expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) p.2 +
    M.Δ_inner (expShearedModelW (expArgC0 seq) p.1)

def expShearedInnerDomain {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    ‖p.2 - (expParamStar seq : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * expParamStar seq ∧
    expShearedModelW (expArgC0 seq) p.1 ∈ branchInnerDomain M.R M.ν M.θ M.δ_θ }

def complexRect (x_lo x_hi y_lo y_hi : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { z : ℂ | x_lo < z.re ∧ z.re < x_hi ∧ y_lo < z.im ∧ z.im < y_hi }

noncomputable def physToSheared {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  ((p.1 - expBasePt seq n) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) -
    expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) ((seq.m_seq n : ℂ) * p.2),
   (seq.m_seq n : ℂ) * p.2)

noncomputable def shearedToPhys {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (n : ℕ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (expBasePt seq n +
    (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * (q.1 + expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) q.2),
   q.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ))

noncomputable def shearedRescaledLift {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (s_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rescaledLift seq s_fn n (q.1 + expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) q.2) q.2

structure ShearedModelAndDeepBridgeProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind) : Prop where
  T_star_pos : 0 < expParamStar seq
  unit_c₀ :
    (expParamStar seq : ℂ) * seq.c₀ =
      Complex.exp ((expArgC0 seq : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  shear_zero : expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) (expParamStar seq : ℂ) = 0
  shear_holo_bounds :
    let U_T_all := Metric.ball (expParamStar seq : ℂ) ((15 / 32 : ℝ) * expParamStar seq)
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (expShearOffset (expParamStar seq)) U_T_all ∧
    ∀ T ∈ U_T_all,
      T ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T‖ < 2 * expParamStar seq ∧
      |(expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) T).im| < 1 ∧
      |(expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) T).re| < 4
  inner_model_reg :
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq (expShearedInnerDomain seq M) (expShearedInnerModel seq M)
  mem_inner_of_lt_log_R :
    ∀ Y_tilde T : ℂ,
      ‖T - (expParamStar seq : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * expParamStar seq →
      Y_tilde.im < Real.log M.R →
      (Y_tilde, T) ∈ expShearedInnerDomain seq M
  mem_inner_of_sector :
    ∀ (sgn : ℝ) (Y_tilde T : ℂ),
      (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
      ‖T - (expParamStar seq : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * expParamStar seq →
      Y_tilde.im < Real.log M.R + 2 * M.ν →
      |Y_tilde.re - (expArgC0 seq - sgn * M.θ)| < 2 * M.δ_θ →
      (Y_tilde, T) ∈ expShearedInnerDomain seq M
  arcsin_collar :
    ∀ (x₀ δ_ϕ : ℝ),
      x₀ ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 4 : ℝ) (1 / 4) → 0 < δ_ϕ →
      ∀ ϕ : ℝ, |Real.sin ϕ - x₀| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * min 1 δ_ϕ →
        ∃ k : ℤ,
          |ϕ - Real.arcsin x₀ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ ∨
          |ϕ - (Real.pi - Real.arcsin x₀) - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ
  deep_sheared_init :
    ∃ D₁ : ℝ, 2 ≤ D₁ ∧
      ∀ (X_deep H_deep_bot : ℝ), 0 < X_deep → H_deep_bot < -D₁ - 4 →
        let U_T_all := Metric.ball (expParamStar seq : ℂ) ((15 / 32 : ℝ) * expParamStar seq)
        let R_deep := complexRect (-X_deep) X_deep H_deep_bot (-D₁ - 1)
        ∃ (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
          (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ),
          (∀ n ≥ N_init,
            let S_sh := shearedRescaledLift seq (s_tilde n) n
            IsDownwardVertConvex (U_phys n) ∧
            0 < δ_base n ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < 4 * expParamStar seq / seq.m_seq n →
              (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ q ∈ R_deep ×ˢ U_T_all, shearedToPhys seq n q ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ S_sh (R_deep ×ˢ U_T_all) ∧
            (∀ q ∈ R_deep ×ˢ U_T_all,
              expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_sh q ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
            (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ∈ U_T_all → Y ∈ R_deep →
              Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ R_deep →
              Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ R_deep →
              SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_sh (Z, T)) n Y T)) ∧
          (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ R_deep ×ˢ U_T_all →
            TendstoUniformlyOn
              (fun n q => shearedRescaledLift seq (s_tilde n) n q)
              (expShearedInnerModel seq M) Filter.atTop K)

def ShearedDiskLiftProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (T_max R_rad η M_g η_plus : ℝ)
    (U_T_prev K_T_prev U_T_c : Set ℂ)
    (x_lo x_c_lo x_c_hi x_hi H_prev_bot y_bot y_top H_c_bot H_c_top : ℝ)
    (g : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
    0 < T_max → 0 < R_rad → 0 < η → 0 ≤ M_g → 0 < η_plus →
    IsOpen U_T_prev → IsCompact K_T_prev → K_T_prev ⊆ U_T_prev →
    U_T_prev ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) T_max →
    IsOpen U_T_c →
    x_lo < x_c_lo - M_g → x_c_lo < x_c_hi → x_c_hi + M_g < x_hi →
    H_prev_bot < y_bot → y_bot < y_top →
    H_prev_bot < H_c_bot - M_g → H_c_bot < H_c_top →
    (let δ_y : ℝ := (y_top - y_bot) / 4
     let y_mid : ℝ := (y_bot + y_top) / 2
     let U_prev : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := complexRect x_lo x_hi H_prev_bot y_top ×ˢ U_T_prev
     let B_rec : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := complexRect x_lo x_hi y_bot y_top ×ˢ U_T_prev
     let W_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := complexRect x_c_lo x_c_hi H_c_bot H_c_top ×ˢ U_T_c
     H_c_bot < y_top - δ_y - η_plus →
     Differentiable ℂ g → g 0 = 0 →
     (∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 → ‖g ζ‖ ≤ M_g ∧ (g ζ).im ≤ η_plus) →
     (∀ T_c ∈ U_T_c, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
       T_c + (R_rad : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ K_T_prev) →
     (∀ T_c ∈ U_T_c, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
       T_c + (R_rad : ℂ) * ζ ∈ U_T_prev) →
     (∀ T_c ∈ U_T_c, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
       |(T_c + (R_rad : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| ≤
         (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η →
       H_c_top + (g (Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im ≤
         y_top - (3 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y) →
     B_rec ⊆ V_mod →
     (∀ p ∈ W_c, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
       (p.1 + g ζ, p.2 + (R_rad : ℂ) * ζ) ∈ V_mod) →
     (∀ (σ : ℝ), (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) →
       ∀ (Y' T' : ℂ),
         x_c_lo - M_g ≤ Y'.re → Y'.re ≤ x_c_hi + M_g →
         y_mid ≤ Y'.im → Y'.im ≤ H_c_top + η_plus →
         T' ∈ K_T_prev → (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η ≤ σ * T'.im →
         ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc y_mid Y'.im,
           let Y_vert : ℂ := (Y'.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
           let s_end : ℝ := (τ - y_mid) / (σ * T'.im)
           (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s_end,
             (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T', T') ∈ V_mod) ∧
           x_lo < (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').re ∧
           (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').re < x_hi) →
     ∀ (N₀ : ℕ) (S_prev : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
       (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_prev n) U_prev) →
       (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ p ∈ U_prev,
         expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_prev n p ∈ X.D_strip) →
       (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
         (Y, T) ∈ B_rec →
         (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_rec →
         (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_rec →
         SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_prev n (Z, T)) n Y T) →
       (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U_prev →
         TendstoUniformlyOn S_prev S_star Filter.atTop K) →
       ∃ (N₁ : ℕ) (S_next : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
         N₀ ≤ N₁ ∧
         (∀ n ≥ N₁, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_next n) W_c) ∧
         (∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ W_c,
           expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_next n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
         (∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ W_c, p.1.im < y_top - δ_y - η_plus →
           S_next n p = S_prev n p) ∧
         TendstoUniformlyOn S_next S_star Filter.atTop W_c)

def VertRecurrenceProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (T_max : ℝ) (U_T K_T : Set ℂ)
    (x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ y_seed δ_r : ℝ)
    (N₀ : ℕ) (S_seq : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
    0 < T_max → 0 < δ_r →
    IsOpen U_T → IsCompact K_T → K_T ⊆ U_T →
    U_T ⊆ { T : ℂ | T ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T‖ < T_max } →
    x₁ + 2 * δ_r < x₂ → y₁ + 2 * δ_r < y₂ →
    y₁ + δ_r < y_seed → y_seed ≤ y₂ →
    complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ ×ˢ U_T ⊆ V_mod →
    (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_seq n) (complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ ×ˢ U_T)) →
    (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ ×ˢ U_T →
      TendstoUniformlyOn S_seq S_star Filter.atTop K) →
    (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ Y T : ℂ, T ∈ K_T →
      Y ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed →
      Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed →
      Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed →
      SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_seq n (Z, T)) n Y T) →
    ∃ N_rec : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N_rec ∧
      ∀ n ≥ N_rec, ∀ T ∈ K_T,
        ∀ Y ∈ complexRect (x₁ + δ_r) (x₂ - δ_r) (y₁ + δ_r) (y₂ - δ_r),
          SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_seq n (Z, T)) n Y T

def StageOneShearedProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ ν' : ℝ, 0 < ν' → ν' < M.ν →
    let T_star : ℝ := expParamStar seq
    let α_c : ℝ := expArgC0 seq
    let r₀ : ℝ := T_star / 32
    let X₁ : ℝ := |α_c| + M.θ + 10
    let U_T_1 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (T_star : ℂ) ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * r₀)
    ∃ (H_1_bot H_cut_0 : ℝ) (N₁ : ℕ)
      (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ) (S₁ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      H_1_bot < Real.log M.R - 55 ∧
      H_1_bot + 1 < H_cut_0 ∧
      H_cut_0 < Real.log M.R - 50 ∧
      (let R_1_full := complexRect (-X₁) X₁ H_1_bot (Real.log M.R - ν')
       let R_1_rec :=
         complexRect (-X₁ + ν' / 8) (X₁ - ν' / 8)
           (H_1_bot + ν' / 8) (Real.log M.R - (9 / 8 : ℝ) * ν')
       (∀ n ≥ N₁,
         IsDownwardVertConvex (U_phys n) ∧
         0 < δ_base n ∧
         DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
         (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < 4 * T_star / seq.m_seq n →
           (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
         (∀ q ∈ complexRect (-X₁) X₁ H_1_bot H_cut_0 ×ˢ U_T_1,
           shearedToPhys seq n q ∈ U_phys n ∧
           expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S₁ n q =
             s_tilde n (shearedToPhys seq n q)) ∧
         DifferentiableOn ℂ (S₁ n) (R_1_full ×ˢ U_T_1) ∧
         (∀ q ∈ R_1_full ×ˢ U_T_1,
           expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S₁ n q ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
         (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ∈ U_T_1 → Y ∈ R_1_rec →
           SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S₁ n (Z, T)) n Y T)) ∧
       TendstoUniformlyOn S₁ (expShearedInnerModel seq M) Filter.atTop
         (R_1_full ×ˢ U_T_1))

noncomputable def rctScaledActionP {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    {kind : ExpProfileKind} (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (n : ℕ) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  P.p_act (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S) J (T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ))

noncomputable def rctModelActionP (kind : ExpProfileKind) {X : ExpStripData}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  frozenActionP kind (T * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S)) J

noncomputable def rctActDS (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun S' => F S' J T) S

noncomputable def rctActDJ (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun J' => F S J' T) J

noncomputable def rctActDJJ (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun J' => deriv (fun J'' => F S J'' T) J') J

noncomputable def rctActDSJ (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun S' => deriv (fun J' => F S' J' T) J) S

noncomputable def rctActDJS (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun J' => deriv (fun S' => F S' J' T) S) J

noncomputable def rctInitSymplecticState {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    {kind : ExpProfileKind} (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (n : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (S_prev S_curr T : ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
  if 0 < σ then
    let D_prev : ℂ := (S_curr - S_prev) / a_n
    (S_curr, rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S_prev D_prev T)
  else
    let D_prev : ℂ := (S_prev - S_curr) / a_n
    (S_curr,
      rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S_curr D_prev T -
        a_n * rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S_curr D_prev T)

noncomputable def rctRunCorridorChain {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (Ψ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ)
    (σ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  | 0, _, _, q₀ => q₀
  | k + 1, Y₀, T, q₀ =>
      let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
      Ψ n (Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)
        (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k Y₀ T q₀)

structure RctFrozenJetAndELProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop where
  chart_jets :
    ∀ (S₀ J₀ T₀ : ℂ),
      IsRegularFrozenState kind
        (T₀ * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S₀)) J₀ →
      let μ₀ : ℂ := rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₀ J₀ T₀
      μ₀ ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ (r_c : ℝ) (N_c : ℕ) (M_c : ℝ),
        0 < r_c ∧ 0 < M_c ∧
        let Q_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
          { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
            ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < r_c }
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctModelActionP kind seq q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_c,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctScaledActionP P seq n q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDSJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          (∀ q ∈ Q_c,
            ‖rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 - μ₀‖ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ ∧
            ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
            ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
            ‖rctActDSJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
            ‖rctActDJS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
            ‖rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c) ∧
          (∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
            (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Q_c → (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Q_c →
            ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
              rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤
              M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖) ∧
            ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
              rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤
              M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖))) ∧
        (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N_ε ≥ N_c, ∀ n ≥ N_ε,
          ∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
            (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Q_c → (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Q_c →
            ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
              rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₁ J₁ T‖ ≤ ε ∧
            ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
              rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₁ J₁ T‖ ≤ ε ∧
            ‖(rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
                rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₁ J₁ T) -
              (rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₂ J₂ T -
                rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₂ J₂ T)‖ ≤
              ε * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_c, ∀ (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ) (Y T : ℂ), T ≠ 0 →
          let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          let D_prev : ℂ := (S_fn Y - S_fn (Y - a_n)) / a_n
          let D_curr : ℂ := (S_fn (Y + a_n) - S_fn Y) / a_n
          (S_fn Y, (D_curr, T)) ∈ Q_c →
          (S_fn (Y - a_n), (D_prev, T)) ∈ Q_c →
          SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq S_fn n Y T →
          rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) (S_fn Y) D_curr T -
            a_n * rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) (S_fn Y) D_curr T =
            rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) (S_fn (Y - a_n)) D_prev T)
  model_euler_lagrange :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', p.2)) p.1) V_mod ∧
      ∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V_mod →
        ∃ (a_max C_EL : ℝ), 0 < a_max ∧ 0 < C_EL ∧
          ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ a : ℂ, 0 < ‖a‖ → ‖a‖ ≤ a_max →
            let Y : ℂ := p.1
            let T : ℂ := p.2
            let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
            let D_prev : ℂ := (S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)) / a
            let D_curr : ℂ := (S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / a
            (Y - a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧ (Y + a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧
            ‖S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
            ‖S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
            ‖D_prev - J_star‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
            ‖D_curr - J_star‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
            ‖(rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y, T)) D_curr T -
                a * rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y, T)) D_curr T) -
              rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y - a, T)) D_prev T‖ ≤
              C_EL * ‖a‖ ^ 2

def RctCorridorStepEngineProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (K_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (σ T_max L_max : ℝ),
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
    IsCompact K_corr → K_corr ⊆ V_mod →
    (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → 0 < T_max → 0 < L_max →
    (∀ p ∈ K_corr, ‖p.2‖ ≤ T_max) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', p.2)) p.1) V_mod ∧
    (∃ (a_max C_EL : ℝ), 0 < a_max ∧ 0 < C_EL ∧
      ∀ p ∈ K_corr, ∀ a : ℂ, 0 < ‖a‖ → ‖a‖ ≤ a_max →
        let Y : ℂ := p.1
        let T : ℂ := p.2
        let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
        let D_prev : ℂ := (S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)) / a
        let D_curr : ℂ := (S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / a
        (Y - a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧ (Y + a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧
        ‖S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖D_prev - J_star‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖D_curr - J_star‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖) ∧
    ∃ (η_corr r_init C_Gron : ℝ) (N_eng : ℕ) (δ_mod : ℕ → ℝ)
      (Ψ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
      0 < η_corr ∧ 0 < r_init ∧ 0 < C_Gron ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ δ_mod n) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto δ_mod Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      let U_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | ∃ q ∈ K_corr, ‖p - q‖ < η_corr }
      IsOpen U_corr ∧ U_corr ⊆ V_mod ∧
      (∀ (n d k₁ : ℕ) (Y₀ T : ℂ) (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n (d + k₁) Y₀ T q₀ =
          rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k₁
            (Y₀ + (d : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n) T
            (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n d Y₀ T q₀)) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_eng, ∀ (Y T : ℂ) (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq S_fn n Y T →
        ‖S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_star (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < r_init →
        ‖S_fn Y - S_star (Y, T)‖ < r_init →
        ‖S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_star (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < r_init →
        ‖(S_fn Y - S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < r_init →
        ‖(S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_fn Y) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < r_init →
        Ψ n (Y, T)
          (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) (S_fn Y) T) =
          rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_fn Y) (S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) T) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_eng, ∀ K_n : ℕ,
        (K_n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max →
        ∀ (Y₀ T S_prev S_curr : ℂ),
          T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
          (∀ k ≤ K_n,
            let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            (Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T) ∈ U_corr) →
          let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          let e_init : ℝ :=
            ‖S_curr - S_star (Y₀, T)‖ +
              ‖(S_curr - S_prev) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
                deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y₀‖
          e_init < r_init →
          ∀ k ≤ K_n,
            let S_k : ℂ :=
              (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k Y₀ T
                (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ S_prev S_curr T)).1
            ‖S_k - S_star (Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ ≤
              C_Gron * (e_init + δ_mod n) ∧
            expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_k ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_eng, ∀ K_n : ℕ,
        (K_n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max →
        ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Y₀_fn T_fn S_prev_fn S_curr_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          IsOpen W →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ Y₀_fn W →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ S_prev_fn W →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ S_curr_fn W →
          (∀ w ∈ W,
            T_fn w ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T_fn w‖ ≤ T_max ∧
            let a_n : ℂ := T_fn w / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            (∀ k ≤ K_n, (Y₀_fn w + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T_fn w) ∈ U_corr) ∧
            ‖S_curr_fn w - S_star (Y₀_fn w, T_fn w)‖ +
              ‖(S_curr_fn w - S_prev_fn w) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
                deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T_fn w)) (Y₀_fn w)‖ < r_init) →
          ∀ k ≤ K_n,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ
              (fun w : ℂ × ℂ =>
                (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k (Y₀_fn w) (T_fn w)
                  (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w))).1)
              W)

noncomputable def wltbExpPt (y_star : ℂ) (wt : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (y_star + Complex.exp wt.1, wt.2)

noncomputable def wltbSlitLog (y_star : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (Real.log ρ : ℂ) - ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +
    Complex.log ((Complex.I / (ρ : ℂ)) * (y - y_star))

noncomputable def wltbDerivY : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, f => f
  | α + 1, f => fun p => Complex.exp (-p.1) * pderivA (wltbDerivY α f) p

noncomputable def wltbDerivYT (α β : ℕ) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iterDerivYT 0 β (wltbDerivY α f) p

noncomputable def wltbHomRankOneDet (W_hom : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  W_hom 0 p * (wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 1) p * wltbDerivYT 0 1 (W_hom 2) p -
    wltbDerivYT 0 1 (W_hom 1) p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 2) p) -
  W_hom 1 p * (wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 0) p * wltbDerivYT 0 1 (W_hom 2) p -
    wltbDerivYT 0 1 (W_hom 0) p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 2) p) +
  W_hom 2 p * (wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 0) p * wltbDerivYT 0 1 (W_hom 1) p -
    wltbDerivYT 0 1 (W_hom 0) p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 1) p)

noncomputable def wltbHomReflectOut (E : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (W_hom : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p =>
    let T₀ := W_hom 2 p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 0) p - W_hom 0 p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 2) p
    let T₁ := W_hom 2 p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 1) p - W_hom 1 p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 2) p
    let N₀ := T₁
    let N₁ := -T₀
    let dotLN := E 0 p * N₀ + E 1 p * N₁
    let dotNN := N₀ * N₀ + N₁ * N₁
    2 * dotLN * (if ι = 0 then N₀ else N₁) - dotNN * E ι p

noncomputable def wltbHomReflectRes (E F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p =>
    let W_hom := homIntersect E F
    let V := wltbHomReflectOut E W_hom
    W_hom 2 p * V ι p - (V 0 p * W_hom 0 p + V 1 p * W_hom 1 p) * F ι p

noncomputable def wltbLineJetEnv (M : ℕ) (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) :
    LineJetVar M → ℂ :=
  fun v =>
    if v.1 = 0 then
      wltbDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (E₀ v.2.1) p
    else
      wltbDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (E₁ v.2.1) p

noncomputable def wltbFieldSymJetEnv {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) (M : ℕ)
    (E : ℤ → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : SymJetVar N_idx M → ℂ :=
  fun v => wltbDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (E (q_idx v.1) v.2.1) p

structure CgpsInverseChordData (U_symm : Set ℝ) (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (h_b : ℝ) (h μ : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  hb_pos : 0 < h_b
  hb_mem : h_b ∈ U_symm
  Rb_ge_one : 1 ≤ ρ h_b
  Rb_gt_zero_val : ρ 0 < ρ h_b
  ρ_mono_nonneg : ∀ y₁ y₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ y₁ → y₁ ≤ y₂ → y₂ ∈ U_symm → y₁ ∈ U_symm ∧ ρ y₁ ≤ ρ y₂
  ρ_bdd_on_Icc : ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → B ∈ U_symm → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc 0 B, ρ y ≤ M
  h_mem_and_inv : ∀ z : ℝ, ρ h_b ≤ z → h_b ≤ h z ∧ h z ∈ U_symm ∧ ρ (h z) = z
  h_strictMono : StrictMonoOn h (Set.Ici (ρ h_b))
  h_left_inv : ∀ y ∈ U_symm, h_b ≤ y → ρ h_b ≤ ρ y ∧ h (ρ y) = y
  μ_mono : MonotoneOn μ (Set.Ici (ρ h_b))
  exp_μ_ge_secant : ∀ z : ℝ, ρ h_b ≤ z → (z - ρ 0) / h z ≤ Real.exp (μ z)
  exp_μ_ge_base : ∀ z : ℝ, ρ h_b ≤ z → (ρ h_b - ρ 0) / h_b ≤ Real.exp (μ z)
  chord_bounds : ∀ z₁ z₂ : ℝ, ρ h_b ≤ z₁ → z₁ < z₂ →
    Real.exp (-μ z₂) * (z₂ - z₁) ≤ h z₂ - h z₁ ∧
    h z₂ - h z₁ ≤ Real.exp (-μ z₁) * (z₂ - z₁)
  exp_decay_height : ∀ c R_star : ℝ, 0 < c → ρ h_b ≤ R_star →
    (∀ z : ℝ, R_star ≤ z → c * z ≤ μ z) →
    ∀ R₁ R₂ : ℝ, R_star ≤ R₁ → R₁ ≤ R₂ →
      h R₂ - h R₁ ≤ Real.exp (-c * R₁) / (1 - Real.exp (-c))

structure UcbStripPoissonData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  kernel_cont : ∀ h' y : ℝ, 0 < h' → h' < S.H → 0 < y → y < h' →
    Continuous (fun u : ℝ => bootStripPoissonKernel h' u y)
  kernel_periodic : ∀ h' y : ℝ, 0 < h' → h' < S.H → 0 < y → y < h' →
    Function.Periodic (fun u : ℝ => bootStripPoissonKernel h' u y) (2 * Real.pi)
  kernel_nonneg : ∀ h' y u : ℝ, 0 < h' → h' < S.H → 0 < y → y < h' →
    0 ≤ bootStripPoissonKernel h' u y
  kernel_integral : ∀ h' y : ℝ, 0 < h' → h' < S.H → 0 < y → y < h' →
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), bootStripPoissonKernel h' u y) = y / h'
  kernel_core_lower : ∃ c_core : ℝ, 0 < c_core ∧
    ∀ h' y u : ℝ, 0 < h' → h' < S.H → 0 < y → y < h' →
      h' - y ≤ h' / 4 → |u| ≤ 4 * (h' - y) →
      c_core / (h' - y) ≤ bootStripPoissonKernel h' u y
  strip_harmonic_V : ∀ h' y x : ℝ, 0 < h' → h' < S.H → 0 < y → y < h' →
    (S.V ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im =
      ∫ ξ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        bootStripPoissonKernel h' (x - ξ) y *
          (S.V ((ξ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im

def VolterraODEProp : Prop :=
  ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    c0Kernel Q 0 = 1 ∧
    c0Deriv Q 0 = 0 ∧
    k0Kernel Q 0 = 0 ∧
    k0Deriv Q 0 = 1 ∧
    ContinuousOn (c0Kernel Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ContinuousOn (c0Deriv Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ContinuousOn (k0Kernel Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ContinuousOn (k0Deriv Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivWithinAt (c0Kernel Q) (c0Deriv Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt (c0Deriv Q) (Q w * c0Kernel Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt (k0Kernel Q) (k0Deriv Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt (k0Deriv Q) (Q w * k0Kernel Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w) ∧
    (∀ y y' : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn y (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn y' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivWithinAt y (y' w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
        HasDerivWithinAt y' (Q w * y w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w) →
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        y w = y 0 * c0Kernel Q w + y' 0 * k0Kernel Q w ∧
        y' w = y 0 * c0Deriv Q w + y' 0 * k0Deriv Q w) ∧
    (∀ g g' : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn g' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        g w ≠ 0 ∧
        HasDerivWithinAt g (g' w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
        HasDerivWithinAt g' (Q w * g w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w) →
      k0Kernel Q 1 = g 0 * g 1 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w)⁻¹ ^ 2)

def VolterraLipHoloProp : Prop :=
  (∀ (M Δ : ℝ) (Q₁ Q₂ : ℝ → ℂ),
    0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ Δ →
    ContinuousOn Q₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    ContinuousOn Q₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₁ w‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖Q₂ w‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ ≤ Δ) →
    ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖c0Kernel Q₁ w‖ ≤ Real.exp M ∧
      ‖k0Kernel Q₁ w‖ ≤ Real.exp M ∧
      ‖c0Deriv Q₁ w‖ ≤ M * Real.exp M ∧
      ‖k0Deriv Q₁ w‖ ≤ 1 + M * Real.exp M ∧
      ‖c0Kernel Q₁ w - c0Kernel Q₂ w‖ ≤ Real.exp M * Δ ∧
      ‖k0Kernel Q₁ w - k0Kernel Q₂ w‖ ≤ Real.exp M * Δ ∧
      ‖c0Deriv Q₁ w - c0Deriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ (1 + M) * Real.exp M * Δ ∧
      ‖k0Deriv Q₁ w - k0Deriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ (1 + M) * Real.exp M * Δ) ∧
  (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U →
    ContinuousOn (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => Q q.1 q.2) (U ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => Q p w) U) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ a₀ U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ a₁ U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c0Kernel (Q p) 1) U ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => k0Kernel (Q p) 1) U ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => kPlusVal (Q p) (a₀ p) (a₁ p)) U ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => kMinusVal (Q p) (a₀ p) (a₁ p)) U)

noncomputable def bivarHybridDiv (N : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (b₀ b₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if b₀ ≠ 0 ∧ b₁ ≠ 0 then
    N b₀ b₁ / (b₀ * b₁)
  else
    (1 / 2 : ℂ) * dslope (fun w₀ => dslope (fun w₁ => N w₀ w₁) 0 b₁) 0 b₀ +
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * dslope (fun w₁ => dslope (fun w₀ => N w₀ w₁) 0 b₀) 0 b₁

noncomputable def cseChartG (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (b σ : ℝ) (S T D : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
  if 0 < σ then
    rctActDJ F S D T - a * rctActDS F S D T
  else
    rctActDJ F (S - a * D) D T

noncomputable def cseChartNewton (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (μ₀ : ℂ) (b σ : ℝ)
    (S P_mom T D : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  D - μ₀⁻¹ * (cseChartG F b σ S T D - P_mom)

noncomputable def cseChartIter (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (μ₀ J₀ : ℂ) (b σ : ℝ)
    (S P_mom T : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => J₀
  | m + 1 => cseChartNewton F μ₀ b σ S P_mom T (cseChartIter F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T m)

noncomputable def cseChartRoot (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (μ₀ J₀ : ℂ) (b σ : ℝ)
    (S P_mom T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (cseChartIter F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T)

noncomputable def cseChartStep (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (μ₀ J₀ : ℂ) (b σ : ℝ)
    (S P_mom T : ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
  let D : ℂ := cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T
  if 0 < σ then
    (S + a * D, P_mom + a * rctActDS F S D T)
  else
    let S_next : ℂ := S - a * D
    (S_next, P_mom - a * rctActDS F S_next D T)

def CseChartActionJet (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S₀ J₀ T₀ μ₀ : ℂ) (r_c M_c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < r_c ∧ 0 < M_c ∧ μ₀ ≠ 0 ∧
  let Q_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < r_c }
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDSJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  (∀ q ∈ Q_c,
    ‖rctActDJJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 - μ₀‖ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ ∧
    ‖rctActDS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
    ‖rctActDJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
    ‖rctActDSJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
    ‖rctActDJS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
    ‖rctActDJJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c) ∧
  (∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
    (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Q_c → (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Q_c →
    ‖rctActDS F S₁ J₁ T - rctActDS F S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤ M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖) ∧
    ‖rctActDJ F S₁ J₁ T - rctActDJ F S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤ M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖))

def CseStepSmall (J₀ μ₀ : ℂ) (r_c M_c b : ℝ) (T : ℂ) : Prop :=
  let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
  ‖a‖ ≤ 1 ∧
  ‖a‖ * (1 + ‖J₀‖ + r_c) ≤ r_c / 4 ∧
  ‖a‖ * M_c * (1 + ‖J₀‖) ≤ min (‖μ₀‖ / 8) (‖μ₀‖ * r_c / 32)

def CseInChartDom (S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ : ℂ) (r_c r_T M_c : ℝ) (S P_mom T : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ‖S - S₀‖ < min (r_c / 4) (‖μ₀‖ * r_c / (32 * M_c)) ∧
  ‖P_mom - P₀‖ < (1 / 16 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ * r_c ∧
  ‖T - T₀‖ < r_T

def CseSingleChartSolverProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S₀ J₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ : ℂ) (r_c r_T M_c b σ : ℝ),
    CseChartActionJet F S₀ J₀ T₀ μ₀ r_c M_c →
    0 < r_T → r_T ≤ r_c → 0 < b →
    (∀ T : ℂ, ‖T - T₀‖ < r_T →
      ‖rctActDJ F S₀ J₀ T - P₀‖ ≤ (1 / 32 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ * r_c) →
    (∀ S P_mom T : ℂ,
      CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c S P_mom T →
      CseStepSmall J₀ μ₀ r_c M_c b T →
      ‖cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T - J₀‖ ≤ r_c / 2 ∧
      cseChartG F b σ S T (cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T) = P_mom ∧
      ∀ D_test : ℂ, ‖D_test - J₀‖ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * r_c →
        ‖cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T - D_test‖ ≤
          (2 / ‖μ₀‖) * ‖cseChartG F b σ S T D_test - P_mom‖) ∧
    (let C_D : ℝ := 2 * (2 * M_c + 1) / ‖μ₀‖
     let C_step : ℝ := C_D + M_c * (1 + 2 * C_D)
     ∀ S₁ P₁ S₂ P₂ T : ℂ,
       CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c S₁ P₁ T →
       CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c S₂ P₂ T →
       CseStepSmall J₀ μ₀ r_c M_c b T →
       let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
       let q₁' := cseChartStep F μ₀ J₀ b σ S₁ P₁ T
       let q₂' := cseChartStep F μ₀ J₀ b σ S₂ P₂ T
       ‖q₁'.1 - q₂'.1‖ + ‖q₁'.2 - q₂'.2‖ ≤
         (1 + C_step * ‖a‖) * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖P₁ - P₂‖)) ∧
    (∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_fn P_fn T_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ S_fn W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ P_fn W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W →
      (∀ w ∈ W,
        CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c (S_fn w) (P_fn w) (T_fn w) ∧
        CseStepSmall J₀ μ₀ r_c M_c b (T_fn w)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun w => (cseChartStep F μ₀ J₀ b σ (S_fn w) (P_fn w) (T_fn w)).1) W ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun w => (cseChartStep F μ₀ J₀ b σ (S_fn w) (P_fn w) (T_fn w)).2) W)

noncomputable def cseModelState {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    {kind : ExpProfileKind} (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (Y T : ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
  rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_star (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) (S_star (Y, T)) T

def CseCorridorAtlasProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (K_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (σ T_max : ℝ),
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
    K_corr.Nonempty → IsCompact K_corr → K_corr ⊆ V_mod →
    (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → 0 < T_max →
    (∀ p ∈ K_corr, ‖p.2‖ ≤ T_max) →
    ∃ (η_corr r_tube r_init_atl C_Lip C_cons : ℝ) (N_atl : ℕ) (δ₀ : ℕ → ℝ)
      (Ψ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
      0 < η_corr ∧ 0 < r_tube ∧ 0 < r_init_atl ∧ 0 < C_Lip ∧ 0 < C_cons ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ δ₀ n) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto δ₀ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      let U_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | ∃ q ∈ K_corr, ‖p - q‖ < η_corr }
      IsOpen U_corr ∧ U_corr ⊆ V_mod ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y T : ℂ) (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq S_fn n Y T →
        ‖S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_star (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < r_init_atl →
        ‖S_fn Y - S_star (Y, T)‖ < r_init_atl →
        ‖S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_star (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < r_init_atl →
        ‖(S_fn Y - S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < r_init_atl →
        ‖(S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_fn Y) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < r_init_atl →
        Ψ n (Y, T)
          (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) (S_fn Y) T) =
          rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_fn Y) (S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) T) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y₀ T S_prev S_curr : ℂ),
        (Y₀, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let e_init : ℝ :=
          ‖S_curr - S_star (Y₀, T)‖ +
            ‖(S_curr - S_prev) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y₀‖
        e_init < r_init_atl →
        let q₀ := rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ S_prev S_curr T
        let q_mod := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y₀ T
        ‖q₀.1 - q_mod.1‖ + ‖q₀.2 - q_mod.2‖ ≤ C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n)) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y T : ℂ) (q₁ q₂ : ℂ × ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let q_mod := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y T
        ‖q₁.1 - q_mod.1‖ + ‖q₁.2 - q_mod.2‖ ≤ r_tube →
        ‖q₂.1 - q_mod.1‖ + ‖q₂.2 - q_mod.2‖ ≤ r_tube →
        ‖(Ψ n (Y, T) q₁).1 - (Ψ n (Y, T) q₂).1‖ +
          ‖(Ψ n (Y, T) q₁).2 - (Ψ n (Y, T) q₂).2‖ ≤
          (1 + C_Lip * ‖a_n‖) * (‖q₁.1 - q₂.1‖ + ‖q₁.2 - q₂.2‖)) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y T : ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let q_mod := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y T
        let q_mod_next := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) T
        ‖(Ψ n (Y, T) q_mod).1 - q_mod_next.1‖ +
          ‖(Ψ n (Y, T) q_mod).2 - q_mod_next.2‖ ≤ C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y T S : ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → ‖S - S_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ r_tube →
        expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Y₀_fn T_fn S_prev_fn S_curr_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Y₀_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ S_prev_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ S_curr_fn W →
        (∀ w ∈ W,
          (Y₀_fn w, T_fn w) ∈ U_corr ∧ T_fn w ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T_fn w‖ ≤ T_max ∧
          let a_n : ℂ := T_fn w / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          ‖S_curr_fn w - S_star (Y₀_fn w, T_fn w)‖ +
            ‖(S_curr_fn w - S_prev_fn w) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T_fn w)) (Y₀_fn w)‖ < r_init_atl) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun w => (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w)).1) W ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun w => (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w)).2) W) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Y_fn T_fn S_fn P_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Y_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ S_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ P_fn W →
        (∀ w ∈ W,
          (Y_fn w, T_fn w) ∈ U_corr ∧ T_fn w ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T_fn w‖ ≤ T_max ∧
          let q_mod := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y_fn w) (T_fn w)
          ‖S_fn w - q_mod.1‖ + ‖P_fn w - q_mod.2‖ ≤ r_tube) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => (Ψ n (Y_fn w, T_fn w) (S_fn w, P_fn w)).1) W ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => (Ψ n (Y_fn w, T_fn w) (S_fn w, P_fn w)).2) W)

noncomputable def idpluSlopeQ {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) (ξ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  dslope (fun z : ℂ => (I.P z)⁻¹) 0 ξ

noncomputable def idpluQ {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) (v : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, v * idpluSlopeQ I ((t : ℂ) * v)

noncomputable def idpluWMap {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) (v : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2 * v * Complex.exp (idpluQ I v)

noncomputable def idpluWReal {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) (r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * r * Real.exp ((idpluQ I (r : ℂ)).re)

noncomputable def idpluRadius {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) : ℝ :=
  sSup (idpluWReal I '' Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) I.v_c)

structure IdpluForwardDiskMapProp {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) : Prop where
  R_pos : 0 < idpluRadius I
  R_le : idpluRadius I ≤ 2 * I.v_c
  Q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (idpluQ I) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c)
  Q_zero : idpluQ I 0 = 0
  Q_even : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c, idpluQ I (-v) = idpluQ I v
  Q_real : ∀ r : ℝ, |r| < I.v_c → (idpluQ I (r : ℂ)).im = 0
  Q_mul_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c,
    v * deriv (idpluQ I) v = (I.P v)⁻¹ - 1
  w_map_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (idpluWMap I) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c)
  w_map_zero : idpluWMap I 0 = 0
  w_map_deriv_zero : deriv (idpluWMap I) 0 = 2
  w_map_odd : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c, idpluWMap I (-v) = -idpluWMap I v
  w_map_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c,
    deriv (idpluWMap I) v = 2 * Complex.exp (idpluQ I v) / I.P v
  w_map_real : ∀ r : ℝ, |r| < I.v_c → idpluWMap I (r : ℂ) = (idpluWReal I r : ℂ)
  w_real_cont : ContinuousOn (idpluWReal I) (Set.Ico 0 I.v_c)
  w_real_strictMono : StrictMonoOn (idpluWReal I) (Set.Ico 0 I.v_c)
  w_real_zero : idpluWReal I 0 = 0
  w_real_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (idpluWReal I)
    (nhdsWithin I.v_c (Set.Iio I.v_c)) (nhds (idpluRadius I))
  w_real_surj : ∀ y ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (idpluRadius I),
    ∃ r ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) I.v_c, idpluWReal I r = y
  w_real_props : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) I.v_c,
    0 < idpluWReal I r ∧ idpluWReal I r < idpluRadius I ∧
    HasDerivAt (idpluWReal I) (idpluWReal I r / (r * (I.P (r : ℂ)).re)) r

structure IdpluLocalNonnegOddSeriesData {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) where
  c : ℕ → ℝ
  r₀ : ℝ
  r₀_pos : 0 < r₀
  r₀_le_R : r₀ ≤ idpluRadius I
  c_zero : c 0 = 0
  c_one : c 1 = 1 / 2
  c_nonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ c n
  c_even_zero : ∀ k : ℕ, c (2 * k) = 0
  local_inv : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀,
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (c n : ℂ) * w ^ n) ∧
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, (c n : ℂ) * w ^ n‖ < I.v_c ∧
    idpluWMap I (∑' n : ℕ, (c n : ℂ) * w ^ n) = w

structure IdpluPringsheimInverseData {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) where
  v_inv : ℂ → ℂ
  v_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ v_inv (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (idpluRadius I))
  v_inv_zero : v_inv 0 = 0
  v_inv_odd : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (idpluRadius I), v_inv (-w) = -v_inv w
  v_inv_maps_to : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (idpluRadius I),
    v_inv w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c
  w_map_v_inv : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (idpluRadius I),
    idpluWMap I (v_inv w) = w
  v_inv_ode : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (idpluRadius I),
    w * deriv v_inv w = v_inv w * I.P (v_inv w)
  v_inv_real : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) I.v_c,
    v_inv (idpluWReal I r : ℂ) = (r : ℂ)

noncomputable def deepPassPt (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (ξ_seq d_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * Z

noncomputable def deepPassStep (d_seq B_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  T * (d_seq n : ℂ) / (B_seq n : ℂ)

noncomputable def deepPassActionSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) (ξ_seq d_seq B_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (T Z J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  smallChordActionP A.Phi (deepPassPt S ξ_seq d_seq n Z) J (deepPassStep d_seq B_seq n T)

noncomputable def deepPassPhiDS (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun s' : ℂ => Phi (s', q.2)) q.1

noncomputable def deepPassPhiDH (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun h' : ℂ => Phi (q.1, h')) q.2

structure DeepPassPartialCalculus (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop where
  phi_ds_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deepPassPhiDS A.Phi) (smallChordDomain S A.η_SL)
  phi_dh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deepPassPhiDH A.Phi) (smallChordDomain S A.η_SL)
  deriv_actionP_J : ∀ s J t : ℂ,
    (s, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    deriv (fun J' : ℂ => smallChordActionP A.Phi s J' t) J =
      3 * J ^ 2 * A.Phi (s, t * J) + J ^ 3 * t * deepPassPhiDH A.Phi (s, t * J)
  deriv_actionP_s : ∀ s J t : ℂ,
    (s, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    deriv (fun s' : ℂ => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J t) s =
      J ^ 3 * deepPassPhiDS A.Phi (s, t * J)
  cauchy_deriv_conv : ∀ (U_Z K_Z : Set ℂ) (ρ_K : ℝ)
      (g_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (g_lim : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U_Z → IsCompact K_Z → 0 < ρ_K →
    Metric.cthickening ρ_K K_Z ⊆ U_Z →
    (∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => g_seq n q.1 q.2)
        (U_Z ×ˢ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4))) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => g_lim q.1 q.2)
      (U_Z ×ˢ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4)) →
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ) => g_seq n q.1 q.2)
      (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => g_lim q.1 q.2)
      Filter.atTop (Metric.cthickening ρ_K K_Z ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 / 16)) →
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (fun J' => g_seq n q.1 J') q.2)
      (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => g_lim q.1 J') q.2)
      Filter.atTop (K_Z ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8)) ∧
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (fun Z' => g_seq n Z' q.2) q.1)
      (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun Z' => g_lim Z' q.2) q.1)
      Filter.atTop (K_Z ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8))

structure DeepPassConeCore (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (α A₀ T₀ δ_b : ℝ) (d_seq B_seq ξ_seq : ℕ → ℝ) where
  D_pass : ℝ
  C_A : ℝ
  C_pass : ℝ
  N_coarse : ℕ
  S_seq : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  D_pass_ge : 20 ≤ D_pass
  C_A_pos : 0 < C_A
  C_pass_pos : 0 < C_pass
  C_A_sq_le : C_A ^ 2 ≤ C_pass
  coarse_bound : ∀ n ≥ N_coarse, ∀ Z : ℂ,
    1 ≤ -Z.im → d_seq n * (-Z.im) ≤ δ_b → |Z.re| ≤ (A₀ + 6) * (-Z.im) →
    (d_seq n / B_seq n) * shapeModulus S (deepPassPt S ξ_seq d_seq n Z) ≤
      C_A * (-Z.im) ^ (-α)
  trunc_and_tube : ∀ R_top : ℝ, D_pass < R_top →
    ∃ N_cone : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_cone,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_seq n)
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1‖ < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * T₀ ∧
          D_pass / 2 < -p.2.im ∧ -p.2.im < R_top ∧
          |p.2.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-p.2.im) } ∧
      (∀ T Y : ℂ,
        ‖T‖ < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * T₀ →
        D_pass / 2 < -Y.im → -Y.im < R_top →
        |Y.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-Y.im) →
        (S_seq n (T, Y)).im < 0 ∧
        ‖S_seq n (T, Y) - Y‖ ≤ C_pass * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℂ, D_pass / 2 < -Y.im → -Y.im < R_top → |Y.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-Y.im) →
        S_seq n (0, Y) = Y) ∧
      (∀ T Y : ℂ,
        ‖T‖ < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * T₀ →
        D_pass / 2 < -Y.im → -Y.im < R_top →
        |Y.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-Y.im) →
        (deepPassPt S ξ_seq d_seq n Y, deepPassStep d_seq B_seq n T) ∈
          finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X →
        S_seq n (T, Y) =
          (S.𝔰 (deepPassPt S ξ_seq d_seq n Y, deepPassStep d_seq B_seq n T) -
            (ξ_seq n : ℂ) - (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I) / (d_seq n : ℂ))

structure DeepPassRecurrenceData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) (α A₀ T₀ δ_b : ℝ)
    (d_seq B_seq ξ_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (C_core : DeepPassConeCore S α A₀ T₀ δ_b d_seq B_seq ξ_seq) where
  D_rec : ℝ
  D_rec_ge : C_core.D_pass ≤ D_rec
  small_field_on_D_rec :
    4 * T₀ ^ 2 * C_core.C_A ^ 2 * (2 / D_rec) ^ (2 * α) < min (A.η_SL / 2) 4
  compact_chord_admissible : ∀ K_pad : Set ℂ, IsCompact K_pad →
    K_pad ⊆ { Z : ℂ | D_rec / 2 < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A₀ + 4) * (-Z.im) } →
    (∃ N_adm : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_adm,
      ∀ Z ∈ K_pad, ∀ J : ℂ, ‖J‖ ≤ 5 / 4 → ∀ T' : ℂ, ‖T'‖ ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) * T₀ →
        (deepPassPt S ξ_seq d_seq n Z, deepPassStep d_seq B_seq n T' * J) ∈
          smallChordDomain S A.η_SL) ∧
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N_deriv : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_deriv,
      ∀ Z ∈ K_pad, ∀ J : ℂ, ‖J‖ ≤ 5 / 4 → ∀ T' : ℂ, ‖T'‖ ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) * T₀ →
        ‖(deepPassStep d_seq B_seq n T' * J) ^ 2 *
          deriv S.f (deepPassPt S ξ_seq d_seq n Z)‖ < ε)
  action_holo_on_open : ∀ T : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ →
    ∀ K_Z : Set ℂ, IsCompact K_Z →
      K_Z ⊆ { Z : ℂ | D_rec < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-Z.im) } →
      ∃ (U_Z : Set ℂ) (ρ_K : ℝ),
        IsOpen U_Z ∧ 0 < ρ_K ∧ K_Z ⊆ U_Z ∧
        Metric.cthickening ρ_K K_Z ⊆ U_Z ∧
        Metric.cthickening (2 * ρ_K) K_Z ⊆
          { Z : ℂ | D_rec / 2 < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A₀ + 4) * (-Z.im) } ∧
        U_Z ⊆ { Z : ℂ | D_rec / 2 < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A₀ + 4) * (-Z.im) } ∧
        ∃ N_holo : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_holo,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deepPassActionSeq S A ξ_seq d_seq B_seq n T q.1 q.2)
            (U_Z ×ˢ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4)) ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun q : ℂ × ℂ =>
              deriv (fun J' => deepPassActionSeq S A ξ_seq d_seq B_seq n T q.1 J') q.2)
            (U_Z ×ˢ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4))
  recurrence_eq : ∀ R_top : ℝ, 3 * D_rec < R_top →
    ∀ T : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ → T ≠ 0 →
      ∃ N_rec : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_rec,
        ∀ Y : ℂ, 2 * D_rec < -Y.im → -Y.im < R_top - 2 → |Y.re| < (A₀ + 2) * (-Y.im) →
          let h_n : ℂ := T / (B_seq n : ℂ)
          let J_p : ℂ := (C_core.S_seq n (T, Y + h_n) - C_core.S_seq n (T, Y)) / h_n
          let J_m : ℂ := (C_core.S_seq n (T, Y) - C_core.S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)) / h_n
          ‖J_p - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16 ∧ ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16 ∧
          D_rec < -(C_core.S_seq n (T, Y)).im ∧
          |(C_core.S_seq n (T, Y)).re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-(C_core.S_seq n (T, Y)).im) ∧
          D_rec < -(C_core.S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)).im ∧
          |(C_core.S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)).re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-(C_core.S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)).im) ∧
          deriv (fun J' => deepPassActionSeq S A ξ_seq d_seq B_seq n T (C_core.S_seq n (T, Y)) J') J_p -
            deriv (fun J' => deepPassActionSeq S A ξ_seq d_seq B_seq n T (C_core.S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)) J') J_m =
            h_n * deriv (fun Z' => deepPassActionSeq S A ξ_seq d_seq B_seq n T Z' J_p) (C_core.S_seq n (T, Y))

noncomputable def steepRowEnergy (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
    (‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2 +
      ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖)

structure SteepDiagonalRowData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (δ_b C_tail' : ℝ) (h_seq ℓ_seq m0_seq : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  C_tail_pos : 0 < C_tail'
  row_basic : ∀ j : ℕ,
    0 < h_seq j ∧
    h_seq j < S.H ∧
    S.H - h_seq j < δ_b ∧
    0 < ℓ_seq j ∧
    0 < m0_seq j ∧
    3 * ((j : ℝ) + 3) * ℓ_seq j < S.H - h_seq j ∧
    steepRowEnergy S (h_seq j) = (m0_seq j) ^ 2
  h_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds S.H)
  ℓ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto ℓ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  prod_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => ℓ_seq j * m0_seq j) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  ratio_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => (S.H - h_seq j) / ℓ_seq j) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  unit_band_bound : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
    |h_seq j + ℓ_seq j * u| < S.H ∧
    steepRowEnergy S (h_seq j + ℓ_seq j * u) / (m0_seq j) ^ 2 ≤
      Real.exp (2 * u) + (4 * Real.exp 2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1))⁻¹
  local_band_bound : ∀ j : ℕ,
    ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-2 * ((j : ℝ) + 2)) (2 * ((j : ℝ) + 2)),
      |h_seq j + ℓ_seq j * u| < S.H ∧
      steepRowEnergy S (h_seq j + ℓ_seq j * u) / (m0_seq j) ^ 2 ≤
        2 * Real.exp (2 * |u|) + 1
  coarse_tail_bound : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ v → ℓ_seq j * v ≤ (5 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_b →
    |h_seq j - ℓ_seq j * v| < S.H ∧
    steepRowEnergy S (h_seq j - ℓ_seq j * v) / (m0_seq j) ^ 2 ≤
      C_tail' * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ))

def DyadicShadowBoundAt (L₀ M_lat C_shad : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (p d τ M_top U₀ H_def : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (N : ℕ) (x_T d_T ρ_T : Fin N → ℝ),
    0 < d → 0 < τ → τ < d / 4 → 0 ≤ U₀ → 0 < H_def →

      d_T i ≤ d / 2 ∧ |x_T i - p| ≤ (L₀ + 3) * d ∧ τ < d_T i / 4) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F criticalLowerHalfPlane →
    (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * d → τ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * d →
      ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top) →

      C_shad * d * (U₀ / H_def)

def DyadicChainRoutingAt (C_route C_len : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (c : Fin (m + 1) → ℂ) (ρ : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (M T : ℝ),
    0 < T →

        meshClosedSquare (c k.succ) (ρ k.succ)).Nonempty ∧
      ρ k.castSucc / 2 ≤ ρ k.succ ∧ ρ k.succ ≤ 2 * ρ k.castSucc) →

    ∃ (γ : List ℂ) (hγ : γ ≠ []),

      γ.getLast hγ ∈ meshClosedSquare (c (Fin.last m)) (ρ (Fin.last m)) ∧
      meshPolyTrace γ ⊆ (⋃ k : Fin (m + 1), meshClosedSquare (c k) (9 * ρ k)) ∧
      meshPolyLength γ ≤ C_len * (∑ k : Fin (m + 1), ρ k) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ meshPolyTrace γ, Real.exp (M - C_route * T) ≤ ‖F z‖

      0 < ρ k ∧
      1024 * ρ k ≤ -(c k).im ∧

      (c k).re ≤ x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - ρ k / 2 ∧

def EpochBandScheduleData (F : ℂ → ℂ) (lam L₀ M_lat C_small : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (u ε_seq M_top : ℕ → ℝ) (L_a L_b : ℕ → ℕ),
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ u j ∧ u j + 1 ≤ u (j + 1)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, 0 < ε_seq j ∧ ε_seq j ≤ C_small) ∧
    Antitone ε_seq ∧
    Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 / C_small ≤ ε_seq j * u j) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, 10 ≤ L_b j ∧ L_b j + 4 ≤ L_a j ∧ L_a j + 4 ≤ L_b (j + 1)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ((L_a (j + 2) + 3 - (L_b j - 3) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ε_seq j * u j) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, lam * u j ≤ M_top j ∧ M_top j ≤ lam * u j + C_small * (ε_seq j * u j)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ z : ℂ,
      |z.re| ≤ 5 →
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a (j + 2) + 6))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im →
      -z.im ≤ 16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b j)⁻¹ →
      ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ x₀ : ℝ, |x₀| ≤ 3 →
      ∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
        16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_a j)⁻¹ < δ_w ∧
        δ_w < ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b j)⁻¹ / 16 ∧
        |p - x₀| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
        (L₀ + M_lat) * δ_w ≤ 1 ∧
        Real.exp (M_top j - C_small * (ε_seq j * u j)) ≤
          ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w →
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a j + 3))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * δ_w →
          ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j))) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ x₀ : ℝ, |x₀| ≤ 3 →
      ∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
        16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_b j - 3))⁻¹ < δ_w ∧
        |p - x₀| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
        (L₀ + M_lat + 2) * δ_w ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
        Real.exp (M_top j - C_small * (ε_seq j * u j)) ≤
          ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w →
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a (j + 2) + 6))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * δ_w →
          ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j)))

noncomputable def ldtTruncDeficit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  K - Real.log (max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m))

structure LdtTruncPotentialToolkit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  cont_on : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ),
    ContinuousOn (ldtTruncDeficit S K m) (horizStrip S.H)
  periodic : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
    ldtTruncDeficit S K m (z + 2 * Real.pi) = ldtTruncDeficit S K m z
  conj_symm : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
    ldtTruncDeficit S K m (starRingEnd ℂ z) = ldtTruncDeficit S K m z
  nonneg_of_norm_le : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
    0 ≤ K → ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K → 0 ≤ ldtTruncDeficit S K m z
  le_of_exp_sub_le : ∀ (K D : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
    Real.exp (K - D) ≤ ‖S.f z‖ → ldtTruncDeficit S K m z ≤ D
  monotone_trunc : ∀ (K : ℝ) (z : ℂ),
    Monotone (fun m : ℕ => ldtTruncDeficit S K m z)
  ofReal_deficit_le_iSup_trunc : ∀ (K : ℝ) (z : ℂ),
    ENNReal.ofReal (K - Real.log ‖S.f z‖) ≤
      ⨆ m : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (ldtTruncDeficit S K m z)
  circle_supermean : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ),
    0 < r → Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
    Real.circleAverage (ldtTruncDeficit S K m) z₀ r ≤ ldtTruncDeficit S K m z₀
  ball_supermean : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z₀ : ℂ) (R : ℝ),
    0 < R → Metric.closedBall z₀ R ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
    (Real.pi * R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ R, ldtTruncDeficit S K m w) ≤
      ldtTruncDeficit S K m z₀
  ball_deficit_le_of_trunc_le : ∀ (K B : ℝ) (z₀ : ℂ) (Δ : ℝ),
    0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ B → 0 < Δ →
    Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ, ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K) →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w : ℂ => K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖)
      (Metric.ball z₀ Δ) MeasureTheory.volume →
    (∀ m : ℕ, (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, ldtTruncDeficit S K m w) ≤ B) →
    (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖)) ≤ B
  slab_max_principle : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (Φ : ℂ → ℝ),
    a < b →
    ContinuousOn Φ { z : ℂ | a ≤ z.im ∧ z.im ≤ b } →
    (∀ z : ℂ, a ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ b → Φ (z + 2 * Real.pi) = Φ z) →
    (∀ x : ℝ, Φ ((x : ℂ) + (a : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤ 0 ∧
      Φ ((x : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤ 0) →
    (∀ z₀ : ℂ, a < z₀.im → z₀.im < b →
      ∃ r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < r₀ →
        Φ z₀ ≤ Real.circleAverage Φ z₀ r) →
    ∀ z : ℂ, a ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ b → Φ z ≤ 0

structure LdtRowAndMomentData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  row_mean_bound : ∃ C_row : ℝ, 0 < C_row ∧
    ∀ (K y : ℝ) (m : ℕ), |y| < S.H →
