  weighted_shifted_balls_bound :
    ∀ (F ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (centers : Finset ℂ) (Δ K C₀ B_row : ℝ),
      Continuous F → Continuous ρ →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ F x) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ρ x) →
      0 < Δ → 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ C₀ → 0 ≤ B_row →
      (∀ c ∈ centers, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ ⊆ horizStrip S.H) →
      (∀ c ∈ centers, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ, ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K) →
      (∀ c ∈ centers, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w : ℂ => K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖)
          (Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ) MeasureTheory.volume) →
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        F x ≤ C₀ * ∑ c ∈ centers,
          (1 + (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ *
            ∫ w in Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ, (K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖))) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ), ∀ c ∈ centers, ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Δ,
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          ldtTruncDeficit S K m ((x : ℂ) + c + u) * ρ x) ≤ B_row) →
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x * ρ x) ≤
        C₀ * (centers.card : ℝ) *
          ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ρ x) + B_row)
  sqrt_q_first_moment :
    ∃ C_q : ℝ, 0 < C_q ∧
      ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        Real.exp (-k) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) ≤
          C_q * (1 + k)

noncomputable def mpwcPolyIntegral (f : ℂ → ℂ) : List ℂ → ℂ
  | [] => 0
  | [_] => 0
  | a :: b :: rest =>
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ), (b - a) * f ((1 - t) • a + t • b)) +
        mpwcPolyIntegral f (b :: rest)

open Classical in
noncomputable def mpwcPolyPrefixTo :
    (L : List ℂ) → L ≠ [] → (p : ℂ) → p ∈ meshPolyTrace L → List ℂ
  | [], hL, _, _ => absurd rfl hL
  | [_], _, p, _ => [p]
  | a :: b :: rest, _, p, hp =>
      if hseg : p ∈ segment ℝ a b then [a, p]
      else a :: mpwcPolyPrefixTo (b :: rest) (List.cons_ne_nil b rest) p (hp.resolve_left hseg)

def sliceRegClosedComp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Set ℂ :=
  (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all)ᶜ

noncomputable def sliceSingDist (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  Metric.infDist y (sliceRegClosedComp S P)

noncomputable def sliceSafeBallRad (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 4 : ℝ) * min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y)

noncomputable def sliceLocalSupTerm (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (k : Fin P.N) (ζ : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N k.val ζ‖ ^ 6 +
    (‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N k.val ζ‖ ^ 6)⁻¹ +
    Real.exp (6 * |(sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val ζ).im|) +
    ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 k ζ)‖ ^ 6 +
    (‖Complex.sin (P.d0 k ζ)‖ ^ 6)⁻¹ +
    ‖P.ℓ_slice k ζ‖ ^ 6 +
    (‖P.ℓ_slice k ζ‖ ^ 6)⁻¹

noncomputable def sliceLocalSupDenom (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  1 + ∑ k : Fin P.N,
    sSup ((fun u : ℂ => sliceLocalSupTerm S P k (y + (sliceSafeBallRad S P y : ℂ) * u)) ''
      Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1)

noncomputable def adaptiveStepRadius (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (L : ℝ) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (Real.exp (-4 * (max L 2) ^ 7) / (10000 * (1 + S.H + S.c) ^ 3)) *
    ((min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y)) ^ 4 / sliceLocalSupDenom S P y)

structure IsScaleAdmissibleStep (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (M : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) : Prop where
  scale_ge_two : 2 ≤ M
  measurable : Measurable ρ
  periodic : ∀ y : ℂ, ρ (y + 2 * Real.pi) = ρ y
  cont_on : ContinuousOn ρ (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all)
  nonneg : ∀ y : ℂ, 0 ≤ ρ y
  pos_iff : ∀ y : ℂ, 0 < ρ y ↔ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all
  le_sing_dist : ∀ y : ℂ, ρ y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y)
  small_shape_step : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤
        Real.exp (-M ^ 2) * sliceShapeDepth S P j y
  jump_log_speed : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      |Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y + z)‖ -
        Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖| ≤ 1
  jump_log_sin_d0 : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (y + z))‖ -
        Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖| ≤ 1
  jump_log_chord : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (y + z)‖ - Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖| ≤ 1
  jump_angle : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ 1
  jump_pos : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ 1
  taylor_impact : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y -
          deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y
  taylor_angle : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y -
          deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y
  taylor_pos₀ : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) 0 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0 -
          deriv (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w 0) y * z‖ ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y
  taylor_pos₁ : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) 1 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1 -
          deriv (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w 1) y * z‖ ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y
  taylor_support : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y -
          deriv (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y

structure WalkBaseAndStopProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_clk : ℝ) : Prop where
  C_clk_pos : 0 < C_clk
  walk_in_reg : ∀ M : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ,
      walkPos ρ om m ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all ∧
      0 < ρ (walkPos ρ om m)
  walk_stops : ∀ M : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure,
      ∃ m : ℕ, M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)
  walk_clock : ∀ M : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
        (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
      (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) ≤ C_clk
  impact_sq_sum : ∀ M : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun om : WalkSpace => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
          ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (m + 1)) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
      (∫ om, (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (m + 1)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) ≤ 2 * S.H ^ 2

def SliceRetreatBoundProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop :=
  ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
    ∃ M_ret : ℝ, 2 ≤ M_ret ∧
      ∀ M : ℝ, M_ret ≤ M →
        ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
          walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
            ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, ∃ j : Fin P.N,
              sliceLogDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om m) <
                sliceHistory S P ρ om j m - 4 * Real.log M} ≤ δ

structure AdmissibleHittingAndClockProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_hit C_rem : ℝ) : Prop where
  C_hit_pos : 0 < C_hit
  C_rem_pos : 0 < C_rem
  first_hit_dom : ∀ M d r_int : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ E : Set ℝ,
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    0 < d → d < S.H / 4 →
    100 * Real.exp (-M ^ 2) * d ≤ r_int →
    MeasurableSet E → (∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ E ↔ x + 2 * Real.pi ∈ E) →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d) ∧
      Set.Ioo
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos ρ om (sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om))).re - r_int)
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos ρ om (sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om))).re + r_int) ⊆
        E} ≤
    C_hit * MeasureTheory.volume.real (E ∩ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))
  rem_clock_tail : ∀ M d B : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → 1 ≤ B → d * Real.exp (B / 4) < S.H / 4 →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      d ^ 2 * Real.exp B <
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om)
            (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
          ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2 *
            (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2} ≤
    C_rem * Real.exp (-B / 4)
  stopped_disp : ∀ M d r_exit q_K : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ,
    ∀ (J : Finset (Fin P.N)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (i : Fin P.N),
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    i ∈ J → 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → 0 < r_exit → 0 < q_K →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ M d J hJ om)
          (sliceDiskExit S P ρ M d r_exit J hJ i om),
        (2 * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2 +
          Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) *
          (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2 ≤ q_K) ∧
      r_exit <
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos ρ om (sliceDiskExit S P ρ M d r_exit J hJ i om)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos ρ om (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ M d J hJ om))‖} ≤
    2 * q_K / r_exit ^ 2

def StoppedLogDeficitProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop :=
  ∀ g : ℂ → ℂ,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ g (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, g y ≠ 0) →
    (∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
      -C₀ ≤ Real.log ‖g x‖ ∧ Real.log ‖g x‖ ≤ C₀) →
    ∃ C_g : ℝ, 0 < C_g ∧
      ∀ M B₀ B₁ : ℝ, 1 ≤ B₀ → 1 ≤ B₁ →
        ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
          (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y →
            |Real.log ‖g (y + z)‖ - Real.log ‖g y‖| ≤ 1) →
          walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
            ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
              (∀ l < m, Real.log ‖g (walkPos ρ om l)‖ ≤ B₀) ∧
              Real.log ‖g (walkPos ρ om m)‖ < -B₁} ≤
            C_g * (1 + B₀) / (1 + B₁)

structure AdmissibleModifiedInverseProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_inv : ℝ) : Prop where
  C_inv_pos : 0 < C_inv
  inv_bound : ∀ M U V : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ,
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ → 1 ≤ U → U ≤ V →
    ∀ I F : Finset (Fin P.N), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
      ∃ E_bad : Set WalkSpace, MeasurableSet E_bad ∧
        walkMeasure.real E_bad ≤ C_inv * (1 + U) / (1 + V) ∧
        ∀ om : WalkSpace, om ∉ E_bad →
          ∀ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
            (∀ n ≤ m, sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ U) →
            (∀ i ∈ I, sliceHistory S P ρ om i m ≤ U) →
            ∃ B_inv : Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ,
              P.B_mat I F (walkPos ρ om m) * B_inv = 1 ∧
              B_inv * P.B_mat I F (walkPos ρ om m) = 1 ∧
              ∀ r c : Fin P.N, ‖B_inv r c‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_inv * V)

def HasUniformPowerGeometry (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (σ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ A_cap : ℝ, 1 ≤ A_cap ∧
    ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
      ∃ M₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ M₀ ∧
        ∀ M M_cap : ℝ, M₀ ≤ M → A_cap * M ≤ M_cap →
          ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M_cap ρ →
            walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
              ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
                M ^ σ < sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om m)} ≤ δ

def dyadicDropUntil {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (x : α) : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | y :: ys => if y = x then y :: ys else dyadicDropUntil x ys

def dyadicParentIdx (i j : ℕ) : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ :=
  let m := Nat.log 2 (1024 + j) - 10
  (m, i / 2 ^ m, (1024 + j) / 2 ^ m - 1024)

def dyadicValidTile (M_w L_min L_max : ℕ) (t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : Prop :=
  t.1 < L_max - L_min ∧ t.2.1 < M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - t.1) ∧ t.2.2 < 1024

noncomputable def dyadicTileSide (L_max : ℕ) (t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ t.1 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 10))⁻¹

noncomputable def dyadicTileX (x_left : ℝ) (L_max : ℕ) (t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : ℝ :=
  x_left + ((t.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicTileSide L_max t

noncomputable def dyadicTileDepth (L_max : ℕ) (t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (1024 + (t.2.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicTileSide L_max t

noncomputable def dyadicTileCenter (x_left : ℝ) (L_max : ℕ) (t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (dyadicTileX x_left L_max t : ℂ) - (dyadicTileDepth L_max t : ℂ) * Complex.I

noncomputable def stepOccupDensity (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (ε h₀ s x v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if |truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v x)| ≤ h₀ then
    ∫ u : ℝ,
      min ((truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S (v + s) (x + u)) -
        truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v x)) ^ 2) (h₀ ^ 2) *
      stripExitKernel (S.H - Real.exp (-(v + s))) (S.H - Real.exp (-v)) u
  else 0

def dtpcChainSpace : ℕ → Type
  | 0 => ℝ
  | n + 1 => dtpcChainSpace n × ℝ

instance dtpcInstMeasurableChainSpace : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasurableSpace (dtpcChainSpace n)
  | 0 => Real.measurableSpace
  | n + 1 => @Prod.instMeasurableSpace (dtpcChainSpace n) ℝ
      (dtpcInstMeasurableChainSpace n) Real.measurableSpace

noncomputable def dtpcStepMeasure (κ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ :=
  MeasureTheory.volume.withDensity (fun u : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (κ m u))

noncomputable def dtpcChainMeasure (κ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) :
    (n : ℕ) → MeasureTheory.Measure (dtpcChainSpace n)
  | 0 =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ •
        MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))
  | n + 1 =>
      (dtpcChainMeasure κ n).prod (dtpcStepMeasure κ n)

def dtpcChainPath : ∀ (n : ℕ), dtpcChainSpace n → (ℕ → ℝ)
  | 0, x₀, _ => x₀
  | n + 1, p, k =>
      if k ≤ n then dtpcChainPath n p.1 k else dtpcChainPath n p.1 n + p.2

def dtpcStepExtend (m : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (u : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  fun k => if k ≤ m then w k else w m + u

def dtpcDependsUpTo (r : ℕ) (Φ : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k ≤ r, w₁ k = w₂ k) → Φ w₁ = Φ w₂

noncomputable def dtpcStopX (R : ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ
  | 0, w => g 0 (w 0)
  | m + 1, w =>
      if ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), g k (w k) ≤ R then
        g (m + 1) (w (m + 1))
      else
        dtpcStopX R g m w

structure AdaptiveStepTopPackage (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop where
  cont : ∀ L : ℝ, Continuous (adaptiveStepRadius S P L)
  periodic : ∀ L : ℝ, ∀ y : ℂ,
    adaptiveStepRadius S P L (y + 2 * Real.pi) = adaptiveStepRadius S P L y
  nonneg : ∀ L : ℝ, ∀ y : ℂ, 0 ≤ adaptiveStepRadius S P L y
  pos_iff : ∀ L : ℝ, ∀ y : ℂ,
    0 < adaptiveStepRadius S P L y ↔ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all
  le_sing_dist : ∀ L : ℝ, ∀ y : ℂ,
    adaptiveStepRadius S P L y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y)
  denom_ge_one : ∀ y : ℂ, 1 ≤ sliceLocalSupDenom S P y
  safe_ball_sub_and_le : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ k : Fin P.N, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall y (sliceSafeBallRad S P y),
      ζ ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all ∧
      sliceLocalSupTerm S P k ζ ≤ sliceLocalSupDenom S P y

noncomputable def stripPoissonKernel (h sgn t v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.cos (Real.pi * v / (2 * h)) /
    (4 * h * (Real.cosh (Real.pi * t / (2 * h)) - sgn * Real.sin (Real.pi * v / (2 * h))))

noncomputable def stripPoissonExt (h : ℝ) (ϕ_pos ϕ_neg : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : ℝ, (ϕ_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
    ϕ_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h (-1) (y.re - x) y.im)

structure StripPoissonToolkitProp (h : ℝ) : Prop where
  cont_on_and_bound : ∀ (ϕ_pos ϕ_neg : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ),
    Measurable ϕ_pos → Measurable ϕ_neg → 0 ≤ B →
    (∀ x : ℝ, |ϕ_pos x| ≤ B) → (∀ x : ℝ, |ϕ_neg x| ≤ B) →
    ContinuousOn (stripPoissonExt h ϕ_pos ϕ_neg) (horizStrip h) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip h, |stripPoissonExt h ϕ_pos ϕ_neg y| ≤ B) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, ∀ R : ℝ, Metric.closedBall y |R| ⊆ horizStrip h →
      Real.circleAverage (stripPoissonExt h ϕ_pos ϕ_neg) y R =
        stripPoissonExt h ϕ_pos ϕ_neg y)
  real_period_integral : ∀ (ϕ_pos ϕ_neg : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ),
    Measurable ϕ_pos → Measurable ϕ_neg →
    Function.Periodic ϕ_pos (2 * Real.pi) → Function.Periodic ϕ_neg (2 * Real.pi) →
    0 ≤ B → (∀ x : ℝ, |ϕ_pos x| ≤ B) → (∀ x : ℝ, |ϕ_neg x| ≤ B) →
    (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      stripPoissonExt h ϕ_pos ϕ_neg (x : ℂ)) =
    (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (ϕ_pos x + ϕ_neg x))
  tendsto_boundary : ∀ (ϕ_pos ϕ_neg : ℝ → ℝ),
    Continuous ϕ_pos → Continuous ϕ_neg →
    Function.Periodic ϕ_pos (2 * Real.pi) → Function.Periodic ϕ_neg (2 * Real.pi) →
    ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
      Filter.Tendsto (stripPoissonExt h ϕ_pos ϕ_neg)
        (nhdsWithin ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I) (horizStrip h))
        (nhds (ϕ_pos x₀)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (stripPoissonExt h ϕ_pos ϕ_neg)
        (nhdsWithin ((x₀ : ℂ) - (h : ℂ) * Complex.I) (horizStrip h))
        (nhds (ϕ_neg x₀))
  slice_l2_domination : ∀ (v : ℂ → ℝ) (v_pos v_neg : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ),
    ContinuousOn v (horizStrip h) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip h, v (y + 2 * Real.pi) = v y) →
    0 ≤ B → (∀ y ∈ horizStrip h, |v y| ≤ B) →
    (∀ y : ℂ, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ horizStrip h →
      Real.circleAverage v y r = v y) →
    Measurable v_pos → Measurable v_neg →
    Function.Periodic v_pos (2 * Real.pi) → Function.Periodic v_neg (2 * Real.pi) →
    (∀ x : ℝ, |v_pos x| ≤ B ∧ |v_neg x| ≤ B) →
    (∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ => v ((x : ℂ) + (((1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (v_pos x)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ => v ((x : ℂ) - (((1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (v_neg x))) →
    ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h,
      let h_n : ℝ := (1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) * h
      let ϕ_n_pos : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => v ((x : ℂ) + (h_n : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      let ϕ_n_neg : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => v ((x : ℂ) - (h_n : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      (v y - stripPoissonExt h ϕ_n_pos ϕ_n_neg y) ^ 2 ≤
        stripPoissonExt h
          (fun x => (v_pos x - ϕ_n_pos x) ^ 2)
          (fun x => (v_neg x - ϕ_n_neg x) ^ 2) y

structure AdmissibleWalkWallExitProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (M : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) : Prop where
  walk_in_reg : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ,
    walkPos ρ om m ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all ∧
    0 < ρ (walkPos ρ om m)
  walk_clock :
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
        (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
      (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) ≤ 2 * (sliceHeight S P.N) ^ 2
  impact_sq_sum : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (m + 1)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
      ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (m + 1)) -
        sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) ≤ 2 * S.H ^ 2
  harmonic_expectation_eq : ∀ (U : ℂ → ℝ) (B : ℝ),
    ContinuousOn U (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N)) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N), |U y| ≤ B) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
      Real.circleAverage U y (ρ y) = U y) →
    ∀ m : ℕ,
      (∫ om, U (walkPos ρ om m) ∂walkMeasure) =
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), U (x : ℂ)
  ae_wall_exit_and_impact_im_conv :
    ∃ (x_inf sgn_inf : WalkSpace → ℝ) (v_inf : Fin P.N → WalkSpace → ℝ),
      Measurable x_inf ∧ Measurable sgn_inf ∧ (∀ j : Fin P.N, Measurable (v_inf j)) ∧
      ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure,
        (sgn_inf om = 1 ∨ sgn_inf om = -1) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => walkPos ρ om m) Filter.atTop
          (nhds ((x_inf om : ℂ) + ((sgn_inf om * sliceHeight S P.N : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ∧
        ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun m : ℕ => (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m)).im)
            Filter.atTop (nhds (v_inf j om))

noncomputable def oddSliceN (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : ℕ :=
  2 * Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) + 3

instance oddSliceNeZero (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : NeZero (oddSliceN S) :=
  ⟨by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩

noncomputable def oddSliceCRec (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : ℝ :=
  2 * (oddSliceN S : ℝ) + 3

noncomputable def holoScaledPos (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  ![S.f s * S.H0 s * Complex.cos (S.ϕ s) - deriv S.H0 s * Complex.sin (S.ϕ s),
    S.f s * S.H0 s * Complex.sin (S.ϕ s) + deriv S.H0 s * Complex.cos (S.ϕ s)]

noncomputable def oddSliceTheta (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (Real.pi : ℂ) +
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (oddSliceN S),
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) (j - (m : ℤ)) y

noncomputable def stateShiftedAngle (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) (m : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  if h : m ≤ j.val then
    S.ϕ (z ⟨j.val - m, by omega⟩)
  else
    S.ϕ (z ⟨(j.val + oddSliceN S - m) % oddSliceN S,
      Nat.mod_lt _ (by unfold oddSliceN; omega)⟩) - 2 * Real.pi

noncomputable def stateTheta (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  (Real.pi : ℂ) +
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (oddSliceN S), (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * stateShiftedAngle S z j m

noncomputable def stateD0 (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  stateTheta S z j - S.ϕ (z j)

noncomputable def stateChordNum (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  let j_next : Fin (oddSliceN S) := @cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j;
  let K₀ : Fin 2 → ℂ := holoScaledPos S (z j);
  let K₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ := holoScaledPos S (z j_next);
  (-(S.f (z j) * K₁ 0 - S.f (z j_next) * K₀ 0)) * Complex.sin (stateTheta S z j) +
    (S.f (z j) * K₁ 1 - S.f (z j_next) * K₀ 1) * Complex.cos (stateTheta S z j)

noncomputable def oddSliceStateVec (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (y : ℂ) :
    Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ :=
  fun j => sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y

noncomputable def oddSliceChordNum (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j

noncomputable def stateDeltaRow (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (∏ m : Fin (oddSliceN S), stateChordNum S z m) *
    (∏ m : Fin (oddSliceN S), Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m))

noncomputable def stateClearedM0Entry (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (i k : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  let inst : NeZero (oddSliceN S) := oddSliceNeZero S
  let ip : Fin (oddSliceN S) := @cycPrev (oddSliceN S) inst i
  let inext : Fin (oddSliceN S) := @cycNext (oddSliceN S) inst i
  let knext : Fin (oddSliceN S) := @cycNext (oddSliceN S) inst k
  let P_sin : ℂ := ∏ m : Fin (oddSliceN S), Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m)
  let P_ell_omit : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ :=
    fun r => ∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, stateChordNum S z m
  (if i = k then
      (S.f (z ip) * S.f (z i) * P_ell_omit ip +
        S.f (z i) * S.f (z inext) * P_ell_omit i) * P_sin
    else 0) +
  (if k = inext then S.f (z i) * S.f (z inext) * P_ell_omit i * P_sin else 0) +
  (if i = knext then S.f (z k) * S.f (z knext) * P_ell_omit k * P_sin else 0)

noncomputable def stateClearedVDiag (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (i : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  (2 / (S.c : ℂ)) * (S.f (z i)) ^ 3 *
    (∏ m : Fin (oddSliceN S), stateChordNum S z m) *
    (∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m))

noncomputable def stateClearedB (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (I F : Finset (Fin (oddSliceN S))) (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin (oddSliceN S)) (Fin (oddSliceN S)) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun i k =>
    if i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F then
      stateClearedM0Entry S z i k - (if i = k ∧ i ∈ I then stateClearedVDiag S z i else 0)
    else if i = k then stateDeltaRow S z else 0

def oddSliceZAll (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Set ℂ :=
  { y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) ∧
    ((∃ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
        S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y j) = 0 ∨
        Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) = 0 ∨
        stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j = 0) ∨
     (∃ I F : Finset (Fin (oddSliceN S)),
        I ⊂ Finset.univ ∧ Disjoint I F ∧
        (stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det = 0)) }

structure OddSliceChordProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  impact_holo : ∀ k : ℤ,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) k)
      (horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)))
  impact_maps_to : ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) k y ∈ horizStrip S.H
  impact_quasiperiodic : ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) k (y + 2 * Real.pi) =
      sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) k y + 2 * Real.pi
  impact_shift_N : ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) (k + (oddSliceN S : ℤ)) y =
      sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) k y + 2 * Real.pi
  impact_conj : ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) k (starRingEnd ℂ y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) k y)
  holoScaledPos_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s => holoScaledPos S s i) (horizStrip S.H)
  holoScaledPos_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H,
    holoScaledPos S (s + 2 * Real.pi) = holoScaledPos S s
  holoScaledPos_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H, S.f s ≠ 0 → ∀ i : Fin 2,
    holoScaledPos S s i = S.f s * S.Γ s i
  θ_holo : ∀ j : ℤ,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (oddSliceTheta S j) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)))
  θ_quasiperiodic : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    oddSliceTheta S j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = oddSliceTheta S j y + 2 * Real.pi
  θ_shift_N : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    oddSliceTheta S (j + (oddSliceN S : ℤ)) y = oddSliceTheta S j y + 2 * Real.pi
  θ_conj : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    oddSliceTheta S j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (oddSliceTheta S j y)
  θ_sum : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    oddSliceTheta S (j - 1) y + oddSliceTheta S j y = 2 * sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j y
  θ_real : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ x : ℝ,
    oddSliceTheta S j x =
      S.Θ_gl
        ((x : ℂ) + ((((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℝ) : ℂ),
          (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ))
  θ_eq_stateTheta : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      oddSliceTheta S j.val y = stateTheta S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j
  θ_eq_gl_strip : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip S.s_star,
    oddSliceTheta S j y =
      S.Θ_gl
        (y + ((((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℝ) : ℂ),
          (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ))
  ℓ_num_holo : ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (oddSliceChordNum S j) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)))
  ℓ_num_periodic : ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S), ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    oddSliceChordNum S j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = oddSliceChordNum S j y
  ℓ_real : ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S), ∀ x : ℝ,
    oddSliceChordNum S j x /
      (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val x *
        sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) x) =
      (S.ℓ_chord (x + (j.val : ℝ) * sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S))
        (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ)
  reg_chord_vec_pt : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    (∀ k : Fin (oddSliceN S), sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) k.val y ≠ 0) →
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      slicePosSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 0 -
        slicePosSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y 0 =
        -(oddSliceChordNum S j y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y *
            sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)) *
          Complex.sin (oddSliceTheta S j.val y) ∧
      slicePosSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 1 -
        slicePosSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y 1 =
        (oddSliceChordNum S j y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y *
            sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)) *
          Complex.cos (oddSliceTheta S j.val y)
  reg_deriv_pos_pt : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    (∀ k : Fin (oddSliceN S), sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) k.val y ≠ 0) →
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      deriv (fun z => slicePosSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val z 0) y =
        -(S.c : ℂ) * (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y) *
          deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y ∧
      deriv (fun z => slicePosSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val z 1) y =
        (S.c : ℂ) * (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y) *
          deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y
  reg_deriv_support_pt : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    (∀ k : Fin (oddSliceN S), sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) k.val y ≠ 0) →
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      deriv (sliceSupportSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y =
        (-slicePosSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y 0 *
            Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y) +
          slicePosSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y 1 *
            Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)) *
        deriv (sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y
  pos_reconstruction_pt : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    (∀ k : Fin (oddSliceN S), sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) k.val y ≠ 0) →
    (∀ k : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      Complex.sin (oddSliceTheta S k.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) k.val y) ≠ 0) →
    ∀ B_ang B_sup : ℝ, 0 ≤ B_ang → 0 ≤ B_sup →
      (∀ k : Fin (oddSliceN S),
        ‖sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) k.val y‖ +
          |Real.log ‖Complex.sin
            (oddSliceTheta S k.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) k.val y)‖| ≤ B_ang) →
      (∀ k : Fin (oddSliceN S), ‖sliceSupportSeq S (oddSliceN S) k.val y‖ ≤ B_sup) →
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
        ‖slicePosSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y‖ ≤
          oddSliceCRec S * Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) * B_sup

structure OddSliceJacobiProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  Z_all_subset : oddSliceZAll S ⊆ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S))
  reg_open : IsOpen (horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S)
  real_not_mem_Z_all : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∉ oddSliceZAll S
  Z_all_periodic : ∀ y : ℂ, y ∈ oddSliceZAll S ↔ y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ oddSliceZAll S
  Z_all_compact_finite : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
    (oddSliceZAll S ∩
      { y : ℂ | y.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
        |y.im| ≤ sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - ε }).Finite
  reg_speed_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S), sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y ≠ 0
  reg_sin_d0_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      Complex.sin (oddSliceTheta S j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y) ≠ 0
  reg_chord_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      oddSliceChordNum S j y /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y *
          sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y) ≠ 0
  jacobi_null : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    (@jacobiH (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) S.c
      (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)
      (fun j => oddSliceTheta S j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)
      (fun j => oddSliceChordNum S j y /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y *
          sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
      (jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
        (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)
        (fun j => oddSliceTheta S j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)
        (fun j => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y)) = 0
  jacobi_M0_mulVec : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      2 * sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y *
        deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y =
        (@jacobiM0 (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S)
          (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i y /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y *
              sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
          (jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
            (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
            (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
            (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val) y)) j
  modified_det_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    ∀ I F : Finset (Fin (oddSliceN S)), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
      (@modifiedJacobiB (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
        (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
        (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y *
            sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
        I F).det ≠ 0
  cofactor_norm : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      (jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
        (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
        (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val) y) j) ^ 2 =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (oddSliceN S - 1) *
        (S.A (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) / (oddSliceN S : ℂ)) *
        (∏ i : Fin (oddSliceN S),
          (oddSliceChordNum S i y /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y *
              sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))) *
        (@modifiedJacobiB (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) S.c
          (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
          (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
          (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i y /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y *
              sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
          (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det
  cleared_cofactor_eq : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      ((S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) *
          deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y) ^ 2 *
        (∏ i : Fin (oddSliceN S), (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y i)) ^ 2) *
        (stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S y)) ^ (oddSliceN S) =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (oddSliceN S - 1) *
        (S.A (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) / (oddSliceN S : ℂ)) *
        (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y j)) ^ 4 *
        (∏ i : Fin (oddSliceN S), stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) i) *
        (stateClearedB S (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅ (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det

noncomputable def coneCurvEnvelope (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (L₀ C₁ C₂ K x₀ k : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (64 / Real.pi) *
    ∫ t in (-C₁ * Real.log (2 * K) - 2 : ℝ)..(C₂ + 5),
      ∫ τ in (-(60 * L₀ + 10) : ℝ)..(60 * L₀ + 10),
        Real.exp (-2 * (k + t)) *
          ‖S.q (upperRowPt S (k + t) (x₀ + Real.exp (-(k + t)) * τ))‖

structure StripAngleAndAmplitudeData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop where
  speed_amp_cap : ∃ C_f : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_f ∧ ∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H,
    ‖S.f s‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_f * (1 + max (-Real.log (S.H - |s.im|)) 0))
  odd_cycle_theta_bound : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    ‖P.θ_seq j.val y‖ ≤ (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi +
      (P.N : ℝ) * Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val y‖)
  odd_cycle_d0_bound : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    ‖P.d0 j y‖ ≤ (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi +
      ((P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val y‖)
  chord_upper_bound : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖ ≤ 4 * Real.exp ‖P.θ_seq j.val y‖ *
      (1 + Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val y‖))
  angle_strip_majorant : ∃ C_har : ℝ, 0 < C_har ∧ ∀ K : ℝ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ K →
    let H_K : ℝ := S.H - Real.exp (-K)
    ∃ (U_K : ℂ → ℝ) (B_UK : ℝ),
      0 ≤ B_UK ∧
      ContinuousOn U_K (horizStrip H_K) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ horizStrip H_K, ‖S.ϕ w - w‖ ^ 2 ≤ U_K w ∧ U_K w ≤ B_UK) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin P.N,
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), U_K (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val x)) ≤
          C_har * K ^ (2 * hBudget.ρ)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin P.N) (y₀ : ℂ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y₀ R,
          z ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) ∧
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val z ∈ horizStrip H_K) →
        Real.circleAverage (fun y => U_K (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y)) y₀ R =
          U_K (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y₀))

noncomputable def sliceRunningPosMax (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 + (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)⟩ fun l =>
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun k : Fin P.N =>
      ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (y_seq l)‖

open Classical in
noncomputable def sliceIsTiny (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (bG : ℝ) (j : Fin P.N) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) : ℕ → Bool
  | 0 => false
  | n + 1 =>
      if sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq n then
        decide (Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq (n + 1))‖ < -bG)
      else
        decide (Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq (n + 1))‖ ≤ -2 * bG)

open Classical in
noncomputable def sliceJointSwitches (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (bG : ℝ) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) (T : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((Finset.range T).filter fun n =>
    ∃ j : Fin P.N, sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq n ≠ sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq (n + 1)).card

open Classical in
noncomputable def sliceAngCutOK (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (r_star : ℝ) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : Bool :=
  decide (∀ l ≤ n, ∀ k : Fin P.N, ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val (y_seq l)‖ ≤ r_star)

noncomputable def sliceModPosMart (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (bG r_star : ℝ) (j : Fin P.N) (ι : Fin 2)
    (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) (m : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m,
    if sliceAngCutOK S P r_star y_seq n && !sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq n then
      slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq (n + 1)) ι - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq n) ι
    else 0

noncomputable def sliceTinySupMart (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (bG r_star : ℝ) (j : Fin P.N)
    (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) (m : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m,
    if sliceAngCutOK S P r_star y_seq n && sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq n then
      ((sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq n : ℂ))⁻¹ *
        (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq (n + 1)) - sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq n))
    else 0

noncomputable def slicePhaseDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  sliceHeight S P.N - |y.im|

noncomputable def bootRunningPosMax (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 + (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)⟩ fun l =>
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun k : Fin P.N =>
      ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (y_seq l)‖

noncomputable def bootEps0 (σ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - σ) / 4

noncomputable def bootGapEta (N : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  bootEps0 σ / (3 * ((N : ℝ) + 2))

noncomputable def bootGapXi (N : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (ν : Fin (N + 1)) : ℝ :=
  σ + bootEps0 σ / 3 + (2 * (ν.val : ℝ) + 1) * bootGapEta N σ

structure ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (x_star : ℝ) where
  δ_arc : ℝ
  δ_arc_pos : 0 < δ_arc
  δ_arc_lt_half_h : δ_arc < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) / 2
  s_ext : ℂ → Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ
  s_ext_holo : ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => s_ext y j)
      (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_arc)
  s_ext_in_strip :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_arc,
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S), s_ext y j ∈ horizStrip S.H
  s_ext_agrees :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_arc,
      y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) →
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S), s_ext y j = sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y
  s_ext_f_ne :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_arc,
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S), S.f (s_ext y j) ≠ 0
  s_ext_sin_ne :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_arc,
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S), Complex.sin (stateD0 S (s_ext y) j) ≠ 0
  s_ext_chord_ne :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_arc,
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S), stateChordNum S (s_ext y) j ≠ 0
  s_ext_deriv_ne :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_arc,
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S), deriv (fun z => s_ext z j) y ≠ 0

noncomputable def clearedReflectE (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let Km := holoScaledPos S s_m
  let K0 := holoScaledPos S s_0
  let Kp := holoScaledPos S s_p
  let fm := S.f s_m
  let f0 := S.f s_0
  let fp := S.f s_p
  let c0 := Complex.cos (S.ϕ s_0)
  let sn0 := Complex.sin (S.ϕ s_0)
  let dm0 := fm * K0 0 - f0 * Km 0
  let dm1 := fm * K0 1 - f0 * Km 1
  let dp0 := f0 * Kp 0 - fp * K0 0
  let dp1 := f0 * Kp 1 - fp * K0 1
  (dm0 * c0 + dm1 * sn0) * (-dp0 * sn0 + dp1 * c0) +
    (-dm0 * sn0 + dm1 * c0) * (dp0 * c0 + dp1 * sn0)

structure ReturnMapNormalFormData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  x_edge : ℝ
  ρ_0 : ℝ
  ρ_v : ℝ
  ρ_1 : ℝ
  ρ_v1 : ℝ
  ρ_s : ℝ
  ρ_bounds :
    0 < ρ_1 ∧ ρ_1 ≤ ρ_0 ∧ ρ_0 < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) / 2 ∧
    0 < ρ_v1 ∧ ρ_v1 ≤ ρ_v ∧ 0 < ρ_s
  s0_arc : ℂ → ℂ
  s1_arc : ℂ → ℂ
  s0_inv : ℂ → ℂ
  s0_arc_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s0_arc
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0)
  s1_arc_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s1_arc
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0)
  s0_arc_in_strip :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0,
      s0_arc u ∈ horizStrip S.H
  s0_inv_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s0_inv
      (Metric.ball (s0_arc ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ρ_s)
  s0_arc_left_inv :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_1,
      s0_arc u ∈
        Metric.ball
          (s0_arc ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ρ_s ∧
      s0_inv (s0_arc u) = u
  s0_inv_right_inv :
    ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball
        (s0_arc ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ρ_s,
      s0_inv w ∈
        Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ∧
      s0_arc (s0_inv w) = w
  F_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  F_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  σ : ℂ → ℂ
  A_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  B_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  A_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  B_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  F_plus_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F_plus
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v)
  F_minus_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F_minus
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v)
  σ_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ σ
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0)
  σ_ne_zero :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0,
      σ u ≠ 0
  rem_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ A_plus
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ B_plus
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ A_minus
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ B_minus
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v)
  F_plus_eq :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0,
      ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v,
        F_plus (u, v) =
          (u + σ u * v + v ^ 2 * A_plus (u, v),
           v - deriv σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * B_plus (u, v))
  F_minus_eq :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0,
      ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v,
        F_minus (u, v) =
          (u - σ u * v + v ^ 2 * A_minus (u, v),
           v + deriv σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * B_minus (u, v))
  F_mutual_inv :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_1,
      ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v1,
        F_plus (u, v) ∈
          Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v ∧
        F_minus (u, v) ∈
          Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v ∧
        F_minus (F_plus (u, v)) = (u, v) ∧
        F_plus (F_minus (u, v)) = (u, v)
  slice_at_t0 :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ρ_1 / 2),
      y.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      S.𝔰 (y, (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) = s0_arc y ∧
      S.𝔰 (y + (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) = s1_arc y
  chartV_deriv_t0 :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ρ_1 / 2),
      y.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      deriv (fun t => S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - s1_arc (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t))))
        (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) =
        (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (σ y)⁻¹
  subheight_tube_step :
    ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      ∃ r_μ : ℝ, 0 < r_μ ∧ r_μ < S.r_star - sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball
            ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ρ_1 / 2),
          y.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
          ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) r_μ,
            (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
            (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
            S.𝔰 (y, t) ∈
              Metric.ball
                (s0_arc ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ρ_s ∧
            (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)), S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - s1_arc (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))) ∈
              Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_1 ×ˢ
                Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v1 ∧
            (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) ∈
                Metric.ball
                  ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ρ_1 / 2) →
              (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ))).im <
                sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
              F_plus (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)), S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - s1_arc (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))) =
                (s0_inv
                  (S.𝔰 (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)), t)),
                 S.𝔰 (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) + t, t) -
                   s1_arc
                     (s0_inv
                       (S.𝔰
                         (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)),
                           t)))))

def steepCorridorSet (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (x_edge δ_cor r_steep : ℝ) :
    Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    |p.1.re - x_edge| < δ_cor ∧
    sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - 2 * δ_cor < p.1.im ∧
    p.1.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) + δ_cor / 2 ∧
    0 < ‖p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)‖ ∧
    ‖p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)‖ < r_steep ∧
    ‖p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)‖ / 3 <
      |(p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)).im| }

structure SteepSliceSectorData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  x_edge : ℝ
  δ_cor : ℝ
  r_steep : ℝ
  δ_cor_pos : 0 < δ_cor
  δ_cor_lt : δ_cor < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) / 4 ∧ δ_cor < S.s_star / 2
  r_steep_pos : 0 < r_steep
  r_steep_lt : r_steep < S.r_star - sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S)
  S_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  S_steep_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_steep (steepCorridorSet S x_edge δ_cor r_steep)
  S_steep_in_strip :
    ∀ p ∈ steepCorridorSet S x_edge δ_cor r_steep, S_steep p ∈ horizStrip S.H
  S_steep_agrees :
    ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      ∃ r_μ : ℝ, 0 < r_μ ∧ r_μ ≤ r_steep ∧
        ∀ p ∈ steepCorridorSet S x_edge δ_cor r_steep,
          p.1.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
          ‖p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)‖ < r_μ →
          S_steep p = S.𝔰 p

def phClkSetDependsUpTo (n : ℕ) (E : Set WalkSpace) : Prop :=
  MeasurableSet E ∧
    ∀ om₁ om₂ : WalkSpace, (∀ k ≤ n, om₁ k = om₂ k) → (om₁ ∈ E ↔ om₂ ∈ E)

noncomputable def phClkWallDist (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (sgn : ℝ) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  sliceHeight S P.N - sgn * y.im

noncomputable def phClkConcaveBarrier (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (sgn R : ℝ) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  phClkWallDist S P sgn y * (4 * R - phClkWallDist S P sgn y)

noncomputable def phClkConvexBarrier (h ε v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -Real.log (h + ε - v) - Real.log (h + ε + v) + 2 * Real.log (h + ε)

structure PhClkStepToolkitProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) : Prop where
  prob_walk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure
  walk_in_reg : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ n : ℕ,
    walkPos ρ om n ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all
  reg_phase_depth_pos_and_step : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    0 < slicePhaseDepth S P y ∧
    ρ y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * slicePhaseDepth S P y
  walkPos_depends : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om₁ om₂ : WalkSpace),
    (∀ l ≤ k, om₁ l = om₂ l) → walkPos ρ om₁ k = walkPos ρ om₂ k
  measurable_im : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => (walkPos ρ om k).im)
  measurable_rho : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => ρ (walkPos ρ om k))
  measurable_logDepth : ∀ (k : ℕ) (j : Fin P.N),
    Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceLogDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om k))
  measurable_geomCost : ∀ k : ℕ,
    Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om k))
  wall_linear_drift : ∀ (n : ℕ) (sgn : ℝ) (E : Set WalkSpace),
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → phClkSetDependsUpTo n E →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (E.indicator fun om : WalkSpace =>
        phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om n)) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, E.indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om n)) om ∂walkMeasure) = 0
  wall_concave_drift : ∀ (n : ℕ) (sgn R : ℝ) (E : Set WalkSpace),
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → phClkSetDependsUpTo n E →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (E.indicator fun om : WalkSpace =>
        phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R (walkPos ρ om n)) walkMeasure ∧
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (E.indicator fun om : WalkSpace => (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, E.indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R (walkPos ρ om n)) om ∂walkMeasure) =
      -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ om, E.indicator
        (fun om : WalkSpace => (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) om ∂walkMeasure
  masked_impact_l2 : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (E : ℕ → Set WalkSpace) (N_hor : ℕ),
    (∀ n : ℕ, phClkSetDependsUpTo n (E n)) →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
          (E n).indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
        (E n).indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) =
      ∫ om, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
        ‖(E n).indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) om‖ ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure
  imag_step_lower_drift : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (L q : ℂ → ℝ) (B_q : ℝ),
    ContinuousOn ψ (Set.Icc (-sliceHeight S P.N) (sliceHeight S P.N)) →
    Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => q (walkPos ρ om n)) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, 0 ≤ q y ∧ q y ≤ B_q) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ δ : ℝ, |δ| ≤ ρ y →
      L y * δ + 2 * q y * δ ^ 2 ≤ ψ (y.im + δ) - ψ y.im) →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ψ ((walkPos ρ om n).im)) walkMeasure ∧
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ψ ((walkPos ρ om (n + 1)).im)) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) ≤
      (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om (n + 1)).im) ∂walkMeasure) -
        (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om n).im) ∂walkMeasure)

def shcbWalkDependsOnPrefix {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (n : ℕ) (H : WalkSpace → α) : Prop :=
  ∃ h₀ : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → α,
    Measurable h₀ ∧ ∀ om : WalkSpace, H om = h₀ (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om)

def shcbWalkPrefixEvent (n : ℕ) (A : Set WalkSpace) : Prop :=
  ∃ S₀ : Set (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ),
    MeasurableSet S₀ ∧ A = Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) ⁻¹' S₀

structure ShcbWalkCircleStepToolkit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop where
  isProbWalk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure
  sliceHeight_bounds : S.s_star ≤ sliceHeight S P.N ∧ sliceHeight S P.N ≤ S.H
  impact_holo : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N))
  impact_maps_to : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N),
    sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y ∈ horizStrip S.H
  impact_real_im_zero : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ x : ℝ,
    (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (x : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧
    sliceShapeDepth S P j (x : ℂ) = S.H
  closedBall_in_reg : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ,
      walkPos ρ om m ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all ∧
      0 < ρ (walkPos ρ om m) ∧
      Metric.closedBall (walkPos ρ om m) (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ⊆
        horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all
  walkPos_measurable : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ m : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => walkPos ρ om m)
  prefix_of_measurable_reg : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] {f : ℂ → α},
      Measurable (Set.domRestrict (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) f) →
      ∀ m : ℕ, shcbWalkDependsOnPrefix m (fun om => f (walkPos ρ om m))
  eval_zero_integral : ∀ F : ℝ → ℝ, Measurable F → (∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |F x| ≤ B) →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om : WalkSpace => F (om 0)) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, F (om 0) ∂walkMeasure) =
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x
  step_pair_integral : ∀ {𝕜 : Type} [RCLike 𝕜] {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ},
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (H : WalkSpace → 𝕜) (K : ℂ → ℂ → 𝕜),
      shcbWalkDependsOnPrefix n H →
      (∃ B_H : ℝ, ∀ om : WalkSpace, ‖H om‖ ≤ B_H) →
      Measurable (Set.indicator
        ((horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) ×ˢ
          (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all))
        (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => K p.1 p.2)) →
      (∃ B_K : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y (ρ y), ‖K y z‖ ≤ B_K) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun om : WalkSpace => H om * K (walkPos ρ om n) (walkPos ρ om (n + 1))) walkMeasure ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun om : WalkSpace => H om * Real.circleAverage (K (walkPos ρ om n))
          (walkPos ρ om n) (ρ (walkPos ρ om n))) walkMeasure ∧
      (∫ om, H om * K (walkPos ρ om n) (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) ∂walkMeasure) =
        ∫ om, H om * Real.circleAverage (K (walkPos ρ om n))
          (walkPos ρ om n) (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ∂walkMeasure
  holo_circle_mean_and_var : ∀ {U : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} {r : ℝ},
    IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → 0 < r → Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ U →
    Real.circleAverage f y r = f y ∧
    Real.circleAverage (fun z => (f z).re) y r = (f y).re ∧
    Real.circleAverage (fun z => (f z).im) y r = (f y).im ∧
    Real.circleAverage (fun z => ‖f z - f y‖ ^ 2) y r =
      2 * Real.circleAverage (fun z => ((f z).im - (f y).im) ^ 2) y r ∧
    r ^ 2 * ‖deriv f y‖ ^ 2 ≤
      2 * Real.circleAverage (fun z => ((f z).im - (f y).im) ^ 2) y r

def ShcbFirstHitDomProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_hit : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ M d r_int : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ E : Set ℝ,
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    0 < d → d < S.H / 4 →
    100 * Real.exp (-M ^ 2) * d ≤ r_int →
    MeasurableSet E → (∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ E ↔ x + 2 * Real.pi ∈ E) →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d) ∧
      Set.Ioo
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos ρ om (sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om))).re - r_int)
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos ρ om (sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om))).re + r_int) ⊆
        E} ≤
    C_hit * MeasureTheory.volume.real (E ∩ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))

def ShcbRemainingClockTailProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_rem : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ M d B : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → 1 ≤ B → d * Real.exp (B / 4) < S.H / 4 →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      d ^ 2 * Real.exp B <
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om)
            (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
          ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2 *
            (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2} ≤
    C_rem * Real.exp (-B / 4)

def ShcbStoppedDisplacementProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop :=
  ∀ M d r_exit q_K : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ,
    ∀ (J : Finset (Fin P.N)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (i : Fin P.N),
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    i ∈ J → 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → 0 < r_exit → 0 < q_K →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ M d J hJ om)
          (sliceDiskExit S P ρ M d r_exit J hJ i om),
        (2 * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2 +
          Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) *
          (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2 ≤ q_K) ∧
      r_exit <
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos ρ om (sliceDiskExit S P ρ M d r_exit J hJ i om)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos ρ om (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ M d J hJ om))‖} ≤
    2 * q_K / r_exit ^ 2

noncomputable def arcS0 (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) {x_star : ℝ}
    (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star) (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  A.s_ext u ⟨0, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩

noncomputable def arcS1 (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) {x_star : ℝ}
    (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star) (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  A.s_ext u ⟨1, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩

structure ClearedReflectionArcProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (x_star : ℝ)
    (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star) : Prop where
  analytic_at_strip :
    ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_m ∈ horizStrip S.H → s_0 ∈ horizStrip S.H → s_p ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      AnalyticAt ℂ (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => clearedReflectE S p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
        ((s_m, s_0), s_p)
  periodic_m :
    ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_m ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      clearedReflectE S (s_m + 2 * Real.pi) s_0 s_p = clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 s_p
  periodic_0 :
    ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_0 ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      clearedReflectE S s_m (s_0 + 2 * Real.pi) s_p = clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 s_p
  periodic_p :
    ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_p ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 (s_p + 2 * Real.pi) = clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 s_p
  subheight_tube_vanish :
    ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      ∃ r_tube : ℝ, 0 < r_tube ∧ r_tube < S.r_star - sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) ∧
        ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ),
          ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) r_tube,
            (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ oddSliceN S + 1 →
              (y + (k : ℂ) * t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X) ∧
            (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ oddSliceN S →
              clearedReflectE S
                (S.𝔰 (y + ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t, t))
                (S.𝔰 (y + (k : ℂ) * t, t))
                (S.𝔰 (y + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t, t)) = 0)
  arc_vanish :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) A.δ_arc,
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
        clearedReflectE S
          (A.s_ext y (@cycPrev (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j))
          (A.s_ext y j)
          (A.s_ext y (@cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j)) = 0
  arc_partials_ne_zero :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) A.δ_arc,
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
        deriv
          (fun z =>
            clearedReflectE S
              (A.s_ext y (@cycPrev (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j))
              (A.s_ext y j) z)
          (A.s_ext y (@cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j)) ≠ 0 ∧
        deriv
          (fun w =>
            clearedReflectE S w
              (A.s_ext y j)
              (A.s_ext y (@cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j)))
          (A.s_ext y (@cycPrev (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j)) ≠ 0

structure ConjugatedReturnMapArcData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (x_star : ℝ)
    (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star) where
  δ_0 : ℝ
  δ_v0 : ℝ
  δ_1 : ℝ
  δ_v1 : ℝ
  δ_bounds : 0 < δ_1 ∧ δ_1 < δ_0 ∧ δ_0 ≤ A.δ_arc ∧ 0 < δ_v1 ∧ δ_v1 < δ_v0
  s0_inv : ℂ → ℂ
  s0_arc_open_map :
    ∀ U : Set ℂ, IsOpen U →
      U ⊆ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 →
      IsOpen (arcS0 S A '' U)
  s0_inv_holo_on_image :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s0_inv
      (arcS0 S A ''
        Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0)
  s0_left_inv :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0,
      s0_inv (arcS0 S A u) = u
  F_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  F_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  F_plus_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F_plus
      (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0)
  F_minus_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F_minus
      (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0)
  F_plus_zero :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0,
      F_plus (u, 0) = (u, 0)
  F_minus_zero :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0,
      F_minus (u, 0) = (u, 0)
  F_mutual_inv :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_1,
      ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v1,
        F_plus (u, v) ∈
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0 ∧
        F_minus (u, v) ∈
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0 ∧
        F_minus (F_plus (u, v)) = (u, v) ∧
        F_plus (F_minus (u, v)) = (u, v)
  arc_slice_at_t0 :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0,
      y.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      S.𝔰 (y, (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) = arcS0 S A y ∧
      S.𝔰 (y + (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) =
        arcS1 S A y
  arc_subheight_step :
    ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      ∃ r_μ : ℝ, 0 < r_μ ∧ r_μ < S.r_star - sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball
            ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_1),
          y.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
          ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) r_μ,
            (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
            (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
            S.𝔰 (y, t) ∈
              arcS0 S A ''
                Metric.ball
                  ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ∧
            (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)), S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - arcS1 S A (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))) ∈
              Metric.ball
                ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_1 ×ˢ
                Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v1 ∧
            (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) ∈
                Metric.ball
                  ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
                  ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_1) →
              (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ))).im <
                sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
              F_plus
                (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)),
                 S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - arcS1 S A (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))) =
                (s0_inv
                  (S.𝔰 (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)), t)),
                 S.𝔰
                   (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) + t, t) -
                   arcS1 S A
                     (s0_inv
                       (S.𝔰
                         (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)),
                           t)))))

structure ConjugacyNormalFormExpansion (y_star : ℂ) (δ_0 δ_v1 : ℝ)
    (F_plus F_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) where
  ρ_v : ℝ
  ρ_v_pos : 0 < ρ_v
  ρ_v_le : ρ_v ≤ δ_v1
  σ : ℂ → ℂ
  A_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  B_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  A_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  B_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  σ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ σ (Metric.ball y_star δ_0)
  σ_nonzero_exists : ∃ y_sub ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, σ y_sub ≠ 0
  rem_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ A_plus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ B_plus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ A_minus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ B_minus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v)
  F_plus_eq :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v,
      F_plus (u, v) =
        (u + σ u * v + v ^ 2 * A_plus (u, v),
         v - deriv σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * B_plus (u, v))
  F_minus_eq :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v,
      F_minus (u, v) =
        (u - σ u * v + v ^ 2 * A_minus (u, v),
         v + deriv σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * B_minus (u, v))
